jobs.title: Consumer Support Professionals: Questionnaire on Administrative Workarounds
jobs.excerpt: What We're ResearchingWe're running a paid study on the everyday administrative hurdles that consumers encounter.
jobs.description:
What We're Researching

We're running a paid study on the everyday administrative hurdles that consumers encounter. We want to understand the common problems people face, how they attempt to resolve them, and the hidden costs involved in these workarounds. Your insights will help identify areas where new software or services could alleviate these burdens.

How It Works

You will complete an independent, eight-question written survey. The questionnaire asks you to describe a recent, anonymous example of a consumer problem you observed. You will provide estimates on the frequency of the issue, associated costs, and potential limits for new software solutions. The entire task is conducted asynchronously through our secure online platform.

Who This Is For

We are looking for adults with recent, direct experience helping consumers navigate administrative tasks. We welcome customer support professionals, social workers, administrative assistants, and dedicated volunteers. Candidates should be comfortable distinguishing observed facts from estimates and providing constructive feedback on potential software solutions.

What You'll Do

  • Complete an eight-question written survey about consumer administrative problems.

  • Describe a recent, anonymous example of a recurring issue you have observed.

  • Estimate the time, financial cost, and frequency of current workarounds.

  • Identify professional, legal, or privacy limits that a new software tool would need to respect.

Who Should Apply

  • Recent professional or volunteer experience assisting consumers with administrative tasks.

  • Ability to clearly distinguish between observed facts and estimates.

  • Comfortable providing detailed written responses independently.

  • Commitment to maintaining consumer privacy by omitting identifying details.

Compensation

$11 one-time

Start your paid interview now

Terac is building the world's largest pool of vetted human experts for AI. Researchers, AI labs, and product teams use Terac to recruit, screen, and pay study participants across industries, languages, and skill sets.

jobs.title: Head of Security
jobs.excerpt: About Hashgraph:Hashgraph is a fast-growing software company committed to supporting, developing and servicing Hedera, an open source, proof-of-stake platform.
jobs.description:
About Hashgraph:

Hashgraph is a fast-growing software company committed to supporting, developing and servicing Hedera, an open source, proof-of-stake platform. Hedera is EVM-compatible and has been specifically built to meet the needs of enterprise and web3 applications, which require speed, security, stability and sustainability. Hedera’s public network is governed by industry-leading organizations, spanning 11 sectors and 14 regions who oversee the development and direction of the decentralized platform.

Why this role exists:

We are hiring a Head of Security to help advance our mission by building the security function for a digital asset trading platform that operates as its own business unit, alongside an established security organization that provides shared services and standards. The work includes setting up the governance that regulators and institutional partners will trust.

This role exists to ensure that user funds and platform infrastructure are protected, and that the governance around them earns the trust of regulators and institutional partners.

In this role, you will:

  • Set the security strategy and own the policy framework and risk management program for the business unit, with right-sized governance around them, including escalation paths, risk registers, risk acceptance and exception processes, and a metrics-driven reporting cadence for executives and external stakeholders. You will be the accountable owner for the business unit’s security posture.

  • Decide which certifications, attestations, and regulatory frameworks the business needs, then carry the chosen ones through to completion. You will also align the program with regulatory requirements in the jurisdictions the business operates in, manage third-party and vendor risk, and serve as the primary security contact for regulators, auditors, institutional partners, and banking counterparties.

  • Custody, wallet infrastructure, key management, and hot, warm, and cold wallet operations fall under your oversight.

  • Govern smart contract security through audit requirements, bug bounty programs, and secure release gates. You will make sure the architecture behind trading, matching, settlement, and withdrawal flows is secure, and drive secure SDLC, vulnerability management, and application security practices.

  • Own security monitoring and incident response, including crisis playbooks for exploits, key compromise, and market-impacting events. You will run tabletop exercises, red team engagements, and penetration testing, coordinate with legal, compliance, communications, and executive leadership when an incident requires regulatory notification or public disclosure, and oversee business continuity and disaster recovery planning as it relates to security.

  • Lead a small security function that combines direct execution with tooling, partners, and shared services, and manage the security budget, tooling strategy, and vendor relationships. You will partner with engineering, product, legal, and finance to embed security into how the company builds and operates, and define how the function should grow, hiring selectively as the business scales.

What success looks like in 6-12 months:

  • A right-sized governance framework is operating, with a risk register, an exception process, defined ownership, metrics reported to the business unit’s leadership, and clear escalation.

  • The certifications, attestations, and regulatory frameworks the business needs have been determined, and the path to them has been delivered with clean outcomes.

  • Incident playbooks for key compromise, exploits, and market-impacting events are written, and the team has worked through at least one tabletop exercise.

  • A staffing plan for the function is in place, setting out what to hire and what to draw from shared services, sequenced to risk and business growth.

What you bring:

Core capabilities:

  • Judgment to decide which frameworks and certifications are warranted for a given stage and market.

  • Practical judgment about what a lean function should build itself and what it should draw from shared services, tooling, and partners.

  • Technical judgment balanced with program-level governance, in a senior, hands-on role with direct visibility to executive leadership.

  • Comfort working in a lean team and a matrixed environment.

  • The ability to communicate clearly with engineers, executives, regulators, and auditors.

Functional expertise:

  • 10+ years in information security, including 5+ years in senior security leadership.

  • Direct security leadership experience at a centralized exchange (CEX), decentralized exchange (DEX), or comparable digital asset trading or custody platform, including leading incident response through a material security event.

  • A track record designing and running security governance programs covering policy, risk, audit, and executive reporting, and building or operating compliance and assurance programs.

  • Strong understanding of crypto-native threats, including private key compromise, smart contract exploits, oracle and bridge attacks, front-end and supply chain compromise, insider risk, and social engineering.

  • Working knowledge of key management and custody models (HSM, MPC, multisig) and blockchain protocol fundamentals.

Preferred skills and experience:

  • Regulatory engagement across multiple jurisdictions (US, EU, UAE, APAC).

  • Background in smart contract security, DeFi protocol risk, or on-chain monitoring and forensics.

  • Experience standing up a security function inside a newer or fast-scaling business unit.

  • Familiarity with DevSecOps and application security posture management.

  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, or CCSP.

  • Contributions to industry standards bodies, ISACs, or open security communities.

jobs.excerpt: The IT Integration Engineer integrates newly acquired firms into Trilon's enterprise IT environment.
jobs.description:
The IT Integration Engineer integrates newly acquired firms into Trilon's enterprise IT environment. The role executes Microsoft 365 and Entra ID integrations and Active Directory consolidation while managing assigned IT integration projects.
Reporting to the Director of IT Integrations, who owns the overall process and provides project oversight, this role works alongside the Senior Integration Engineer and other Integration Engineers. The Senior Integration Engineer provides technical guidance, owns technical tools and processes, and participates in execution. Engineers own assigned workstreams and maintain the knowledge to cover all aspects of an integration.
Strong Microsoft infrastructure fundamentals and practical troubleshooting skills are essential. Candidates with strong relevant experience can develop migration and project management expertise with the team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage assigned integration projects with Director oversight and Senior Integration Engineer guidance. Coordinate plans, schedules, risks, dependencies, status reporting, and weekly calls across Security, Infrastructure, Production Technology, and Strategy and Portfolio Management until all functional units complete their required tasks.
  • Conduct technical discovery, document systems and dependencies, and recommend mappings for users, domains, groups, and data into Trilon's environment. Develop migration approaches and necessary technical solutions with the Senior Integration Engineer and responsible teams.
  • Execute Microsoft 365 migrations, including Exchange Online, SharePoint, and Teams, Entra ID integrations, and Active Directory consolidation using established standards and runbooks. Own assigned workstreams while maintaining the knowledge and flexibility to cover all integration activities.
  • Troubleshoot identity, mail flow, DNS, and related dependencies; modify existing PowerShell scripts and Microsoft Graph requests to resolve time-sensitive migration issues. Assist with software deployments through Group Policy, ScreenConnect, Intune, or other delivery methods as needed.
  • Complete migration readiness checks, identify risks, establish recovery or rollback plans, and participate in collective team go/no-go decisions. Validate data, access, mail flow, and service functionality after cutover, resolving issues and documenting results.
  • Coordinate the transition from legacy support workflows to Trilon's support processes at tenant migration. Work closely with the business, Service Delivery, Helpdesk, and Field Support through stabilization to address gaps, clarify ownership, communicate changes, and provide training or onsite assistance as needed.
  • Assess legacy systems and dependencies, recommend retention, consolidation, or retirement, and develop retirement plans with responsible teams. When assigned, take ownership of completing those plans across IT infrastructure and cloud systems.
  • Maintain technical documentation, apply enterprise security standards, and coordinate exceptions with responsible teams. Improve runbooks, tools, and automation with the Senior Integration Engineer; contribute to infrastructure modernization, operational initiatives, troubleshooting, and escalations when not actively executing integrations.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Relevant infrastructure engineering, systems administration, or IT integration experience, typically five or more years, or equivalent demonstrated technical capability.
  • Strong understanding of Active Directory, Entra ID, and hybrid identity, including authentication, access, and dependencies across connected systems.
  • Hands-on Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online administration experience, with a solid understanding of mail flow, DNS, and related troubleshooting.
  • Ability to read, understand, modify, and troubleshoot existing PowerShell scripts and Microsoft Graph requests used to administer Microsoft 365 and Entra ID.
  • Ability to diagnose unfamiliar issues, adapt established tools and scripts, and apply sound technical judgment during time-sensitive migrations.
  • Strong organization, documentation, and project coordination skills, including tracking schedules, dependencies, risks, and commitments across teams and explaining technical requirements and recommendations to business leaders.

About Trilon

Trilon was formed with the vision of building the next Top 20 infrastructure consulting firm in North America by bringing together some of the nation’s best infrastructure consulting firms, focused on delivering practical and sustainable infrastructure solutions. Trilon is backed by Alpine Investors, a PeopleFirst Private Equity Firm. Trilon currently comprises 5,500+ staff across the US. For more information, visit www.trilon.com.

Pay Transparency
The base salary range for this role is indicated in the posting. This range reflects the company’s good faith estimate of the compensation for this position at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location.

About BukuWarung

BukuWarung is building the digital and financial infrastructure for millions of underserved merchants.

We operate at the intersection of payments, credit, software, and commerce. As we scale toward serving 1M+ merchants, our engineering organization must evolve from fast-moving startup to disciplined, high-scale platform company, without losing speed.

We are looking for an Engineering Manager who still thinks like a builder.

Own a squad end-to-end. Drive execution without sacrificing architecture. Raise the bar on both velocity and engineering depth.

  • Lead a cross-functional squad (engineering + product alignment)

  • Translate business outcomes into strong technical execution plans

  • Drive realistic commitments and intelligent pushback when needed

  • Ensure system design rigor before implementation

This role is for someone who wants to build both systems and people.

If you have hunger, care about craftsmanship, and want to build infrastructure that impacts millions, this role is for you.

Build What Matters at RevStar

Position: Solutions Architect

  • Reports To: CEO
  • Location: Remote
  • Employment Type: Full-Time W2 (US-Based) / 1099 (DE, ES)

Job Summary

Are you an expert AWS architect who loves running pre-sales discovery, designing cutting-edge GenAI/data platforms, and scoping cloud migrations—without the burden of carrying a sales quota? RevStar is an AI-first innovation shop and AWS Advanced Tier Partner building transformative cloud solutions for enterprise clients. We are seeking a customer-focused Solutions Architect to serve as our primary technical authority during the pre-sales lifecycle. Partnering directly with Account Executives and AWS field teams, you will validate use cases, architect Bedrock/SageMaker pipelines, build migration strategies, and calculate AWS cost models to accelerate deal velocity. Above all, the ideal candidate embodies RevStar’s core values:

  • Self-Mastery: We hold a high bar for how we think, communicate, and improve.
  • Ownership: We own outcomes, not just effort.
  • Shared Destiny: We rise or fall together.

Your Impact Pillars

Your technical leadership is organized into four core strategic pillars:

1. Pre-Sales Discovery & Customer Engagement

  • Lead technical discovery sessions to uncover customer requirements, existing infrastructure constraints, and modernization goals.
  • Serve as the trusted technical authority in client meetings, articulating architectural tradeoffs across AWS GenAI, data, and cloud migrations.
  • Partner with Account Executives on AWS co-sell motions to validate technical fit, scope use cases, and build client trust.

2. Modern Architecture & Migration Strategy

  • Design Well-Architected AWS reference diagrams covering GenAI (Bedrock, SageMaker, RAG, agentic workflows) and modern data platforms.
  • Define cloud migration and database modernization strategies (RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB) using rehost, replatform, or refactor frameworks.
  • Evaluate implementation risks, application sequencing, and security/compliance standards (HIPAA, SOC2).

3. SOW Development & AWS Pricing

  • Build accurate AWS cost estimates utilizing the AWS Pricing Calculator to highlight optimization opportunities early.
  • Draft technical scopes, implementation timelines, and delivery assumptions for Statements of Work (SOWs) and client proposals.
  • Provide technical inputs required for AWS funding programs (PoCs, MAP credits) alongside Account Executives.

4. Handoff & Delivery Alignment

  • Collaborate with internal engineering teams prior to deal close to ensure solution feasibility and delivery alignment.
  • Conduct seamless technical handoffs to delivery teams with fully documented architectures, migration assumptions, and risk logs.

Requirements

What You Bring

  • Experience: 5+ years in a Solutions Architect, Pre-Sales Consultant, or Cloud Architect role within a consulting environment.
  • AWS Mastery: Deep expertise across AWS services, specifically AI/ML (Bedrock, SageMaker), data platforms (Redshift, Glue), and migration services.
  • Presales Capabilities: Proven ability to build SOWs, calculate AWS pricing models, and communicate complex architectural tradeoffs to executive stakeholders.
  • Certifications (Preferred): Active AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Professional) or AWS Machine Learning Specialty.

Benefits

Benefits for Full-Time W2 Positions:

  • Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and stay productive.
  • Remote-First Working Environment – Collaborate from anywhere while staying connected with our global team.
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage – Medical, Dental, Vision
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan – Plan for your future with access to a company-sponsored 401(k) program.
  • Annual Learning & Development Stipend – Invest in your skills with conferences, certifications, or courses.
  • Peer Mentorship & Coaching – Learn from experienced engineers, product managers, and architects to accelerate your growth.
  • Professional Growth Opportunities – Exposure to cutting-edge AWS GenAI, data, and cloud technologies across diverse industries.
  • Company Outings & Volunteer Opportunities – Build relationships and give back to the community.
  • Collaborative, Innovative Culture – Work alongside top talent in a fast-paced, supportive environment that values curiosity and initiative.

Description

We are seeking an exceptional Director, Product Owner (DPO) to lead the Digital Online Sales Product Owner team within Direct Distribution, a critical growth engine for Liberty Mutual.

jobs.description:
Expected Travel: None

Requisition ID: 14577

Ingenyx proudly launched as a new, independent company following its divestiture from Teleflex on August 3, 2026.

Ingenyx is a leading global provider of product development and production services for medical device manufacturers. We set ourselves apart with deep expertise, decades of experience, a dedication to design for manufacturability, and extensive, in-house capabilities, which include engineering, regulatory services, material selection and formulation, prototyping, manufacturing, assembly and packaging. We deliver industry-changing innovations and next-generation solutions for extrusions; diagnostic and interventional catheters; balloons and balloon catheters; sheath/dilator sets; specialty sutures, braids and fibers; and bioabsorbable sutures, yarns and resins. Join a dynamic, growing team that offers healthcare providers an array of medical technology solutions that make a difference in patients’ lives.

For more information, please visit

Position Summary

We are seeking a Quality Systems & Digital Quality Engineer to support the digital transformation, validation, administration, and continuous improvement of Quality Management System (QMS) technologies and applications across a global medical device organization.

Reporting to the Quality Systems Manager, this role serves as the Quality functional and technical liaison between Quality process owners, IT, business stakeholders, and software vendors. The position is responsible for Computer System Validation/Computer Software Assurance (CSV/CSA), digital Quality workflows, Quality data and analytics, and ongoing lifecycle management of computerized Quality systems.
The role will help ensure Quality applications are compliant, effective, appropriately validated, and designed to support efficient and standardized Quality processes.

**Candidates must be based remotely in the US, with a strong preference for Eastern and Central Time Zones**

Principal Responsibilities

CSV / Computer Software Assurance – Approximately 30%
•Own CSV/CSA activities for eQMS platforms, ERP Quality functionality, and other computerized applications supporting Quality processes.
•Develop risk-based validation strategies appropriate to the system's intended use, functionality, and potential impact on product quality and patient safety.
•Develop, review, and maintain validation documentation, including requirements, risk assessments, validation plans, test protocols/scripts, traceability, deviations, and validation summary documentation.
•Coordinate and execute testing for new systems, configurations, integrations, enhancements, upgrades, and significant changes.
•Ensure business and Quality requirements are appropriately traced to testing and release documentation.
•Assess computerized system changes for validation impact and determine appropriate testing and documentation requirements.
•Maintain systems in a validated state throughout their lifecycle.
•Support investigation and resolution of validation deviations and system-related quality issues.
•Apply risk-based CSA principles to streamline validation activities while maintaining appropriate compliance and objective evidence.
•Support audit and regulatory inspection readiness for computerized system validation records.

QMS Technology & Digitalization – Approximately 30%
•Serve as a Quality functional SME and super-user for eQMS, ERP Quality modules, and other Quality applications.
•Partner with Quality process owners to translate business and regulatory requirements into effective digital workflows and system requirements.
•Support configuration, implementation, testing, deployment, and enhancement of Quality system functionality.
•Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate Quality processes.
•Support conversion of manual, paper-based, or spreadsheet-driven Quality processes into controlled electronic workflows.
•Develop process maps, functional requirements, user requirements, and workflow designs for Quality applications.
•Support integration between Quality applications and ERP, document management, training, manufacturing, supplier, and other business systems.
•Partner with IT and software vendors to troubleshoot system issues and coordinate enhancements.
•Support user acceptance testing and deployment of new or revised functionality.
•Develop and maintain user guides, work instructions, and system/process documentation.
•Support training and adoption of new digital Quality processes and tools.

Quality Data & Analytics – Approximately 20%
•Develop and maintain Quality metrics, dashboards, and reporting tools.
•Analyze Quality data to identify trends, risks, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities.
•Support reporting and trending for CAPA, nonconformance, complaints, audits, suppliers, inspection, training, and other Quality processes.
•Partner with process owners to establish meaningful KPIs and measures of process effectiveness.
•Improve standardization, consistency, and integrity of Quality data across systems.
•Identify opportunities to automate recurring Quality reports and reduce manual data manipulation.
•Support Quality Management Review and leadership reporting.
•Perform data analysis to support continuous improvement, CAPA, project activities, and Quality objectives.
•Support development of data visualization and reporting capabilities that enable timely, risk-based decision-making.

Principal Responsibilities Continued

System Lifecycle & Continuous Improvement – Approximately 20%
•Maintain or support the inventory of computerized systems used within the Quality organization.
•Maintain system information, including intended use, ownership, Quality/regulatory impact, validation status, interfaces, and lifecycle status.
•Coordinate periodic reviews of validated Quality systems.
•Support system and change impact assessments.
•Support Quality aspects of user access, roles, permissions, and periodic access reviews in partnership with IT and system owners.
•Support vendor assessments and ongoing oversight of third-party Quality system providers.
•Support data migration, system upgrades, system retirement, archival, and record retention activities.
•Monitor system performance and identify opportunities for improved usability, efficiency, compliance, and standardization.
•Support investigation and remediation of system-related audit findings, data integrity concerns, and compliance gaps.
•Promote standardized digital Quality processes and sharing of best practices across sites and functions.

Compliance & Governance

  • Support compliance with applicable Quality System, electronic record, electronic signature, and computerized system requirements.
    •Support compliance with 21 CFR Part 11, FDA QMSR, ISO 13485, and applicable internal procedures.
    •Apply data integrity principles throughout the computerized system lifecycle.
    •Maintain validation and system lifecycle documentation in an audit- and inspection-ready state.
    •Support internal audits, customer audits, and regulatory inspections involving Quality computerized systems.
    •Partner with Quality Systems, IT, and process owners to maintain appropriate controls for electronic records, electronic signatures, audit trails, security, access, backup, recovery, and data retention.
    •Support development and continuous improvement of CSV/CSA, digital Quality, data governance, and system lifecycle procedures and practices.

Education / Experience Requirements

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Quality, Life Sciences, Data Analytics, or a related technical discipline.
    • 3+ years of experience in Quality Systems, Quality Engineering, computerized system validation, digital Quality, business systems, or a related function within a regulated industry.
    • Working knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11, FDA QMSR, and ISO 13485.
    • Familiarity with Computer Software Assurance (CSA), CSV, GAMP 5, and risk-based validation principles.
    • Experience supporting computerized systems within a Quality or regulated environment.
    • Experience with system requirements, testing, validation, change control, or system implementation.
    • Working knowledge of Quality Management Systems and regulated business processes.
    • Strong analytical skills with experience analyzing and presenting Quality or operational data.
    • Ability to translate business and Quality requirements into system requirements and practical solutions.
    • Strong technical writing, documentation, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
    • Ability to work effectively across Quality, IT, Operations, business functions, and external vendors.

Preferred

• Medical device industry experience.

  • Experience with eQMS and/or ERP Quality functionality.
    • Experience with CAPA, nonconformance, document control, training, audit, supplier quality, complaint, or change management applications.
    • Experience developing Quality dashboards, metrics, automated reporting, or data visualization.
    • Experience with cloud/SaaS applications and vendor-managed systems.
    • Familiarity with data integrity, electronic records, electronic signatures, audit trails, and computerized system lifecycle management.
    • Experience supporting regulatory inspections or customer audits involving computerized systems.

Specialized Skills / Other Requirements

jobs.title: Senior Architect, Corporate Systems
jobs.excerpt: Overview: Our Culture and ImpactCvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 34,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500.
jobs.description:
Overview:

Our Culture and Impact

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 34,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

Corporate Systems is Cvent’s internal business application platform, responsible for designing, building, and operating the systems that power how revenue is captured, cash moves, people are supported, and data flows across the company. Our core corporate system platforms include Salesforce (Sales, Service, CPQ, Experience Cloud), Oracle EBS, Snowflake, Informatica, Sigma, UiPath, Coupa, Concur, Certinia, and Intellievent, along with adjacencies such as HighRadius, Kyriba, Safebooks.AI, Marketo, 6sense, Gainsight, Staircase, Chorus, Gong, Nice InContact, and ZoomInfo. We operate nine sub-functions and run simultaneous transformation programs — and as a serial acquirer, maintain a consistent, scalable playbook for Post-Merger System Integration (PMI) — each with direct impact on revenue, customer experience, and financial integrity.

We are hiring a Corporate Systems Architect to provide the architectural leadership this complexity demands — setting the standards, patterns, and technical direction that enable our teams and partners to design, build, and scale with consistency and confidence across our application estate, data landscape, and AI capabilities.


In This Role, You Will:

Define and steward enterprise architecture

  • Own the target-state architecture across our core corporate system platforms — Salesforce (Sales, Service, CPQ, Experience Cloud), Oracle EBS, Snowflake, Informatica, Sigma, UiPath, Coupa, Concur, Certinia, and Intellievent, along with adjacencies such as HighRadius, Kyriba, Safebooks.AI, Marketo, 6sense, Gainsight, Staircase, Chorus, Gong, Nice InContact, and ZoomInfo — ensuring a coherent, well-governed, and future-ready platform estate.
  • Establish Cvent’s architectural paved road — reusable reference patterns across experience, integration, data, AI, and security that empower delivery teams and partners to design and scale with confidence. Define data contracts, cross-system impact assessment, and how quality and resilience are built in as enduring principles.

Lead AI architecture and the agentic framework

  • Own the AI orchestration and agentic framework — connecting Agentforce agents, Snowflake Cortex models, semantic layers, and business rules into a governed, production-ready ecosystem across the enterprise application estate.
  • Architect AI-enabled solutions across the Lead-to-Cash lifecycle — including Agentforce Account Summary and Next Best Action, conversational analytics agents, PS intelligent automation, and AI-driven financial governance — with data privacy and responsible AI governance embedded from the outset in partnership with the AI Governance Council and the broader IT organization including InfoSec.

Shape Lead-to-Cash architecture across PLG, SLG, and M&A

  • Own the end-to-end Lead-to-Cash architecture — how leads are qualified and progressed, commercial terms configured, and orders, subscriptions, overages, and revenue flows modelled and governed across Salesforce CPQ, Oracle EBS, Stripe/Chargebee, Snowflake, and Gainsight — underpinning revenue integrity and financial reporting.
  • Architect PLG and SLG convergence for acquired organizations as we execute PMI — delivering repeatable, documented approaches that accelerate time-to-value with each acquisition.

Own data and integration architecture with Data Governance

  • Define master data architecture for Accounts, Contacts, Subscriptions, Contracts, Products, and Financials — establishing systems of record and data contracts across Salesforce, EBS, CVII, Marketo, and Snowflake. Partner closely with the Data Governance function to embed quality, stewardship, and lineage into platform design from the outset.
  • Set integration design standards governing pipeline architecture, schema change management, resilience patterns, and entitlement management. Collaborate with Analytics and CloudOps to advance Snowflake as the enterprise intelligence platform for analytics, BI, and AI workloads.

Lead governance, provide the architecture framework, and build the community

  • Serve as architecture owner for transformation programs across Corporate Systems and Cvent, the overall AI portfolio, and M&A — providing the architecture framework of standards, patterns, review processes, and decision criteria that enables architects across CRM, Oracle, Snowflake, and integration domains to operate with autonomy and scale their work.
  • Drive design review (ARB) across teams and external partners. Act as trusted advisor to VP IT, CIO, and business leaders. Work closely with architects already embedded across CRM, Oracle, and Snowflake environments — co-owning direction, raising collective standards, and contributing to talent strategy as the architecture community grows.

Here's What You Need:

  • 15–20+ years in enterprise or corporate systems architecture, owning large-scale CRM, ERP, and data platform transformations in complex, global B2B environments.
  • Deep, hands-on Salesforce expertise: Sales, Service, CPQ, Experience Cloud — Apex, integration patterns, security model, org design, and Agentforce configuration and governance.
  • Solid Oracle EBS knowledge: GL, AR/AP, billing and revenue flows, and the patterns connecting Salesforce commercial data to EBS invoicing, revenue recognition, and financial controls.
  • Meaningful Snowflake architecture experience — schema design, semantic and data contract layers, Cortex and AI capabilities, and how DWH design choices shape analytics and AI workloads.
  • Integration and MDM depth with Informatica or comparable platforms (MuleSoft, Boomi, Tray) and a strong understanding of resilient, observable pipeline architecture across complex application landscapes.
  • Practical experience designing agentic architectures — LLM grounding and retrieval, multi-agent orchestration, human-in-the-loop design, and governance frameworks that scale across an enterprise.
  • The ability to build architecture frameworks that enable distributed teams to make consistent, high-quality design decisions — and to communicate trade-offs clearly to Finance, CS, and RevOps leaders.
  • Proven Senior Director track record owning cross-functional programs and influencing senior stakeholders. Salesforce Architect certifications strongly preferred. Snowflake, Oracle EBS, TOGAF a plus.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (12–24 MONTHS):

  • A North Star architecture for Corporate Systems — spanning transformation programs, Lead-to-Cash, the AI portfolio, and M&A — actively used as the authoritative reference by delivery teams and partners.
  • An architecture framework in place that enables architects across CRM, Oracle, Snowflake, and integration domains to make consistent, high-quality design decisions independently and at scale.
  • A governed AI and agentic architecture with high-impact solutions in production across the Lead-to-Cash lifecycle, with clear data contracts, observable behavior, and measurable business outcomes.
  • A Corporate Systems architecture community recognized for technical depth, shared design culture, and a consistently high standard of quality across all sub-functions and programs.

If we learn during the course of our recruitment process that, due to an applicant’s location, further information about the position is required, including certain salary information, this information in this posting will be supplemented accordingly.

Reference: NOWH

Spændende mulighed for dansktalende

Vil du gerne bo i en varm og solrig kystby med et pulserende natteliv, smukke parker og hyggelige caféer, hvor du kan være sammen med venner og skabe varige minder? Eller vil du bo i de sneklædte bjerge og stå på ski før og efter arbejde? Eller måske begge dele?

Med de nyetablerede juridiske EU-love i cyberbranchen søger vi nu en dansktalende forretningsudvikler til den juridiske tech-branche. Stillingen kan udføres hvor som helst i verden inden for en passende tidszone.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Arbejd helt eksternt, hvor du vil!

  • Forbedre dine kommunikations- og salgsevner

  • Arbejde fuldtid fra mandag til fredag og opretholde en sund balance mellem arbejde og privatliv.

  • Udviklingsmuligheder (AE eller teamlead)

  • Præstationsbonusser

Om virksomheden:

Kunden er en hurtigt voksende virksomhed, der opererer i flere europæiske lande. Deres mål er at være den førende leverandør af whistleblower- og relaterede compliance-løsninger til virksomheder i Europa, så de kan fremme en kultur med gennemsigtighed, ansvarlighed og etisk adfærd og samtidig beskytte deres omdømme, aktiver og interessenter. Og de leder efter en passioneret ny kollega fra Danmark - er det dig?

Jobbet:

Hvis du er klar til at begive dig ud på en spændende rejse og bidrage til at bruge dine evner inden for salg og kommunikation, må du ikke gå glip af denne fantastiske mulighed! Du vil arbejde som salgsrepræsentant og forventes at være meget dygtig til udgående telefonopkald, som mødebooker og have evnen til at få adgang til den rigtige person og handle i rummet mellem potentielle forhindringer. For at få succes med at sikre ny forretning er du nødt til at have en dyb forståelse af organisationens marked, målgruppe og produkt.

Dit daglige arbejde vil omfatte opgaver som disse:

  • Arbejde inden for normal kontortid med fri i weekenden.

  • Booking af udgående telefonmøder.

  • Få adgang til den rigtige person, og arbejd i rummet mellem gatekeeperne.

  • Håndtere udgående opkald på en venlig og professionel måde.

  • Udfordringen er, at folks behov hele tiden ændrer sig, så du skal være fleksibel og hurtig til at tilpasse dig, så du bruger tid på altid at være ajour.

Dine kvalifikationer:

💭 Du taler og skriver dansk på modersmålsniveau og er flydende i engelsk (B2).

🎓 Mindst 6-12 måneders erfaring med udgående mødebooking og produktintroduktion - det er et plus, hvis det er B2b og software. Desuden skal du være selvmotiveret og have erfaring med at arbejde hjemmefra.

💻 Du har en grundlæggende forståelse for og færdigheder i at håndtere computere, og du har evnen til at bruge tilgængelige datakilder til at identificere og nå ud til potentielle kunder.

💪🏻 Overbevisende præsentationsevner med evnen til at skabe engagement, forberede og kvalificere betydelige salgsmuligheder i planlagte og bekræftede onlinemøder.

🥇 Vindende personlighed, der skinner igennem under telefonsamtaler, og med et stærkt individuelt drive og præstationsniveau - evne til at være en holdspiller og blive motiveret af holdets succes.

About Trackonomy

Trackonomy is pioneering a transformative network of interconnected objects. Our goal is to bring inanimate objects to life, enabling them to communicate, think, and interact in real time.

The Role

Trackonomy is looking for an experienced payroll professional to provide centralized review, reconciliation, and reporting across our global payroll operations.

This is a part-time, highly flexible remote position designed for an experienced payroll professional who enjoys detailed analysis and problem-solving and wants meaningful work without a traditional full-time schedule.

Trackonomy has approximately 700 employees globally, with payroll administered locally across multiple countries through internal teams, payroll providers, PEO/EOR partners, and external accounting firms. This role does not process payroll. Instead, you will provide the independent review and reporting layer across those payrolls.

Your objective is to help us confidently answer three questions every month:

  • Did we pay people correctly?
  • Did we pay the correct employment-related costs?
  • Can we explain what changed?

You will review payroll results, reconcile activity to employee and compensation changes, investigate unusual variances, identify errors and potential overpayments, and work with HR, Finance, local teams, and payroll providers to resolve discrepancies.

You will also own our consolidated global payroll reporting, giving HR and Finance a reliable view of payroll costs across countries, entities, and providers.

Success in this role means creating a disciplined global payroll review process that catches errors, explains payroll movement, improves controls, and provides leadership with accurate and timely payroll information.

Experience and Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in payroll, payroll accounting, payroll audit, payroll reconciliation, or a closely related field.
  • Strong experience reviewing payroll registers, reconciling payroll activity, and identifying discrepancies.
  • Solid understanding of gross-to-net payroll, employer taxes and contributions, deductions, bonuses, commissions, and other payroll-related employer costs.
  • Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills, including pivot tables, lookups, reconciliations, and variance analysis.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze payroll data, recognize unusual activity, investigate discrepancies, and follow issues through resolution.
  • Ability to reconcile payroll changes to hires, terminations, compensation changes, bonuses, commissions, and other employee activity.
  • Strong analytical skills and exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to organize and consolidate data received from multiple systems, providers, and formats.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience reviewing payroll across multiple countries, legal entities, or payroll providers.
  • Experience with global payroll reporting and reconciliation.
  • Experience working with Professional Employer Organization (PEO) and/or Employer of Record (EOR) arrangements.
  • Experience reviewing payroll provider invoices, employer taxes, statutory contributions, and other employment-related costs.
  • Familiarity with payroll accounting, accruals, and month-end close processes.
  • Experience reviewing bonuses, commissions, or other variable compensation.
  • Experience identifying payroll overpayments, duplicate payments, provider billing discrepancies, tax or contribution errors, or other payroll-related exceptions.
  • Experience developing or improving payroll controls, reconciliation processes, or reporting.
  • Experience working in a high-growth, international, or decentralized organization.

You do not need to have processed payroll in every country where we operate. We are looking for someone who understands payroll well enough to recognize when something does not make sense, knows what questions to ask, and can work with local experts and providers to determine the answer.

What You'll Accomplish

We care about accuracy, responsiveness, and results—not where you sit or whether you work traditional office hours.

Growth and Development

At Trackonomy, your growth is driven by your capabilities, passion, ownership, and results. As part of an early-stage, high-growth company, you will have opportunities to take on diverse responsibilities, learn directly from experienced leaders, and expand your role as your impact grows.

Company: Proxima Studios (Creators of Suck Up!)

Location: Remote / Flexible

Role Type: Full-Time Contract or Permanent

About Us

We are the indie team behind Suck Up!, where we turned goofy social deduction and conversational AI into pure comedic chaos (with over 200m views on YouTube). Now, we are building our next title: a management simulation that sits between the sandbox of The Sims and the chaotic/comedy of Schedule 1.

We operate small, fast, and scrappy. We value creative ownership, rapid prototyping, and people who can establish a cohesive, signature visual language from the ground up.

The Role

We are seeking a Lead 3D Generalist & Technical Artist with a cartoonist’s comedic timing and a systems-first mindset.

You will architect our character pipeline from the ground up. You will build a scalable, modular character system: designing plug-and-play facial features, swappable clothing kits, and a unified rig that lets code drive endless distinct NPCs. Your characters must prioritize bold silhouettes and comedic physicality, extreme emotional states, physical impairment, and chaotic meltdowns instantly readable in first person.

Key Responsibilities

  • Modular Character Pipeline: Model, texture, and rig a stylized, low-poly character kit with modular heads, socketed facial features, and swappable clothing that read clearly across extreme states (drunkenness, rage, distress) and across actions.
  • Master Rigging & Retargeting: Build and maintain a unified humanoid skeleton with standardized attachment sockets (hands, eyes, accessories, seats) to share animations seamlessly across all roles.
  • Smart Objects & Environments: Model modular furniture, stages, and props adhering strictly to interaction metrics, snap grids, and navmesh constraints.
  • Unity Integration: Configure character prefabs, Mecanim state machines, dynamic interior lighting, optimized materials, and essential comedic VFX (particles, mess decals).
  • Visual Direction: Establish color palettes, trim sheets, and style guidelines that creates a unified aesthetic.

What We Are Looking For

Artistic & Design Sense

  • Cartoonist's Comedic Instinct: Strong grasp of silhouette, exaggerated postures, and physical slapstick (Schedule I, The Sims). You favor punchy readability over photorealism.
  • Systemic Thinking: Experience designing reusable, modular kits meant to be mixed and matched hundreds of times.

Technical Competencies

  • Full Stylized 3D Pipeline: End-to-end expertise in Blender (or equivalent) for low-poly modeling, texturing, rigging, and skinning with clean optimization.
  • Deep Unity Proficiency: Direct experience setting up Humanoid Avatars, Prefabs, Animator Controllers, and collision hulls.
  • Sockets & Retargeting: Proven workflow for modular prop attachment, socket hierarchies, and retargeting shared animations across varied body types.
  • Code based animations: Unity C# scripting for procedural animation/IK, animation blending, target tracking, and more.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume and portfolio link.

Portfolio Priorities:

  • In-engine captures of stylized/low-poly characters in motion with distinct silhouettes.
  • Rigging and animation samples showing comedic timing and clean skinning.
  • Modular workflows (customization kits, swappable parts, grid-based props).

Journal of Applied Ecology publishes novel, high-impact papers on the interface between ecological science and the management of biological resources. The primary aim of the journal is to drive forward the field of applied ecology by providing a high-quality evidence base for scientists, managers and policymakers. We recently celebrated our 60th birthday with an Editorial which evaluated our impact in the real world. The journal has strong citation metrics including a current impact factor of 5.3 and a CiteScore of 8.8. We are continually seek to improve equity and inclusion in ecology through mentoring schemes and ECR prizes.

The Journal’s editorial team consists of six Editors who are supported by dedicated editorial office personnel and an international board of around 100 Associate Editors. The Senior Editors work together to determine journal strategy and to increase the reputation and quality of the Journal, in addition to making decisions on around 2100 manuscripts submitted each year. Further details about the Journal and its current editorial team can be found here.

Requirements

About you

We are seeking an Editor to strengthen and complement the editorial team and to continue raising the Journal’s profile worldwide.

To complement our Editor team, we are looking for an active researcher broad interests in applied ecology. Applications are welcome from leading scientists covering any areas of the Journal’s scope who could contribute to the Journal’s development in topical and developing fields.

The ideal candidate will be a clear communicator who works well as part of a team and a good decision-maker who acts with integrity in both their editorial and own scientific work. They will be a creative thinker, with a solid understanding of their own field of applied ecology, as well as an overview of the wider discipline; experience of reviewing and editing processes; commitment to maintaining the high editorial standards of the Journal; and an interest in ongoing developments within academic publishing.

  • PhD in ecology or related fields and evidence of an active and relevant publication record

jobs.description:
Consultor SAP Supply Chain (WM / EWM / TM / GTS / IBP)

Descripción de la empresa
Cliente final de manufactura confidencial en Panama

Descripción de la posición

El consultor SAP Supply Chain participará en la implementación y el despliegue (rollout) de soluciones de cadena de suministro en nuevas filiales o países, con base en una plantilla global. Se especializará en una o más de estas áreas: gestión de almacenes (WM / EWM), transporte (TM), comercio exterior y aduanas (GTS) o planificación integrada de la demanda y S&OP (IBP). Trabajará con consultores senior, líderes funcionales y usuarios clave de logística, comercio exterior y planificación.

Responsabilidades Principales

  • Participar en implantación y rollouts de su especialidad siguiendo la plantilla global existente.
  • Analizar requerimientos de negocio y requisitos legales locales, e identificar brechas (fit-gap) frente a los procesos de negocio.
  • WM / EWM: configurar la estructura del almacén, estrategias de entrada y salida, oleadas, picking, packing, inventario físico, unidades de manipulación y operación con radiofrecuencia (RF).
  • TM: configurar la red de transporte, unidades de flete, planificación y optimización de cargas, selección de transportistas, órdenes de flete y liquidación de costos de flete.
  • GTS: configurar el control de cumplimiento (listas restringidas, embargos, licencias), la clasificación arancelaria, las declaraciones de importación y exportación y la gestión de preferencias.
  • IBP: configurar áreas de planificación e indicadores clave, pronóstico de demanda, planificación de suministro, ciclo S&OP y vistas en Excel Add-in y Fiori.
  • Asegurar la integración con MM, SD, PP y FI, y la integración de datos de IBP con S/4HANA (CI-DS o Integration Suite).
  • Participar en la migración y validación de datos maestros.
  • Ejecutar pruebas unitarias (Unit Test), integrales (SIT) y de aceptación (UAT).
  • Elaborar documentación funcional y materiales de capacitación, capacitar a usuarios clave y dar soporte en la salida a producción y la estabilización (hypercare).

Requisitos

  • Profesional en Ingeniería Industrial, Logística, Comercio Exterior, Negocios Internacionales, Ingeniería de Sistemas o carreras afines.
  • Al menos 5 años de experiencia en SAP.
  • Participación en al menos 3 proyectos completos de implementación o rollout SAP.
  • Conocimientos funcionales sólidos de al menos una especialidad: WM / EWM, TM, GTS o IBP.
  • Conocimiento de procesos logísticos, de comercio exterior o de planificación según la especialidad.
  • Conocimientos de SAP MM y SD.
  • Experiencia en pruebas funcionales, capacitación y soporte a usuarios.
  • Experiencia en entornos SAP S/4HANA.
  • Inglés intermedio (B1–B2).

Deseable por especialidad

  • WM / EWM: migración de WM a EWM, EWM descentralizado, automatización (MFS), Yard Management y cross-docking.
  • TM: TM embebido en S/4HANA, integración TM–EWM, transporte internacional e Incoterms.
  • GTS: GTS edición para SAP HANA, normativa aduanera latinoamericana, zonas francas e integración con agentes aduaneros.
  • IBP: IBP for Inventory, IBP for Response and Supply, DDMRP y migración desde SAP APO.
  • También se valoran: dominio de más de una especialidad, proyectos multi-país, la metodología SAP Activate y certificación SAP en el área.

Inicio del Proyecto: 2026-11-03
Duración del Proyecto: 6 meses

We treat our people like family, we are mission-focused, and we give back! Join us today.

We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our team to support the Army Material Command. This position will be responsible for working with clients to strengthen their financial management processes, operations and systems, with a focus on maximizing the impact of the organization’s resources. Additionally, this position will provide data management, analysis, and visualization capabilities with the accounting and financial processes, creating continuous audit readiness as well as provide advisory and support on asset visibility and accountability, asset resolution, and disposition.


Responsibilities

Seeking an experienced Data Engineer to join our practice with a dedicated focus on military clients in the Defense & Security segment. This individual will have a big data architecture background, responsible for writing new python scripts, running existing code/jobs, editing complex inter-related python scripts, running Glue jobs (and other pipelines), implementing star-schema data models for PowerBI, designing Power Automate workflows, and other responsibilities with managing a Data Lake. The Data Engineer will collaborate with cross-functional teams to modernize legacy environments, and support advanced automations and analytics initiatives for our federal client.

Responsibilities include:

  • Create ad hoc python script/SQL code or edit existing scripts for data ingestion or transformation.
  • Manage pipelines in a large Databricks AWS Data Lake (via Databricks: S3 > Glue > S3 via SQL and Python).
  • Restructure source data (implement a data model) and connection for PowerBI dashboards.
  • Provide documentation or work with another team member to create documentation for products created.
  • Analyze existing technical processes and systems to identify gaps, recommend improvements, and support modernization initiatives. Gaps include AWS environment size and scoping, opportunities for ML models, NLP models, connections to source data rather than uploaded data, PowerAutomate workflows, in-built QA flags, etc.
  • Support integration of advanced analytics and automation tools, leveraging platforms such as Power BI, Qlik, Power Apps, and Databricks to improve reporting and decision-making.
  • Design, configure, and develop custom solutions in Microsoft Power Platform using Power Apps, Power Automations, and Microsoft Dynamics 365.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues in development and production environments to maintain stable and reliable data pipelines.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or minimum 5 years or more of experience in Accounting, Finance, Information Technology, Logistics or Business Management.
  • Strong Core Technological Skills in: Python, SQL, Microsoft Dataverse (CDS), Power Apps, Power Automate, Databricks, and PowerBI.
  • Experience with data analytics, automation, and AI tools.
  • Experience with ETL pipelines, integration of data sources, and big data processing.
  • Experience refactoring and optimizing legacy code.
  • Strong communication and ability to synthesize complex information and deliver high-impact solutions in fast-paced environments.
  • An active Secret DoD security clearance and the ability to maintain it throughout employment.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience with Army financial systems, such as ADVANA, GFEBS, and LMP.
  • Prior experience supporting federal audit readiness or CFO functions within DoW or similar agencies.
  • Experience in data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Qlik), familiarity with data platforms (e.g., Databricks), and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure).

  • Experience with testing frameworks (pytest, unittest)

  • Knowledge of message queues or event-driven systems

  • Self-learner: Can pick up new concepts quickly

  • Detail-oriented: Writes careful, clean code

  • Curious: Asks questions and wants to understand how things work

  • Collaborative: Works well with the team

  • Persistent: Doesn't give up when facing challenges

Why Join Us?

Early Startup Team Benefits

  • Real Impact: Your work directly shapes the product and company direction

  • Fast Learning: Exposure to entire tech stack and business decisions

  • Ownership: Take ownership of features and projects from day one

  • Mentorship: Work closely with founders

jobs.description:
Claims Senior Casualty Adjuster

Job Summary
The Claims Senior Casualty Adjuster handles moderate to high complexity claims involving material damage, property and/or liability lines of insurance written by the Interinsurance Exchange in compliance with all regulatory and statutory requirements. The primary functions include liability investigation, coverage evaluation, negotiation strategies and claims resolution of moderate to high complexity claims. Employs discretion and independent judgment to ensure compliance with state and federal law, and with established company, technical, and customer service best practices. Under general supervision, works within specific limits of authority to resolve claims.

Job Duties

  • Conduct phone and/or field investigations to determine liability and damages. May attend and participate in legal proceedings. Identify and obtain statements from insureds, claimants and witnesses.
  • Communicate and interact with a variety of individuals including insureds and claimants. Explain benefits, coverages, fault and claims process either verbally or in writing in compliance with regulatory and statutory requirements. Recognize and appropriately address moderate complexity coverage issues.
  • Evaluate and determine claim values upon receipt and assessment of property, bodily injury and liability data.
  • Negotiate within settlement authority with insureds and claimants to resolve first and third party claims.
  • Update database production reports, and document and update claim files via company systems, i.e. CACS, HUON, HOC, GUIDEWIRE, etc.
  • Control expenses for areas of responsibility.
  • Verify and interpret / resolve coverage by gathering necessary information to ensure policy applicability. Coordinate with internal and external departments as required.
  • Respond quickly to customer needs and problems.
  • Independently resolve claims within authority level.

Qualifications

  • Bachelors Equivalent combination of education and experience Preferred
  • 7-9 years Prior claims handling experience. Preferred
  • 4-6 years Property, Auto, Casualty or relevant claims administration experience. Required
  • Comprehensive knowledge of claims administration best practices and procedures.
  • Advanced knowledge of insurance, fault assessment, negligence and subrogation principles required.
  • Comprehensive understanding of building and vehicle repair procedures and third-party liability issues.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office suite, general computer software and claims software.
  • Advanced organization and planning recognition skills required.
  • Advanced oral and written communication skills required.
  • Advanced interpersonal skills required.
  • Advanced leadership skills among peers required.
  • Exhibit proficiency and understanding of medical terminology and causality
  • Valid Driver's License, acceptable Department of Motor Vehicles record and minimum liability insurance - Issued by State Required
  • Chartered Property Casualty Underwriter - Insurance Institute of America Preferred
  • Associate in Claims - Insurance Institute of America Preferred
  • An insurance/claims adjuster license may be required for claims administration in specific states.

Travel Requirements

  • Occasional travel to business meetings or conferences.

$38.64 - $51.46

Insurity’s Next Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)

Insurity is seeking a strategic, operational, and technically credible Chief Information Security Officer to lead Insurity’s enterprise security, cybersecurity risk and privacy programs.

The CISO will protect Insurity’s information assets, products, customer environments, and technology ecosystem while enabling growth, cloud adoption, international expansion, and responsible use of artificial intelligence. This leader will translate cybersecurity, privacy, compliance, and technology risk into clear business decisions for executive leadership and the Board.

The successful candidate will combine executive presence with practical execution. They need to be comfortable setting strategy, leading through influence, engaging with customers executives and regulators, directing major incidents, reviewing architecture, and building the processes, team, and culture required for a growing SaaS company.

 What Our Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) Will Do

Enterprise security strategy and governance

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve Insurity’s enterprise information security strategy, policies, standards, and control framework.
  • Establish security priorities that align with business strategy, product roadmaps, customer commitments, and the organization’s risk appetite.
  • Reinforce an enterprise security governance structure, including executive steering forums and appropriate reporting to the executive team and Board of Directors.
  • Define clear accountability for security across Engineering, Product, Corporate IT, Cloud Operations, Legal, Privacy, and Compliance business functions.
  • Provide risk-mitigating direction for initiatives with technology, data, cloud, product, or customer-security implications.
  • Maintain a forward-looking view of emerging threats, technologies, regulations, and business risks.

HIPAA, PHI data protection

  • Own and mature Insurity’s HIPAA compliance and electronic protected health information program where applicable to Insurity’s products, services, customers, vendors, and business operations.
  • Lead documented HIPAA risk analyses, risk treatment plans, control testing, remediation tracking, and periodic program evaluations.
  • Ensure appropriate administrative, physical, and technical safeguards for protected health information, including access control, authentication, audit controls, integrity, transmission security, encryption, contingency planning, and workforce security.
  • Partner with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Product, and Customer Success on the HIPAA Privacy, Security, and Breach Notification Rules.
  • Establish requirements for Business Associate Agreements, customer obligations, subcontractors, cloud providers, and other third parties that create, receive, maintain, or transmit PHI.
  • Maintain audit-ready evidence and support customer diligence, independent assessments, regulatory inquiries, and OCR requests.
  • Lead the security component of PHI breach assessment, containment, investigation, notification coordination, and post-incident remediation.
  • Ensure HIPAA-specific workforce training, sanctions, and awareness requirements are incorporated into the broader security program.

AI security, governance, and responsible adoption

  • Establish and lead Insurity’s enterprise AI security and governance program.
  • Maintain an inventory of AI, machine learning, large language model, generative AI, and agentic systems used, developed, procured, or embedded in Insurity products and operations.
  • Define AI intake, risk classification, ownership, approval gates, prohibited uses, and human-oversight requirements.
  • Establish secure-use standards for generative AI, including requirements for confidential information, PHI, PII, customer data, source code, proprietary data, prompts, outputs, retention, and model training.
  • Define controls for AI-specific risks, including prompt injection, data leakage, insecure agents and tools, model abuse, data poisoning, supply-chain risk, unauthorized access, and unreliable or harmful outputs.
  • Partner with Legal, Privacy, Product, Engineering, Data, and Compliance to address transparency, intellectual property & data rights of emerging AI regulations.
  • Incorporate AI security and governance requirements into procurement, third-party risk management, secure development, cloud architecture, product reviews, and customer commitments.

Risk management, compliance, and assurance

  • Develop a risk-based process for identifying, assessing, prioritizing, treating, and accepting information security and technology risks across Insurity’s ecosystem.
  • Maintain alignment with applicable requirements and leading practices, including HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, GDPR & the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
  • Orchestrate internal and external audits through planning, evidence collection, testing, findings management, remediation, and executive reporting.
  • Establish control ownership, evidence standards, issue-management processes, and sustainable remediation tracking.
  • Advise management on the costs, value, and risks of security and technology investments.
  • Support cyber-insurance requirements, underwriting reviews, claims preparation, and risk-improvement initiatives.
  • Monitor regulatory and contractual changes and translate them into practical requirements, policies, and implementation plans.
  • Report material risks, exceptions, incidents, and remediation plans to executive leadership and the Board.

Security operations and incident response

  • Lead the enterprise security operations program, including monitoring, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, detection and response, penetration testing, and security investigations.
  • Manage security incident response coordinating both internally and externally from inception to resolution.
  • Maintain an incident response program that covers cyber incidents, privacy events, PHI incidents, ransomware, cloud compromise, insider threats, supply-chain events, and AI-related incidents.
  • Lead security incident response partnering with Insurity’s COO and CLO while remaining sufficiently engaged in technical and operational details.
  • Establish escalation criteria, severity definitions, communications protocols, evidence-preservation practices, and post-incident review requirements.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Communications, customers, insurers, law enforcement, and regulators as appropriate.
  • Measure response effectiveness through exercises, lessons learned, time-to-detect, time-to-contain, time-to-recover, and remediation completion.
  • Lead regular cyber crisis tabletop exercises and simulations with executive leadership, key operational teams, customers, and external partners where appropriate.
  • Maintain crisis communications and breach-disclosure playbooks in partnership with Legal, Communications, Privacy, and executive leadership.
  • Ensure lessons from incidents and exercises are converted into funded improvements.

Product, application, cloud, and infrastructure security

  • Embed security-by-design into product development, architecture, engineering, DevOps, and change-management processes.
  • Establish and oversee application security practices, including secure coding, threat modeling, SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, penetration testing, vulnerability disclosure, and release gates.
  • Lead software supply-chain security, including dependency governance, SBOMs, artifact integrity, code-signing expectations, CI/CD controls, and third-party component risk.
  • Oversee cloud-security architecture, identity and access management, encryption, secrets management, network segmentation, logging, monitoring, data-loss prevention, and secure configuration management.
  • Promote Zero Trust principles, least privilege, strong authentication, secure-by-default configurations, and continuous control monitoring.
  • Review and approve security architecture for major products, platforms, infrastructure changes, AI systems, and customer-facing capabilities.

Third-party risk, customer trust, and commercial enablement

  • Establish a risk-based third-party security and privacy program covering vendors, cloud providers, subprocessors, partners, supply-chain participants, and other external parties.
  • Ensure contracts, security requirements, audit rights, breach obligations, data-use restrictions, and Business Associate obligations are addressed with Legal and Procurement.
  • Establish and maintain data classification, data inventory, data-flow, retention, deletion, residency, and access-governance practices.
  • Ensure security requirements are addressed across the lifecycle of customer, employee, regulated, confidential, and proprietary information.

Leadership, organization, and culture

  • Build and lead a cost-efficient, high-performing security organization with appropriate direct and dotted-line relationships across Engineering, Product, IT, Cloud Operations, Privacy, Compliance, and other functions.
  • Hire, develop, coach, and retain security talent while establishing clear operating rhythms and accountability.
  • Create and manage security awareness and role-based training for employees, contractors, approved system users, developers, administrators, and executives.
  • Promote a culture in which security is viewed as an enabler of customer trust, product quality, resilience, and business growth.
  • Manage the security budget, partner strategy, managed service providers, and external security resources.
  • Define and report meaningful security metrics, risk indicators, maturity measures, control health, remediation progress, incident trends, audit results, customer commitments, and AI-governance metrics.

Who We’re Looking For 

  • A strategic leader and builder who can establish vision, create alignment, and execute through influence.
  • A credible executive communicator who can brief the Board, lead a crisis, engage customers, and explain complex issues in simple terms.
  • A pragmatic security leader who balances risk reduction, business enablement, customer commitments, speed, and cost.
  • A collaborative partner to Engineering, Product, IT, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, and executive leadership.
  • A calm, decisive leader who can operate effectively in high-pressure, high-stakes situations.
  • A leader who is comfortable working hands-on when necessary while building a scalable team and operating model.

Required qualifications and experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in information security, computer science, information technology, business, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 8–10 years of progressive experience in information security, cybersecurity, technology risk, or related disciplines within a SaaS, cloud, technology, insurance, healthcare, or other regulated environment.
  • At least 5 years of executive or senior leadership experience in a CISO, Deputy CISO, Head of Security, or comparable role.
  • Demonstrated experience building and operating an enterprise security program across a distributed or remote organization.
  • Experience with HIPAA, ePHI, Business Associate requirements, healthcare data protection, or comparable regulated-data obligations.
  • Demonstrated experience leading security risk assessments, audits, remediation programs, and regulatory or customer assurance activities.
  • Experience leading material incidents, crisis response, business continuity, disaster recovery, and executive communications.
  • Experience establishing or operating an AI security, AI governance, responsible AI, model-risk, or secure-generative-AI program.
  • Strong understanding of cloud, SaaS operating models, identity, encryption, application security, vulnerability management, incident response, and third-party risk.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder-influencing skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, partners, vendors, priorities, and complex cross-functional programs.

Preferred qualifications

  • CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, CCSP, or equivalent certification.
  • Experience with SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, NIST AI RMF, or comparable frameworks.
  • Experience with AI/ML security, LLM security, agent security, model risk management, AI impact assessments, or AI red teaming.
  • Experience supporting customer security reviews, RFPs, renewals, and executive-level trust discussions.
  • Experience in insurance technology, property and casualty insurance, healthcare technology, or another data-intensive regulated industry.
  • Experience with cyber-risk quantification, cyber insurance, secure software supply chains, DevSecOps, and cloud-native security.
