Le futur Directeur de la sécurité de l'information d’Insurity 

Insurity est à la recherche d’un chef de la sécurité de l’information (CSI) doté d’une vision stratégique, de compétences opérationnelles et d’une expertise technique reconnue, afin de diriger les programmes de sécurité d’entreprise, de gestion des risques liés à la cybersécurité et de protection de la vie privée d’Insurity.

Le CSI assurera la protection des actifs informationnels, des produits, des environnements clients et de l’écosystème technologique d’Insurity, tout en favorisant la croissance, l’adoption du nuage, l’expansion internationale et l’utilisation responsable de l’intelligence artificielle. Ce dirigeant saura traduire les enjeux liés à la cybersécurité, à la protection de la vie privée, à la conformité et aux risques technologiques en décisions d’affaires claires à l’intention de la haute direction et du conseil d’administration.

Le candidat retenu alliera une présence de haut niveau à un sens pratique de l’exécution. Il devra être à l’aise pour définir des stratégies, diriger par l’influence, interagir avec les dirigeants des clients et les organismes de réglementation, gérer les incidents majeurs, examiner l’architecture et mettre en place les processus, l’équipe et la culture nécessaires à une entreprise de SaaS en pleine croissance.

Ce que notre Directeur de la sécurité de l'information fera 

Stratégie et gouvernance de la sécurité d’entreprise
  • Élaborer, mettre en œuvre et améliorer continuellement la stratégie, les politiques, les normes et le cadre de contrôle en matière de sécurité de l’information d’Insurity.
  • Établir des priorités en matière de sécurité qui s’alignent sur la stratégie d’affaires, les feuilles de route des produits, les engagements envers les clients et l’appétit pour le risque de l’organisation.
  • Renforcer la structure de gouvernance de la sécurité de l’entreprise, notamment par le biais de comités de pilotage de la haute direction et de rapports appropriés à l’intention de l’équipe de direction et du conseil d’administration.
  • Définir clairement les responsabilités en matière de sécurité au sein des fonctions d’ingénierie, de développement de produits, des TI d’entreprise, des opérations dans le nuage, des affaires juridiques, de la protection de la vie privée et de la conformité.
  • Fournir des orientations visant à atténuer les risques pour les initiatives ayant des répercussions sur la sécurité des technologies, des données, du nuage, des produits ou des clients.
  • Maintenir une vision prospective des menaces, des technologies, des réglementations et des risques d’affaires émergents.
HIPAA, protection des renseignements médicaux protégés (RMP)
  • Assurer et faire évoluer le programme de conformité à la loi HIPAA et de protection des renseignements médicaux protégés sous forme électronique d’Insurity, dans la mesure où cela s’applique aux produits, aux services, aux clients, aux fournisseurs et aux activités commerciales d’Insurity.
  • Diriger les analyses de risques documentées relatives à la loi HIPAA, les plans de gestion des risques, les tests de contrôle, le suivi des mesures correctives et les évaluations périodiques du programme.
  • Veiller à la mise en place de mesures de protection administratives, physiques et techniques appropriées pour les renseignements de santé protégés, notamment le contrôle d’accès, l’authentification, les contrôles d’audit, l’intégrité, la sécurité des transmissions, le chiffrement, la planification d’urgence et la sécurité du personnel.
  • Collaborer avec les services juridiques, de protection de la vie privée, de conformité, des produits et de la réussite client concernant les règles HIPAA en matière de confidentialité, de sécurité et de notification des violations.
  • Établir les exigences relatives aux ententes de partenariat d’affaires, aux obligations des clients, aux sous-traitants, aux fournisseurs de services en nuage et aux autres tiers qui créent, reçoivent, conservent ou transmettent des renseignements de santé protégés (RSP).
  • Conserver des preuves prêtes pour les vérifications et appuyer la diligence raisonnable des clients, les évaluations indépendantes, les enquêtes réglementaires et les demandes de l’OCR.
  • Diriger le volet sécurité de l’évaluation des violations de renseignements médicaux protégés (RMP), de leur endiguement, de l’enquête, de la coordination des avis et des mesures correctives post-incident.
  • Veiller à ce que les exigences spécifiques à la loi HIPAA en matière de formation du personnel, de sanctions et de sensibilisation soient intégrées au programme de sécurité global.
Sécurité de l’IA, gouvernance et adoption responsable
  • Mettre en place et diriger le programme d’entreprise d’Insurity en matière de sécurité et de gouvernance de l’IA.
  • Tenir à jour un inventaire des technologies d’IA, d’apprentissage automatique, de grands modèles linguistiques, d’IA générative et de systèmes agentiques utilisés, développés, acquis ou intégrés dans les produits et les opérations d’Insurity.
  • Définir les procédures d’intégration de l’IA, la classification des risques, la responsabilité, les étapes d’approbation, les utilisations interdites et les exigences en matière de supervision humaine.
  • Établir des normes d’utilisation sécuritaire pour l’IA générative, y compris les exigences relatives aux renseignements confidentiels, aux renseignements médicaux protégés (RMP), aux renseignements personnels identifiables (RPI), aux données des clients, au code source, aux données exclusives, aux invites, aux résultats, à la conservation et à l’entraînement des modèles.
  • Définir des contrôles pour les risques propres à l’IA, notamment l’injection d’invites, les fuites de données, les agents et outils non sécurisés, l’utilisation abusive des modèles, l’empoisonnement des données, les risques liés à la chaîne d’approvisionnement, les accès non autorisés et les résultats peu fiables ou nuisibles.
  • Collaborer avec les services juridiques, de protection de la vie privée, des produits, de l’ingénierie, des données et de la conformité pour traiter les questions de transparence, de propriété intellectuelle et de droits relatifs aux données dans le cadre des nouvelles réglementations sur l’IA.
  • Intégrer les exigences en matière de sécurité et de gouvernance de l’IA dans les processus d’approvisionnement, la gestion des risques liés aux tiers, le développement sécurisé, l’architecture de nuage, les évaluations de produits et les engagements envers les clients.

Gestion des risques, conformité et assurance

  • Élaborer un processus axé sur les risques visant à identifier, évaluer, hiérarchiser, traiter et accepter les risques liés à la sécurité de l’information et aux technologies au sein de l’écosystème d’Insurity.
  • Veiller à la conformité avec les exigences applicables et les pratiques exemplaires, notamment la loi HIPAA, la norme SOC 2, la norme ISO/IEC 27001, le RGPD et le cadre de cybersécurité du NIST.
  • Coordonner les vérifications internes et externes par le biais de la planification, de la collecte de preuves, des essais, de la gestion des constatations, des mesures correctives et de la production de rapports à l’intention de la direction.
  • Établir la responsabilité des contrôles, les normes en matière de preuves, les processus de gestion des problèmes et un suivi durable des mesures correctives.
  • Conseiller la direction sur les coûts, la valeur et les risques liés aux investissements en matière de sécurité et de technologie.
  • Appuyer les exigences en matière de cyberassurance, les examens de souscription, la préparation des réclamations et les initiatives d’amélioration de la gestion des risques.
  • Surveiller les changements réglementaires et contractuels et les traduire en exigences pratiques, en politiques et en plans de mise en œuvre.
  • Signaler les risques importants, les exceptions, les incidents et les plans de mesures correctives à la haute direction et au conseil d’administration.
Opérations de sécurité et intervention en cas d’incident
  • Diriger le programme d’opérations de sécurité de l’entreprise, notamment la surveillance, le renseignement sur les menaces, la gestion des vulnérabilités, la détection et la réponse, les tests d’intrusion et les enquêtes de sécurité.
  • Gérer l’intervention en cas d’incident de sécurité en assurant la coordination tant à l’interne qu’à l’externe, de la détection à la résolution.
  • Maintenir un programme d’intervention en cas d’incident couvrant les cyberincidents, les incidents liés à la protection des renseignements personnels, les incidents liés aux renseignements médicaux protégés (RMP), les rançongiciels, les compromissions dans le nuage, les menaces internes, les incidents liés à la chaîne d’approvisionnement et les incidents liés à l’IA.
  • Diriger la réponse aux incidents de sécurité en collaboration avec le chef de l’exploitation (COO) et le chef de la conformité (CLO) d’Insurity, tout en restant suffisamment impliqué dans les détails techniques et opérationnels.
  • Établir des critères d’escalade, des définitions de gravité, des protocoles de communication, des pratiques de préservation des preuves et des exigences en matière d’examen post-incident.
  • Assurer la coordination avec les services juridiques, de protection de la vie privée, de conformité, de communications, ainsi qu’avec les clients, les assureurs, les forces de l’ordre et les organismes de réglementation, selon les besoins.
  • Évaluer l’efficacité de la réponse au moyen d’exercices, des leçons apprises, des délais de détection, de confinement et de rétablissement, ainsi que de l’achèvement des mesures correctives.
  • Mener régulièrement des exercices sur table et des simulations de crises cybernétiques avec la haute direction, les équipes opérationnelles clés, les clients et les partenaires externes, le cas échéant.
  • Tenir à jour les guides de communication en cas de crise et de divulgation des violations, en collaboration avec les services juridiques, des communications, de la protection des renseignements personnels et la haute direction.
  • Veiller à ce que les leçons tirées des incidents et des exercices se traduisent par des améliorations financées.
Sécurité des produits, des applications, du nuage et de l’infrastructure
  • Intégrer la sécurité dès la conception dans les processus de développement de produits, d’architecture, d’ingénierie, de DevOps et de gestion du changement.
  • Mettre en place et superviser les pratiques de sécurité des applications, notamment le codage sécuritaire, la modélisation des menaces, les tests SAST et DAST, l’analyse de la composition logicielle, les tests de pénétration, la divulgation des vulnérabilités et les « release gates ».
  • Diriger la sécurité de la chaîne d’approvisionnement logicielle, y compris la gouvernance des dépendances, les SBOM, l’intégrité des artefacts, les exigences en matière de signature de code, les contrôles CI/CD et les risques liés aux composants tiers.
  • Superviser l’architecture de sécurité dans le nuage, la gestion des identités et des accès, le chiffrement, la gestion des secrets, la segmentation du réseau, la journalisation, la surveillance, la prévention des pertes de données et la gestion sécurisée des configurations.
  • Promouvoir les principes du « Zero Trust », du principe du privilège minimal, de l’authentification forte, des configurations sécurisées par défaut et de la surveillance continue des contrôles.
  • Examiner et approuver l’architecture de sécurité des principaux produits, des plateformes, des changements d’infrastructure, des systèmes d’IA et des fonctionnalités destinées aux clients.
Risques liés aux tiers, confiance des clients et facilitation des activités commerciales
  • Mettre en place un programme de sécurité et de protection de la vie privée axé sur les risques et couvrant les fournisseurs, les fournisseurs de services nuage, les sous-traitants, les partenaires, les acteurs de la chaîne d’approvisionnement et d’autres parties externes.
  • S’assurer que les contrats, les exigences de sécurité, les droits d’audit, les obligations en cas de violation, les restrictions d’utilisation des données et les obligations des partenaires d’affaires sont traités en collaboration avec les services juridiques et d’approvisionnement.
  • Mettre en place et maintenir des pratiques de classification des données, d’inventaire des données, de flux de données, de conservation, de suppression, de résidence et de gouvernance des accès.
  • S’assurer que les exigences de sécurité sont respectées tout au long du cycle de vie des renseignements relatifs aux clients, aux employés, ainsi que des renseignements assujettis à une réglementation, confidentiels et exclusifs.

Leadership, organisation et culture

  • Mettre en place et diriger une organisation de sécurité performante et rentable, avec des relations hiérarchiques directes et indirectes appropriées avec les équipes d’ingénierie, de produit, de TI, d’exploitation du nuage, de protection de la vie privée, de conformité et d’autres fonctions.
  • Recruter, former, encadrer et fidéliser les talents en matière de sécurité, tout en établissant des rythmes opérationnels clairs et des responsabilités bien définies.
  • Concevoir et gérer des programmes de sensibilisation à la sécurité et des formations adaptées aux rôles pour les employés, les sous-traitants, les utilisateurs autorisés des systèmes, les développeurs, les administrateurs et les cadres supérieurs.
  • Promouvoir une culture dans laquelle la sécurité est considérée comme un facteur clé de la confiance des clients, de la qualité des produits, de la résilience et de la croissance de l’entreprise.
  • Gérer le budget de sécurité, la stratégie de partenariat, les fournisseurs de services gérés et les ressources de sécurité externes.
  • Définir et communiquer des indicateurs de sécurité pertinents, des indicateurs de risque, des mesures de maturité, l’état des contrôles, les progrès en matière de correction, les tendances des incidents, les résultats d’audit, les engagements envers les clients et les indicateurs de gouvernance de l’IA.

La personne que nous recherchons 

  • Un leader stratégique et un bâtisseur capable de définir une vision, de susciter l’adhésion et de mener à bien les projets grâce à son influence.
  • Un dirigeant doté d’une grande crédibilité en matière de communication, capable de faire le point devant le conseil d’administration, de gérer une crise, de mobiliser les clients et d’expliquer des enjeux complexes en termes simples.
  • Un responsable de la sécurité pragmatique qui sait trouver le juste équilibre entre la réduction des risques, le soutien aux activités, les engagements envers les clients, la rapidité et les coûts.
  • Un partenaire collaboratif pour les équipes d’ingénierie, de produit, de TI, des affaires juridiques, de la protection des renseignements personnels, de la conformité, des finances, des ventes, de la réussite client et la haute direction.
  • Un leader calme et déterminé, capable d’agir efficacement dans des situations de forte pression où les enjeux sont importants.
  • Un leader à l’aise pour intervenir concrètement au besoin, tout en mettant en place une équipe et un modèle opérationnel évolutifs.

Qualifications et expérience requises

  • Baccalauréat en sécurité de l’information, en informatique, en technologies de l’information, en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe; une expérience équivalente peut être prise en considération.
  • De 8 à 10 ans d’expérience progressive en sécurité de l’information, en cybersécurité, en gestion des risques technologiques ou dans des disciplines connexes, au sein d’un environnement SaaS, de nuage, technologique, d’assurance, de soins de santé ou d’un autre secteur réglementé.
  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience à un poste de direction ou de haute direction en tant que RSSI, RSSI adjoint, chef de la sécurité ou dans un rôle comparable.
  • Expérience avérée dans la mise en place et l’exploitation d’un programme de sécurité d’entreprise au sein d’une organisation décentralisée ou dont les employés travaillent à distance.
  • Expérience en matière de HIPAA, d’ePHI, d’exigences relatives aux partenaires d’affaires, de protection des données en santé ou d’obligations comparables liées aux données réglementées.
  • Expérience avérée dans la direction d’évaluations des risques de sécurité, d’audits, de programmes de correction et d’activités d’assurance réglementaire ou auprès des clients.
  • Expérience dans la gestion d’incidents majeurs, la gestion de crise, la continuité des activités, la reprise après sinistre et la communication avec la haute direction.
  • Expérience dans la mise en place ou l’exploitation d’un programme de sécurité de l’IA, de gouvernance de l’IA, d’IA responsable, de gestion des risques liés aux modèles ou d’IA générative sécurisée.
  • Solide compréhension du nuage, des modèles d’exploitation SaaS, de la gestion des identités, du chiffrement, de la sécurité des applications, de la gestion des vulnérabilités, de la réponse aux incidents et des risques liés aux tiers.
  • Compétences exceptionnelles en rédaction, en communication orale, en présentation, en négociation et en capacité à influencer les parties prenantes.
  • Capacité avérée à gérer les budgets, les partenaires, les fournisseurs, les priorités et les programmes interfonctionnels complexes.

Qualifications souhaitées

  • Certification CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, CCSP ou équivalente.
  • Expérience avec les normes SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, NIST AI RMF ou des cadres comparables.
  • Expérience en matière de sécurité de l’IA et de l’apprentissage automatique (ML), de sécurité des modèles de langage (LLM), de sécurité des agents, de gestion des risques liés aux modèles, d’évaluations d’impact de l’IA ou d’exercices de simulation d’attaques (red teaming) dans le domaine de l’IA.
  • Expérience dans l’accompagnement des examens de sécurité des clients, des appels d’offres, des renouvellements et des discussions de confiance au niveau de la haute direction.
  • Expérience dans le domaine des technologies de l’assurance, de l’assurance de biens et de responsabilité civile, des technologies de la santé ou d’un autre secteur réglementé à forte intensité de données.
  • Expérience en quantification des risques cybernétiques, en cyberassurance, en chaînes d’approvisionnement logicielles sécurisées, en DevSecOps et en sécurité native du nuage.

Ce que nous vous offrons

Travailler là où vous vous épanouissez

Trouvez l’environnement de travail qui vous convient le mieux, qu’il soit à distance, au bureau ou hybride, en fonction de votre rôle et de votre lieu de travail. Notre approche Flex First Workforce offre de nombreuses possibilités de travail à distance, tandis que certaines équipes suivent des horaires hybrides ou au bureau pour rester en contact et collaborer.

Prenez du temps quand vous en avez besoin

Nous faisons confiance à nos équipes pour gérer leur temps grâce à notre politique de congés ouverts (PTO), ce qui vous permet de vous ressourcer lorsque c’est le plus important.

Des avantages qui commencent dès le premier jour

Dès votre premier jour, vous bénéficiez d’une couverture santé complète et de régimes d’épargne-retraite avec contribution de l’employeur, car nous savons à quel point ces avantages sont importants pour vous.

Vivre nos valeurs au quotidien

Nos valeurs fondamentales sont plus que des mots sur un mur – elles guident la façon dont nous recrutons, développons et conservons les meilleurs talents.

Une intégration primée

De votre premier jour à votre premier anniversaire, notre programme d’intégration est conçu pour vous mettre sur la voie du succès et vous aider à avoir un impact immédiat.

Faites évoluer votre carrière de l’intérieur

Nous croyons en la promotion interne. En fait, plus de 25% de nos postes ouverts sont occupés par des candidats internes.

Un mentorat qui compte

Notre programme de mentorat vous met en contact avec des dirigeants expérimentés qui s’engagent à vous aider à progresser sur le plan personnel et professionnel.

Podcasts Insurity

Découvrez les podcasts de notre équipe Formation et développement pour mieux comprendre les produits Insurity, l'innovation au sein de l'entreprise et son activité dans son ensemble.

Continuez à apprendre, toujours

Alimentez votre croissance en bénéficiant d’un accès complet à LinkedIn Learning et Kaplan – car la formation continue est essentielle à la réussite.

Investissez dans votre avenir – et celui de votre famille

Grâce à notre partenariat avec l’Université du campus mondial de l’Arizona, vous et les membres de votre famille bénéficiez de frais de scolarité réduits pour poursuivre vos objectifs éducatifs à moindre coût.

Touchez une prime pour chaque personne référée

Vous aimez votre emploi? Invitez vos proches à nous rejoindre! Notre programme de primes de recommandation récompense votre contribution à bâtir une équipe exceptionnelle.

Nous avons cinq (5) valeurs fondamentales chez Insurity, dont l'une est d'agir avec intégrité. La transparence des salaires vous aide à prendre la meilleure décision pour vous.  Nous analysons et mettons à jour en permanence nos fourchettes de salaires pour nos postes en fonction des tendances du marché, non seulement pour nous assurer que nos employés sont payés équitablement, mais aussi pour contribuer à combler les écarts salariaux basés sur le sexe, la race et le handicap.  En plus des avantages énumérés ci-dessus, la fourchette salariale pour ce poste est comprise entre216,000 $ et 325,000 $. Nous communiquons un salaire indicatif correspondant au niveau de carrière, mais le salaire réel peut varier en fonction de votre expérience et de vos qualifications. Si votre candidature est retenue, votre recruteur examinera ces détails avec vous lors d'un entretien vidéo.

Langues pour les candidats du Québec : Il faut savoir parler français pour les postes permanents au Québec. L'anglais est nécessaire pour ce poste pour pouvoir communiquer avec les clients, les partenaires et les collègues qui sont tous basés à l'extérieur du Québec. Une formation en français sera offerte aux candidats qui ne maîtrisent pas bien cette langue. 

INSURITY est fière d'être un employeur offrant l'égalité des chances. 

Nous nous engageons à créer un environnement de travail exceptionnel pour tous nos employés en intégrant une culture de diversité, d’équité, d’inclusion et d’appartenance dans le tissu même de notre société. Nous acceptons les différences et la diversité d'identité, d'expérience et de pensée, et nous nous efforçons activement d'adopter des comportements inclusifs dans toute l’entreprise.  

Nous veillerons à ce que les personnes handicapées bénéficient de mesures d’adaptation raisonnables pour participer au processus de soumission de candidatures et/ou d'entrevues, pour accomplir les fonctions essentielles du poste et pour bénéficier des autres avantages et privilèges liés à l'emploi. Veuillez communiquer avec nous si vous désirez une mesure d’adaptation raisonnable. 

Nous vous remercions de l'intérêt que vous portez à Insurity, et de comprendre qu'en raison du volume de candidatures que nous recevons, nous communiquerons uniquement avec les candidats sélectionnés.

jobs.description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such as email, notes, tasks and calendar, and they’re not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world who is not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, and enable high-quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

You will build our digital presence, grow and engage audiences, and drive user acquisition through organic and paid channels.

jobs.title: Head of Account Management
jobs.excerpt: Money stress is the biggest productivity killer in the workplace - My Money Matters exists to change that.
jobs.description:
Money stress is the biggest productivity killer in the workplace - My Money Matters exists to change that. We're building an app that improves employees' finances automatically every pay day - giving them financial tools that directly improve their financial health with less effort.

Every pay day is an opportunity to build better money habits. We make it easy. Employees can accelerate retirement savings with tax-efficient pension top-ups, build a safety net effortlessly with auto savings, or access their already-earned salary ahead of pay day for emergencies.

For employers, fewer employees with money worries means more focus on work. We're trusted by major organisations including the NHS, and we're growing fast.

The role

You’ll lead the team responsible for growing My Money Matters’ revenue across our portfolio of existing employers. You’ll own the commercial outcomes of the function across expansion revenue, renewal conversion and employee adoption, leading and developing a team of Account Managers to deliver these results.

You’ll also manage the Customer Launch Manager, who is responsible for day-to-day launch delivery and managing the launch team. You’ll be accountable for overall launch outcomes as part of the wider customer lifecycle, ensuring customers are set up for success and positioned for long-term growth.

Many of our current customers have our share-cost additional voluntary contribution (SCAVC) pension product, and it is your job to set the strategy that brings them onto our full platform offering, of Payroll Savings and On Demand Pay. We earn when employees use the service, so adoption is growth, and driving adoption at scale, is what we’ll be measuring.

This is a commercially led, target oriented leadership role, reporting into the Commercial Director, with direct line management responsibility across two functions within the post-sale customer lifecycle. This role is hybrid (1-2 days in London) with travel for customer meetings, engagement events and strategy sessions.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own and deliver the expansion target across our portfolio of employers, personally leading the largest or most complex accounts from discovery to close

  • Hire, lead, develop and hold the Account Management team accountable to commercial targets, coaching account planning and deal strategy and reviewing the biggest opportunities.

  • Manage and develop the Customer Launch Manager, setting expectations and holding them accountable for launch performance and outcomes, while giving them ownership of day-to-day delivery and management of the launch team.

  • Build the account planning standard and playbooks the team uses to bring customers from SCAVCs onto the full platform, including On Demand Pay and Payroll Savings

  • Drive employee take-up as a portfolio-wide priority, since usage is what turns contracts into revenue

  • Own renewal outcomes across the portfolio, starting renewal planning 9–12 months ahead of contract end so the platform case is evidenced well before theformal renewal window.

  • Lead negotiation on the largest or most contested renewals, and build the team's fluency in public sector procurement and contractual constraints

  • Maintain a portfolio-wide view of account health, proactively identifying churn risks and putting mitigation plans in place to protect revenue and strengthen customer relationships.

  • Build and hold direct relationships with budget holders and executives across HR, Payroll, Pensions and Finance on the most strategic accounts, turning platform data into a commercial story that lands at C-level

  • Own CRM accuracy, pipeline management and forecasting across the team, ensuring renewals, expansion opportunities and revenue risks are visible and forecasts are reliable.

  • Own the handover between Sales, Launch and Account Management, ensuring clear accountability throughout the customer lifecycle.

  • Represent the account management and launch function with Marketing and Product, and act as the senior voice of the customer internally

Skills and Competencies

  • Strong commercial acumen: spots opportunity, builds the business case, negotiates and closes, and coaches others to do the same

  • Strong people leadership: able to lead, develop and hold both commercial and operational teams accountable for performance, with clear ownership and without close supervision.

  • Consultative and growth-minded, positioning a multi-product solution against customer needs

  • Influences and holds relationships at C-level and senior budget-holder level, personally and through the team

  • Translates product capability into commercial language for a senior, non-technical audience

  • Organised, data-literate and comfortable running a portfolio-wide pipeline and forecast

Experience & Background

  • Proven track record of hitting expansion, upsell or cross-sell targets in an account management or similar commercial role, including experience managing or leading a team

  • Experience owning renewals, ideally moving customers onto broader or multi-product agreements

  • Experience overseeing customer onboarding, implementation or launch processes, with the ability to drive consistency, efficiency and accountability.

  • Experience managing relationships with C-level or senior budget-holder stakeholders

  • Experience building or scaling a commercial team, including hiring, coaching and performance management

  • Experience with complex, regulated or public sector organisations is advantageous but not essential

  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS business, ideally in an adjacent sector (HR, benefits, payroll, financial wellbeing, finance)

How Is Success Measured?

Growth measures come first; retention is the baseline that you and your team protect.

  • Net revenue retention: portfolio growth after churn and contraction

  • Expansion revenue vs target: new team-wide revenue closed from existing accounts

  • Platform conversion rate: share of renewals converting to platform agreements

  • Launch performance: customers launched successfully and within agreed timelines.

  • Employee take up: Share of eligible employees using each product, across the portfolio

  • Gross revenue retention: Revenue kept, before expansion

  • Team attainment: Share of Account Managers hitting their individual expansion target

Our Recruitment Process

Stage 1 | People & Culture Call – An initial conversation about your experience, motivations and what you're looking for in your next role.

Stage 2 | Hiring Manager Interview – An interview with our Commercial Director to explore your experience leading a commercial team in more detail, your approach to the role, and give you the opportunity to learn more about the team and what we're building.

Stage 3 | Practical Exercise – A practical exercise designed to give you the opportunity to demonstrate how you would approach some of the key areas of the role, including team strategy and a major account scenario. You'll be provided with a briefing and any relevant context in advance, so you have time to prepare.

Stage 4 | Leadership – A conversation with a senior leader to discuss your approach to building and running a commercial team, and your fit with the wider business.

Benefits

🇬🇧 Remote working within the UK
Work remotely from anywhere in the UK, giving you flexibility to work where you perform at your best.

🖥️ Home office budget
Receive a £200 annual budget to help you set up and improve your home working space.

🌴 Annual leave
25 days’ annual leave, increasing with tenure, plus the option to purchase up to 5 additional days each year.

🎂 Birthday off
Take your birthday off, because everyone deserves time to celebrate properly.

🤝 Collaborative team bonus
For non-commission roles, you’ll be part of our collaborative team bonus scheme, recognising shared success across the business.

💰 Pension scheme

Access to our pension scheme.

✨ Perkbox salary sacrifice schemes
Access salary sacrifice schemes through Perkbox, including car leasing, gym memberships and tech purchases.

🩺 Medical cashback scheme

Helping with everyday healthcare costs.

👶 Enhanced parental leave

Support during important life moments.

🎉 Team connection
Regular opportunities to connect as a team, including our annual Summer Conference.

jobs.description:
SAE Industry Technologies Consortia (ITC), Performance Review Institute (PRI) and SAE International (SAE), deliver shared solutions to industry's common challenges.

Join us and create a higher standard for a better world.

The Principal Engineer provides general technical and engineering management expertise to the best practices, standards, and technical report development process. Facilitates and manages working groups and/or user forum projects developing applicable industry guidance, standards and technical reports. Business activities include but are not limited to supporting the development, management and marketing of standards & technical reports, qualification/certification programs, referee materials, cooperative research and identifying markets for the same. Supports implementation of company strategy and continuous improvement initiatives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Applies job specific technical/ engineering expertise in project management and product development. Supports industry through demonstrated ability to facilitate and influence task groups to achieve industry desired outcomes
  • Support and perform product development / project engineering tasks for working groups, and/or user forums as assigned, including:
  • Develop proposals for statement of work for new and revised standards & technical reports
  • Support projects, make plans to accomplish goals and facilitate the integration of technical activities
  • Develop industry guidance, standards and technical reports, coordinating responses to industry comments and coordinating with related industry groups and representing the subcommittees and working groups in meetings and forums
  • Support and perform technical oversight report generation/assessment as directed with strict confidentiality and compliance with procedural and regulatory requirements; conduct technical oversight as required; review/update reports; follow up and close non-conformances; ensure effective closure of reports for timely release of documents; provide technical summary reports to the assigned task group; quick elevation of issues for resolution.
  • Supports the work programs of assigned subcommittees and working groups, including technical planning, meeting logistics, facilitation, and meeting report preparation. Function as the focal point for committee activities by writing and issuing agendas and minutes, resolving problems, communicating information, answering inquiries, etc.
  • Plans and conducts technical meetings, prepares materials, and facilitates technical sessions and seminars. Prepares technical meeting reports and presentation of results for industry coordination.
  • Supports the planning of and contributes to the technical sessions at Industry Conferences & Technical Meetings. Support the program communication strategy plan. Provide input to the plan and support workshops, appearances and exhibits, as assigned. Also support and help to coordinate the development of marketing materials, as applicable.
  • Execute straightforward tasks to support leadership committees as assigned and required.
  • Provide limited support of straightforward new initiatives, as assigned. Recommend process improvements for assigned programs. Identify gaps/problems and report to appropriate management. Participates in user-experience research to identify obstacles, improve ease-of-use, customer satisfaction and inform future product and service development, as applicable.
  • Support the program strategic plan through alignment with deadlines, goals, and milestones.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS


  • 6 years’ experience in automotive or automated vehicle engineering, project management, project engineering, or technical management roles.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, quality, science, or business management.
  • Technical/engineering expertise with experience in the areas of responsibility for technical standards use, development, or auditing (automated or automotive industry use preferred).
  • Strong interpersonal and communications skills along with excellent analytical, writing, editing, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to organize effectively, carry out independent action, work on simultaneous assignments, and perform functions of a confidential manner.
  • Strong project management skills.
  • Global and cultural sensitivities.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Strong teamwork, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
  • Understanding of trade association operations.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree in, engineering, science, quality, finance, or business management
  • Role-related certifications.
  • 2 years of experience managing volunteer committees, or similar experience.
  • Strong computer skills including MS Office and typical office application software; Knowledge of software and database systems.

WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Standard business hours with flexibility for global meetings.
  • Remote office with reliable, secure internet connection and proper ergonomic setup.
  • Frequent virtual meetings; occasional travel (up to 30%) for technical conferences or committee sessions.
  • Must maintain a confidential and secure workspace and comply with company data security policies.

#ITC

ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION

SAE Industry Technologies Consortia® (SAE ITC) enables organizations to define and pilot best practices. SAE ITC industry stakeholders are able to work together to effectively solve common problems, achieve mutual benefit for industry, and create business value.

The Performance Review Institute® (PRI) is the world leader in facilitating collaborative supply chain oversight programs, quality management systems approvals, and professional development in industries where safety and quality are shared values.

SAE International® (SAEI) is a global organization serving the mobility sector, predominantly in the aerospace, automotive and commercial-vehicle industries, fostering innovation, and enabling engineering professionals. Since 1905, SAE has harnessed the collective wisdom of engineers around the world to create industry-enabling standards. Likewise, SAE members have advanced their knowledge and understanding of mobility engineering through our information resources, professional development, and networking.

Fullsight is a shared services group working across three affiliate organizations, SAE ITC, SAE International, and Performance Review Institute (PRI), uniformly delivering HR, IT, Legal, Customer Success, Finance, and Procurement services, which enables us to distribute resources across all parts of our businesses.

EEO CLAUSE

Fullsight provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer-Native Mobile Development
jobs.excerpt: About the Role We are seeking a visionary, hands-on Principal Software Engineer to provide enterprise-wide technical leadership across the Financial Services application ecosystem, with particular depth in Spruce native mobile engineering for iOS and Android.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a visionary, hands-on Principal Software Engineer to provide enterprise-wide technical leadership across the Financial Services application ecosystem, with particular depth in Spruce native mobile engineering for iOS and Android. This role will shape technical design, development practices, and engineering quality across mobile applications, backend services, cloud and on-premises infrastructure, data flows, and third-party integrations.

The Principal Engineer will guide the continued evolution from hybrid frameworks to secure, scalable native experiences using Swift and Kotlin; advance practical adoption of AI-assisted engineering through agentic workflows and development best practices; and ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security, reliability, accessibility, and operational standards across all applications.

Serving as a senior technical advisor, this leader will partner with Product, Design, Architecture, Security, Operations, Infrastructure, Data, and vendor teams. The role requires deep knowledge of the Financial Services portfolio and the Block enterprise architecture, sound judgment in buy-versus-build decisions, active participation in vendor and technology reviews, and a strong commitment to mentoring engineers and raising engineering capability across teams.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provide technical vision and leadership across Financial Services applications, with deep ownership of the Spruce native mobile ecosystem and its integration with services, infrastructure, data platforms, and third-party providers.
  • Architect and guide the development of robust, scalable, accessible, observable, and secure native mobile applications using Swift for iOS and Kotlin for Android.
  • Define, evolve, and enforce engineering and architecture standards, including MVVM, Clean Architecture, modular design, API and integration patterns, reusable components, secure coding, performance, resiliency, and cloud-native practices.
  • Ensure enterprise standards are consistently met across applications, including architecture governance, cybersecurity, privacy, regulatory and compliance expectations, accessibility, quality engineering, release management, observability, and production support readiness.
  • Advance AI-enabled software delivery by establishing best practices for agentic workflows, AI-assisted design and development, specification-driven development, test generation, code review, documentation, and responsible use of enterprise-approved AI tools.
  • Identify high-value AI use cases, define guardrails and reusable patterns, measure engineering outcomes, and help teams adopt AI in ways that improve quality, speed, maintainability, and developer experience without compromising security or compliance.
  • Mentor engineers and technical leads through architecture reviews, design sessions, code reviews, pairing, coaching, and communities of practice; build technical depth and encourage continuous learning across teams.
  • Maintain deep working knowledge of Financial Services products and applications, business capabilities, customer journeys, infrastructure, operational dependencies, data exchanges, APIs, event flows, and third-party integrations.
  • Collaborate with Product, Design, Engineering, Architecture, Security, Operations, Data, and other enterprise stakeholders to translate business goals and regulatory needs into cohesive technical strategies and executable solutions.
  • Participate in vendor evaluations, technology assessments, proofs of concept, contract and capability reviews, security and architecture reviews, and ongoing vendor performance discussions.
  • Lead technology selection and buy-versus-build analysis using clear criteria such as strategic fit, customer experience, total cost of ownership, time to market, security, compliance, scalability, extensibility, vendor viability, integration complexity, and operational support.
  • Apply a broad understanding of the Block enterprise architecture to ensure solutions align with approved platforms, shared capabilities, integration patterns, data standards, identity and access controls, infrastructure strategy, and long-term modernization objectives.

The initial focus is WBP's new mobile valuation application, with other development and BAU work as priorities require.

Global Resolution Engineer - NCP SME

Customer Success

WEKA is leading a paradigm shift in how data is stored, managed, and processed in the cloud and AI era. We are a pre-IPO, growth-stage company on a hyper-growth trajectory that has raised over $275M in capital and is backed by dozens of world-class venture capital and strategic investors.

Our flagship product, the WEKA® Data Platform, is a software-based, hybrid cloud solution transforming stagnant legacy data silos into dynamic data pipelines that power GPUs efficiently and fuel performance-intensive workloads like generative AI and machine learning seamlessly and sustainably.

We’re passionate about helping our customers overcome complex data management challenges to accelerate their innovation and help grow their businesses. If you share our passion, we invite you to join us on this exciting journey.

Summary

As a Global Resolution Engineer (GRE) at WEKA, you are the engineer we call when a problem does not fit inside a single ticket. You work across the entire customer solution: GPU and compute servers, clients, the network fabric, the WEKA Data Platform, cloud infrastructure, and the applications driving the workload. You find the root cause rather than the symptom, and you turn every resolution into something that protects the rest of our customer base. GREs bridge Customer Success and Development and act as the technical owner of our most complex escalations, from first analysis through permanent fix.

NCP coverage: this GRE seat carries additional focus on NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) and NVIDIA DGX Cloud accounts, some of the largest GPU environments WEKA runs on. These customers build to NVIDIA reference architectures, measure against NVIDIA acceptance and benchmark tests, and escalate directly to WEKA, often with NVIDIA engineers on the bridge. You will become a subject matter expert for these environments, and part of your schedule extends coverage for NCP accounts outside their regional business hours, working alongside the Premium Services teams that own each account day to day.

Responsibilities:

  • Own complex escalations end to end, from first analysis to permanent fix, including direct engagement on customer bridges during critical incidents
  • Analyze the complete solution stack (application, GPU and compute, client, network fabric, storage, cloud) to isolate root cause across component and vendor boundaries
  • Recognize patterns across cases, customers, and versions; determine the fleet exposure of a defect and drive proactive action before other customers are affected
  • Resolve issues within the team wherever possible; when a code change is required, deliver R&D ready defects with reproduction steps, evidence, and a root cause hypothesis
  • Author and maintain Known Issues, WEKA Technical Advisories (WTA), and Knowledge Base (KB) articles
  • Turn recurring escalations into product and process improvements: feedback to Development, diagnostic gaps, and supportability requirements
  • Build and improve analysis tools and automation that make the entire Support organization faster
  • Mentor Customer Success engineers and raise the technical bar across the Support organization
  • Deliver technical training for Customer Success, new hires, and cross-team knowledge sharing
  • Participate in on-call rotations for 24/7 coverage
  • Act as a subject matter expert for NCP and DGX Cloud environments: reference architectures, acceptance and benchmark tooling (elbencho, wekatester), and joint troubleshooting with NCP and NVIDIA engineers

Required Skills:

  • Systems thinking: the ability to reason about how a change in one layer (network, kernel, storage, application) shows up as a symptom in another
  • Deep Linux expertise: kernel, memory management, NUMA, CPU scheduling, drivers
  • Experience with distributed storage or parallel file systems
  • High performance networking: RDMA, RoCE, InfiniBand, Ethernet
  • Advanced debugging: core dump and log analysis at scale, perf, eBPF, gdb, and the ability to read source code
  • Performance analysis: forming a hypothesis from metrics, then proving or disproving it with data
  • Clear communication with audiences ranging from a customer executive to a WEKA developer
  • Strong sense of ownership and urgency
  • Experience with GPU and AI workloads, GPUDirect Storage, and NVIDIA DGX, SuperPOD, or NCP reference architecture environments is strongly preferred
  • Experience with public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI), Kubernetes, containerization, and virtualization is a plus
  • Knowledge of NFS, SMB, and S3 protocols, DPDK, UCX, and automation tools (Python, Bash, Ansible, Terraform) is a plus

Minimum Qualifications (Education & Experience):

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • 10+ years in advanced technical support, sustaining engineering, SRE, or systems engineering roles with direct customer exposure
  • Proven track record of resolving complex issues in distributed systems
  • Track record of turning individual escalations into systemic fixes: product changes, advisories, or tooling
  • Experience working directly with customers during critical, high visibility incidents
  • Experience partnering with engineering teams on defect resolution, including reproduction and root cause evidence
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Willingness to work flexible hours as part of a global team

You will create pathways for educators to progress from literacy to creator to builder, facilitate peer-to-peer learning, and support distributed leadership so self-organizing collectives can emerge and thrive, all working across diverse cultures, regions, languages, and time zones.

This role is for a self-starter who is deeply engaged with the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem, uses foundation models daily, and understands that transformation happens through community and collective leadership rather than top-down mandates, shifting educators from dependency to agency.

About the Team

This role reports to the Director of the Global Institute and works in close collaboration with the broader Global Institute team — including the Chief Learning Officers and their respective circles, and the Outreach and Engagement team — to build out a shared AI learning agenda. The role also works closely with Teach For All's central team, particularly on technology and communications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Program management: driving delivery of the AI AAA Series and other AI LCC programming, and developing partnerships with frontier AI companies.
  • Community facilitation and growth: building and scaling the AI LCC community across WhatsApp and other platforms, designing learning circles, and identifying power-users.
  • AI integration and innovation: piloting AI-driven tools to summarize, translate, and resource the community at scale.
  • Ethical AI dialogue: facilitating safe-space conversations on data privacy, bias, and responsible adoption.
  • Operations, analytics, and content: tracking community and program health metrics, and producing mobile-first multimedia content.

Project Breakdown & Capacity Allocation

Program Management & Partnerships (45%)

  • Manage delivery of AI LCC programming, including the weekly AI AAA Series featuring thought leaders.
  • Develop and steward partnerships with frontier AI companies (e.g., Anthropic, Google) to support the community's growth.
  • Build pathways for educators to progress from literacy to creator to builder.

Community Facilitation & Growth (35%)

  • Design and moderate structured learning circles where educators share AI prompts, lesson plans, and case studies across languages and contexts.
  • Identify emerging leaders within WhatsApp/Telegram groups and equip them to lead sub-chapters or specialized interest groups.
  • Guide community expansion from WhatsApp into platforms like Discord or a custom Teach For All platform, laying the foundation for a future Teach For All community platform.

Operations, Analytics & Content (20%)

  • Develop and track community and program health metrics capturing engagement depth, learning outcomes, and impact.
  • Collect and amplify "bright spot" stories from educators for Teach For All's global communications.
  • Maintain a content calendar across platforms, producing original multimedia content optimized for mobile.

Qualifications

  • Experience managing program delivery and/or building, scaling, and managing high-engagement digital communities, particularly on social-first platforms such as WhatsApp, Telegram, or Discord
  • Demonstrated experience with distributed or facilitative leadership models, empowering members to take ownership rather than relying on top-down moderation
  • Experience developing partnerships, ideally with technology or AI companies
  • Deep, hands-on experience with foundation models (e.g., Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT, Midjourney) and practical prompt engineering skills in educational or professional contexts
  • Experience creating multimedia content (video, graphics, guides) and familiarity with tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or equivalent
  • Comfort using data and community analytics to track engagement, sentiment, and learning outcomes
  • Experience working across global, cross-cultural, and multi-time-zone contexts
  • Strong alignment with Teach For All's mission and a commitment to educational equity
  • Spanish fluency or working proficiency is a plus

What Teach For All Offers:

  • Commitment to cultivating a culture in which all staff members feel they belong, are valued for their contributions, and have an impact on our organization’s progress
  • Professional and personal development experiences and ample opportunities to make a positive impact on the work of Teach For All and beyond
  • Comprehensive benefits package designed for your well-being and work-life needs
  • Generous time off and flexible work arrangements
  • And much more!

Application Instructions

If this opportunity sounds like the next best step in your career, please submit your resume or curriculum vitae (CV) and a one-page letter of motivation (in English) directly online. Your letter should summarize motivations for your application and how your skills and experience align with the terms of this opportunity. We look forward to learning about you and your passion for ensuring educational opportunity for all!

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Therefore, candidates are encouraged to apply at their earliest convenience.

Work authorization

This position does not offer employment visa sponsorship, immigration assistance, or support for work permits or residency applications. To be considered, candidates must already possess valid work and residency authorization to work in the country of hire at the time of application.

Compensation

Salary for this position is competitive and dependent on country of hire and prior work experience and includes a comprehensive benefits package.

Travel and Hours

Travel up to 30% of the time may be required. Given that we work across different time zones, some non-traditional hours for early or later calls are an expectation of this role.

About Teach For All

Teach For All is a global network of over 60 independent, locally led organizations and a global organization united by a commitment to developing collective leadership to ensure all children can fulfill their potential. Each network partner recruits and develops promising leaders to teach in their nations’ under-resourced schools and communities and, with this foundation, to work with others, inside and outside of education, towards a world where all children have the education, support, and opportunity to shape a better future. Teach For All’s global organization works to increase the network’s impact by supporting the development of new organizations; fostering network connectivity and learning; providing coaching and consulting; and enabling access to global resources for the benefit of the network.

About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

Abridge's has multiple products - the core product is ambient clinical notes, but we’ve expanded surfaces: billing, clinical decision support, orders, nursing, etc. Measuring quality reliably and iterating fast without breaking clinician trust sit at the core of every single product’s success.

The Evals team owns the tooling, templates, and consultation that product teams use across the eval lifecycle: curate, build, iterate, and deploy. This builds the strategy, platform, and process that enables evals to be fast, trustworthy, consistent, and a true moat.

We are hiring a Product Manager to lead this platform. You will work with 10+ teams and partner closely with engineering, ML, data science, and clinician science. You will help set the standard for how Abridge measures AI quality, decide what the platform builds, and make evaluating a new model cheap and routine as frontier models ship frequently.

What You'll Do

  • Drive product strategy and execution for the evals platform. Own the roadmap across the eval lifecycle and own outcomes against it.

  • Build the shared measurement infrastructure. Help build the systems that let any pod define quality, run experiments, compare models, and watch production. Own the standards for LLM judges, rule-based evaluators, human annotation, and online monitoring, and be clear about where each belongs.

  • Make model selection fast and routine. Give teams a repeatable way to evaluate a new frontier model within days of release, and a defensible framework for when a post-trained specialty model is worth it over a prompted frontier one. Keep the eval system model-agnostic so it stays a neutral referee.

  • Own the operating model across pods. Define the eval gates from early build through GA and steady-state monitoring, which gates are hard versus advisory, and who owns non-negotiable floors like critical-error rates. Land this across pods you don't own, without formal authority.

  • Cross functional execution. Work with Data Engineering on the de-identification pipeline, Data Science on bootstrapping judge quality with less human annotation, Clinical Science on flagged production cases, and the agent platform team as workflows go agentic.

  • Operate with a high bar for quality, speed, and accountability.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience with significant ownership of ML powered products or platform systems.

  • Deep understanding of how to measure and improve model quality, including evaluation frameworks, annotation pipelines, and benchmark design.

  • Strong technical fluency across ML, data pipelines, and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with ML researchers and engineers to drive impact in production.

  • Ability to balance long term architectural investments with near term quality improvements.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear decisions and narratives.

  • A track record of delivering high quality products in domains where accuracy, reliability, and trust are paramount.

Bonus Points If…

  • You have experience building evaluation platforms, ML observability systems, or quality measurement pipelines.

  • You have worked in clinical, healthcare, or regulated environments with a high bar for accuracy and compliance.

  • You have worked on specialty specific or domain specific model adaptations.

  • You have worked on personalization systems, context ingestion frameworks, or ambient intelligence products.

  • You have experience shipping large scale ML products with human in the loop workflows.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. jobs.description:
We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer with deep expertise in healthcare data to join a pioneering team building data products that enable world-leading research. Whether your experience comes from academia, healthcare, biotech, or a fast-growing health-tech startup, you'll bring a strong understanding of healthcare data standards such as OMOP or FHIR, alongside the technical leadership required to be a Senior Engineer.

In this role, you'll design and build scalable data pipelines that transform complex health records into trusted, research-ready datasets used by scientists and researchers tackling challenges with global significance. You'll work at the intersection of engineering, data science and epidemiology, helping to establish best practices, shape technical direction and create reusable, high-quality data products that can operate at industrial scale.

If you're a senior engineer who enjoys solving complex data challenges, influencing how healthcare data is curated and delivered, and making a meaningful impact on research that improves lives, we'd love to hear from you.

Our Future Health will be the UK’s largest ever health research programme, bringing people together to develop new ways to detect, prevent, and treat diseases. Diseases like cancer, dementia, diabetes, and heart disease affect the lives of many people in our communities. Our goal is to create a world-leading resource for health research, to improve our understanding and spot the patterns of how and why common diseases start, so treatments can begin sooner and be more effective.

Our plan is to bring together 5 million volunteers from right across the UK who will be asked to contribute information to help build one of the most detailed pictures we have ever had of people’s health. Researchers will be able to use this information to make new discoveries about human health and diseases. So future generations can live in good health for longer.

What you'll be doing:

  • Designing and building scalable data pipelines that ingest healthcare data from multiple providers into trusted research environments and data platforms.
  • Developing and maintaining data transformation logic in Python to create high-quality, curated and research-ready datasets.
  • Contributing to complex, shared codebases while following engineering best practices including code reviews, testing and clean coding standards.
  • Collaborating with data scientists, epidemiologists, software engineers and product teams to understand requirements and deliver impactful data solutions.
  • Processing large-scale healthcare datasets and implementing robust data quality, validation and governance controls.
  • Transforming and harmonising healthcare data into common data models such as OMOP and FHIR to support research and analytical use cases.
  • Creating reusable, scalable and maintainable data products that enable efficient consumption by multiple stakeholders.
  • Communicating effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders to translate complex requirements into practical engineering solutions.
  • Producing clear and comprehensive technical documentation covering data pipelines, transformation logic, architecture and operational processes.
  • Supporting the design, scoping and implementation of data flows across the wider healthcare data ecosystem.
  • Leveraging cloud and big data technologies, including Azure, Databricks, Spark and Data Lakes, to deliver high-performing data solutions.
  • Adopting and promoting data engineering best practices, healthcare data standards and continuous improvement across the team.
  • Keeping abreast of emerging trends, technologies and standards within healthcare, research and data engineering to drive innovation and excellence.

Requirements

To succeed in tis role you will need to demonstrate some of the following:

  • Proven Data Engineering experience within complex, large-scale data environments.
  • Experience designing, building and maintaining scalable, reliable data pipelines that process large volumes of data from multiple sources.
  • Experience working with healthcare data across academia, healthcare, life sciences, health technology or related sectors.
  • Knowledge of healthcare data standards and common data models, including OMOP and/or FHIR.
  • Experience transforming and remodelling data between different Common Data Models (CDMs).
  • Understanding of healthcare terminologies and ontologies, including SNOMED CT, ICD-10 and Read Codes.
  • Experience contributing to shared codebases and developing reusable, maintainable data solutions.
  • Proficiency in Python and software engineering best practices.
  • Good command-line and Unix/Linux skills.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms, ideally Microsoft Azure.
  • Experience using technologies such as Spark, Databricks and data lake architectures.
  • Knowledge of data storage and transformation formats such as Apache Parquet and Delta Lake.
  • Experience with containerisation and orchestration technologies, including Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience using Git/GitHub and working within collaborative development environments.
  • Experience working within Agile delivery teams.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary from £74,000 per annum
  • Generous Pension Scheme – We invest in your future with employer contributions of up to 12%
  • 30 Days Holiday pro rata + Bank Holidays – Enjoy a generous holiday allowance with the flexibility to take bank holidays when it suits you
  • Enhanced Parental Leave – Supporting you during life’s biggest moments
  • Cycle to Work Scheme – Save 25-39% on a new bike and accessories through salary sacrifice

jobs.excerpt: The Opportunity:We are seeking a Principal level GNSS / PNT Systems Engineer to provide technical leadership in architecting, developing, and validating advanced test solutions for CRPA antennas, GNSS receivers, and next generation LEO/MEO PNT signals.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity:

We are seeking a Principal level GNSS / PNT Systems Engineer to provide technical leadership in architecting, developing, and validating advanced test solutions for CRPA antennas, GNSS receivers, and next generation LEO/MEO PNT signals. In this role, you will define system level test strategies, lead complex RF/signal simulation architectures, and shape the technical direction of future PNT capability development. You will work across RF, digital signal processing, and algorithm teams to ensure our PNT solutions meet the highest performance and resiliency standards expected in contested and evolving operational environments.

Our Technology:

Safran Federal Systems provides Resilient Positioning, Navigation and Timing (R-PNT) solutions and custom engineering services to U.S. Government agencies, defense organizations and their contractors. Safran Federal Systems is authorized to work on the full spectrum of U.S. Government classified and unclassified projects, in addition to supporting strategic partnerships for key defense PNT technologies.

How I will Contribute:

  • Serve as the technical authority for end‑to‑end test architecture development supporting qualification of CRPAs, GNSS receivers, and multi-orbit PNT signal sources.
  • Develop and oversee complex scenario models—dynamic Doppler environments, orbital visibility profiles, threat scenarios, and mission-representative degradation conditions.
  • Architect advanced RF test configurations involving multi-channel GNSS/LEO/MEO simulation systems, phase-coherent distribution, interference injection, and precision timing frameworks.
  • Drive the creation and validation of new-signal simulation capabilities for emerging LEO/MEO PNT systems, alternative waveforms, and hybrid PNT constructs.
  • Lead high-level analysis of spatial processing performance, including beamforming, nulling, interference mitigation, and multi-element calibration.
  • Evaluate receiver performance: sensitivity, tracking dynamics, anti-jam/spoof robustness, and multi-orbit signal fusion.
  • Lead major lab and field test campaigns, setting technical objectives, ensuring data quality, and guiding root-cause analyses.
  • Provide technical leadership for design reviews, program capture efforts, roadmap planning, and customer engagements.
  • Mentor engineering teams, including active mentoring of junior engineers.
  • Maintain awareness of evolving PNT threats, multi-orbit architectures, CRPA advancements, and industry standards.

What You Bring to Safran Federal Systems:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Physics, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in GNSS/PNT system engineering, RF test development, receiver/antenna integration, or advanced PNT research.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership in CRPA systems, phased-array testing, and spatial signal processing.
  • Deep expertise with GNSS and non-GNSS signals, including next-generation LEO/MEO PNT concepts.
  • Strong proficiency with multi-channel signal simulators, RF vector generators, spectrum analyzers, and PNT‑specific test environments.
  • Proven ability to architect complex test frameworks and guide teams in their implementation.
  • Advanced modeling and analysis experience with MATLAB, Python, or equivalent environments.
  • Proficiency in C++ for simulation tooling, systems integration, or high-performance processing modules.
  • Experience with PNT architecture, orbital modeling, time-transfer techniques, and high-dynamic signal simulation preferred.
  • Expertise in CRPA calibration, array manifolds, interference threat modeling, and advanced jamming/spoofing scenarios preferred.
  • Familiarity with PNT resiliency techniques and MIL‑STD environmental/qualification testing preferred.
  • Experience with hardware‑in‑the‑loop (HIL) simulation systems preferred.
  • Active or eligible security clearance, preferred.
  • Strong communication skills, with a track record leading cross-disciplinary engineering efforts and influencing design direction.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Positive attitude, willingness to learn.
  • Ability to move throughout the office to access file cabinets, office equipment, etc.
  • Ability to remain in a stationary position approximately 50% of the time.

About Safran Federal Systems:

Safran Federal Systems has been awarded as a Winner of the USA Today and Rochester Metro Area Top Workplaces 2026 Award.

In 2022, Safran acquired Orolia, now Safran Trusted 4D, the world leader in Resilient PNT. At the intersection of critical infrastructure and national defense, Safran Trusted 4D solutions govern and protect the integrity of systems that shape the world. In early 2019, Orolia Defense & Security spun off as a separate entity from its parent company Orolia, with the mission of providing resilient Positioning, Navigation and Timing (PNT) solutions and custom engineering services to U.S. Government agencies, U.S. Defense organizations, and their contractors.

In August of 2019, Safran Federal Systems acquired Talen-X, a U.S. company specializing in advanced GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System) Simulation solutions and Interference, Detection, and Mitigation (IDM) technologies. Talen-X's portfolio was an ideal fit and has helped to enhance Safran FS's overall offerings. The acquisition enabled Talen-X's existing resources, operations and capabilities to be scaled and accelerated to better support the warfighter. Read the press release here.

​

Safran Federal Systems operates as a proxy-regulated company, Free of Foreign Ownership, Control, or Influence (FOCI). As such, Safran FS Defense & Security is approved to work on the full spectrum of U.S. Government classified and unclassified projects and is positioned to support strategic partnerships in the development of key PNT technologies for the defense market.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Please note this description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Salary: $160,000-$195,000
