jobs.description:
About Proactis Ltd
Proactis Ltd is a global software company that provides cloud-based Source-to-Pay (S2P) procurement and spend management solutions through a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) model. Its platform enables organisations to digitally manage and automate the entire procurement lifecycle, including supplier sourcing, tendering, purchasing, invoice processing, and payment, within a single integrated system. By centralising procurement and finance activities, Proactis helps organisations improve operational efficiency, strengthen financial control, ensure compliance, and gain greater visibility over organisational expenditure. The SaaS delivery model allows customers to securely access the system via the cloud, reducing the need for internal IT infrastructure while benefiting from scalability and regular updates. Proactis primarily serves service-led and regulated sectors, including public sector bodies, housing associations, financial services, education, and professional services, where effective spend control, transparency, and supplier management are essential. Its solutions support organisations in modernising procurement processes, reducing administrative burden, improving accuracy, and enabling more informed, strategic financial and procurement decision-making.

Job Purpose: Technical Account Manager at Proactis Ltd is the dedicated technical point of contact for a defined set of existing customer accounts, bridging the gap between the customer’s technical environment and Proactis’s product, implementation, and support teams. This role exists to resolve the technical friction that blocks adoption, stalls migrations, and - if unaddressed - creates real renewal and churn risk.
Working across Account Management, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Engineering, the Technical Account Manager provides hands-on technical guidance on integrations, data management, migrations, platform upgrades, and configuration issues. They bring product depth to triage problems independently, identify the correct internal path, and work cross-functionally to provide solutions minimising internal escalations.
The Technical Account Manager will join recurring customer calls as the technical voice, lead initial investigations of suspected bugs and platform issues, own data extract and export requests, and support integration, migration, and upgrade workstreams end-to-end. Success in this role requires a blend of technical capability, customer-facing confidence, and commercial awareness- understanding precisely when an unresolved technical issue becomes a retention risk that the wider team needs to act on.

Key Accountabilities/BAU Objectives:What
Measures
Technical issue triage and resolution support:
  1. Serve as first-line technical reviewer for suspected bugs, platform issues, and configuration queries raised by existing customers - conducting structured initial investigations before escalating to Engineering, Professional Services or Product
  2. Own data extract, data export, and data migration requests end-to-end across assigned accounts, working with internal technical teams to deliver accurate, timely outputs that meet customer specifications
  3. Maintain a structured log of open technical issues per account, tracking status, ownership, and resolution timelines - communicating proactively with customers on progress to prevent escalation and ensuring
  4. Average time to initial triage of reported technical issues
  5. First-contact resolution rate (issues resolved at TAM level before Engineering/PS escalation)
  6. Data request on-time delivery rate
  7. Open issue age - average days to resolution per account

Integration, migration and upgrade support:
  1. Act as the technical point of contact for integration-related topics across assigned accounts, including PunchOut (cXML/OCI), EDI/XML, REST/SOAP APIs, ERP touchpoints (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite), and catalogue management -guiding customers through configuration, testing, and issue resolution
  2. Support migration-related work and remediation activity, working alongside Professional Services and Implementation teams to ensure technical workstreams are scoped correctly, tracked, and delivered on schedule
  3. Handle upgrade-related questions and technical blockers, preparing customers for version and environment changes, identifying compatibility risks early, and coordinating the appropriate internal resource to clear blockers before they impact go-live or renewal timelines
  4. Integration issue resolution rate and time-to-resolution
  5. Migration remediation tasks completed on time and within scope
  6. Upgrade blocker clearance rate and escalation rate to Engineering

Customer technical engagement and commercial alignment:
  1. Join recurring customer calls as the dedicated technical point of contact, providing confidence, clarity, and forward momentum on open technical workstreams — ensuring customers never feel technically stranded
  2. Develop a deep understanding of each assigned customer’s technical environment, integration landscape, ERP configuration, and internal workflows — using this knowledge to anticipate issues before they surface and act as a credible technical advisor
  3. Work closely with Account Managers and the Renewals Manager to flag technical issues that create renewal or churn risk, providing clear commercial framing so the wider team can act proactively and protect revenue
  4. Customer satisfaction with technical support (CSAT/NPS - touchpoints)
  5. % of at-risk technical issues flagged to AM/Renewals >45 days before renewal
  6. Recurring customer call attendance rate and post-call action closure rate

Professional Skills / Qualifications / Experience

3+ years in a Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Implementation Consulting, or Solutions Engineering role within a SaaS or enterprise software environment; direct experience working with existing customers on technical workstreams
Hands-on experience with integration technologies relevant to the Proactis platform, including APIs (REST/SOAP), EDI/XML, PunchOut (cXML/OCI), ERP integrations, and catalogue management - able to troubleshoot independently without requiring Engineering involvement for standard queries
Proven experience supporting data migration, data extract/export, or technical remediation projects: comfortable working with structured data, understanding data mapping requirements, and coordinating multi-party technical workstreams to a deadline
Strong technical troubleshooting skills and structured problem-solving approach: able to reproduce and document issues clearly, triage root cause, and identify the correct internal escalation path - reducing escalations for Engineering whilst keeping customers informed
Confident communicating technical topics to non-technical stakeholders: equally comfortable in a customer call, a written technical update, or an internal cross-functional discussion - adapting depth and language to audience without losing accuracy

Behaviours/Core Values

Technically curious and self-directed: proactively builds deep product knowledge, stays current on platform changes and releases, and brings a structured investigative mindset to every issue rather than defaulting to escalation
Customer-confident under pressure: comfortable joining customer calls as the sole technical voice, managing expectations when issues are unresolved, and building credibility quickly with both technical contacts and senior stakeholders
Commercially aware: understands that unresolved technical issues translate directly into churn and renewal risk; proactively bridges the gap between technical and commercial teams rather than treating these as separate concerns
Highly organised and accountable: tracks every open issue with rigour, communicates status updates consistently, and closes the loop on every workstream - customers and colleagues always know where things stand
Collaborative and escalation-savvy: works effectively across Engineering, Support, Professional Services, and Account Management to resolve issues independently escalating as appropriate

jobs.description:
About Powerfleet

Powerfleet (Nasdaq: AIOT; JSE: PWR) is a global leader in the artificial intelligence of things (AIoT) software-as-a-service (SaaS) mobile asset industry. With more than 30 years of experience, Powerfleet unifies business operations through the ingestion, harmonization, and integration of data—regardless of source—and delivers actionable insights to help companies meet their strategic objectives around Safety, Compliance, Efficiency and Sustainability. Our people-first culture and relentless innovation empower customers to achieve measurable, sustainable business improvements. Powerfleet serves over 2.6 million subscribers across more than 48,000 customers in 120 countries, with commercial operations across every major continent.

About the Role

The Sr. Director, North America Logistics is responsible for leading all logistics operations across the region, including warehousing, transportation, inventory, and trade compliance. This role is critical to ensuring operational efficiency, cost control, and high service levels.

The ideal candidate is a strategic and hands-on leader with experience managing complex, multinational logistics networks. They will work closely with cross-functional teams—including Sales, customer support, Planning, and Supply Chain—to align logistics operations with business goals, drive continuous improvement, and enhance customer experience.

Key Responsibilities

Logistics & Operations Management

  • Oversee warehousing and inventory operations across North America to ensure accuracy, efficiency, and compliance.

  • Manage air, sea, and ground transportation, optimizing delivery performance and cost.

  • Lead all international trade and customs processes in alignment with global compliance standards.

  • Drive effective reverse logistics programs to improve return processes and asset recovery.

  • Manage operations across multiple remote locations and outsourced logistics providers.

Customer & Commercial Alignment

  • Collaborate with Sales, Customer Support, and other business units to ensure logistics supports customer commitments and service level agreements.

  • Build logistics solutions with a customer-first mindset, ensuring reliability and responsiveness.

Operational Excellence

  • Define and track logistics KPIs to drive accountability and visibility across operations.

  • Lead process improvement initiatives with a focus on lean logistics and continuous improvement.

  • Identify and implement network optimization and cost-saving opportunities.

Systems, Tools & Analytics

  • Utilize ERP and Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) to drive accuracy and operational performance.

  • Leverage data analytics tools and Excel to support forecasting, planning, and performance evaluation.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Lead and develop a high-performing logistics team across various locations.

  • Promote a culture of operational ownership, collaboration, and accountability.

  • Manage remote teams and collaborate with global logistics and supply chain counterparts.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in logistics, distribution, or supply chain managerial roles within multinational environments.

  • Proven success leading large-scale logistics operations across North America.

  • Proven experience managing 3PL’s.

  • Strong understanding of international trade, customs compliance, and transportation networks.

  • Hands-on experience with ERP and WMS systems; advanced Excel skills required.

  • Demonstrated success in process improvement and lean logistics initiatives.

  • Strong leadership and team development skills, including managing remote and cross-functional teams.

  • Bachelor's degree in supply chain, Business, or related field; Master’s degree preferred.

  • Willingness to travel to Tampa to visit logistics location on a monthly basis.

The annual salary range for this full-time position is$150,000 - $200,000USD. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, skills, and location.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Epidemiologist, Oncology, Real World Evidence (FSP Sponsor Dedicated)

Job Location: San Francisco, California, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Location: United States, home-based, West Coast


Join IQVIA's Sponsor-Dedicated FSP team and help advance healthcare through real-world evidence. We bring together scientific expertise and real-world data to help sponsors make decisions and accelerate evidence generation to improve patient outcomes.


In this role, you'll work closely with one sponsor, gaining deep knowledge of its therapies while leveraging IQVIA's global expertise.


Overview

As a Senior Epidemiologist supporting a sponsor-dedicated oncology program, you will independently execute real-world evidence initiatives that inform early clinical development. Your work will focus on using RWE to characterize the natural history of disease, assess disease landscapes, evaluate study feasibility, and support Phase 1-3 clinical development programs, with a primary emphasis on ovarian cancer and additional work in lung cancer. This is a hands-on execution role for an experienced epidemiologist who can take ownership of assigned work with limited supervision and operate effectively within a pharmaceutical environment.


Responsibilities

  • Independently plan and execute epidemiology and real-world evidence activities supporting early clinical development programs across Phases 1-3.
  • Use real-world data and epidemiologic methods to describe the natural history of disease and characterize oncology disease landscapes.
  • Conduct feasibility assessments to evaluate research questions, available data, study populations, endpoints, and potential study approaches.
  • Develop and contribute to study protocols, analysis plans, study reports, clinical study reports, and other scientific deliverables.
  • Support regulatory-grade real-world evidence studies, applying appropriate epidemiologic rigor and documentation standards.
  • Provide hands-on epidemiology execution for ovarian cancer programs and contribute to lung cancer studies as assigned.
  • Interpret study findings and communicate methods, assumptions, limitations, and results clearly to sponsor stakeholders and cross-functional partners.
  • Manage assigned work proactively, resolve execution issues, and deliver high-quality outputs with minimal oversight.
  • Work effectively within a sponsor-dedicated model, collaborating with sponsor teams across functions and time zones.

Requirements

  • PhD in Epidemiology is required.
  • Demonstrated experience applying epidemiology and real-world evidence to Phase 1-3 clinical development programs.
  • Prior pharmaceutical industry experience is required.
  • Knowledge of regulatory-grade real-world evidence expectations and rigorous observational research methods.
  • Demonstrated oncology epidemiology experience, including ovarian cancer; lung cancer experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience conducting natural history, disease landscape, and study feasibility work using real-world data.
  • Experience developing study protocols, clinical study reports, and related epidemiology deliverables.
  • Proven ability to work independently, take ownership of assigned studies, and execute with limited supervision.
  • Strong scientific writing, analytical, project management, and stakeholder communication skills.

What's in it for you?

  • Be part of a forward-thinking team that helps shape the next generation of evidence-based healthcare.
  • Work hand-in-hand with one leading sponsor, gaining deep expertise in its therapies and development programs.
  • Access IQVIA's global network and scientific community to support your continued growth.

This is your chance to make an impact while building a career that matters.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

IQVIA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by applicable law.

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

jobs.description:
About Us

QISG leverages Quanta’s comprehensive resources to deliver collaborative solutions for our partners' energy infrastructure needs. We use in-house talent, expertise and resources to plan, design, engineer, manage, conduct maintenance on and construct projects.

Our turnkey service capabilities provide our customers with efficiency, consistency, attention to detail and safe execution. The QISG team brings together Engineering, Safety, Quality, Material Procurement, QA/QC, Right-of-Way Acquisition, Scheduling, Environmental Planning, Permitting, Title and Land Management expertise that ensure outstanding results for our clients.

About this Role

Job Title: Supervising Engineer - Transmission Line

At QISG, our Transmission Line teams play a vital role in the safe, reliable, and efficient delivery of power across communities and regions. We design, build, maintain, and upgrade high-voltage transmission infrastructure that supports the backbone of the electric grid. Whether working on new construction, line upgrades, or critical maintenance, our teams ensure projects are executed with the highest standards of safety, quality, and performance. Our work involves both traditional methods and the latest industry innovations to deliver sustainable, cost-effective, and reliable solutions for our customers.

The Supervising Engineer will oversee the planning and design of high voltage infrastructure projects. This role involves managing a team of engineers and designers to ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and in compliance with all relevant regulations and standards. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in civil, mechanical, or electrical engineering, with extensive experience in high voltage infrastructure projects.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and manage projects from inception to completion, including planning, design, permitting, construction support, and closeout.
  • Supervise a team of engineers, designers, and support staff, providing guidance, training, and performance evaluations.
  • Oversee the preparation of engineering designs, specifications, and plans for utilities infrastructure projects such as electrical substations and transmission lines.
  • Develop and manage project budgets, monitor expenses, and ensure cost-effective solutions.
  • Ensure all projects comply with local, state, and federal regulations and standards, including environmental and safety requirements.
  • Coordinate with stakeholders, including government agencies, contractors, and the public, to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Implement and oversee quality control procedures to ensure the highest standards of workmanship and materials.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed project status reports, engineering documentation, and records.

What You'll Bring

  • Minimum of 7 years’ experience in the electric utility industry performing engineering related duties and/or management for high voltage projects.
  • Bachelor of Science degree (B.S.) or Graduate degree in Engineering from an ABET accredited university.
  • P.E. license required.
  • Proven track record of successfully leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and delivering complex projects on time and within budget.
  • Strong technical expertise in structural, civil, electrical, or mechanical engineering, with a comprehensive understanding of engineering principles and practices.
  • Expert knowledge of electric utility engineering and construction standards.
  • Knowledge of utility industry processes including scheduling, contracts, coordinating and managing all disciplines.
  • Knowledge of process and procedures for project controls and estimates.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting external customers.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams, clients, and external partners.
  • Knowledge of relevant industry codes, standards, and regulations, including ANSI, ASTM, ACI, AISC, NEC, NESC, and others.
  • Able to deal with ambiguity and ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks and determine priorities in a complex environment.

What You'll Get

  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Holiday Pay
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage
  • Pet Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Professional Development
  • Tuition Assistance

Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

What You’ll Do:

  • Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.
  • Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.
  • Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.
  • Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.
  • Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.
  • Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.
  • Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

About Us

Bonterra exists to propel every doer of good to their peak impact. We measure that impact against our vision to increase the giving rate as a percentage of GDP from 2% to 3% by 2033. We know that this goal is lofty, but we are confident that the right technology and expertise will strengthen trust in the sector, allowing the social good industry to accelerate growth and reach peak impact. Bonterra's differentiated, end-to-end solutions collectively support a unique network of over 20,000 customers, including over 16,000 nonprofit organizations and over 50 percent of Fortune 100 companies. Learn more at bonterratech.com.

About the Role

The HR Business Partner serves as the primary day-to-day HR resource for employees, managers and senior managers within assigned Operational client groups, delivering HR support independently across employee relations, performance and talent processes, organizational changes, HR administration, and workforce data. The role applies knowledge of HR policy, processes, and applications to make independent decisions on routine matters within policy, and takes direction from and escalates enterprise-level, precedent-setting, and high-risk matters to the Sr. Director, HR Business Partner. Consistent with Bonterra's AI-first approach, this role uses AI tools where appropriate to draft documentation, analyze people data, and streamline recurring HR work, while applying human judgment and safeguarding confidentiality and data privacy in all people decisions.


Essential Functions

  • Serve as the first line of HR support for employees and managers in assigned client groups, responding to questions on policy, team structure, career paths, and leveling, and escalating enterprise-level, precedent-setting, or high-risk issues to the Sr. Director, HR Business Partner.
  • Partner with senior leaders in assigned client groups, as directed by the Sr. Director, to translate business priorities into people actions such as workforce planning, headcount and capacity discussions, and organizational health, using data on attrition, engagement, span of control, and hiring and promotion trends to diagnose issues and support recommendations.
  • Execute reorganizations, restructures, and reductions in force at the direction of the Sr. Director, including role and org-chart documentation, HRIS updates, notification logistics, and audience-specific communications and talking points for executives, managers, and impacted employees, coordinating with Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Finance, and Legal to align structure, hiring, and compensation.
  • Manage employee relations intake, documentation, and investigations from open to close, coach managers and employees on resolution, and maintain complete case files; escalate complex or high-risk matters, including terminations and severance, to the Sr. Director and Legal before action is taken.
  • Handle day-to-day labor relations for collectively represented employee populations, where applicable, including grievance handling and bargaining support, and escalate labor strategy and significant matters to the Sr. Director in partnership with Legal.
  • Run the performance management cycle for assigned client groups, including calibration management, promotion and leveling documentation, and compensation guidance to managers in partnership with Total Rewards; escalate complex talent decisions to the Sr. Director.
  • Coach managers on team dynamics, difficult conversations, performance, and change, and develop templates, tools, and playbooks that extend manager capability beyond one-on-one support.
  • Execute HR administration independently, including new hire, transfer, leave, compensation change, and separation transactions, applying knowledge of HR policy, processes, and applications to ensure accuracy and timeliness.
  • Provide case guidance and work review to Associate HRBPs on administrative and employee relations tasks, without formal reporting lines, to maintain quality and consistency of HR delivery.
  • Run and analyze reports in Workday and other HR applications on a recurring basis and ahead of leadership discussions to identify trends in attrition, engagement, employee relations, hiring, and promotion, and present findings with recommendations.
  • Identify opportunities to automate, template, or accelerate recurring HRBP work using AI tools, and apply them responsibly with attention to data privacy, confidentiality, and appropriate use in people decisions.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit-ready records, and ensure policies are applied consistently and in compliance with federal, state, and local requirements.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

LEADERSHIP & NAVIGATION EXPECTATIONS

  • This position does not have people management responsibilities.

KEY BEHAVIORS – THE “HOW”

  • Applies knowledge of HR policy, employment practices, and HR applications to resolve routine and complex matters independently within policy, and brings a data-informed perspective to manager and employee issues. Solves intricate people problems with creativity and develops practical methods, templates, or tools that improve how HR work gets done. Exercises discretion with confidential information, tailors communication to employees, managers, and senior leaders, and builds strong partnerships by sharing knowledge with peers, including informal guidance to Associate HRBPs. Recognizes the limits of independent authority and escalates enterprise-level, precedent-setting, and high-risk matters to the Sr. Director in a timely manner.

OUTCOME EXPECTATIONS – THE “IMPACT”

  • Employees and managers receive timely, sound, and consistent HR support. HR administration is accurate and runs without close oversight. Employee relations, labor, and organizational change matters are documented and escalated at the right time, reducing legal and reputational exposure. People data and reports are accurate and inform leader decisions. Recurring HR work is completed faster and at higher quality through responsible use of AI tools, and the work directly supports major business outcomes within assigned client groups.

Required Minimum Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of HR generalist practices, including employee relations, performance management, organizational change, HR administration, and compensation and leveling concepts.
  • Working knowledge of federal, state, and local employment laws and the ability to apply policy consistently.
  • Proficiency with HRIS and HR applications, such as Workday, and the ability to run and interpret HR reports.
  • Prior experience in an HR generalist or HR business partner capacity supporting employees and managers, including HR administration.
  • Ability to investigate and document employee relations matters objectively and maintain confidential case files.
  • Ability to coach managers and employees through difficult conversations and deliver messages with credibility and care.
  • Ability to analyze people data and present findings and recommendations to leaders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to tailor messages to different audiences.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to document work accurately and in audit-ready form.
  • Sound judgment and discretion with confidential information, and the ability to recognize when to escalate.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently within defined policy in a fast-paced, changing environment.
  • Willingness to use AI tools in HR work, with an understanding of data privacy and confidentiality expectations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5 – 8 year HR experience including 3-5+ years of HR generalist or HR business partner experience, including HR administration and HR applications.
  • Experience in a high-growth, B2B SaaS, or technology environment.
  • Experience supporting reorganizations, restructures, or reductions in force, including notification logistics and communications.
  • Experience supporting employee relations investigations in partnership with Legal.
  • Experience with union or collectively represented employee populations, including grievance handling.
  • Experience supporting global or distributed workforces, including multi-country employment considerations.
  • Experience supporting performance calibration, talent reviews, and compensation guidance.
  • Proficiency with Workday and people analytics tools, and experience applying AI tools to HR work.
  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • HR certification (for example, SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR).

At Bonterra, we’re innovating with a higher purpose: to increase giving to 3% of US GDP by 2033, creating $573 billion more in global impact every year. General Summary:

U.S. Urology Partners, LLC (USUP) and its physician groupsare committed to promoting conduct that is responsible, ethically sound, and compliance with applicable law. USUP’s Compliance Department (CD) fosters a corporate culture of ethical behavior and integrity in all matters related to compliance with the laws and regulations that govern the delivery and reimbursement of health care. An integral function of USUP’s compliance program is auditing and monitoring compliance with billing, coding, and documentation requirements of its providers. An CPC, CCS-P, or CPMA is required for this position.

Compliance Audit Services:

Compliance audit initiatives include physician, other providers, and facility documentation audits as well as preparation of guidance documents and tools to assist physicians and staff in appropriate billing, coding, and documentation. The audit program looks at professional fee billing, coding, and documentation as well as other areas that are identified by the CD. The audits to be performed each year are identified based on the then-current Office of Inspector General Workplan, its Compliance Guidance’s, and compliance risk analyses.

Reporting to the Compliance Director, the Compliance Audit Analyst is responsible for the timely and effective completion of Health Care Integrity Program documentation audits and risk assessment projects for coding, documentation and billing accuracy as identified by the organization, CD, and the Office of the Inspector General. The specifics of the audits are outlined in related annual work plans created by USUP’s CD and communicated to USUP’s leadership team.

Essential Functions:

  • Conduct physician/provider and facility documentation audits.

  • Ensures accuracy of data entered into the CD Internal Audit Database and prepares reports for audited providers, department leadership, and organization leadership.

  • Analyze audit data and provides summary feedback to clinic and billing staff, making recommendations for improvement.

  • Works with the billing and coding departments to determine charge corrections and refunds resulting from compliance audits.

  • Works closely with the billing department to help minimize denial issues so that appropriate reimbursementsare achieved.

  • Receives and responds to audit, documentation, and coding reviewrequests from the billing department.

  • Performs research for numerous billing and coding scenarios.

  • Provide input in the development and improvement of procedures used to complete the audit function.

  • Assist in conducting formal/informal education sessions for the purpose of educating and training physicians, non-physician providers, and other staff.

  • Identifyadditional opportunities to improve education of physicians, non-physician providers and staff.

  • Working with the billing and coding departments, prepare and produce billing/coding/documentation communication for use as guidance documents, website content, newsletter content, education content, and other communication channels.

  • Develop materials for use in education and communication derived from audit findings for feedback to physicians, department billing staff, and other compliance staff.

  • Based on types of questions/issues received, identify education/awareness opportunities and guidance topics.

Other Functions:

  • Position requires an individual with expertise in health information and clinical documentation audits.

  • Adherence to internal audit schedule and other deadlines is necessary.

Qualifications:

  • Experience with using and navigating through an electronic medical record system.

  • Knowledge of state, federal, local, and payer-specific regulations and policies pertaining to documentation, coding, and billing is required.

  • Demonstrated capacity to work independently in an organized, detailed manner while maintaining a collaborative team environment is required.

  • Ability to think abstractly and concretely required.

  • Ability to develop reports, presentations, and spreadsheets required.

  • Strong computer skills including the ability to effectively use software applications such as Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, Access, and Internet Explorer isrequired.

  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills isrequired.

  • Experience in handling complex organizational projects; and an excellent problem identification and solution skill to address difficult, complex issues is required.

  • Ability to gain the trust and confidence of the providers, compliance team and billing staff.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in health administration, health information management, or another related field preferred. CPC, CCS-P, or CPMA, required.

Experience

Minimum of three years of experience in healthcare compliance, healthcare operations, coding and/or documentation auditing in a healthcare organization is preferred.

Work Hours:

This is a remote position, typical work hours for the Compliance Auditor Analyst will be Monday through Friday 8:30 A.M. until 5:00 P.M. with a half hour meal break. When normal business hours are extended due to practice needs the Compliance Billing Auditor may be requested to provide coverage.

Candidate must be located in the EasternUnited States and be willing to travel as needed.

Work is normally performed in anoffice setting and requires prolonged sitting.

Physical requirements needed to perform the job are eye-hand coordination and manual dexterity sufficient to operate a keyboard, photocopier, telephone, calculator, and other office equipment. Requires normal range of hearing and eyesight to record, prepare and communicate appropriate documents.

Compassion

Make Someone’s Day

Rankona Mazon AB is seeking a proactive and organized Executive Assistant to support our fast-growing Amazon agency. As the Executive Assistant, you will play a critical role in streamlining our operations, preparing bookkeping and and lighter financial tasks for the accounting firm and facilitating effective communication within our team and with external partners.

Your primary focus will be to manage the schedules and priorities of our CEO, enabling him to concentrate on strategic initiatives. This position requires a detail-oriented individual with exceptional organizational skills who can handle a variety of tasks and adapt to a dynamic work environment. You are also an innovative and curious person who are using AI to be more effecient and productive.

You will need to possess excellent communication abilities and be comfortable interacting with stakeholders at all levels. Ideal candidates should thrive in a fast-paced atmosphere and have a strong drive to contribute positively to our agency's success.

In addition, you will be responsible for managing project timelines, coordinating meetings, and preparing important documents that are necessary for presentations.

You understand SoMe, LinkedIn in particular, and want to help the CEO and the agency to grow the following and increase the views of the communication continously.

You are open to evolve in the role and together with the CEO develop and finetune your role and your tasks as the agency grows.

If you are motivated by collaboration and have a passion for supporting a vision in the rapidly evolving e-commerce landscape, and if you like working with a CEO with great visions and ideas that have too much on his plate, this is an exciting opportunity for you to grow with us at Rankona Mazon AB.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the CEO's schedule and appointments efficiently.
  • Prepare and manage correspondence, reports, and documents for the executive team.
  • Find, sort and prepare income and expenses to the accounting firm.
  • Prepare financial and KPI reports for the board.
  • Coordinate meetings and events, ensuring all logistics are handled smoothly.
  • Serve as a liaison between executives and internal/external stakeholders.
  • Schedule, prepare and conduct performance meetings with the employees, followed by reporting.
  • Help building a talent database for future hires and keep them warm.
  • Find, interview and vet future hires before introducing them to the right teams for the final part of the hiring process.
  • Making sure the different teams are following their processes and get their tasks done in time.
  • Making sure the teams are using ClickUp to measure their hourly input on each client and to create reports that show our profitability per client.
  • Conduct research and compile data for strategic decision-making.
  • Assist in the preparation of presentations and important documentation.
  • Maintain a filing system and database for efficient information retrieval.
  • Get AI summaries from some of the CEO's meetings and compile actionable to-dos including delegating to responsible teams and make sure things get done within set timeline.
  • Helping the CEO making the agency more effecient with AI and automations.
  • Conducting some of the CEO's meetings to screen potential cooperation partners, future hires or other opportunities.
  • Helping planning, creating and scheduling some of the agency's and CEOs SoMe.
  • Setting upp, planning, creating and scheduling the agency's email newsletter.
  • Making sure our employees understands and lives our core values - every day.
  • Helping build company culture and create teambuilding and relation building activities.

Requirements

  • Proven experience as an executive assistant or in other administrative roles.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities to manage various tasks.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Teams.
  • Experience in bookkeeping preparing (receipts, invoices, income/expenses)
  • An understanding of company financials to be able to prepare financial reports to the board.
  • Experience in using Canva (or similar design programs and a will to learn Canva).
  • Experience in using AI (or a will to quickly learn how to use it), such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Jasper etc.
  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with e-commerce platforms, especially Amazon, is a plus, but not necessary.

Benefits

Rankona Mazon AB is the only Amazon agency in the Nordic that has reached the Platinum level in the Amazon Agency program in EU. We are a full-service agency that help other brands to succeed on Amazon globally.

We are innovative and continously strive to be the best in our industry with cutting edge Amazon knowledge and focus on delivering sales results and profitability for our clients.

The CEO is an authority within the field with 13 years of experience of selling on Amazon where he has built 5 private label brands on Amazon's marketplaces before founding Rankona Mazon. He is the founder of the Amazon event amaNordic and the Amazon course KNAA. He is also the author of the book Lyckas på Amazon "Succeed on Amazon" and is the go to person for Nordic news and industry media when it comes to questions regarding selling on Amazon.

Joining Rankona Mazon offers you the chance to work completely remotely, emphasizing results over the number of hours you personally commit. We value freedom and flexibility, allowing you to choose your work location, determine your working hours (provided you attend scheduled meetings), and actually decide how many hours you will work (as long as you achieve the desired outcomes). This free role demands an individual who is self-driven and possesses the motivation and self drive to complete tasks effectively while achieving positive outcomes and results.

Our core values are important to us and is something we want each Rankona Mazonian to live every day:

• Always Ahead, Providing WOW Experiences (we want clients & employees to be WOWed)

• Stand Out, Remain Humble (we always dare to stand out in our industry, being the beacon people are following or being the nail in the eye, but we are always humble in the same time)

• Embracing our entrepreneurial spirit (we want everyone to act like an entrepreneur which creates innovation)

• Using the Alexandrian solution to all “impossible” challenges (Nothing is impossible, there are always solutions)

• Always Caring

About the job - Part time initially

We are initially looking for a part time solution. Together with the growth of the agency the goal is to make this a full time job.


Possible Background Checks
Please note that we may do a background check conducted in accordance with the provisions of POPIA upon hiring. We do not do any background checks before any written consent from the applicant.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionThis is a remote/virtual position.  Candidate can be based anywhere within Canada.
jobs.description:
Description

This is a remote/virtual position. Candidate can be based anywhere within Canada.

Sargent & Lundy Consulting (SLC) works on behalf of clients to support electric power projects. We evaluate and optimize technical, commercial, environmental, and financial aspects of the projects for a variety of clients.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will help work on large, isolated power systems integrating equipment such as gas turbines, BESS, reciprocating engines, and other generating technologies with large dynamic electrical loads.

We are seeking a Controls & Grid Integration Planning Engineer to support Owner’s Engineer and design teams on large, isolated power systems integrating equipment such as gas turbines, reciprocating engines, BESS, Solar PV, with large dynamic loads. The role will provide independent technical oversight of plant control philosophies, ensuring that OEM, EPC, and system integrator designs collectively deliver stable, resilient, and compliant operation under steady-state, transient, and islanded conditions. The engineer will review and challenge dynamic studies, control narratives, plant controller strategies, and protection philosophies without directly performing detailed PSS®E or PSCAD modeling. Responsibilities include validating integration between GT controls, BESS EMS/PPC systems, SCADA, and overall coordination strategies (frequency response, voltage control, inertia management, black start, load rejection, and large motor/data center step loads).

The position requires strong cross-disciplinary leadership, risk identification capability, and the ability to translate complex control interactions into clear recommendations for owner and lender stakeholders.

Your responsibilities will include engineering design reviews, technical due diligence, project development support, and conceptual design. Particular experience in electrical design of thermal power projects is desired.

You will have the opportunity to travel within North America as well as internationally.

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in Canada for this position.

This position may require access to U.S. export-controlled information. As such, candidates must be a citizen of a country listed in Appendix A to Part 810 of the Code of Federal Regulations. Please click here to determine your eligibility.

  • Essential skills and experience:

    • This position requires a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering
    • 10+ years’ experience in power generation controls, grid integration, or utility-scale plant systems
    • Demonstrated experience with islanded or isolated grids
    • Strong understanding of dynamic performance studies (transient stability, EMT, frequency response), even if not the primary modeler
    • Familiarity with gas turbine control systems (e.g., Mark VIe or equivalent) and BESS plant/energy management systems, power plant controllers
    • Experience reviewing EPC deliverables, grid code compliance documentation, and performance guarantees
    • Knowledge of protection coordination and system-level control architecture
    • Strong communication skills for engagement with developers, OEMs, lenders, and regulatory bodies
    • Experience in development support and conceptual design of thermal power projects:
      • Simple cycle gas turbines,
      • Combined cycle projects,
      • Coal fired generation, or
      • Reciprocating engines (RICE)

Valued but not required skills and experience:

  • Master's degree in electrical engineering is a plus.
  • Experience in technical due diligence and owner’s engineering design reviews of thermal power projects is a plus.
  • General understanding of power station operations and performance reviews is a plus.
  • General understanding of process design at electric power generation facilities is a plus.
  • Contract development experience is a plus.
  • Reliability modeling experience is a plus.

Technology & Innovation

Sargent & Lundy values the appropriate use of technology to improve how work gets done and deliver high-quality outcomes for our clients. Depending on the role, employees may use data, automation, artificial intelligence, and other digital tools to support research, analysis, engineering and design activities, workflow improvement, or other aspects of their work. We value candidates who demonstrate an interest in learning and effectively using emerging technologies where relevant to their role. Employees remain accountable for their work and are expected to apply appropriate professional judgment and review when using technology-assisted tools. Experience with AI, automation, programming, or similar technologies is valued where relevant but is not required unless specifically identified elsewhere in the job description.

Award-Winning Benefits

At Sargent & Lundy, we care about the health and well-being of our employees. Our commitment extends beyond the workplace, offering comprehensive healthcare plans and generous paid time off to support our team members in every aspect of their lives. We understand the importance of work-life balance, which is why we are proud to provide competitive, award-winning benefits. Our dedication to employee satisfaction has earned us the prestigious Top Workplaces Culture Excellence Award for compensation and benefits in 2022, 2023, and 2024.

Compensation Range

$130,193 - $179,016

Transparency Statement

This posting is to fill an existing vacancy. Sargent & Lundy discloses compensation ranges that comply with all provincial and federal legislation. The total compensation package for eligible positions will include a base salary or an hourly rate and a comprehensive benefits package, reflecting our commitment to rewarding performance and supporting the overall well-being of our employees. Individuals may also be eligible to participate in our yearly discretionary bonus.

Equal Opportunity

Sargent and Lundy is fully committed to abiding by all equal opportunity employment standards. Our employment policies strictly prohibit all forms of discrimination on any of the grounds in relevant laws. All our employment practices are solely based on individual merit and our organization's needs at the time. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. We embrace the responsible use of artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance the candidate experience and streamline our recruitment process. AI-enabled tools may support certain stages of recruitment, but human judgment remains central to the candidate experience, and all hiring decisions are made by human reviewers.

1. JOB PURPOSE / SUMMARY

The QA/QC Engineer is responsible for implementing and maintaining the Quality Management System (QMS) for oil & gas projects. This role ensures that all products, materials, and processes comply with client specifications, applicable codes, industry standards, and regulatory requirements. The engineer will oversee inspection, testing, documentation, and non-conformance control to guarantee project integrity and safety.

2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Quality Assurance (QA)

  • Develop, implement, and maintain project-specific Quality Plans, Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), and procedures in line with ISO 9001 and API Q1/Q2.
  • Conduct internal and external quality audits (suppliers, subcontractors, project phases).
  • Manage document control for quality records – ensure latest revisions of drawings, specs, and standards are used.
  • Lead root cause analysis and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) for non-conformances (NCRs).

Quality Control (QC)

  • Oversee day-to-day inspection activities (incoming, in-process, final) for equipment, piping, structural, and welding works.
  • Coordinate and witness NDT (Non-Destructive Testing) such as UT, RT, MT, PT.
  • Review material test certificates (MTCs) and ensure traceability.
  • Verify welding procedures (WPS/PQR) and welder qualifications.
  • Monitor coating, painting, and insulation quality as per project specs.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Prepare and review QA/QC reports, test packages, and final handover dossiers.
  • Ensure all documentation meets client and regulatory requirements (e.g., ASME, API, ASTM, BS).
  • Maintain logs for NCRs, inspection requests, calibration records, and personnel certifications.
  • Liaise with client representatives and third-party inspection agencies.

Coordination & Reporting

  • Coordinate with engineering, procurement, and construction teams to resolve quality issues.
  • Provide QA/QC training and guidance to site teams.
  • Report quality performance metrics and KPIs to management.

3. QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS

Essential

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Metallurgical, Civil, or related field).
  • Experience: Minimum 5+ years of QA/QC experience specifically in oil & gas projects (onshore/offshore, pipelines, refineries, or petrochemicals).
  • QMS Knowledge: Hands-on experience with ISO 9001 and API Q1/Q2.
  • Inspection & Testing: Proven experience in inspection, testing, and documentation control.
  • NDT & Standards: Strong knowledge of NDT techniques (UT, RT, MT, PT) and industry standards (ASME Sec V, VIII, IX; API 1104; AWS D1.1; etc.).
  • Software: Proficient in MS Office and quality management software (e.g., LIMS, QMS tools).

Język: Angielski

Opis stanowiska:

Nasz klient, wiodąca firma holdingowa specjalizująca się w digitalizacji roszczeń samochodowych za pomocą AI, poszukuje Senior DevSecOps Engineer z silnym naciskiem na aspekty SecOps. Ich centralna platforma łączy różnych dostawców, usprawniając ścieżkę klienta i czyniąc proces bardziej efektywnym i przyjaznym dla użytkownika.

Środowisko pracy:

Klient wykorzystuje najnowocześniejsze technologie do utrzymania i zabezpieczania swojej infrastruktury:

  • Platforma chmurowa: AWS z Kubernetes do wdrażania mikroserwisowej architektury.
  • Monitorowanie i logowanie: Datadog dla kompleksowej obserwowalności.
  • Bezpieczeństwo: Cloudflare Zero Trust do zabezpieczania dostępu do zasobów wewnętrznych.
  • Analiza danych: Snowflake i AWS do zaawansowanej analizy danych.
  • Postawa bezpieczeństwa: Prisma Cloud od Palo Alto dla zaawansowanych środków bezpieczeństwa.

Twoje główne zadania:

  • Konfiguracja Prisma Cloud: Ustawienie ram zgodności i tworzenie alertów dla istotnych informacji o bezpieczeństwie. Zapewnienie przestrzegania najlepszych praktyk bezpieczeństwa w usługach chmurowych.
  • Rozwój infrastruktury: Wspieranie inicjatyw Infrastructure as Code za pomocą Terraform. Współpraca z zespołami w celu automatyzacji i usprawnienia operacji.
  • Zarządzanie tożsamością: Audyt i konfiguracja dostawców tożsamości, takich jak Okta i Microsoft Entra ID, w celu zapewnienia bezpiecznego zarządzania dostępem.
  • Przegląd bezpieczeństwa: Przeprowadzenie corocznego przeglądu bezpieczeństwa wymaganego przez spółkę matkę, obejmującego kompleksową ocenę 300 pytań.
  • Ciągłe doskonalenie: Śledzenie najnowszych zagrożeń bezpieczeństwa i rozwiązań. Dostarczanie praktycznych wniosków i rekomendacji dotyczących ulepszania środków bezpieczeństwa.
  • Współpraca: Ścisła współpraca z zespołami rozwoju, operacji i danych w celu integracji bezpieczeństwa w cyklu życia oprogramowania (SDLC).

Czego szukamy:

  • Mentalność startupowa: Proaktywność i innowacyjność, zdolność do przewidywania potrzeb i sugerowania usprawnień bez oczekiwania na instrukcje.
  • Ekspertyza w zakresie bezpieczeństwa chmury: Silne zrozumienie architektury chmurowej, z naciskiem na identyfikowanie i łagodzenie luk w zabezpieczeniach.
  • Znajomość sieci komputerowych: Biegłość w koncepcjach sieciowych, w tym IP, routingu, SSL, firewallach i web application firewallach.
  • DevOps z naciskiem na bezpieczeństwo: Specjalista DevOps z solidnym zapleczem w zakresie bezpieczeństwa, zdolny do poprawy infrastruktury jako kodu w celu zwiększenia jej bezpieczeństwa. Zdolność do udziału w ulepszaniu infrastruktury (tworzenie nowych modułów).
  • Zgodność z przepisami: Zdolność do zrozumienia wymagań bezpieczeństwa od ISO (Information Security Officer) i przekształcenia ich w wymagania techniczne na AWS i Prisma Cloud oraz realizacja wdrożeń.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Doświadczenie z narzędziami takimi jak Terraform i GitLab do zarządzania infrastrukturą i procesami CI/CD.
  • Certyfikacje: Certyfikat AWS Security Specialist lub Palo Alto PCCSE będzie dodatkowym atutem.
  • Śledzenie raportów bezpieczeństwa: Bieżąca znajomość najnowszych zagrożeń i podatności. Wykorzystanie Prisma Cloud do tworzenia odpowiednich alertów przy wykryciu problemów i priorytetyzacja ryzyka na podstawie potencjalnego wpływu.

Dołącz do naszego klienta i bądź częścią zespołu, który wykorzystuje najnowocześniejsze technologie do usprawniania i zabezpieczania procesów roszczeń samochodowych. Aplikuj teraz, aby wnieść swój wkład w rewolucjonizowanie branży!

jobs.description:
Alternative Payments is building the financial operating system for SMBs, consolidating the disconnected tech stack that holds service-based businesses back. Starting with MSPs, we've spent five years perfecting accounts receivable, and we're now expanding into accounts payable, AI-powered analytics, and beyond. We're at an inflection point: closing the loop on money movement and laying the foundation for a platform that will reshape how service businesses operate financially.

We're growing fast, thinking big, and building a global team that wants to be part of something that lasts. We believe the best solutions come from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and a shared obsession with customer impact. If you're energized by real problems, real customers, and real impact, we want to hear from you!

What we’re looking for

We’re seeking a Head of Product to join our Product team and own the full product vision across our growing AI platform, spanning accounts receivable, accounts payable, and analytics.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives on cross-functional ownership and technical depth, and wants to take a hands-on role in shaping product strategy, raising the bar for the PM team, and driving innovation that connects data, AI, and payments into a coherent product experience.

This role is available to candidates eligible to work in New York or Toronto, hybrid.

What you’ll do

  • Own the product roadmap across AR, AP, and analytics: understanding how these products intersect and where the gaps create friction for customers and engineering.

  • Manage and grow a team of product managers and product designers, overseeing product design scope across the organisation.

  • Work closely with PMs to sharpen PRDs and bring technical rigour to requirements, acting as the bridge between product and engineering when needed.

  • Define and own the future product vision for Alternative Payments, synthesising market signals, customer insight, and company strategy into a coherent roadmap.

  • Implement AI thoughtfully across the product organization, not just for workflow efficiency, but as a genuine product capability that creates value for partners.

  • Propose and establish best practices for how the product team operates: discovery, prioritization, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration.

What you’ll bring

  • 10+ years of product experience, with meaningful time in financial technology (payments, lending, or money movement) or a vertical SaaS company with large payments revenue contribution.

  • Proven experience managing product managers and designers across a multi-product portfolio.

  • Technical enough to read a system design doc, challenge an engineering estimate, and help PMs write PRDs that engineering teams trust.

  • Fluency with AI as a product capability: you can articulate how you’ve implemented AI in a product org, not just team tooling, but as a product surface.

  • Conceptual depth with AI technology: familiarity with embeddings, RAG, and agent-based architectures at a level that earns engineering credibility.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to write clean strategy docs and run tight leadership reviews.

Nice to have

  • Experience managing design across an organization (product design + marketing design + sales collateral).

  • Prior experience transitioning product ownership from a founder — navigating that trust-building and handover process.

  • Track record of raising the technical floor in a PM team through coaching, process changes, or targeted hiring.

  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment where the roadmap evolves quickly.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary tailored to your experience, skills, and expertise.

    • The base salary range for this role is $160K–$250K, plus equity. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the approximate total target compensation for the position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors including relevant skills, experience, education/training.

  • Equity opportunities so you can share in our growth and success.

  • Unlimited PTO and flexibility when you need it the most.

  • Yearly learning & development stipend to help you grow and do your best work.

Why Choose Alternative Payments?

At Alternative Payments, you’ll do work that truly matters.

  • Own your impact: Lead meaningful, high-impact projects and collaborative initiatives that are shaping the future of FinTech and redefining how businesses get paid.

  • Collaborate: Work with a diverse, innovative team where every voice is heard and great ideas come from anywhere.

  • Grow with us: Your career journey is top of mind. We prioritize internal growth and give you the space to shape your path based on your goals — whether that’s deepening your expertise in your domain or exploring something new.

  • Thrive in a supportive culture: As a scaling start-up, there’s a lot to be done and initiative is key. We believe in shared learning, open communication, and building each other up. When one of us grows, we all do.

Want to see what we're actually building?

We made a short video so you don't have to take our word for it. Get a glimpse of our product, our people, and the problems we're solving, then decide if it sounds like your kind of place.

Our Values

  • Transparency & Honesty: We communicate openly and truthfully with partners, investors, and each other so everyone understands where we stand and where we’re headed.

  • Resourcefulness & AI: We stay scrappy, find creative solutions, and make progress even when the path isn’t obvious. We have a bias for action and seek out the information and resources necessary to make decisions and move quickly.

  • Partnership: We win and lose together. We collaborate with our partners, investors, and teammates to tackle big challenges and reach shared goals.

  • Revolutionary & Boldness: We challenge conventions, take calculated risks, and build better, stronger solutions that move our business and the industry forward.

  • Accountability: We take ownership of our decisions and results. We follow through on our commitments knowing our work directly impacts our partners, our team and our business.

Applying to Alternative Payments

We’re looking for candidates who are ready to step in and make an impact from day one. We know that sometimes people hold back unless they meet every requirement, but if you’re excited about the role, bring relevant experience, and are ready to contribute, we want to hear from you!

All resumes are reviewed by our small but mighty talent team. While we may use AI tools to help prioritize applications, real people are behind every resume review and hiring decision. We’re also committed to an inclusive and accessible process. If you require reasonable accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know upon being selected to interview.

jobs.excerpt: Statistiker:in (m/w/d)Ab 4. 500 € brutto / Monat · Klare Steigerung nach Ergebnissen · Kleines Team, große Verantwortung Worum es gehtWir begleiten Mediziner:innen durch ihre Promotion — von Methodik über Auswertung bis zur fertigen Dissertation.
jobs.description:
Statistiker:in (m/w/d)

Ab 4.500 € brutto / Monat · Klare Steigerung nach Ergebnissen · Kleines Team, große Verantwortung

Worum es geht

Wir begleiten Mediziner:innen durch ihre Promotion — von Methodik über Auswertung bis zur fertigen Dissertation. Unsere Klient:innen sind keine Studenten, sondern erwachsene Profis, die liefern müssen. Du bist die Person, die dafür sorgt, dass das passiert.

Konkret heißt das: Du übernimmst Projekte von der ersten Methodendiskussion bis zur finalen Abgabe. Du analysierst Daten (R, Python, SPSS, MAXQDA — je nachdem, was das Projekt verlangt), überarbeitest wissenschaftliche Texte, erklärst Doktorand:innen Methoden ruhig und klar, gibst Feedback, hältst Termine ein und triffst Entscheidungen, ohne dass jemand dich an die Hand nehmen muss.

Ehrlich gesagt

Wir sind ein kleines Unternehmen mit hoher Schlagzahl und hoher Effizienz. Wir brauchen sorgfältige, einsatzbereite und belastbare Leute, die methodisch sauber arbeiten, überdurchschnittlich verdienen wollen und in einem wachsenden Unternehmen von Anfang an dabei sein wollen.

Im Gegenzug bekommst du etwas, das ein Konzern nicht bieten kann: Vom ersten Tag an eigene Projekte, direkten Kundenkontakt, sichtbare Wirkung, und einen Aufstieg, der sich an deinen Ergebnissen bemisst und nicht an deiner Betriebszugehörigkeit.

Was du machst

  • Mediziner:innen durch den kompletten Promotionsprozess führen — Methodik, Statistik, Schreiben, Struktur

  • Statistische und qualitative Auswertungen liefern (R, Python, SPSS, MAXQDA)

  • Doktorand:innen Methoden geduldig und klar erklären — schriftlich und im Gespräch

  • Wissenschaftliche Texte überarbeiten, Feedback geben, methodische Sauberkeit sicherstellen

  • Mehrere parallele Projekte koordinieren — Termine, Qualität, Kundenkontakt

  • KI- und Automatisierungstools so einsetzen, dass du schneller und besser wirst als ohne

  • Mit Professor:innen, Lehrstühlen und Forschungsstellen sauber kommunizieren

Was du mitbringst

  • Hochschulabschluss (Bachelor oder Master) in Statistik, Psychologie (empirisch/quantitativ), Sozialwissenschaft (quant), Wirtschaftsmathematik, BWL mit Empirie-Schwerpunkt, Mathematik, Public Health (quantitativ) oder vergleichbar. Eine Promotion ist nicht erforderlich und gibt hier keinen Bonus.

  • Strukturierte, methodische Arbeitsweise. Du planst, bevor du loslegst. Du arbeitest sorgfältig statt hektisch. Du erkennst Inkonsistenzen in Daten oder Texten, die andere überlesen.

  • Bodenständigkeit. Du hast in deinem Leben schon einmal richtig gearbeitet — Gastro, Bau, Pflege, Pflichtdienst, Lager, Versorgerjobs, körperliche Tätigkeiten neben dem Studium. Wer einmal eine 10-Stunden-Schicht in der Küche oder auf der Baustelle gemacht hat, weiß, was ehrliche Arbeit bedeutet

  • Aktuelle Statistik-Praxis. Du hast in den letzten 12 Monaten konkret mit R, Python, SPSS oder MAXQDA gearbeitet — nicht nur im Studium.

  • Erfahrung im Erklären von Methoden — als Tutor:in, Nachhilfelehrer:in, Übungsleiter:in, Werkstudent:in im Lehrstuhl-Umfeld oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle. Wer Lernenden schon einmal Statistik ruhig erklärt hat, bringt das wichtigste Soft-Skill mit.

  • Emotionale Stabilität. Wenn ein:e Klient:in panisch wird, bleibst du ruhig. Wenn drei Mandate parallel brennen, sortierst du methodisch, statt dich anstecken zu lassen. Du nimmst Fehler sachlich, nicht persönlich.

  • Eigenverantwortung und Verbindlichkeit. Du strukturierst deinen Tag selbst, hältst Deadlines ein, lieferst zuverlässig — auch wenn niemand drüberguckt.

  • Belastbarkeit in intensiven Phasen — keine Schönwetter-Mentalität.

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau — du musst Texte korrigieren und gegenüber Senior-Klient:innen klar, aber respektvoll argumentieren können.

  • Lust auf Privatwirtschaft, nicht auf Uni-Atmosphäre.

Berufserfahrung von Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Wir nehmen auch Berufseinsteiger:innen mit starkem Tutor-Track. Mit 2-5 Jahren Berufserfahrung in datenorientierten Bereichen (Marktforschung, Pharma-Innendienst, Junior Analytics, klinische Studien) bist du im Vorteil.

Was wir bieten

  • Geld: Ab 4.500 € brutto, reale Steigerung in den ersten 6–12 Monaten nach Ergebnissen

  • Aufstieg nach Leistung: Wer liefert, kommt schnell hoch — Zugehörigkeit zählt nicht

  • Echte Verantwortung: Eigene Projekte, eigene Kunden, eigene Entscheidungen — ab Tag 1

  • Profi-Umfeld: MacBook, moderne Tools, KI-Stack — keine Bastellösungen

  • Klare Strukturen: Max. 2–3 Personen pro Büro, keine Konzernpolitik, keine Meetings ohne Zweck

  • Entwicklung: Methodisch, technisch und unternehmerisch — du wächst hier real

Wen wir nicht suchen

Wir suchen keine Akademiker:innen, die in der Forschungsblase bleiben wollen. Keine Theoretiker:innen, die sich in Details verlieren, ohne zu liefern. Keine Leute, die "Work-Life-Balance" auf das Stundenkonto reduzieren. Wer langsam, unzuverlässig oder konfliktscheu ist, wird hier nicht glücklich — und wir auch nicht.

Wir suchen jemanden, der ruhig, methodisch und ergebnisorientiert arbeitet — und dafür entsprechend bezahlt werden will.

Bewerbung

Schick uns Lebenslauf und ein aussagekräftiges und persönliches Anschreiben.

  1. Warum du in eine kleine Firma willst — nicht in einen Konzern oder die Uni.

  2. Was du in den nächsten 12 Monaten konkret erreichen möchtest.

Relevante Arbeiten, Code oder Projektbeispiele gerne dazu.

Unvollständige Bewerbungen sortieren wir aus. Bei passenden Bewerbungen melden wir uns innerhalb von 5 Werktagen.

The Customer Care Specialist is a key member of the National Customer Care team, responsible for delivering exceptional service to internal warranty teams and homeowners within their assigned area. This role manages customer interactions across multiple communication platforms—including phone, email, chat, and SMS.
Immersed in the company’s “Love the Customer” culture, the Customer Care Specialist collaborates with cross-functional teams to address customer inquiries, create service tickets, and ensure timely follow-up on outstanding issues. This position also supports proactive customer outreach efforts, maintains accurate records of customer interactions, and operates proficiently across various software platforms. The Customer Care Specialist is expected to demonstrate strong relationship-building skills, attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while upholding company policies and service standards.

This position is Remote and open to candidates in Arizona.

Job Details

What You’ll Do

We trust that as a Customer Care Specialist you will:

  • Handle inbound customer inquiries via phone, email, chatbot, SMS, and internet chat, including warranty questions, emergencies, and escalated issues.
  • Proactively return customer calls and conduct outbound communication to gather feedback, confirm completed work, and follow up on unresolved matters.
  • Execute outbound calls for the Love Connection program and survey collection efforts.
  • Create warranty service tickets from webform submissions and other channels.
  • Aid and encourage submission of warranty requests through the Customer Portal.
  • Record, distribute, and manage customer escalations by division within the SharePoint system
  • Manage escalated customer issues with professionalism, collaborating with Customer Experience Managers and cross-functional departments.
  • Generate and distribute Power BI reports for survey outreach.
  • Collaborate with divisional warranty leadership to ensure support provided is impactful and addresses key needs
  • Operate proficiently across various software platforms including CRM systems, Telephony, Surveys, and internal communication tools.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of company policies, principles, and departmental strategies.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What You Will Need:

  • Adherence to 'Love the Customer' behaviors and Customer Service Strategies.
  • Ability to organize and multi-task in a fast-paced work environment.
  • Strong relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to work independently and with a team.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to solve problems quickly and effectively.
  • Strong active listening skills.
  • Ability to stay composed under pressure.

Sound Like You?

You might be just who we’re looking for if you have…

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Experience in customer service required.
  • Experience within homebuilding warranty department preferred.
  • Type 40-50 wpm.
  • Friendly and calm.
  • Team player with a strong sense of urgency.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Organized, with attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships and maintain confidentiality.
  • Microsoft Office applications proficiency.

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

This position is considered a non-exempt position for purposes of wage-hour law, which means that you will be required to keep a time record and will be eligible for overtime pay.

Successful job applicants will be able to perform these functions. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Work remotely with little to no supervision and adhere to schedule.
  • Ability to access, input, and retrieve information from a computer and/or electronic device

  • Ability to sit or stand for long periods of time and move around work environment as needed

  • Comply with company policies and procedure

Physical Demands:

  • Must be able to able to remain in a stationary position up to 50% of the time
