Overview

The Remote ROI Specialist is responsible for providing remote support to MRO’s healthcare clients by processing Release of Information (ROI) requests for patient medical records*

This a fully remote position.

Responsibilities

  • Determines records to be released by reviewing requestor information in accordance with HIPAA guidelines and securely accessing pertinent patient data from client electronic health record (EHR) systems and other approved electronic sources that match the patient request.
  • Responds to phone calls, emails, and secure messages from requesters concerning various ROI issues.
  • If necessary, responds to and processes requests from physician offices on a priority basis and transmits the requested information securely (for example, secure electronic delivery or eFax).
  • Logs medical record requests into Exchange Manager.
  • Uploads and indexes electronic medical records into Exchange Manager.
  • Complies with MRO and client facility policies and regulations, including HIPAA privacy and security requirements and MRO remote work and information security policies.
  • Other duties as assigned.

    • Qualifications

    • High School Diploma/GED required.
    • Prior work experience in Release of Information in a physician’s office or HIM Department is a plus.
    • Demonstrates proficiency using computer applications and web-based systems. One or more years experience entering data into computer systems. Experience using the internet is required.
    • Demonstrates the ability to work independently in a remote environment, managing time effectively and meeting production goals established by MRO.
    • Strong verbal and written communication skills; demonstrated success responding to customer inquiries by phone, email, and virtual platforms.
    • Demonstrates success working in an environment that requires attention to detail.
    • Proven track record of dependability.
    • Knowledge of medical terminology is a plus.
    • Knowledge of HIPAA regulations is preferred.

    WORK ENVIRONMENT:

    • This is a fully remote, work-from-home position.
    • Requires a private, dedicated workspace that meets MRO privacy and security requirements for handling protected health information (PHI).
    • Requires reliable high-speed internet service and use of MRO-approved equipment and secure access methods (such as VPN and multi-factor authentication).
    • Participates in virtual meetings and trainings using video and collaboration tools.
    • Extended periods of sitting and computer work are required.

    *This job description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions. It does not prescribe or reflect the tasks that may be assigned.

    MRO’s employees work at client facilities throughout the United States. We are proud of the culture we create for our employees and offer an outstanding work environment. We strive to match the right applicant to the right position. To learn more about us, visit www.mrocorp.com. MRO is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

    This position is approved for hire in select U.S. states only. Candidates must reside and perform work in one of the approved hiring states at the time of hire and throughout employment. Currently approved states: Kentucky, Mississippi, New Mexico, and Texas.

    Total CompensationBase pay is one element of the total compensation package. Eligible employees may also have access to a comprehensive benefits offering, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and a 401(k) plan.

CECO Environmental is a global leader in providing sustainable solutions for industrial air, water, and energy transition. Since 1966, we’ve been addressing the world’s most pressing environmental challenges. Our mission is to protect people, the environment, and industrial equipment, making a tangible impact across industries like renewable energy, semiconductor manufacturing, power generation, and water treatment. As a purpose-driven company, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and integrity, ensuring that every project we undertake creates lasting positive change. At CECO, you’ll be part of a growing, dynamic team committed to a cleaner, safer, and more sustainable future.

We are proud to share that CECO was named one of Newsweek’s America’s Greatest Companies for 2025 and that Forbes recognized CECO as one of America’s Most Successful Small‑Cap Companies for 2026, marking our third consecutive year on the Forbes list. CECO Environmental is a publicly traded company on the NASDAQ under the ticker CECO, reflecting our strong growth, financial performance, and commitment to delivering value to shareholders.

The Field Service Technician will be responsible for defining and executing post-sale on-site technical product support and services for CECO Industrial Solutions. CECO is compromised of the following product lines: Adwest, Busch, CECO Filters, Flex-Kleen, Fisher Klosterman and HEE-Duall which are focused on providing hazardous gas and odor control, volatile organic compounds (VOC) abatement, particulate filtration/purification, separators, and ventilation solutions. The ideal candidate has solid experience with mechanical, thermal, chemical, and electrical devices.

This is a remote role with 75% travel but travel will typically only be for part of the week. Some weekends will be required.

Your Responsibilities Will Be:

  • Executes the established field services processes and procedures
  • Conducts on-site installation, equipment start-up/commissioning, testing, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
  • Ensures all field service projects are completed within budget/deadline to meet customers' needs
  • Maintains active contact with other departments, which is positive and supportive of that group’s planning and budget objectives; ensures communication with customers and/or other team members is conducted in a manner that builds trust and leads to efficient and effective problem resolution.
  • Maintains the confidentiality of all information concerning the Company’s operational practices, marketing, engineering, pricing and sales strategies, as well as customer and prospect lists. The list of items to be considered confidential also includes, but is not limited to, information related to the financial operations and performance of the company.
  • Allocates time efficiently and effectively keeping track of critical information, schedules and deadlines.
  • Adheres to all safety policies and procedures in accordance with guidelines established by the Company/OSHA; pursues safety initiatives in support of the Company’s vision of “zero accidents”; maintains a clean, safe and orderly environment.

  • Performs other duties of a similar nature and level as assigned.

  • 5+ years’ experience working as a Field Services Specialist and/or Technician.
  • Experience working with FRP and Welding a plus
  • Valid in-state driver’s license. Driving record must meet acceptable company standards and be maintained as such in order to operate a vehicle while on company business.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical documentation pertaining to specifications of components and materials and computer aided design (CAD) drawings and specifications.

  • Considerable knowledge of the use of Field Service management tools and software.

  • Considerable knowledge of safe handling, storage and operations of equipment that utilizes hazardous chemicals.
  • Considerable knowledge of rotating equipment, including dampers, actuators, controls, and seal air fans.
  • Ability to travel up to 75% of the time; must have ability to travel across state borders.

ADA Requirements:

• Positions in this function typically require standing, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, crawling, reaching, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, lifting, fingering, grasping, feeling, talking, hearing, seeing and repetitive motions.

Include but are not limited to:

  • Provide technical support for software configuration, updates, and troubleshooting related to ThermalWorks control systems.

  • Experience configuring, commissioning, and supporting automated control systems.
  • Experience working with networked control environments, including industrial networking and system connectivity.
  • Experience supporting commissioning and troubleshooting activities in industrial facilities, commercial buildings, data centers, or similar environments.

At RevStar, we build cutting-edge cloud, data, and Generative AI solutions that transform how enterprise organizations operate. As an Advanced AWS Consulting Partner, we don’t just deliver code—we solve complex business problems, modernize legacy infrastructure, and deploy production-grade cloud native and AI applications that drive real business value. We are seeking a Data & AI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our Digital Solutions Practice. As an FDE, you are both a master cloud builder and a trusted technical advisor. You will own the full delivery lifecycle for high-impact enterprise accounts—architecting resilient cloud-native environments, modernizing legacy infrastructure, and deploying state-of-the-art AWS Generative AI (Amazon Bedrock, Q, SageMaker) architectures. Simultaneously, you will drive AWS adoption and consumption growth by identifying new workloads, building POCs, and driving strategic technical alignment with client executive leadership.

  • Hands-On Cloud Architecture & Implementation: Design, build, and deploy secure, scalable, and resilient cloud architectures on AWS using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation) and modern microservices/serverless patterns (Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, DynamoDB).
  • Enterprise Customer Delivery: Serve as the primary technical leader on strategic enterprise client engagements. Partner with CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Infrastructure/Engineering, and client development teams to translate complex business goals into high-performing AWS solutions.
  • Cloud Migration & Application Modernization: Lead large-scale migrations from on-premises data centers or legacy platforms to AWS (using AWS Application Migration Service, Database Migration Service, etc.) and re-architect legacy monolithic applications into modern serverless or containerized architectures.
  • AWS Generative AI & Machine Learning: Architect and deploy enterprise GenAI and ML workloads leveraging Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Vector Databases (OpenSearch, Pinecone, pgvector), and custom RAG implementations.
  • Drive Platform Adoption & Growth: Partner with RevStar account leadership to identify new, high-value cloud workloads within client accounts, driving AWS consumption expansion and clear ROI for client executive stakeholders.
  • Technical Mentorship & Practice Building: Coach and mentor Cloud Engineers and Solutions Architects. Drive internal RevStar accelerators, reusable Terraform modules, AWS Well-Architected Review frameworks, and cloud delivery best practices.

Requirements

Qualifications & Requirements

Technical Expertise:

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in Cloud Architecture, DevOps/SRE, or Software Engineering with a focus on AWS.
  • 3+ years in a client-facing consulting, Solutions Architecture, or Forward Deployed Engineering role.
  • Deep AWS Core Expertise: Mastery across core AWS services (IAM, VPC, EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudFront, Route 53).
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & CI/CD: Expert-level proficiency in Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation, along with automated CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, AWS CodePipeline).
  • AWS GenAI & Data Services: Practical experience with Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Glue, Redshift, or OpenSearch for building data platforms and AI solutions.
  • AWS Certifications: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional and/or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional required. Specialty certifications (Security, Machine Learning, Data Analytics) are a plus.

Client & Business Acumen:

  • Enterprise Track Record: Proven experience leading technical delivery for Fortune 500 or mid-market enterprise clients (Healthcare, Financial Services, Retail, or SaaS).
  • Consulting & Communication Skills: Outstanding verbal and written communication; adept at whiteboarding complex architectures, building working POCs/demos, and presenting to C-level executives.
  • Growth Mindset: Ability to spot technical expansion opportunities, conduct AWS Well-Architected Reviews, and advocate for cloud modernization to expand account footprint.

Benefits

  • 401(k) Retirement Plan – Plan for your future with access to a company-sponsored 401(k) program.

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Risk & Analytics Team

The Risk & Analytics (R&A) team makes crucial decisions that direct Affirm’s business strategy. We partner with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Capital Markets, and Commercial teams to grow Affirm responsibly by optimizing approval, conversion, losses, and profitability.

Operating across the entire customer and merchant lifecycle, we tackle a diverse array of challenges, from optimizing checkout conversion and mitigating fraud risk to building scalable data foundations and enabling international growth. We analyze performance not just to report on it, but to determine where to invest resources for maximum impact through building tools, scalable data infrastructure, and analytical frameworks.

We improve the analytics experience across Affirm by streamlining workflows and fostering a culture of learning and documentation. By taking ownership of the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision, we turn complex data and systems into clear, actionable signals that ensure Affirm grows efficiently and intelligently.

One Role, Multiple Teams

We are hiring multiple Senior Analyst roles across Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across R&A.

If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.

Potential team placements include:

  • Point of Sale (POS): Optimize merchant and checkout performance to improve conversion, approvals, and unit economics across the purchase funnel.
  • Direct to Consumer (DTC) / Card: Drive engagement, repeat usage, and lifecycle health across Affirm's app, web, and card experiences.
  • Fraud: Prevent and reduce fraud losses across the customer journey while maintaining a frictionless user experience.
  • Core Analytics: Build the quantitative research, performance monitoring, and scalable data foundations that enable fast, economically sound decisions.
  • Servicing: Enhance the post-origination customer experience by analyzing repayment behavior, collections strategies, and operational efficiency.
  • International Expansion: Build the measurement and decision foundations needed to sustainably launch and scale Affirm in new global markets.

About the Role

As a Senior Analyst in Affirm's Risk & Analytics organization, you will join one of several analytical teams working across the customer and merchant lifecycle. While the specific problems you tackle will depend on your eventual team placement, all Senior Analyst roles share a common foundation: owning complex analytical problems end to end, translating data into business strategy, and influencing decisions across technical and non-technical teams.

You will operate with autonomy to own the entire analytical lifecycle, from initial question to final business decision. You bring exceptional analytical rigor, deep domain expertise, and the ability to translate complex regulatory, economic, and machine learning insights into actionable business strategies. You thrive in ambiguity, balance growth with resilience, and are comfortable operating at both strategic and execution levels to influence stakeholders across the organization.

What You Will Do

  • Optimize End-to-End Strategy: Leverage advanced data analytics to independently derive insights, develop, and optimize business, risk, or growth strategies across products and geographies.
  • Manage Macro & Market Trends: Monitor portfolio performance and exogenous macroeconomic trends, proactively adjusting analytical and operational strategies to mitigate risk and balance growth.
  • Model & Capability Building: Partner deeply with Engineering and Machine Learning teams to design, build, and interpret performance metrics for scalable risk, fraud, or growth models.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate closely with Product, Legal, and Compliance teams to interpret evolving regulatory and market requirements, translating them directly into analytical policy and product design recommendations.
  • Oversee Frameworks & Launches: Oversee the development and execution of analytical frameworks. Drive cross-functional discussions to ensure new product launches and market entries align with risk appetite, operational capabilities, and local regulations.
  • External & Strategic Alignment: Engage with external stakeholders, including merchants, vendors, and partners, to align practices, ensure compliance, and strengthen strategic relationships.
  • AI Leverage & Mentorship: Build repeatable AI-assisted workflows that compound across the team's analyses, while mentoring junior analysts on technical craft and domain nuances.

What We Look For

  • 2–5 years of proven experience in an analytically driven role within the consumer lending, credit, or fintech industry, specifically leveraging advanced analytics to develop and optimize business strategies.
  • Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, or other scripting languages.
  • Deep expertise in data mining, data visualization, and statistical modeling, with experience applying machine learning techniques to business or risk management problems.
  • Proven experience leading cross-functional initiatives that bridge Product, Legal, Compliance, and Engineering to align analytical strategies with business objectives.
  • Strong understanding of consumer lending regulations, regional market dynamics, and the broader economic landscape influencing policy and growth.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex regulatory and economic insights into actionable strategies.
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across technical and non-technical functions.

Pay Grade - K

Equity Grade - 6

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $145,000 - $205,000
USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $128,000 - $188,000

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

jobs.description:
Join an award-winning and talented organization that delivers world-class healthcare workforce solutions. Working within a vibrant and passionate team of recruitment and sales professionals you will bring your energy and enthusiasm to help grow the firm by assisting in all clinical operations, remediation, and coaching/counseling for our healthcare providers working at different facilities and our internal staff.

About the Role:

Most marketing job posts say "seeking a creative self-starter" and then describe a job where someone hands you a brief every Monday. This is not that job. Cynet — an award-winning US healthcare and technology staffing group, ranked #17 among travel nurse staffing firms in the US by Staffing Industry Analysts — is hiring a senior marketer in Costa Rica who can look at a search query and know what the searcher actually wants, look at a dull post and find the angle that makes it travel, and look at a "great idea" and know when it would quietly hurt the brand.

Location: Costa Rica (100% Remote) · Type: 1099 Independent Contract, Full-time · Travel: 4–8 US trips/year, fully paid by Cynet · Equipment: You must own your own laptop and have reliable internet

What will you be doing day to day?

  • Own content, end to end. You'll create and manage content across four distinct brands — travel nursing, locum physicians, enterprise/government technology, and Canadian healthcare — each with its own audience and its own voice. Four rooms, four registers, one writer. That means social posts, website content and landing pages, and a hand in drafting company news and announcements. You'll research what's worth saying before writing a word: real data, verified stories, primary sources. We cite reports by name on our pages, and a number without a source doesn't ship here.
  • Run social like an editor, not a scheduler. You'll own the LinkedIn calendars — what runs, when, and why. Every post needs a point someone could disagree with. "Healthcare workers are amazing" is not a point. "ER wait times are not an ER problem" is. If the difference between those two sentences is obvious to you, keep reading.
  • Hunt for what's worth sharing. We expect you to actively source quality content from beyond our own walls — verified positive news, human stories, humor that lands with clinicians and professionals, polls, and whatever else earns genuine engagement. The feel-good story a local news station ran yesterday, the stat that sounds wrong until you read it twice, the joke only a night-shift nurse fully gets — finding that material is a core weekly discipline here, not a nice-to-have. One rule travels with it: we verify everything to its original source before it ships. The fun is real, and so are the facts.
  • Be the brand in the room, not just on the page. Publishing is half of social; presence is the other half. You'll engage as Cynet — joining industry conversations, commenting, reacting, and tagging where it's genuinely relevant, and creating and managing our LinkedIn newsletters. A page that only talks about itself is a billboard. You'll make ours a participant.
  • Keep our reputation tended. Once a week — genuinely about 20 minutes — you'll respond to public reviews under our written privacy guidelines. In healthcare, a careless reply can expose protected information, so this small task carries real judgment. You'll be trained on the rules; following them is non-negotiable.
  • Get on planes. Cynet shows up at conferences and tradeshows across the US, and marketing goes along — running our presence, feeding content home from the floor, and working alongside the sales and delivery teams who need you there. Expect 4–8 trips a year, all travel costs on us.

Requirements

Your Experience and Skills:

  • Unrestricted, self-managed United States entry. You are a U.S. citizen or permanent resident, OR you hold a current valid U.S. visa that you maintain yourself. Cynet does not sponsor or arrange entry documentation, and U.S. travel is a written condition of the contract. We ask about this in the first conversation — please be ready to answer plainly.
  • Native-level conversational English writing. Not "proficient." Your English should read like it was never translated from anything.
  • 5+ years in content marketing or editorial roles. A portfolio of self-created work is strongly preferred — and if you share one, be ready to tell us exactly which parts were yours.
  • A track record of judgment. Healthcare marketing lives next to privacy law, and staffing marketing lives next to people's livelihoods. You instinctively know which drafts need a second look before the world sees them.
  • Your own equipment. This is a contract engagement — you bring a reliable laptop and home internet that can carry video calls and content work.

What makes you great at this:

You read a query like "travel nurse pay breakdown" and immediately know whether that person wants a calculator, a definition, or reassurance — and what content wins them. You see a competitor's post get 400 comments and reverse-engineer why. You treat SEO, social, and email as one craft — getting the right words in front of the right person — not three departments. Editorial or newsroom experience is a genuine plus; so is anything that proves you can find the story in a spreadsheet.

What you get:

Competitive senior-level compensation (this role is scoped and paid above our specialist band) · fully remote from Costa Rica with U.S. travel on us. A marketing function small enough that your work is visible from the CEO's chair, and growing fast enough that this seat shapes what the team becomes. Four brands' worth of creative range — you will never be bored by the ICU-to-federal-buyer whiplash. We promise.

How to apply:

Two things are required: your resume, and one thing most applicants won't do — pick any post from the Cynet Health LinkedIn page and, in three sentences or fewer, tell us the angle you'd have given it instead. Applications without that answer won't be reviewed; it's the first thing we read, before your resume. A portfolio of work you personally created is optional but strongly encouraged — it's the fastest way to stand out.

About Cynet Health:

Headquartered in the Washington, D.C. metro area, Cynet Health is a Joint Commission Certified Workforce solutions company that helps our clients realize their talent potential through custom staffing & recruiting solutions. Cynet is an equal opportunity employer. We're ranked #3 Best Travel Nursing Company by BluePipes and Joint Commission certified — credentials our marketing is never allowed to exaggerate, which should tell you something about how we work. For more information, please visit our website,

About Home Heart Florida

Home Heart Florida is a pediatric home health agency. We send nurses into the homes of medically complex children across Florida, many of whom rely on ventilators, trachs, or feeding tubes. Families count on us to get care started quickly, and a lot has to happen behind the scenes before a nurse can walk through the door.

About the role

We're hiring a full-time, Philippines-based Intake Coordinator to help move new patients from referral to their first nursing visit. When a child is referred to us, we need medical records from their doctors, a signed nursing order, verified insurance, and an approval from the child's Medicaid health plan before care can begin. You'll be the person who gathers those pieces, follows up until each one comes in, and keeps every family's file organized and current. You'll work closely with our Intake Manager and the rest of the intake team, and you'll be in regular contact with parents, doctors' offices, and health plans.

This job suits someone who is organized, persistent, and calm. Doctors' offices are slow and families are busy, so much of the work is polite, steady follow-up until things get done.

What you'll do

  • Follow up with parents to complete and return intake forms, such as medical record release forms.
  • Request medical records and nursing orders from doctors' offices by fax, phone, and email, and keep following up until they arrive.
  • Sort incoming faxes and file each document to the right patient's chart.
  • Create new patient charts in our records system and get every detail right: parent contact information, Medicaid ID, the child's school or day care schedule, physicians, and insurance details.
  • Check Medicaid eligibility and insurance coverage in health plan portals.
  • Help prepare and submit authorization requests to health plans, and track each one until it is approved.
  • Keep our patient pipeline in HubSpot current so the team can see where every family stands.
  • Send families short, friendly updates so no one is left wondering what is happening.
  • Post a short end-of-day update in Slack covering what you finished, what is stuck, and what comes next.

What we're looking for

  • At least 1 year of hands-on work in U.S. healthcare administration, such as patient intake, medical records, prior authorization, insurance or eligibility verification, or medical billing. Work on a U.S. healthcare account at a BPO counts.
  • Excellent written and spoken English. You'll be calling U.S. doctors' offices and writing to U.S. families every day.
  • You are smart and meticulous. You notice when a Medicaid ID is off by one digit or a date doesn't match between two documents, and you fix it before it causes a problem.
  • Strong organization. You can keep 30 or more open files moving at once without anything falling through the cracks.
  • You follow up without being reminded, and you own a task until it is finished.
  • You learn new software quickly.
  • Reliable internet, a quiet place to work, and a backup power plan.

Pluses (not required)

  • Florida Medicaid or Medicaid managed care experience
  • Pediatrics, home health, or private duty nursing
  • HubSpot, an electronic medical records system, Availity, or other health plan portals
  • Spanish

Schedule and pay

  • Full-time, Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, fully remote.
  • $1,200 USD per month.

How to apply

Use the Apply button on this post. When the application asks for the hidden word, type LANTERN. The application asks for all of the following:

  1. Your resume.
  2. A 2-minute video in English (Loom or an unlisted YouTube link). Introduce yourself and tell us about a time you had to chase someone for something important, and how you finally got it.
  3. Short written answers to these four questions:
    1. What U.S. healthcare administration work have you done, and which systems or portals did you use?
    2. A doctor's office has ignored two requests for records we need this week. What do you do next?
    3. How do you keep track of 30 open tasks so that nothing is missed?
    4. Which U.S. Eastern hours can you commit to, and what is your internet and backup power setup?

We don't review applications that are missing any of these, because attention to detail matters a lot in this job and the application is the first test of it. jobs.description:
Money stress is the biggest productivity killer in the workplace - My Money Matters exists to change that. We're building an app that improves employees' finances automatically every pay day - giving them financial tools that directly improve their financial health with less effort.

Every pay day is an opportunity to build better money habits. We make it easy. Employees can accelerate retirement savings with tax-efficient pension top-ups, build a safety net effortlessly with auto savings, or access their already-earned salary ahead of pay day for emergencies.

For employers, fewer employees with money worries means more focus on work. We're trusted by major organisations including the NHS, and we're growing fast.

The role

We're growing our commercial team and looking for an experienced new business salesperson who knows how to generate their own pipeline, engage senior stakeholders and close complex B2B deals.

You'll own the full sales cycle, initially focusing on public sector organisations across local government, the NHS and education. Joining at an exciting stage of growth, you'll help expand our financial wellbeing proposition and play a key role in driving new customer acquisition.

This is an opportunity for someone who thrives on winning new business, operates independently and wants to make a tangible commercial impact.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Generate new business: Build and manage your own pipeline through targeted prospecting, account research, outreach and relationship development.

  • Lead the sales cycle: Run discovery, deliver tailored presentations, build compelling business cases and negotiate contracts through to close.

  • Navigate complex deals: Engage multiple stakeholders and manage procurement processes, objections and longer sales cycles.

  • Own commercial performance: Deliver against revenue targets, maintain accurate pipeline data and forecast reliably in HubSpot.

  • Develop our market approach: Share customer insight with Marketing and Product to help refine our proposition and sales strategy.

  • Drive successful handovers: Work with Customer Success and Onboarding to ensure a smooth transition from sale to implementation.

  • Build market presence: Represent MMM at relevant conferences, employer forums and industry events to develop relationships and generate opportunities.

Skills & Experience

  • A demonstrable track record of sourcing and closing new B2B business, with specific examples of deals you've personally won.

  • Experience owning the full sales cycle and consistently working towards individual revenue targets.

  • Strong prospecting, discovery, negotiation and closing skills, with the ability to build relationships across complex buying groups.

  • Commercial judgement, resilience and the ability to maintain momentum through longer sales cycles.

  • Strong pipeline management and forecasting discipline.

Preferential experience

  • Experience selling into the public sector and an understanding of procurement frameworks and budget cycles.

  • Experience selling SaaS, payroll, HR technology, employee benefits, financial wellbeing or other consultative B2B solutions.

  • Experience using HubSpot or a comparable CRM.

  • Experience developing a proposition or establishing a new market.

You don't need experience in financial wellbeing specifically. We're interested in strong sales performers who can learn a new proposition and turn opportunities into revenue.

Our Recruitment Process

Stage 1 | People & Culture Call – An initial conversation about your experience, motivations and what you're looking for in your next role.

Stage 2 | Hiring Manager Interview – A 30-minute interview with the Hiring Manager to explore your experience in more detail, your approach to the role, and give you the opportunity to learn more about the team and what we're building.

Stage 3 | Practical Exercise – A practical exercise designed to give you the opportunity to demonstrate how you would approach some of the key areas of the role.

Work remotely from anywhere in the UK, giving you flexibility to work where you perform at your best.

jobs.title: Remote Senior Training Developer (VA ESOM)
jobs.excerpt: Overview Thank you for considering IT Concepts dba Kentro, where innovation drives opportunity and collaboration leads to success.
jobs.description:
Overview

Thank you for considering IT Concepts dba Kentro, where innovation drives opportunity and collaboration leads to success. Our dynamic community of experts is fully committed to advancing our customers' missions, fostering professional growth, and making a positive impact on our communities.

By joining our supportive community, you will find that Kentro is dedicated to your personal and professional development. Together, we can drive meaningful change, spark innovation, and achieve extraordinary milestones.

Kentro is seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Training Developer to lead the design, development, and full-scale delivery of a comprehensive training program supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs’ enterprise ServiceNow Hardware Asset Management (HAM) implementation. As the VA transitions from multiple legacy asset systems, including AEMS/MERS, Maximo, DMLSS, and spreadsheet-based processes, to ServiceNow HAM across 150+ sites nationwide, the need for consistent, scalable, and role-based training has become a program-critical requirement.

This is a senior-level role that goes well beyond documentation and foundational train-the-trainer support. The Senior Training Developer will lead Kentro’s transition to a full-scale training delivery model, encompassing instructor-led virtual office hours, short-form how-to videos, interactive learning assets, scenario-based hands-on practice, and a centralized knowledge hub — all tailored to diverse user groups with varying levels of ServiceNow proficiency and legacy system backgrounds. The ideal candidate is a confident facilitator, skilled instructional designer, and effective change management partner who thrives in a fast-paced, complex federal environment.

Location: Remote - This position can be performed remotely within the United States and will support Eastern Time working hours.

Compensation Range: The anticipated base salary range for this position is $80,000 –$125,000 annually and reflects Kentro’s good-faith expectations at the time of posting. Final compensation is determined based on the role’s requirements, relevant skills, experience, education, certifications, work location, applicable security clearance requirements, market conditions, internal equity, and contract requirements.

This Job Description reflects the primary duties of the role; however, it is not intended to be all‑inclusive. Team members may be asked to take on additional responsibilities in alignment with customer expectations, business needs, and Kentro’s culture of collaboration and adaptability.


Responsibilities

Curriculum & Learning Asset Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain role-based training modules tailored to distinct VA user groups, including Supply Chain Management (SCM), Office of Information and Technology (OIT), Custodial Officials, facility managers, leadership/supervisors, and system administrators.
  • Create short-form “how-to” videos covering key HAM workflows and ServiceNow tasks, optimized for on-demand access and self-directed learning.
  • Develop interactive simulations, click-through demos, scenario-based exercises, and mock processes — such as Report of Survey walkthroughs — to build user confidence prior to system go-live.
  • Update and maintain SOPs, Job Aids, and Knowledge Articles for clarity, accuracy, and alignment with current platform configurations and VA governance requirements.
  • Build and manage a centralized training library and knowledge hub on SharePoint, packaging existing documentation alongside new multi-modal content for easy, searchable access.
  • Develop templates, reports, charts, tables, and presentations using Microsoft Office and Adobe Acrobat; use Microsoft Visio to create workflow diagrams and process models supporting HAM training content.

Training Delivery & Facilitation

  • Plan, schedule, and facilitate live virtual weekly or biweekly office hours open to all users, with size caps to ensure meaningful engagement and direct Q&A support.
  • Engage a multi-disciplined audience across VA facilities, ensuring training content effectively illustrates proper system utilization and results in measurable operational efficiencies.

Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Coordinate change management initiatives as part of the Kentro HAM Change Management Team, collaborating with VA stakeholders to drive adoption and system adaptation across the enterprise.
  • Position and support VA “Change Champions” as super-users who reinforce — but do not replace — structured training delivery, providing them with the tools and guidance needed to serve as site-level resources.
  • Engage with a diverse range of VA stakeholders across roles, facilities, and levels of technical familiarity, communicating complex HAM and ServiceNow concepts in clear, accessible, plain language.
  • Build strong stakeholder relationships and drive consensus to keep training delivery aligned with the program schedule and location go-live commitments.
  • Operate effectively in a rapidly changing environment with competing and shifting priorities, adjusting training plans to align with implementation schedule changes and location-specific go-live timelines.

Feedback, Evaluation & Continuous Improvement

  • Evaluate end-user feedback from office hours and collaboration with the consolidated feedback obtained by the Hypercare Lead, integrating input into job aid updates and future training cycles.
  • Track office hour attendance, engagement levels, user proficiency, and error rates across locations to assess effectiveness and identify areas for improvement.
  • Maintain training content links in SharePoint with current, accurate content; conduct regular audits to ensure documentation reflects the latest platform configurations and VA governance standards.

Analysis & Process Improvement

  • Analyze business and information processes to identify risks, training gaps, and opportunities for increased operational efficiency across VA HAM workflows.
  • Provide recommendations to improve OIT business and training operations based on data, user feedback, and observations from facilitated sessions.
  • Support special projects related to business process efforts, gap analyses, feasibility studies, and trade-off analyses as needed.
  • Synthesize and analyze data across multiple functions, systems, and internal and external sources to inform training strategy and curriculum decisions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Education, Communications, Information Technology, or a related field with 5 years of relevant experience (8 years of additional relevant experience may be substituted for education).
  • Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and delivering training programs for complex enterprise IT systems or federal technology implementations.
  • Experience developing multi-modal training content including instructor-led materials, video walkthroughs, job aids, SOPs, and knowledge articles.
  • Prior experience with ServiceNow or similar enterprise software automation platforms, with the ability to understand system functionality and translate it into effective training curriculum.
  • Proven ability to tailor training content and delivery to diverse audiences with varying roles, technical backgrounds, and learning needs.
  • Strong facilitation skills with experience leading live virtual office hours, and working sessions for large, geographically dispersed user populations.
  • Experience supporting change management initiatives in a federal or large enterprise environment.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Visio), SharePoint, and Adobe Acrobat.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical information in plain, accessible language.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with team members, project managers, technical leads, and client stakeholders to align training delivery with program priorities.

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience supporting a ServiceNow HAM, SAM, or ITAM implementation, with familiarity of hardware asset lifecycle workflows and platform configurations.
  • Experience developing training programs for federal agencies or VA-specific programs, with knowledge of VA organizational structures and user communities.
  • Familiarity with legacy asset management systems such as AEMS/MERS, Maximo, or DMLSS and the change management challenges associated with system migrations.
  • Experience building and managing SharePoint-based training portals or centralized knowledge repositories.
  • Proficiency with video production and e-learning authoring tools such as Camtasia, Articulate Storyline, or Adobe Captivate.
  • PROSCI Change Management certification or equivalent change management credential.
  • ATD Certified Professional in Learning and Performance (CPLP) or equivalent instructional design certification.
  • Experience with data validation workflows, inventory reconciliation processes, or asset lifecycle management in a federal environment.

Clearance Requirement:

  • US Citizen or Lawful Permanent Resident (Green Card)
  • Willing and able to obtain and maintain Public Trust Clearance
  • Must meet updated ID requirements:
    • If you do not currently meet the ID requirements outlined, you must be willing and able to update your current forms of ID in a timely manner to complete the suitability process successfully.

Benefits

The Company

We believe in generating success collaboratively, enabling long-term mission success, and building trust for the next challenge. With you as our partner, let’s solve challenges, think innovatively, and maximize impact. As a valued member of our team, you have the unique opportunity to work in a diverse range of technology and business career paths, all while supporting our nation and delivering innovative technology solutions. We are a close community of experts that pride ourselves on creating an environment defined by teamwork, dedication, and excellence.

We hold three ISO certifications (27001:2013, 20000-1:2011, 9001:2015), two CMMI ML 3 ratings (DEV and SVC) and CMMC Level 2 Certification.

Industry Recognition

Growth | Inc 5000’s Fastest Growing Private Companies, DC Metro List Fastest Growing; Washington Business Journal: Fastest Growing Companies, Top Performing Small Technology Companies in Greater D.C.

Culture | Northern Virginia Technology Council Tech 100 Honoree; Virginia Best Place to Work; Washington Business Journal: Best Places to Work, Corporate Diversity Index Winner – Mid-Size Companies, Companies Owned by People of Color; Department of Labor’s HireVets for our work helping veterans transition; SECAF Award of Excellence finalist; Victory Military Friendly Brand; Virginia Values Veterans (V3); Cystic Fibrosis Foundation Corporate Breath Award

Benefits

We offer competitive benefits package including paid time off, healthcare benefits, supplemental benefits, 401k including an employer match, discount perks, rewards, and more. We invest in our employees – Every employee is eligible for education reimbursement for certifications, degrees, or professional development. Reimbursement amounts may fluctuate due to IRS limitations. We want you to grow as an expert and a leader and offer flexibility for you to take a course, complete a certification, or other professional growth and networking. We are committed to supporting your curiosity and sustaining a culture that prioritizes commitment to continuous professional development.

We work hard; we play hard. Kentro is committed to incorporating fun into every day. We dedicate funds for activities – virtual and in-person – e.g., we host happy hours, holiday events, fitness & wellness events, and annual celebrations. In alignment with our commitment to our communities, we also host and attend charity galas/events. We believe in appreciating your commitment and building a positive workspace for you to be creative, innovative, and happy.

Commitment Equal Opportunity Employment & VEVRAA

Kentro is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

Kentro is strongly committed to compliance with VEVRAA and other applicable federal, state, and local laws governing equal employment opportunity. We have developed comprehensive policies and procedures to ensure our hiring practices align with these requirements.

As part of our VEVRAA compliance efforts, Kentro has established an equal opportunity plan outlining our commitment to recruiting, hiring, and advancing protected veterans. This plan is regularly reviewed and updated to ensure its effectiveness.

We encourage protected veterans to self-identify during the application process. This information is strictly confidential and will only be used for reporting and compliance purposes as required by law. Providing this information is voluntary and will not impact your employment eligibility.

Our commitment to equal employment opportunity extends beyond legal compliance. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees, including protected veterans, are treated with dignity, respect, and fairness.

How to Apply

You’ll work at the intersection of customer needs and commercial opportunities to shape what we build and how we bring it to market. jobs.description:
The Security Engineer is an intermediate technical individual contributor who investigates and resolves Level 2 and Level 3 SOC escalations, develops and tunes detections, builds approved automation, and contributes to SOC engineering projects. The role applies general knowledge of industry practices, techniques, standards, concepts, and principles to technical problems of moderate scope and complexity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Investigate and resolve Level 2 and Level 3 alerts, cases, and incidents using established procedures, playbooks, and escalation paths.
  • Analyze endpoint, identity, email, cloud, network, and application telemetry to validate activity, determine scope, and document findings.
  • Develop, test, deploy, tune, and document detections for defined use cases across SIEM, XDR, EDR, cloud, identity, email, and other telemetry.
  • Develop approved enrichment, triage, notification, containment, and remediation workflows for Tier 1 scenarios that outsourced providers cannot fully address.
  • Perform scoped threat hunts and retrospective searches using documented hypotheses and established analysis methods.
  • Support telemetry onboarding, platform configuration, integrations, and troubleshooting for assigned systems and use cases.
  • Maintain accurate case records, detection documentation, automation runbooks, and technical procedures.
  • Contribute to project milestones and escalate work that exceeds established authority, procedures, or technical scope.
  • Monitor and investigate security events generated from SaaS applications, PaaS platforms, APIs, web applications, and database services, and develop detections, enrichment logic, and response workflows to improve visibility into application-layer threats and unauthorized data access.

Core Functional Responsibilities

SOC Escalations and Incident Response: Handle both Level 2 and Level 3 escalations within established procedures; conduct evidence gathering, scoping, validation, containment, remediation, recovery support, and case documentation; engage senior responders when authority, impact, or complexity exceeds defined boundaries.

Detection Engineering: Build and tune defined detections, queries, correlations, analytics rules, and incident logic; complete testing, peer review, deployment, regression validation, MITRE ATT&CK mapping, and documentation.

Tier 1 Automation: Address repeatable Tier 1 gaps that outsourced services cannot resolve by developing approved enrichment, triage, notification, containment, and remediation workflows.

SOC Platform Engineering: Support Sentinel, Defender XDR, SOAR, telemetry connectors, case management, and related integrations; troubleshoot assigned platform, rule, data-quality, and automation issues.

Application Security Monitoring & Detection Engineering: Develop and maintain detections for suspicious application activity, administrative actions, privilege changes, API abuse, authentication anomalies, database access, and data-exfiltration indicators while validating telemetry quality and monitoring coverage.

Threat Hunting and Analysis: Execute scoped hunts and retrospective searches using established hypotheses and methods; document findings and recommend detection or telemetry improvements.

Collaboration and Documentation: Coordinate routine technical work with internal teams and service providers; maintain current cases, runbooks, detection documentation, and automation procedures.

Leveling Alignment

Knowledge and problem solving: Frequent use and general knowledge of industry practices; solves problems of moderate scope and complexity.

Discretion and latitude: Works under only very general supervision. Work is reviewed for soundness of judgment and overall adequacy and accuracy. Uses established policies and practices for guidance.

Organizational impact: Contributes to milestones associated with specific projects and operational goals. Errors may delay schedules or require additional resources to correct.

Internal and external contacts: Primarily internal company contacts, with infrequent inter-organizational or outside contact on routine matters.

Required Qualifications

  • General knowledge of security operations, incident response, detection engineering, and common attacker techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR/XDR, SOAR, or comparable security technologies.
  • Experience using KQL, SPL, SQL, or a comparable query language.
  • Foundational experience with PowerShell, Python, APIs, or comparable automation technologies.
  • Ability to document technical findings clearly and exercise sound escalation judgment.
  • Experience investigating endpoint, identity, email, cloud, network, or application security activity and preserving clear evidence of analysis.
  • Working understanding of incident classification, escalation, containment, remediation, and recovery practices.
  • Ability to use established engineering standards, peer review, source control, testing, and controlled deployment processes.
  • Ability to balance concurrent incidents and engineering work, communicate status, and request guidance when scope or authority is exceeded.

Education and Experience

Bachelor + 2 years; Master + 0 years; PhD + 0 years; or equivalent. Relevant equivalent knowledge or work experience may be considered in accordance with the FA Technical Leveling definitions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365, Defender for Cloud, Azure, AWS, or Microsoft 365.
  • Experience working with an outsourced SOC, MDR, MSSP, or managed threat hunting provider.
  • Experience creating security rules, playbooks, automation workflows, response actions, dashboards, or operational metrics.
  • Relevant certifications such as SC-200, Security+, CySA+, AZ-500, or equivalent.

Measures of Success

  • Accurate and timely resolution of assigned Level 2 and Level 3 escalations.
  • Reliable detections and automations delivered in accordance with team standards.
  • Reduction in repetitive Tier 1 escalations through approved playbooks and automation.
  • Complete and usable case, detection, and workflow documentation.

jobs.excerpt: Zipliens is a leading lien resolution company that specializes in streamlining the lien process for personal injury law firms.
jobs.description:
Zipliens is a leading lien resolution company that specializes in streamlining the lien process for personal injury law firms. We are looking for proactive, results-driven individuals to join our dynamic team.

Zipliens' Director of Partnerships builds and leads our partnerships function at the strategic level. You will carry a number towards which you will originate and close priority relationships with business-level partners, including management services organizations (MSOs), multi-office and national firms, legal-tech and case management platforms, and industry associations, and you will operationalize the referral and channel programs that bring qualified opportunities into the pipeline without a cold outbound motion.

The most successful persona for this role not only brings the required experience and outcomes, but is also highly personable and can go from relationship building and networking to negotiating at the executive table. You will own who partners with Zipliens, on what terms, and why, and you will work as a high-performing individual contributor inside the sales organization: building your own pipeline, running complex deals from first conversation to signed agreement, and holding yourself to the same forecasting and CRM discipline as any quota-carrying seller.

You will report to the VP of Sales once that role is filled; in the interim, you will report to the Chief Customer Officer. You will partner closely with Sales Development, Account Executives, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, Legal, and Finance to make sure partner relationships turn into pipeline, signed agreements, and retained revenue.

Requirements

Responsibilities:

Strategic Partnerships & Enterprise Alliances

  • Partnership Strategy: Define the partnership strategy and target partner map across our Single Event and Mass Tort segments and new verticals as they arise. Decide where partnerships create reach, product value, or revenue that direct sales cannot.
  • Strategic Entity Relationships & Deal Structuring: Originate, negotiate, and close relationships with business-level partners such as MSOs, multi-office and national firms, legal-tech and case management platforms, and industry associations. Engage at the executive and ownership level, not only with day-to-day contacts. Lead negotiation of partnership, referral, vendor, and integration agreements, including commercial terms, referral economics, exclusivity, and service expectations, working with Legal and Finance on structure and risk.
  • Executive Sponsorship: Act as the executive sponsor for Zipliens' top partners. Run joint business planning and recurring business reviews with partner leadership, and hold both sides to commitments.
  • Co-Development: Work with Product to identify integrations, co-sell motions, and co-marketing opportunities that deepen partner value and make Zipliens harder to replace.

Referral & Channel Program

  • Program Ownership: Own the strategy, growth, and health of Zipliens' referral and channel partner network, including referring attorneys, firms, and professional associations. Design the program structure: partner tiers, agreements, incentives, and rules of engagement.
  • Partner Recruitment: Identify and recruit new referral and channel sources aligned with our Single Event and Mass Tort segments, and additional business verticals as they arise.
  • Partner Retention: Maintain and grow existing relationships, ensuring partners stay engaged and see clear value in referring business to Zipliens.

Sales Execution & Pipeline

  • Quota & Forecast: Carry a revenue target for partner-sourced and partner-influenced business, and forecast it accurately as part of the broader sales forecast.
  • Pipeline Building: Build and work your own pipeline in HubSpot, from partner target research and outreach through qualification, with clear stage definitions, next steps, and close dates on every opportunity.
  • Deal Execution: Run discovery, qualification, and multi-stakeholder deal cycles for partner-led and strategic opportunities. Partner with Account Executives on joint calls and hand off signed relationships cleanly to Customer Success.
  • Sales Enablement: Equip Sales Development and Account Executives with partner plays, talk tracks, and co-sell materials, and run training sessions so partner-sourced leads are worked well.

Partner Enablement & Program Operations

  • Attribution & Tracking: Track partner and referral-sourced pipeline in HubSpot with clear attribution, and report on partner program health and ROI. You will play a part in defining those KPIs.
  • Partner Enablement: Build the materials and processes partners need to refer business effectively, such as simple referral paths, co-branded materials, and training and enablement sessions.
  • Budget Ownership: Propose and manage the partnerships budget, directing spend to the activities, engagements, and events that drive the most ROI for Zipliens.

Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Pipeline Routing: Partner with Sales Development and Account Executives to make sure partner-sourced leads are routed cleanly and worked promptly. Pipeline progress should be transparent, and communication in both directions must be proactive and productive.
  • Marketing Collaboration: Partner with the Director of Marketing on co-branded partner content, joint events, and conference sponsorship strategy focused on partner development.
  • Customer Success: Work with Customer Success on onboarding and retention of partner-introduced clients, and bring partner and client feedback back into the partnership plan.
  • Reporting: Report partnership pipeline, revenue, program health, and the partnership plan and investment cases to the VP of Sales and CCO, and to the executive team as needed.

Industry Presence & Market Intelligence

  • Executive Presence: Represent Zipliens at conferences and industry events with a focus on deepening strategic relationships. Host or speak at partner and peer gatherings where it builds credibility.
  • Market Fluency: Stay current on the referral, vendor, MSO, and legal-tech landscape across Single Event and Mass Tort, and bring new channel and alliance opportunities to leadership.

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in partnerships, strategic alliances, channel sales, or enterprise business development, ideally in B2B services, legal tech, or the personal injury legal ecosystem.
  • Track record of originating, negotiating, and closing strategic partnerships with enterprise or multi-entity organizations, and structuring those agreements with support from Legal.
  • Demonstrated experience building or scaling a referral or partner program from an early stage, with measurable revenue outcomes.
  • Proven quota-carrying sales performance: consistent attainment, experience running complex multi-stakeholder deal cycles, and forecasting accuracy.
  • Strong sales process and CRM discipline, with hands-on HubSpot experience preferred, for pipeline tracking and partner attribution.
  • Strong relationship-builder with executive presence, credible with attorneys, law firm leadership, MSO and vendor executives, and internal leaders alike. The personal injury community is like a small town, and reputation is everything.
  • Ability to build structure in ambiguous environments and operate with autonomy, while collaborating across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, and Legal.
  • Experience coaching or enabling teammates; people leadership experience is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel for partner relationship building and industry events (up to 40%+).

Benefits

  • Private Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Company HSA contributions for HDHP participants
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (Health & Dependent Care)
  • Company-Paid Short-Term Disability Coverage
  • Voluntary Long-Term Disability, Life, AD&D, and Supplemental Coverage Options
  • 401(k) Plan with Company Match
  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick Time & Select Holidays)
  • Paid Parental Leave

Pay Disclosure: The total base salary range for this role is $147,00 - $199,000 annually, with opportunity for a discretionary bonus. Final compensation will be determined based on skills and experience.

Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer-sponsored visa support now or in the future.

Job Description

Join Us as a Clinical Trial Coordinator II – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation
We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

As part of our global team, you’ll have the opportunity to provide administrative and technical support to the Project Team. As a Clinical Operations Delivery Associate II, you'll support audit readiness by ensuring files are reviewed according to the schedule detailed in the organization's SOP and department guidance document. You will provide administrative support for site activation activities and aid in the development of the critical path for site activation within assigned projects to support rapid site activations. Representing the organization in the global medical research community, you may develop collaborative relationships with investigators and site personnel to conduct feasibility assessments in accordance with feasibility processes and within deliverable timelines. You may develop a local knowledge base of sites in the respective market through collaboratively working with local company personnel. Additionally, you may utilize local knowledge, organization systems, external site lists, and sponsor directives to develop and review site lists that are suitable for the strategic needs of feasibility activities and to provide local input into the site tiering process. You may act as a buddy during the onboarding phase, support training of new staff, and participate in departmental initiatives to aid in process improvements and enhancements.

    •Where applicable, develops and maintains relationship with client local affiliates.
    •Champions the inclusion of Strategic Collaboration sites into the process.
    •Where applicable, conducts on-site feasibility visits (Asia Pac only).
    •Trains new personnel in processes and systems.
    •May support the maintenance of study specific documentation and global support with specific systems, tools and trackers, including, but not limited to, study team lists, tracking of project specific training requirements, system access management for organization/vendor/clients and tracking of project level activity plans in appropriate system. Ensures (e)TMF is up to date by following file review schedules and documenting findings in appropriate system(s).
    •May provide system support (i.e., Activate & eTMF).

    •May transmit documents to client and centralized IRB/IEC.

    •May complete the ‘Site Interest Plan’ in CTMS and collection and delivery of associated documents from investigators and site personnel. Document in real time all communication, attempts and follow up associated with site contact and survey responses.

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned.

modelling.

Company Overview

team.blueis an ecosystem of 60+ successful brands working together across 22 European countries to provide its 3.3 million SMB customers with everything they need to succeed online by offering best-in-class expertise and services.

team.blue's brands are a mix of traditional hosting businesses that offer services from domain names, email, shared hosting, e-commerce, and server hosting solutions and, as specialist SaaS providers, adjacent products such as compliance, marketing tools, and team collaboration products. This broad product offering makes it a one-stop partner for online businesses and entrepreneurs across Europe.

Role:

We are looking for a hands-on, tech-savvy Head of Compliance to build and lead team.blue’s central Compliance function within group legal. Regulation is expanding quickly (AI Act, DSA, Data Act, DORA, NIS2, GDPR) and we operate across a fragmented, multi-country footprint. meets a fragmented, multi-geography footprint. This role is to turn that regulatory load into something teams can act upon themselves, rather than something we chase reactively.

Our operating philosophy is simple: enable, don’t gate — default to “how”, not “no”. Compliance is a growth lever, not a checkpoint. You will run a risk-based, pragmatic and scalable function: focus effort where likelihood × impact is highest, standardise and automate the routine, and reserve deep expertise for where it genuinely adds value. Good enough and fast beats perfect and late.

Given the size and geographical diversity of the group, the ambition is not a separate compliance silo. The function is embedded in group legal and works through co-creation: we set the standard once at the centre, enable divisions to self-serve through shared tools, and co-create with divisional General Counsels and legal-on-the-ground, who own their product and commercial risk posture within that standard.

Team & Leadership Scope:

This is a people-leadership role. You will lead and develop a central compliance capability, with the following reporting into you:

  • Privacy Counsels — the group’s data-protection and GDPR specialists.
  • AI Counsels — the group’s AI Act and AI-governance specialists.
  • A general compliance risk-monitoring and assurance function — regulatory watch, continuous risk monitoring, the assurance loop and adoption tracking (AI-enabled).

You steer this team to standardise once and scale everywhere, and you steer, rather than manage, local legal counsels to embed compliance in the business lines.

You will also have access to the operational Legal Hub, headed by the legal ops lead, and act as a spoke to it: you deploy your standards, policies and playbooks as self-serve templates and automation through the Hub, and draw on its shared tooling, regulatory-watch and risk analytics.

You set and steer the standard; the Hub is the delivery layer that scales it.

Key Responsibilities:

Compliance Advisory & Implementation

  • Act as a first-line (1LOD) advisory function embedded in group legal, working alongside legal and the business rather than at arm’s length — enabling delivery, not blocking it.
  • Drive the practical implementation of regulatory requirements into the business lines — translating obligations into operational change and self-serve readiness, not just written guidance.
  • Apply a risk-based approach to set priorities across the group’s brands and jurisdictions, as a joint call with the business, not a legal veto.

Regulatory Scope — Data & Technology

  • Own the group compliance agenda on data- and technology-driven legislation, which forms the core of the remit: GDPR, the AI Act, the Data Act, DORA and NIS2.
  • Coordinate the group’s Digital Services Act (DSA) standard centrally — setting a single approach to avoid fragmented entity-level reporting — while the operational abuse-report handling is executed by the divisions (see Scope Boundaries).
  • Set the group standard, policies and playbooks on these topics, and deploy them as self-serve templates and automation through the Legal Hub.
  • Anticipate incoming EU digital regulation and assess its operational impact across the portfolio.

Broader Compliance Topics

  • Own or coordinate the wider compliance agenda, including sanctions, AML, conflicts of interest, third-party risk management (TPRM), fraud, consumer protection and business integrity.
  • Safeguard independence of judgement on topics that require it — notably whistleblowing, conflicts of interest and TPRM — and provide independent oversight on escalation.

Risk Monitoring & Assurance

  • Own the group’s compliance risk-monitoring and assurance loop — continuous monitoring, not point-in-time assurances — so our controls are demonstrable and our register stays current.
  • Run regulatory watch and translate change into prioritised, register-driven action.
  • Steer the function by clear KPIs (maturity and awareness, self-serve adoption, response time, residual risk).

Co-Creation with Divisional General Counsels

  • Partner with divisional GCs as co-owners of compliance, not recipients of policy — they steer their own product and commercial risk posture within the group standard you set.
  • Foster a genuine compliance culture across the divisions, enabling local counsels and non-legal teams to self-serve and apply standards, escalating only true exceptions.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and divisional GCs on compliance risk and regulatory exposure.
  • Work closely with the Sustainability Director to advance team.blue’s digital-trust agenda — connecting data protection, AI governance and platform integrity to the group’s ESG and responsible-technology commitments, so trust is treated as both a compliance and a sustainability outcome.
Skills & Qualifications:

Education & Professional Background

• Qualified lawyer.

  • Proven seniority at manager level, with the standing to promote compliance culture while operationally driving implementation forward — not only thinking, but doing.
  • Demonstrated experience in an internal compliance role, preferably in the non-financial (1LOD advisory) sector rather than a regulated financial-services 2LOD control function.
  • Not a transactional lawyer — this is an operational, implementation-led compliance leadership role.
  • Experience in an international or multi-jurisdictional environment is a strong advantage.

Technical Skills

  • Knowledge of IT- and data-driven legislation (GDPR, AI Act, Data Act, DSA, DORA, NIS2).

  • Fluent with a risk-based, self-serve and automation-first way of working — build it once so it is reused, not redone.
  • Ability to prioritise and lead a broad, multi-topic compliance agenda across a decentralised group.

Language Requirements

  • Additional European language skills are an advantage.

Core Competencies

  • Enabler, not gatekeeper — you default to “how”, not “no”, and treat legal confidence as a growth lever.
  • Hands-on and operational — you both think and do; you move topics from policy to implementation.
  • Pragmatic and risk-based — you focus effort where the exposure is greatest and accept that good enough and fast beats perfect and late.
  • A co-creator — you build with divisional GCs and the business, not around them.
  • Good communicator, credible and convincing across legal, business and leadership audiences.
  • High personal integrity — integer, and trusted to hold an independent line where required.
  • Able to lead through influence, steering counsels you do not directly manage.
What We Offer
  • A senior, high-impact role building and leading the group compliance function from within, with direct access to the Group General Counsel and group leadership.

  • A team to lead — privacy, AI and compliance risk-monitoring specialists — and the mandate to shape the function.

About Lokal

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

  • Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
  • Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
  • Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
  • Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
  • Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
  • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
  • Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
  • Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.We ship fast.

We learn fast. We build for Bharat.We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital
