CyberSheath Services International LLC is a rapidly growing Managed Services Provider primarily focused on providing Cybersecurity services to the Defense Industrial Base (DIB). We are excited to be expanding our staff due to our growth and are looking to add a Director of Channel Partnerships & Business Development to our team!

CyberSheath integrates compliance and threat mitigation efforts and eliminates redundant security practices that don’t improve and, in fact, may weaken an organization’s security posture. Our professionals tell clients where to stop spending, where to invest, and how to take what they are already doing and integrate it in a way that delivers improved security.

Successful candidates for CyberSheath are self-motivated, think out of the box, work, and solve issues independently. Additionally, our most successful people are self-starters and willing to put on many hats in order to succeed. CyberSheath is fast-growing and seeks candidates who want to be part of our upward trajectory.

Position Overview

CyberSheath is seeking a strategic, hands-on Director of Marketing to build and lead a high-performing marketing function during a pivotal period of market growth and increasing CMMC adoption. This leader will own the development and execution of an integrated marketing strategy that strengthens brand authority, creates qualified pipeline, accelerates revenue, and positions CyberSheath as the trusted cybersecurity compliance partner for the Defense Industrial Base.

The Director of Marketing will translate complex cybersecurity, regulatory, and technical concepts into clear, credible, audience-specific messaging that resonates with executive buyers, IT and security leaders, compliance stakeholders, and operational leaders at defense contractors. This person will combine strategic rigor with operational excellence—setting the go-to-market plan while remaining close to campaigns, content, events, demand generation, performance analytics, and sales alignment.

The ideal candidate is a data-driven B2B marketing leader with experience in cybersecurity, managed services, compliance technology, government contracting, or similarly complex technical markets. They are comfortable operating in a growth-stage, private equity-backed environment, understand long sales cycles and multi-stakeholder buying committees, and know how to create measurable marketing impact.

What You’ll Do

Marketing Strategy and Go-to-Market

  • Develop and lead CyberSheath’s annual and quarterly marketing strategy in partnership with executive leadership, sales, solution engineering, customer success, and service delivery.
  • Define target segments, ideal customer profiles, buyer personas, market priorities, and account-tiering strategies for defense contractors and subcontractors navigating CMMC, DFARS, and NIST SP 800-171 requirements.
  • Build integrated go-to-market plans for CyberSheath’s core managed compliance, managed security, managed IT, assessment, implementation, and secure enclave offerings.
  • Establish clear marketing priorities, budgets, milestones, operating cadences, and performance expectations tied to company revenue objectives.
  • Identify market trends, competitive dynamics, regulatory developments, and customer pain points that should inform messaging, campaigns, sales enablement, and product/service positioning.
  • Support market expansion and new-service launches with disciplined positioning, audience targeting, launch planning, campaign execution, and performance measurement.

Demand Generation and Revenue Marketing

  • Own the demand-generation engine from awareness through opportunity creation, working closely with Sales to drive pipeline quality, velocity, conversion, and revenue contribution.
  • Create and optimize multi-channel campaigns across digital advertising, search, email nurture, webinars, content syndication, events, partner marketing, social media, and account-based marketing.
  • Design programs that engage key buying-committee members, including CEOs, COOs, CFOs, CISOs, CIOs, IT leaders, compliance leaders, program managers, and operations executives.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to define lead stages, service-level agreements, qualification criteria, routing processes, follow-up expectations, and closed-loop reporting.
  • Build account-based marketing programs for priority accounts, strategic verticals, and high-value partner ecosystems.
  • Develop nurture paths that educate prospective customers on compliance urgency, business risk, assessment readiness, remediation needs, and the operational requirements of maintaining CMMC compliance over time.
  • Continuously test audience, channel, message, offer, and conversion-path hypotheses to improve marketing efficiency and pipeline outcomes.

Brand, Messaging, and Content

  • Own CyberSheath’s brand strategy, voice, positioning, messaging architecture, and narrative across external and internal-facing marketing assets.
  • Ensure CyberSheath clearly communicates its differentiation as a specialized, end-to-end cybersecurity compliance partner for defense contractors rather than a generalist technology or security provider.
  • Lead development of high-value thought leadership, including executive articles, regulatory explainers, blogs, guides, case studies, solution briefs, webinars, customer stories, analyst-facing content, and event presentations.
  • Translate highly technical and regulatory subject matter into accessible, commercially relevant content without sacrificing accuracy or credibility.
  • Partner with internal subject-matter experts to develop compelling perspectives on CMMC 2.0, DFARS, NIST SP 800-171, secure CUI environments, managed security, assessment readiness, and continuous compliance.
  • Maintain a high editorial standard and a consistent content calendar that supports organic demand, customer education, sales enablement, search visibility, and executive thought leadership.
  • Oversee website messaging, conversion paths, content governance, SEO priorities, and user experience improvements.

Product and Sales Enablement

  • Partner with Sales, Solution Engineering, and Service Delivery to sharpen service positioning, customer value propositions, competitive differentiation, and proof points.
  • Develop sales-enablement materials such as pitch decks, battlecards, solution briefs, case studies, industry-specific messaging, objection-handling resources, and customer presentation templates.
  • Equip revenue teams with clear, current, and consistent messaging for every stage of the buyer journey.
  • Create mechanisms to capture and distribute market intelligence from prospects, customers, partners, competitors, and frontline revenue teams.
  • Support customer marketing initiatives, including advocacy, testimonials, referral programs, case studies, and expansion campaigns.

Events, Partnerships, and Field Marketing

  • Refine CyberSheath’s strategy for industry events, trade shows, conferences, webinars, and executive programs relevant to the DIB, defense contracting, cybersecurity, compliance, and government technology markets.
  • Ensure events are planned against measurable objectives, including target-account engagement, meeting generation, pipeline influence, partner activation, and revenue impact.
  • Build co-marketing programs with strategic technology, channel, and ecosystem partners, including Microsoft and other organizations serving the compliance and defense-contractor market.
  • Identify opportunities for CyberSheath executives and subject-matter experts to build visibility through speaking engagements, contributed content, media opportunities, and industry participation.

Analytics, Operations, and Team Leadership

  • Establish a metrics-driven marketing operating model that measures awareness, engagement, marketing-sourced pipeline, marketing-influenced pipeline, conversion rates, customer acquisition cost, campaign ROI, pipeline velocity, and revenue contribution.
  • Build and maintain reliable dashboards and executive reporting that clearly communicate marketing performance, key insights, risks, and recommended actions.
  • Manage marketing technology, data hygiene, attribution, campaign operations, and budget discipline in partnership with Revenue Operations and other internal stakeholders.
  • Evaluate and optimize the marketing technology stack, vendors, agencies, freelancers, and internal resources to ensure efficient execution.
  • Hire, develop, coach, and retain a high-performing marketing team as the organization grows.
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, customer-centric culture that values speed, quality, experimentation, commercial impact, and continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 6 to 12 months, the Director of Marketing will be expected to:

  • Establish a clear, differentiated, and consistent market narrative for CyberSheath and its service portfolio.
  • Implement an integrated demand-generation strategy that produces a predictable flow of qualified opportunities.
  • Strengthen alignment between Marketing, Sales, Solution Engineering, and Customer Success around target accounts, lead management, messaging, and pipeline goals.
  • Improve visibility into marketing performance through practical, trusted funnel and revenue reporting.
  • Elevate CyberSheath’s thought-leadership presence in the CMMC, DFARS, NIST SP 800-171, and broader DIB cybersecurity compliance market.
  • Build a scalable content engine that supports organic growth, outbound sales efforts, customer education, and partner engagement.
  • Improve conversion across core marketing journeys, including website engagement, webinar registration, gated-content conversion, demo requests, assessment inquiries, and sales-accepted leads.
  • Establish a repeatable field, event, and partner-marketing framework tied to measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
  • 8+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience, including 3+ years in a marketing leadership role.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing marketing strategies that drive measurable pipeline, revenue, and market growth.
  • Experience marketing complex B2B services, technology solutions, cybersecurity offerings, managed services, compliance solutions, SaaS, or enterprise IT services.
  • Strong command of demand generation, account-based marketing, content strategy, digital marketing, field marketing, campaign operations, and marketing analytics.
  • Experience supporting sales organizations with long, complex sales cycles and multiple economic, technical, and operational stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to translate technical concepts into customer-focused positioning, messaging, and content.
  • Strong executive communication, presentation, writing, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Experience managing budgets, agencies, vendors, and marketing technology platforms.
  • Track record of building and leading high-performing teams in fast-moving, growth-oriented environments.
  • Analytical mindset and fluency with funnel metrics, attribution, conversion analysis, pipeline reporting, and campaign performance optimization.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in cybersecurity, cybersecurity compliance, managed security services, managed IT services, GRC, risk management, or regulated technology markets.
  • Familiarity with the Defense Industrial Base, federal contracting, CMMC 2.0, DFARS, NIST SP 800-171, FedRAMP, CUI, or government cloud environments.
  • Experience marketing to defense contractors, manufacturers, engineering firms, federal contractors, or regulated mid-market organizations.
  • Experience working in a private equity-backed or high-growth business environment.
  • Familiarity with CRM, marketing automation, web analytics, SEO, paid media, intent-data, ABM, and attribution tools.
  • Experience launching services, entering new markets, repositioning a brand, or scaling a marketing organization.

Work Environment

Overview

Vice President Sales - Provider

Drive Enterprise Growth. Shape the Future of Healthcare.

About Carenet Health

Carenet Health is a San Antonio based healthcare engagement company, and we are growing fast. For more than 30 years we have helped health plans, health systems and healthcare companies engage their members and patients at every step of their journey. Today we serve more than 500 clients, we have grown 500%, and we have delivered 18 straight years of profitability. We operate multiple nearshore and offshore locations alongside our U.S. teams. Our services span member and patient engagement, contact center and BPO services, clinical support and nurse advice, telehealth, advocacy and navigation, patient access and scheduling, and digital and AI-enabled engagement. With Invene and Orbita now part of Carenet, we also bring healthcare data, AI and conversational technology to the table.

Why This Role Exists

We are growing. 2027 is a step change for Carenet, and we are adding executive sales talent who open doors and keep opening them. We are making a real investment in this role, and in you. In return, we are looking for the best talent in the industry: sellers who build relationships every day. This role owns new logo and expansion growth with health systems and provider organizations.

The Engine Behind You

You will not be selling alone. Carenet has invested heavily in building a growth engine around every seller.

  • Marketing: A dedicated Marketing team, a refreshed brand and website, targeted campaigns and a calendar of industry events, all built to put you in front of the right buyers.
  • Sales Development: An SDR team that works with you 1:1 and provides outbound calling support on your accounts, with an expectation of at least 2 net new meetings per week on your calendar.
  • Deal support: Sales Engineering, executive sponsorship and a Deal Desk that helps you shape and win large pursuits.

Who We Are Looking For

Your network.

You already know the people who run patient access and patient experience at health systems. You have relationships with Chief Patient Experience Officers, VPs of Patient Access, revenue cycle leaders, CNOs, CMOs, Chief Digital Officers and population health leaders at health systems, physician groups and specialty organizations. These are people who see you as a leader and a champion of their business.

Your work ethic.

You have grit. You keep going through a long and demanding sales journey. You are always on offense: you build your own pipeline, you do not wait for leads, and you bring the next idea to the client before they ask. You are intellectually curious. You learn the client's business, the market and our solutions deeply enough to have a different conversation than everyone else in their inbox. You take ownership of your number and your word. You are a trusted advisor.

What You Will Do

  • Build and execute a territory plan across health systems, hospitals, physician groups, specialty practices, ambulatory surgery centers and MSOs.
  • Open new logos and expand within existing provider clients.
  • Build multi-threaded executive relationships, become the partner a health system calls before an RFP exists, and build account strategies for large clients.
  • Sell patient access and scheduling (including InQuicker), centralized scheduling, 24/7 nurse advice and triage, after-hours coverage, physician referral, post-discharge follow-up, patient concierge and digital front door and EHR patient portal support.
  • Use low-cost entry points to land, then expand across the patient journey.
  • Bring deals to Deal Desk early and shape the win strategy with the executive team.
  • Work with your SDR, Marketing and Sales Engineering to build pipeline through targeted campaigns and events.
  • Keep Salesforce and HubSpot current and forecast accurately every week.

How You Will Be Successful

  • Bookings (ACV) against an annual quota, set each year
  • Qualified pipeline created and coverage against your number
  • Executive meetings held with decision makers
  • Forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene in Salesforce and HubSpot
  • Growth of your relationships into multi-threaded account relationships

What You Bring

  • 7+ years of sales to health systems and provider organizations, with patient access, contact center, nurse triage or digital health solutions preferred
  • Experience selling to both clinical and operational leaders
  • Working knowledge of patient access, revenue cycle and EHR workflows (Epic preferred)
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • A track record of exceeding quota, with results you can show
  • Comfort running complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, including RFPs
  • Fluency with Salesforce, HubSpot and LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or the ability to get there fast

How We Hire

Our process looks at the whole picture: your talent, experience, network, relationships and account leadership. In your second interview, bring a written network plan: 25 named relationships at organizations in this segment, their title, how you know them, and how you would turn each into a first meeting. We will walk through it together. It tells us more than a resume.

jobs.title: CDD/Freelance QA Engineer
jobs.excerpt: AboutSwan is the leading European fintech specialized in embedded banking.
jobs.description:
About

Swan is the leading European fintech specialized in embedded banking. A laureate of the French government’s selective year list of tech champions, “French Tech Next 120,” we are quickly expanding across Europe.

Over 100 European companies have already seamlessly integrated banking services such as accounts, cards, and payments into their products through our Banking-as-a-Service platform. This approach, known as “embedded finance”, empowers businesses to elevate their offerings and create new revenue streams — often times tripling their revenue!

Our founders’ vision from the beginning was Simplicity: that anyone with a fintech idea at 2 am can visit our website, start building, and buy themselves a coffee with a self-issued card the very next day. That vision has taken us far.

Following a 38M€ Series B round last September, we have been doubling our headcount and already have over 230 Swanees across offices in Paris, Bordeaux, Berlin, Barcelona, Amsterdam, and Milan! If you’re excited about joining a European fintech adventure, Swan is the way!

To learn more about us:About Swan;Our story.

Job description

In this role, you will be the QA reference for two product squads at Swan: KYC/Onboarding (how individuals and companies open an account and get verified) and Capital Deposit (how entrepreneurs deposit share capital to incorporate their company). You will join the QA team, which works with every product squad so that Swan ships reliable banking features to its partners. The QA team is small, experienced and close-knit: we share practices and back each other up.

✨ Your mission

Your main mission is to ensure the quality of everything the KYC/Onboarding and Capital Deposit squads release for the duration of the contract, while reducing the automated-test debt on these flows and making good use of AI to test faster and better.

✨ Main Tasks

  • Get up to speed quickly on the onboarding and capital deposit flows, their business rules and their regulatory constraints, and take over QA activities in both squads.

  • Analyze specifications and user stories with Product Managers and engineers, raising ambiguities, missing rules and risks early (shift left).

  • Design risk-based test strategies and functional test cases (ISTQB techniques: equivalence partitioning, boundary values, decision tables, state transitions…) for new features.

  • Execute functional, exploratory and regression testing (UI and API), and validate releases.

  • Automate E2E scenarios with Cucumber (Gherkin) and Playwright (TypeScript) to cover new features and close the existing automation gap, and maintain the existing test suites.

  • Maintain the test repository (Qase) and the requirements repository so that requirements, test cases and coverage stay accurate and traceable.

  • Report bugs clearly, qualify bugs reported by others, follow them up to resolution, and take part in root-cause analyses and post-mortems.

  • Prioritize your work across two squads, and keep both teams informed of test status, risks and blockers.

  • Use AI tools (Claude) to speed up test analysis, test design and test automation, critically review what the AI produces, and share good practices with the QA team.

✨ Curious about your future team?

In this part please provide a short 3 to 4 line paragraph that gives us the scoop on the team such as the composition, internal structure, operational approach, key stakeholders, and any other detail of the team.

You will join a QA team of 4 QA engineers and a QA Platform Engineer led by the QA Manager, inside an Engineering organization of [X]+ people. Each QA engineer is embedded in one or more product squads (4 to 8 engineers with a dedicated Product Manager) that plan their roadmap quarterly and deploy as they go. Day to day, you will work closely with the engineers, Engineering Managers and Product Managers of the KYC/Onboarding and Capital Deposit squads, and with other QA team members.
Within the QA team, we share a common automation framework, common tools (Qase, Linear, Notion, GitHub, home-made requirement repository tool) and an AI-assisted QA pipeline that we keep improving together.

Our technical environment:

  • E2E test automation: Cucumber (Gherkin) + Playwright (TypeScript)

  • Test management: Qase; requirements repository linked to test cases

  • Project management & documentation: Linear, Notion; code & CI: GitHub

  • AI: Claude / Claude Code, used across the QA team to support test analysis, test design and automation

  • Swan's public API is GraphQL

Preferred experience

✨ You’re a great match if:

  • You are a confirmed QA Engineer / software tester (around 4+ years of experience), ideally in an agile product team

  • You can work with several teams at once: you prioritize, you say what will and won't be done, and you keep everyone informed.

  • You are comfortable testing APIs (GraphQL or REST) as well as web interfaces.

  • You have hands-on experience with test automation, ideally Playwright and/or Cucumber/Gherkin, and you are comfortable reading and writing TypeScript (or a similar language).

  • You build good relationships easily, you communicate clearly in writing and out loud, and you can explain a risk or a bug to an engineer, a PM or a business stakeholder alike.

  • You already use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT…) in your testing work, or you are keen to, and you keep a critical eye on what they produce.

  • Experience in banking, fintech or another regulated industry is a strong plus.

  • You know the ISTQB concepts and vocabulary (test levels, test techniques, risk-based testing, defect lifecycle) and apply them pragmatically. An ISTQB certification is a plus.

  • Languages: you are fluent in English and French.

  • Our ideal teammate: Sociable. Skilled. Empathetic. Frank. We love to challenge each other, and we leave our egos at the door 🙂

It’s okay if you don’t tick all the boxes — don’t let imposter syndrome prevent you from applying! 🙌

Swan is committed to providing a caring work environment for all employees, regardless of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion, or belief.

When it comes to recruitment, we’re interested in your work experience, skills, and overall personality. Because diversity makes the workplace stronger and is necessary for Swan’s success, we are intensifying efforts to incorporate concrete actions to help us improve in this area.

About Swan

✨ Our values:

Swan’s core values guide our actions daily. Individually, they may seem obvious, but together, they form a unique culture.

Simplicity: Leonardo Da Vinci said: “simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.” If something's convoluted or confusing, we work extra hard to break it down. - Making complex things simple is what we do.

Long Term: We always play the long game, whether it's to support our partners in their growth journey, or make tangible commitments to climate action.

Excellence: We are a team of experts who consistently go all out to create pixel-perfect banking services and exceed our partners' expectations— whatever it takes.

Be Human: We believe in the power of kindness and the importance of acting with integrity. But embracing our humanity extends beyond interpersonal interactions, it means caring about greater issues that affect our planet.

You can find out more about our culture.

Recruitment process

  • A 30-min video call with our Talent Acquisition Manager, to get to know you, understand your career expectations and answer your questions

  • Hiring Manager interview

  • Case study

  • Peer Interview automation, test execution, collaboration

  • Last interview with our CTO

Who We Are

As the largest private-sector power producer in the world and the nation's largest producer of clean and reliable energy, Constellation is focused on our purpose: lighting the way to a brilliant tomorrow for all. We have been the leader in clean energy production for more than a decade, and we are cultivating a workplace where our employees can grow, thrive, and contribute. Together, we're creating healthier communities and a cleaner planet, and our people are the driving force behind our success. At Constellation, you can build a fulfilling career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact. By doing our best work and meeting new challenges, we can accomplish great things. Join us in meeting the country's energy needs today and tomorrow.


Total Rewards

Constellation offers an extensive selection of benefits and rewards to help our employees thrive professionally and personally. We provide competitive compensation and a wide-range of benefits that support both employees and their families, helping them prepare for the future. In addition to highly competitive salaries, eligible employees are offered a bonus program, 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase program; comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits, including robust wellbeing programs; disability and life insurance benefits; paid time off for vacation, holidays, and sick days; and much more.

Expected salary range of $118,800 to $132,000, varies based on experience, along with comprehensive benefits package that includes bonus and 401(k).

Primary Purpose of Position

The Senior Business Development Manager (BDM) is a member of the Arise Energy sales organization and is responsible for supporting customer acquisition and business development efforts for the Arise digital platform. In this role, the Senior BDM partners closely with the Sales Manager to prospect targeted customers and guide them toward the Arise Energy digital customer acquisition platform. The position focuses on proactive engagement with potential customers, including outreach to warm leads identified by the Sales Manager and introducing prospective clients to the capabilities and value of the Arise platform. The Senior BDM also supports broader marketing and relationship development efforts by networking with potential customers at industry events, leveraging existing market contacts and relationships, and contributing to prospecting activities that expand awareness of the platform. In addition, the role provides sales support to both existing accounts and prospective customers to help ensure a positive customer experience and continued business growth. Arise Energy was founded with the mission of making corporate energy purchasing easier. Its proprietary self service online platform enables customers to take control of their energy purchasing decisions, while a client focused team of advisors helps organizations achieve cost, budget, and sustainability goals. Arise Energy operates as an independent subsidiary of Constellation, a Fortune 200 clean energy leader.


Primary Duties and Accountabilities

  • Develop and maintain a strong understanding of the Arise Energy platform and energy industry fundamentals in order to clearly articulate the platform's features, value proposition, and ability to address common industry challenges to prospective customers.
  • Identify and pursue prospective customers by building and maintaining an active pipeline through lead generation activities such as cold calling, email outreach, industry networking, follow up on marketing generated leads, and participation in industry events.
  • Manage and maintain a pipeline of prospective Arise Energy platform customers while also tracking opportunities outside current platform parameters, including natural gas opportunities, managed products, large RFPs, and Constellation Navigator opportunities.
  • Guide prospective customers through the digital customer journey from account setup through contract execution, including quote requests and responses, plan comparison and selection, and contract execution, using web based meeting tools such as MS Teams and Zoom.
  • Respond to and resolve prospective customer inquiries and concerns through chat, email, and phone channels by identifying and classifying issues, coordinating with internal pricing, technology, and operations teams and third party energy suppliers, and tracking resolution through CRM and service systems.
  • Collaborate with leadership, the digital product team, and marketing to identify opportunities to improve the digital customer experience and recommend enhancements to processes, procedures, and platform functionality based on customer interactions and market insights.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree and 8 years of energy industry experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 8 years of experience in a customer facing role, such as sales, sales support, customer service, or account management experience, with an emphasis on outbound customer interactions
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively build and maintain relationships with customers and prospects
  • High proficiency in Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills applied in a fast-paced team environment, maintaining rapport with colleagues, channel partners and customers
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, problem-solving/conflict resolution, time management, and independent decision-making
  • Demonstrated ability to balance multiple priorities with a strong focus on results and customer needs
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality of all information

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in outside sales, sales support, or customer support for an eCommerce or SaaS platform
  • Experience in go-to-market strategy and or supporting sales efforts for new products

jobs.description:
About the Role

The Product Manager (PM) drives a cross-functional team through a discovery-to-delivery model: turning customer opportunities into validated bets, and validated bets into shipped product. This role owns the opportunity from the moment it surfaces in discovery through the review that closes out each build cycle. It includes writing the brief that locks a bet's scope and success criteria, running the team's milestone reviews, and keeping the discovery record, delivery tracker, and team knowledge base in sync. The PM aligns product bets with strategic goals, nurtures relationships with cross-functional partners and leadership, and owns the outcome of every bet the team makes - whether it validates, invalidates, or ships.

Day to day, you'll...

  • Run product discovery: surface and write up opportunities in the customer's voice, tag them to the relevant part of the customer journey, and map the assumptions beneath each one by risk category (e.g. desirability, feasibility, defensibility, viability) and strength of supporting evidence
  • Decide whether each initiative is a validation test (to reduce uncertainty before committing) or a committed build, and defend that call to the team and to leadership
  • Write the brief for each initiative: the outcome hypothesis ("If we do X, we expect Y, measured by Z"), the problem statement, the assumption map, and - for validation tests - a pre-declared pass/fail/inconclusive threshold, locked before the build begins
  • Write user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria that translate cleanly into tracked tickets and automated tests, and keep the definition of done clear and role-tagged across product, design, and engineering
  • Drive the team through a recurring build cycle: a prep phase (retro, lock scope, initial scope review) and a build phase (build, test, demo), and lead the milestone reviews - scope locked, design aligned, build validated on device with learnings captured
  • Prioritize the backlog using a scoring model and bet type, balancing scope, schedule, quality, and risk across the team's opportunities
  • Work daily with embedded design and engineering partners to pressure-test technical and design feasibility before a bet is locked, not after
  • Bring data-driven recommendations to leadership through a clear decision framework — know when you're the one driving a decision, the one approving it, or simply informed of it
  • Own the team's OKRs and the accountability for both each cycle's immediate verdict and the longer-term product outcome
  • Grow your product craft alongside the team's discovery-to-delivery operating model, as well as adjacent disciplines like Agile, Lean, and DevOps

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or the equivalent through a combination of education and related work experience
  • Demonstrated decision making, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Comfort leveraging AI tools throughout the product development lifecycle, with a curiosity for emerging technologies and ability to apply them to improve outcomes
  • Effective oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills with demonstrated effectiveness in presenting complex information to multiple organizational levels, with strong facilitation and presentation skills
  • Introduction to formal product management methodologies
  • 3 years minimum related work experience
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office software and product planning tools

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or contributing to AI-powered product experiences, with an understanding of how AI can enhance customer value
  • Introduction to structured technology delivery/software development lifecycles
  • PMP certification, or equivalent, or completed work towards PMP certification, or equivalent

Why work for us

At H&R Block, our purpose is simple: to provide help and inspire confidence in our clients and communities everywhere. For more than 70 years, we’ve led the tax industry and we continue to evolve through our Block Next strategy, blending human expertise with digital innovation.

That same commitment to care extends to our associates. When you join us, you become part of a High Performing, Connected Culture built on strong relationships, continuous learning, and a shared commitment to making a meaningful impact. We invest in your well-being through competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and support for life both in and outside of work.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a Senior Security / Command Cyber Readiness Inspection (CCRI) Analyst to support cybersecurity compliance, findings management, inspection readiness, and corrective-action tracking for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Senior Security / Command Cyber Readiness Inspection (CCRI) Analyst to support cybersecurity compliance, findings management, inspection readiness, and corrective-action tracking for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

The Security / CCRI Analyst will maintain the enterprise cybersecurity findings register, track POA&M milestones and closure evidence, and consolidate FISMA, IAVM, and monthly status reporting. The analyst will coordinate inspection preparation, evidence collection, assessment-team support, and corrective actions associated with scheduled and unscheduled cybersecurity inspections.

This role will also incorporate Government-provided scan results and remediation status into CCRI readiness reporting, maintain applicable cybersecurity procedures and policy records, and support validation of network and managed-services access requests.

This position is remote, with a preference for candidates located in the Chicago area.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Security / CCRI Analyst will:

  • Maintain the enterprise cybersecurity findings register as the authoritative record of inspection, assessment, compliance, and remediation findings.
  • Record and maintain finding descriptions, affected assets, risk levels, remediation owners, milestones, dependencies, deadlines, evidence, and closure status.
  • Create, update, and monitor POA&Ms associated with CCRI findings and other cybersecurity deficiencies.
  • Track POA&M milestones, corrective actions, due dates, progress, supporting evidence, and Government closure decisions.
  • Review closure evidence for completeness, accuracy, traceability, and consistency with the identified finding.
  • Escalate overdue, high-risk, recurring, or inadequately addressed findings to cybersecurity and program leadership.
  • Consolidate cybersecurity information for FISMA, IAVM, Monthly Status Report, and other Government reporting requirements.
  • Incorporate Government-provided scan results, compliance-check results, and remediation status into CCRI readiness reports.
  • Maintain accurate CCRI status, findings, remediation, and results reporting.
  • Support compliance with applicable CCRI technical requirements, cyber network defense directives, contributing factors, and DISA standards.
  • Coordinate preparation for scheduled and unscheduled CCRI assessments and related cybersecurity inspections.
  • Develop and maintain inspection-readiness schedules, evidence requests, checklists, trackers, and preparation materials.
  • Coordinate evidence collection across infrastructure, application, operations, cybersecurity, asset-management, and Government teams.
  • Organize inspection evidence so that each artifact is current, approved, traceable, and mapped to the applicable requirement or finding.
  • Support Government and external assessment teams during inspections by coordinating requests, gathering documentation, and tracking follow-up actions.
  • Coordinate technical-scan and policy-compliance evidence needed to demonstrate operational resilience and adherence to applicable standards.
  • Assist with planning, executing, documenting, and monitoring post-inspection corrective actions.
  • Track Government comments, questions, and requests for additional evidence through resolution.
  • Support validation of network-access and managed-services access requests in coordination with service-operations and cybersecurity personnel.
  • Maintain approved cybersecurity standard operating procedures, policies, records, user guides, and inspection-support documentation.
  • Monitor changes to applicable federal, DoD, Army, DISA, and USMEPCOM cybersecurity requirements and identify needed updates to inspection materials or procedures.
  • Prepare findings summaries, risk analyses, trend reports, status dashboards, and executive-level briefing materials.
  • Identify recurring findings, systemic compliance gaps, weak corrective actions, and evidence-quality issues.
  • Recommend process, policy, control, and documentation improvements that strengthen inspection readiness and reduce repeat findings.
  • Maintain complete records supporting findings resolution, POA&M closure, Government reporting, and future inspection activities.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant cybersecurity, information assurance, compliance, inspection-readiness, or information-security experience.
  • Current CompTIA Security+ certification.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Current ISC2 Certified in Governance, Risk and Compliance (CGRC) certification.
  • Experience supporting Command Cyber Readiness Inspections or comparable DoD cybersecurity assessments.
  • Experience preparing organizations for scheduled and unscheduled cybersecurity inspections.
  • Experience maintaining enterprise findings registers and tracking corrective actions through validated closure.
  • Experience creating and maintaining cybersecurity POA&Ms, including milestones, remediation evidence, and closure documentation.
  • Experience consolidating FISMA, IAVM, monthly status, compliance, and executive-level cybersecurity reporting.
  • Knowledge of applicable CCRI technical requirements, cyber network defense directives, contributing factors, and DISA standards.
  • Experience coordinating inspection evidence across infrastructure, application, operations, cybersecurity, and Government teams.
  • Experience reviewing Government-provided scan results and incorporating remediation status into readiness reporting.
  • Knowledge of the DoD Risk Management Framework, NIST SP 800-53 controls, DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides, and applicable DoD cybersecurity requirements.
  • Experience maintaining cybersecurity policies, standard operating procedures, access-control records, compliance evidence, and inspection documentation.
  • Familiarity with eMASS, ACAS or Tenable, Endpoint Security Solutions, STIG Viewer, SCAP tools, ServiceNow, or comparable governance and workflow platforms.
  • Experience developing findings metrics, remediation-aging reports, compliance dashboards, trend analyses, and leadership briefings.
  • Additional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CASP+, CySA+, or equivalent cybersecurity credentials.
  • Familiarity with current DoD 8140 cybersecurity workforce qualification requirements.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, technical-writing, communication, and stakeholder-coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple findings, evidence requests, reporting deadlines, and corrective-action activities in a structured compliance environment.

It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.

jobs.description:
About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

The Strategic Analytics & Transformation Manager is responsible for delivering data-driven insights, financial analysis, sales performance reporting, and operational support for SHI's strategic sales organization. This role serves as a trusted advisor to sales leadership by developing forecasting models, measuring campaign effectiveness, identifying growth opportunities, and creating scalable reporting frameworks that support informed business decisions.

This position combines financial acumen, operational excellence, and practical AI capabilities to improve sales productivity, automate reporting processes, and generate actionable insights across revenue, gross margin, pipeline, bookings, and strategic growth initiatives. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment and brings strong analytical judgment, business acumen, and experience applying business intelligence and AI tools to business challenges.

Role Description

Financial Analysis & Forecasting

  • Develop, maintain, and enhance financial and operational models that support revenue growth, gross margin performance, forecasting, and strategic planning.
  • Analyze sales performance trends and prepare executive-ready reporting to support decision-making.
  • Perform scenario modeling, investment analysis, and business-case development for strategic initiatives.
  • Partner with Finance and Sales Leadership to improve forecast accuracy and planning processes.
  • Monitor and report key business metrics, including revenue, gross margin, pipeline health, bookings, and quota attainment.

Sales Operations & Performance Management

  • Design and maintain KPI scorecards, dashboards, and scalable reporting frameworks.
  • Develop tracking methodologies for sales campaigns, partner programs, strategic initiatives, and growth motions.
  • Identify operational efficiencies through automation, standardization, and process improvement.
  • Support executive business reviews through performance analysis, concise insights, and recommended actions.
  • Create mechanisms that improve visibility into sales activity, campaign effectiveness, and organizational performance.

Campaign Analytics & Strategic Programs

  • Track and measure campaign adoption, pipeline influence, conversion, bookings, gross margin contribution, and return on investment.
  • Build repeatable campaign reporting structures, scorecards, and attribution approaches.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and strategic partners to evaluate program effectiveness and recommend optimization opportunities.
  • Analyze business outcomes and translate findings into actions that accelerate growth and improve sales execution.

Data, AI & Automation Enablement

  • Apply AI-powered technologies and automation tools to enhance reporting, forecasting, business analysis, and operational workflows.
  • Develop scalable AI-assisted workflows that reduce manual effort and accelerate insight generation.
  • Evaluate practical use cases for emerging analytical capabilities that improve decision-making and sales productivity.
  • Promote responsible adoption and effective utilization of AI-enabled sales and operational tools.
  • Document model logic, data sources, assumptions, controls, and repeatable processes to support consistency and governance.

Behaviors and Competencies


  • Financial & Business Acumen: Applies strong financial and business judgment to evaluate performance, identify opportunities, and support informed decision-making.
  • Analytical Problem-Solving & Structured Thinking: Approaches complex business challenges with a structured, data-driven mindset and translates analysis into actionable recommendations.
  • Executive Communication & Data Storytelling: Communicates complex data and insights clearly and concisely to support executive-level understanding and decision-making.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management: Builds effective partnerships across Sales, Marketing, Finance, and other stakeholders and influences across multiple levels of the organization.
  • Process Design & Continuous Improvement: Develops scalable processes, documentation, and reporting frameworks while continuously identifying opportunities for greater efficiency.
  • Adaptability & Prioritization: Effectively manages multiple priorities and adjusts to changing business needs in a fast-paced environment.
  • Attention to Detail & Bias for Action: Maintains a high level of accuracy and attention to detail while proactively moving work forward and driving results.

Skill Level Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Financial Analysis, Business Intelligence, or a related discipline.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and financial modeling capabilities.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Salesforce, Dynamics, or comparable analytics and CRM platforms.
  • Strong understanding of forecasting methodologies, KPI management, pipeline analytics, and performance reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable business recommendations.
  • Strong verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.
  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders at multiple levels.

Other Requirements

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting an enterprise technology sales organization.
  • Experience developing sales campaign measurement frameworks, scorecards, or attribution models.
  • Working knowledge of AI-enabled productivity, analytics, and business intelligence tools, including Microsoft Copilot or comparable platforms.
  • Experience with Power Query, DAX, SQL, Python, or other advanced reporting and analytics technologies.
  • Experience with data automation, dashboard development, and data-quality controls.
  • MBA or advanced degree preferred.

What Success Looks Like


  • Establish standardized campaign measurement and reporting processes.
  • Improve visibility into pipeline, revenue, gross margin, and sales performance.
  • Enhance forecasting accuracy through scalable models, consistent assumptions, and clear reporting.
  • Deliver executive-ready dashboards and KPI scorecards that support timely decisions.
  • Identify and implement practical automation opportunities using AI and analytics technologies.
  • Provide actionable insights that strengthen sales execution and support profitable growth.

The estimated annual pay range for this position is $135,000 - $185,000 which includes a base salary and bonus. The compensation for this position is dependent on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending.

jobs.excerpt: Real opportunities.  Real impact.  Your career, redefined.
jobs.description:
Real opportunities. Real impact. Your career, redefined.

(NOTE: A human reviews every application at Oceans, so please apply for only one position and only once a year—if you're a better fit for another role, we’ll route your application accordingly and if we’re not quite ready for you, we’ll reach back out later.)

At Oceans, we believe that talent knows no boundaries. That’s why we connect the best and brightest professionals with career-defining opportunities that challenge, inspire, and accelerate their career growth. Our community, whom we call Divers, don’t just work—they dive deep, solve complex challenges, and make a real impact with global industry leaders. And in doing so, they don’t just support bold ideas—they expand their skills, broaden their expertise, and grow their careers.

As an Accounts Receivable & Financial Operations Specialist, you will join a growing pest management services company serving commercial and residential accounts across diverse sectors, including school districts, commercial properties, and multifamily real estate. In this role, you will take ownership of day-to-day accounts receivable execution, commercial billing workflows, collections support, and financial reporting.

You will manage the end-to-end receivables lifecycle—from customer invoicing and third-party vendor portal submissions to payment tracking, routine account reconciliations, and AR analytics. Working in a detail-oriented, hands-on capacity, you will ensure high financial data accuracy, maintain smooth customer billing communications, and streamline operational workflows across internal systems and customer portals.

Accountability

As an Accounts Receivable & Financial Operations Specialist, your success will be defined by your ability to maintain highly accurate customer account records, ensure timely invoicing across specialized commercial portals, track incoming payments, and deliver accurate AR reporting.

Here’s how you’ll make an impact:

Accounts Receivable & Payment Management

  • Execute daily AR workflows, monitoring incoming customer payments and processing credit card transactions in accordance with established procedures.
  • Maintain accurate customer account balances, tracking outstanding invoices and identifying overdue accounts promptly.
  • Review incoming billing inquiries, responding professionally to routine payment questions and resolving account discrepancies.
  • Maintain precise records of payment activity and customer communications in the CRM, escalating unresolved payment issues when senior finance involvement is required.

Commercial Billing & Portal Invoicing

  • Prepare and submit invoices for commercial accounts with specialized billing procedures, including school districts and multifamily properties.
  • Download, organize, and convert billing documentation into required formats (such as PDF) for submission to specialized third-party vendor portals (e.g., VendorCafe, VendorShield, Tech Agile).
  • Track invoice submission deadlines to prevent billing delays and resolve routine portal administrative roadblocks.
  • Ensure all supporting documentation is complete, accurate, and aligned with agreed customer billing schedules.

Collections Support & AR Reporting

  • Generate recurring weekly accounts receivable and collections reports to assist the on-site collections team with prioritization.
  • Maintain full visibility into outstanding balances, customer payment statuses, and recurring payment delays.
  • Organize relevant account notes and updates to support collections communications and mitigate AR risk.

Account Reconciliation & Data Quality

  • Assist with routine account reconciliation activities by verifying that financial transactions align with supporting records.
  • Review ledger balances for inconsistencies, identifying missing or misclassified entries to support financial data cleanup.
  • Ensure all supporting financial documentation is organized, complete, and audit-ready.

Finance Systems, Technology & Process Improvement

  • Maintain accurate customer profile and billing data within PestPac CRM.
  • Utilize Microsoft Excel and Google Workspace for financial data organization, tracking, and reporting workflows.
  • Support the team's exploration and adoption of AI-enabled reporting, analytics capabilities, and process improvements to reduce repetitive administrative work.
  • Identify recurring workflow bottlenecks and proactively recommend practical process enhancements.

Colleagues

You will work closely with the internal Finance team and on-site AR and collections personnel to coordinate customer account updates, align on billing requirements, and ensure operational continuity.

At Oceans, you’ll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you’re continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area, paired with broad curiosity and interests. As an Accounts Receivable & Financial Operations Specialist, your vertical strength will be accounts receivable execution, commercial billing workflows, and payment tracking, while your horizontal capabilities should span account reconciliation support, financial reporting, portal navigation, and process optimization.

To excel in this role, you should have:

  • Experience: Hands-on experience in accounts receivable, commercial invoicing, collections support, or financial operations, including experience with specialized billing procedures and vendor portals.
  • Tools/Systems: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (data organization, spreadsheets) and Google Workspace, with hands-on experience navigating billing/CRM software (e.g., PestPac) and vendor portals (e.g., VendorCafe, VendorShield, Tech Agile). Exposure to credit card processing and AI-assisted workflows is preferred.
  • Analytics/Process: Strong understanding of AR workflows, payment tracking, balance reporting, account reconciliation support, and variance/discrepancy identification.
  • Mindset: Highly organized, detail-oriented, and accountable, with excellent written English skills for professional customer communications and a proactive approach to learning new platforms.

During the interview process, you’ll have the opportunity to showcase your skills in the following areas:

  • Accounts Receivable Execution: How do you manage incoming customer payments, maintain accurate account balances, and track outstanding invoices?
  • Commercial Portal Billing: How do you organize and submit specialized invoices across third-party vendor portals while meeting tight deadlines?
  • Collections Support & AR Reporting: How do you compile data-driven AR reports to support collections prioritization and identify recurring payment risks?
  • Data Accuracy & Reconciliation Support: How do you review financial records, spot discrepancies, and ensure data integrity across multiple systems?
  • Systems Adaptability & Workflow Optimization: How do you learn unfamiliar billing software or adopt tech tools (such as AI capabilities) to streamline repetitive financial tasks?

Diversity of experience is core to Oceans. You are expected to work inclusively with individuals from a variety of backgrounds, ensuring that both personal and collective dignity are supported.

Role Specifications

This is a remote role, where you will be expected to work a split shift with some overlap with our client’s time zone. You will, however, be expected to be present for in-person training programs during your first 3.5 weeks with us. During the offer process, we’ll share more information about our benefits and compensation philosophy, considering both market trends and individual factors.

About Oceans

At Oceans Talent, we connect the world’s top talent with visionary companies building what’s next. Here, you’re not just stepping into another role — you’re joining a team that values individuality, ambition, and growth without limits. Unique, like you.

We’re always excited to share more about our journey, where we’re headed, and how you can grow with us throughout the interview process.

Want to learn more about our recruitment process, what to expect from interviews, and possible outcomes? Check out [The Dive].

Sobre St. Publius Corporate Services Limited

St. Publius Corporate Services Limited es una firma de asesoría fiscal internacional con un equipo de entre 11 y 50 empleados. Nuestros servicios abarcan la elaboración de cuentas anuales, la gestión de declaraciones fiscales y el soporte continuado en la operativa diaria de estas sociedades extranjeras.

Lo que esperamos de usted

Buscamos un perfil con experiencia previa demostrable en el ámbito contable y de teneduría de libros, capaz de gestionar con precisión la contabilidad diaria de clientes internacionales. Sus primeros meses en St. Publius Corporate Services Limited

About the Client

A venture-backed software company replacing the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern, AI-native software. Its systems of record are already live across federal civilian agencies and inside the Department of War, and revenue has grown many times over this year. Backed by top-tier venture investors, with teams in New York and Washington, DC.

About the Role

The company already has a foothold inside the Department of War. The Air Force is the next front: a service with its own acquisition culture, its own program offices, and its own version of legacy-system fatigue.

You will own the full sales cycle across the Department of the Air Force, Air Force and Space Force together. That means opening new relationships inside AFLCMC and its program offices, then carrying them through demos, procurement and close, and building a repeatable motion across major commands and installations rather than chasing a single flagship win. It means knowing how the Air Force actually buys, through OT pathways or traditional program-of-record channels, and earning trust with program offices, contracting officers and installation staff who have watched vendors overpromise before.

Responsibilities

  • Own the Air Force and Space Force sales cycle end to end, from outbound prospecting through demos, proposals, negotiation and close.
  • Build strategic account plans and turn a standing start into a repeatable motion across AFMC and other major commands and installations.
  • Navigate Air Force and Space Force procurement pathways, including OT awards, GSA MAS, IDIQs, BPAs and installation-level task orders.
  • Build direct relationships within AFLCMC, installation leadership, and contracting officers across Air Force and Space Force bases.
  • Lead discovery sessions and in-person product demos tailored to Air Force and Space Force workflows, without sales engineering support.
  • Partner with the proposal, capture and design teams on solicitation responses and pricing.
  • Represent the company at Air Force and Space Force industry days and conferences.

Must-Haves

  • Deep experience in or with the Air Force or Space Force, whether in uniform, as a civilian, or selling into it.
  • A record of building accounts from zero and closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals against a quota. Current relationships and what you have personally built count for more than a years-of-experience number.
  • Fluency with Air Force and Space Force major programs, procurement vehicles and buying cycles.
  • The appetite to be an individual contributor: prospecting, carrying an ambitious number, and owning the deal from first call to transition into delivery.
  • Comfort demoing software on your own, and working fluency with tools like Salesforce.
  • U.S. citizenship, given the security and eligibility requirements tied to Department of War contracts.

Nice-to-Haves

  • An active U.S. security clearance. TS/SCI preferred.
  • Existing relationships within AFMC, SSC or a specific major command.
  • Experience with an Air Force or Space Force software factory (for example Kessel Run or Platform One), or selling quality-of-life, base services or enterprise IT modernization programs.

Not a Fit

  • You need an account plan that is already built. The Air Force is a standing start and most of the map is unclaimed.
  • You are not comfortable being the one who has to earn trust from a program office that has been burned before.
  • You would rather sell into a service you already know than open new relationships from scratch.

We are seeking an experienced .NET Full Stack Developer to design, build, and maintain enterprise-grade web applications and distributed systems built on Microsoft technology stacks. This role spans the full engineering lifecycle — requirements analysis, architectural design, hands-on implementation, code review, deployment, and post-release support — with particular emphasis on building scalable APIs, responsive front-end applications, and cloud-integrated services. The ideal candidate will combine strong backend expertise in C# and .NET Core with hands-on experience developing modern front-end applications using JavaScript frameworks, and will be comfortable deploying solutions into Azure or AWS environments while maintaining high standards of code quality, security, observability, and operational reliability.

Key Responsibilities
  • Provide comprehensive end-to-end design, development, and advanced technical troubleshooting for enterprise-level web applications, from initial discovery through long-term operational ownership.
  • Develop secure, high-performance backend services using .NET Core and ASP.NET Web API, applying strong object-oriented design, clean architecture principles, and proven enterprise patterns.
  • Design and implement scalable architecture patterns — including microservices, service-oriented designs, and event-driven workflows — that support the demands of growing, distributed user bases.
  • Build modern, responsive front-end applications using Angular, React, or similar frameworks, ensuring excellent user experience, accessibility, and performance across browsers and devices.
  • Develop and optimize relational database schemas, stored procedures, indexes, and complex queries in SQL Server, with attention to performance, locking behavior, and long-term maintainability.
  • Produce thorough architecture and technical design documentation, ensuring alignment with performance, security, compliance, and operational standards of the enterprise.
  • Participate in system design discussions and ensure that development consistently aligns with enterprise architecture constraints, technology road-maps, and platform standards.
  • Implement robust authentication and authorization mechanisms using OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, and modern identity management services such as Azure AD or Okta.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline integration, automated builds, infrastructure-as-code practices, and reliable deployment processes across development, staging, and production environments.
  • Perform thorough root-cause analysis and methodically troubleshoot production issues, working to restore service quickly while ensuring long-term operational stability.
  • Identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and architectural gaps, and proactively propose and implement well-scoped improvements with measurable benefits.
  • Collaborate fully in Agile/Scrum environments — including planning, daily standups, demos, and retrospectives — to deliver incremental, high-quality releases on a predictable cadence.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation of systems, APIs, integration workflows, and operational runbooks so that the team can scale and onboard new engineers efficiently.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of professional software development experience building production-grade enterprise applications.
  • Strong understanding of object-oriented programming principles, data structures, design patterns, and end-to-end system design.
  • Advanced proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and ASP.NET Web API, including familiarity with dependency injection, async/await patterns, and middleware design.
  • Hands-on experience developing front-end applications using Angular, React, or similar component-driven frameworks.
  • Strong SQL skills with deep, hands-on experience working with SQL Server, including stored procedures, query plans, and performance tuning.
  • Solid experience with CI/CD tooling and Git-based version control systems, including branching strategies and release workflows.
  • Hands-on experience deploying applications to Azure or AWS cloud environments, including managed services and identity integration.
  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills, with the ability to investigate complex production issues calmly and effectively.
  • Experience working in large enterprise-scale environments where reliability, security, and audit-ability are first-class concerns.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Practical experience designing and operating microservices architectures in production.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and container-based deployment patterns.
  • Exposure to distributed system design principles, including eventual consistency, idempotency, and circuit breakers.
  • Experience implementing automated testing frameworks across unit, integration, and end-to-end levels.

jobs.description:
Statistiker:in (m/w/d)

Ab 4.500 € brutto / Monat · Klare Steigerung nach Ergebnissen · Kleines Team, große Verantwortung

Worum es geht

Wir begleiten Mediziner:innen durch ihre Promotion — von Methodik über Auswertung bis zur fertigen Dissertation. Unsere Klient:innen sind keine Studenten, sondern erwachsene Profis, die liefern müssen. Du bist die Person, die dafür sorgt, dass das passiert.

Konkret heißt das: Du übernimmst Projekte von der ersten Methodendiskussion bis zur finalen Abgabe. Du analysierst Daten (R, Python, SPSS, MAXQDA — je nachdem, was das Projekt verlangt), überarbeitest wissenschaftliche Texte, erklärst Doktorand:innen Methoden ruhig und klar, gibst Feedback, hältst Termine ein und triffst Entscheidungen, ohne dass jemand dich an die Hand nehmen muss.

Ehrlich gesagt

Wir sind ein kleines Unternehmen mit hoher Schlagzahl und hoher Effizienz. Wir brauchen sorgfältige, einsatzbereite und belastbare Leute, die methodisch sauber arbeiten, überdurchschnittlich verdienen wollen und in einem wachsenden Unternehmen von Anfang an dabei sein wollen.

Im Gegenzug bekommst du etwas, das ein Konzern nicht bieten kann: Vom ersten Tag an eigene Projekte, direkten Kundenkontakt, sichtbare Wirkung, und einen Aufstieg, der sich an deinen Ergebnissen bemisst und nicht an deiner Betriebszugehörigkeit.

Was du machst

  • Mediziner:innen durch den kompletten Promotionsprozess führen — Methodik, Statistik, Schreiben, Struktur

  • Statistische und qualitative Auswertungen liefern (R, Python, SPSS, MAXQDA)

  • Doktorand:innen Methoden geduldig und klar erklären — schriftlich und im Gespräch

  • Wissenschaftliche Texte überarbeiten, Feedback geben, methodische Sauberkeit sicherstellen

  • Mehrere parallele Projekte koordinieren — Termine, Qualität, Kundenkontakt

  • KI- und Automatisierungstools so einsetzen, dass du schneller und besser wirst als ohne

  • Mit Professor:innen, Lehrstühlen und Forschungsstellen sauber kommunizieren

Was du mitbringst

  • Hochschulabschluss (Bachelor oder Master) in Statistik, Psychologie (empirisch/quantitativ), Sozialwissenschaft (quant), Wirtschaftsmathematik, BWL mit Empirie-Schwerpunkt, Mathematik, Public Health (quantitativ) oder vergleichbar. Eine Promotion ist nicht erforderlich und gibt hier keinen Bonus.

  • Strukturierte, methodische Arbeitsweise. Du planst, bevor du loslegst. Du arbeitest sorgfältig statt hektisch. Du erkennst Inkonsistenzen in Daten oder Texten, die andere überlesen.

  • Bodenständigkeit. Du hast in deinem Leben schon einmal richtig gearbeitet — Gastro, Bau, Pflege, Pflichtdienst, Lager, Versorgerjobs, körperliche Tätigkeiten neben dem Studium. Wer einmal eine 10-Stunden-Schicht in der Küche oder auf der Baustelle gemacht hat, weiß, was ehrliche Arbeit bedeutet

  • Aktuelle Statistik-Praxis. Du hast in den letzten 12 Monaten konkret mit R, Python, SPSS oder MAXQDA gearbeitet — nicht nur im Studium.

  • Erfahrung im Erklären von Methoden — als Tutor:in, Nachhilfelehrer:in, Übungsleiter:in, Werkstudent:in im Lehrstuhl-Umfeld oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle. Wer Lernenden schon einmal Statistik ruhig erklärt hat, bringt das wichtigste Soft-Skill mit.

  • Emotionale Stabilität. Wenn ein:e Klient:in panisch wird, bleibst du ruhig. Wenn drei Mandate parallel brennen, sortierst du methodisch, statt dich anstecken zu lassen. Du nimmst Fehler sachlich, nicht persönlich.

  • Eigenverantwortung und Verbindlichkeit. Du strukturierst deinen Tag selbst, hältst Deadlines ein, lieferst zuverlässig — auch wenn niemand drüberguckt.

  • Belastbarkeit in intensiven Phasen — keine Schönwetter-Mentalität.

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau — du musst Texte korrigieren und gegenüber Senior-Klient:innen klar, aber respektvoll argumentieren können.

  • Lust auf Privatwirtschaft, nicht auf Uni-Atmosphäre.

Berufserfahrung von Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Wir nehmen auch Berufseinsteiger:innen mit starkem Tutor-Track. Mit 2-5 Jahren Berufserfahrung in datenorientierten Bereichen (Marktforschung, Pharma-Innendienst, Junior Analytics, klinische Studien) bist du im Vorteil.

Was wir bieten

  • Geld: Ab 4.500 € brutto, reale Steigerung in den ersten 6–12 Monaten nach Ergebnissen

  • Aufstieg nach Leistung: Wer liefert, kommt schnell hoch — Zugehörigkeit zählt nicht

  • Echte Verantwortung: Eigene Projekte, eigene Kunden, eigene Entscheidungen — ab Tag 1

  • Profi-Umfeld: MacBook, moderne Tools, KI-Stack — keine Bastellösungen

  • Klare Strukturen: Max. 2–3 Personen pro Büro, keine Konzernpolitik, keine Meetings ohne Zweck

  • Entwicklung: Methodisch, technisch und unternehmerisch — du wächst hier real

Wen wir nicht suchen

Wir suchen keine Akademiker:innen, die in der Forschungsblase bleiben wollen. Keine Theoretiker:innen, die sich in Details verlieren, ohne zu liefern. Keine Leute, die "Work-Life-Balance" auf das Stundenkonto reduzieren. Wer langsam, unzuverlässig oder konfliktscheu ist, wird hier nicht glücklich — und wir auch nicht.

Wir suchen jemanden, der ruhig, methodisch und ergebnisorientiert arbeitet — und dafür entsprechend bezahlt werden will.

Bewerbung

Schick uns Lebenslauf und ein aussagekräftiges und persönliches Anschreiben.

  1. Warum du in eine kleine Firma willst — nicht in einen Konzern oder die Uni.

  2. Was du in den nächsten 12 Monaten konkret erreichen möchtest.

Relevante Arbeiten, Code oder Projektbeispiele gerne dazu.

Unvollständige Bewerbungen sortieren wir aus. Bei passenden Bewerbungen melden wir uns innerhalb von 5 Werktagen.
