jobs.description:
Overview

Company Overview:

Elevate your security career with Allied Universal® Enhanced Protection Services, a global leader in security and threat mitigation. We specialize in risk consulting, executive protection, intelligence, investigations, and emergency response, offering exciting career opportunities for professionals passionate about security and safety. Join our innovative team committed to excellence in the security industry and make a meaningful impact. Explore key roles, such as executive protection agents, intelligence analysts, armed security operatives, x-ray screeners, and security consultants.

Job Description

Supply Chain & Logistics Resilience Analyst

Location: RemoteAnnual Salary: $95,000Employment Type: Full-TimeExperience Level: Early Career / Junior Analyst

Position Summary

We are seeking a data-driven and solutions-oriented Supply Chain & Logistics Resilience Analyst to support operational continuity, supply chain risk management, and business resilience across a complex logistics ecosystem.

In this role, you will analyze data from multiple sources, identify emerging risks and operational dependencies, develop dashboards, and translate complex information into actionable insights for program managers and senior leadership. You will also contribute to contingency planning, scenario analysis, and business continuity initiatives designed to strengthen resilience and minimize operational disruptions.

The ideal candidate has a foundation in emergency management, logistics, supply chain operations, crisis management, business continuity, or data analytics. This individual is curious, detail-oriented, and comfortable connecting disparate information sources to identify vulnerabilities, anticipate disruptions, and support informed decision-making.

The position offers an opportunity to apply analytical skills and emerging AI-enabled tools to practical resilience challenges while collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders in a dynamic operating environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop Risk and Resilience Dashboards: Build and maintain dashboards using raw, multi-source data to transform complex logistics metrics into clear, actionable visualizations for program managers and senior leadership.
  • Analyze Supply Chain Dependencies: Identify relationships and dependencies across logistics nodes to uncover upstream and downstream vulnerabilities before they result in operational disruptions.
  • Monitor Emerging Risks: Identify, analyze, and track emerging risk trends using analytics platforms, operational data, and insights from cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Leverage AI-Enabled Tools: Apply approved AI tools to accelerate risk detection, scenario analysis, data synthesis, and continuity planning while validating outputs for accuracy and relevance.
  • Identify Leading Risk Indicators: Challenge existing assumptions and identify indicators that may signal emerging vulnerabilities across the global logistics and supply chain ecosystem.
  • Maintain Criticality and Data Integrity: Support accurate, consistent data management and criticality tiering for suppliers, warehouses, airports, and other essential logistics nodes.
  • Support Contingency Planning: Assist in developing and maintaining contingency playbooks that define potential threats, decision triggers, mitigation strategies, and recovery procedures.
  • Prepare Leadership Briefings: Support program managers with data preparation, analytical inputs, presentation materials, and executive briefing decks for leadership reviews and roundtable discussions.
  • Collaborate Across Functions: Work with stakeholders in logistics, supply chain operations, business continuity, risk management, and related functions to strengthen shared situational awareness and operational preparedness.
  • Improve Analytical Processes: Identify opportunities to enhance data quality, reporting workflows, visualization methods, risk monitoring, and continuity planning processes.

Required Qualifications

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent military, public-sector, or professional experience.
  • One to three (1–3) years of relevant professional experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Emergency response logistics
    • Business continuity or Continuity of Operations (COOP)
    • Crisis or incident management
    • Supply chain, logistics, or procurement operations
    • Risk management or risk reporting
    • Data analytics or business intelligence
    • Business continuity planning and operational resilience support
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize large, complex, or ambiguous datasets into clear, decision-quality insights.
  • Experience preparing reports, presentations, dashboards, or other analytical deliverables to support operational or management decisions.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • A data-first mindset with strong analytical, research, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Ability to translate complex information into actionable recommendations and concise narratives for non-technical audiences.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
  • Familiarity with at least one data visualization or analytics platform, such as Tableau or Microsoft Power BI.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare and present concise briefings.
  • Understanding of risk management, operational continuity, supply chain resilience, or crisis preparedness principles.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams while independently managing assigned analytical tasks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with recognized business continuity, risk management, and supply chain resilience frameworks, including:
    • ISO 22301 — Business Continuity Management
    • ISO 31000 — Risk Management
    • ISO 28000 — Security Management Systems for the Supply Chain
    • ISO 22318 — Business Continuity Guidance for Supply Chain Continuity
  • Relevant professional certifications, including CBCP, ABCP, ARMP, CSCP, CPIM, CPSM, or CERP, or active pursuit of these credentials.
  • Experience developing dashboards, data visualizations, risk indicators, or analytics-driven reporting tools.
  • Exposure to AI-enabled analytics, scenario modeling, workflow automation, or other emerging technologies that support risk identification and continuity planning.
  • Experience supporting emergency preparedness, contingency planning, crisis response, or operational recovery initiatives in the private or public sector.
  • Familiarity with supplier criticality assessments, logistics network dependencies, facility risk analysis, or supply chain disruption monitoring.

Work Arrangement

Remote Position

This role is designated as remote, with day-to-day collaboration conducted through appropriate virtual communication, reporting, and project-management tools.

Work Environment

The role primarily involves computer-based analytical work, including data analysis, dashboard development, research, report preparation, virtual meetings, and participation in briefings. The position requires sustained attention to detail, sound analytical judgment, and effective communication with stakeholders across multiple functions.

Equal Employment Opportunity

We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified applicants. Reasonable accommodations may be made throughout the application and employment process, consistent with applicable law.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit an updated resume highlighting relevant experience in supply chain operations, business continuity, risk management, emergency response logistics, data analytics, or crisis management.

Applicants are encouraged to highlight experience with dashboard development, data visualization platforms, contingency planning, risk assessment frameworks, and AI-enabled analytical tools.

We welcome candidates who are passionate about using data, technology, and collaborative problem-solving to strengthen supply chain resilience and support operational continuity.

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionOligo is a fast-growing cybersecurity startup transforming how organizations protect their applications, cloud environments, and AI systems at runtime.
jobs.description:
Description

Oligo is a fast-growing cybersecurity startup transforming how organizations protect their applications, cloud environments, and AI systems at runtime. Backed by top-tier investors including Greenfield Partners, Red Dot Capital Partners, Lightspeed, Ballistic Ventures, and TLV Partners, we're on a mission to make real-time security a reality.

Oligo's industry's leading runtime security platform built to stop attacks in real time without stopping the business. We transform security from passive visibility to active protection across applications, cloud services, workloads, and AI systems. By uncovering the deepest layers of what actually runs in production, Oligo helps organizations prioritize exploitable vulnerabilities, detect malicious behavior as it happens, and stop modern attacks in their tracks.

We're looking for a Director of Product Marketing to own Oligo’s story end to end- from market positioning and differentiation across our product lines (runtime protection/ADR, AI security, and runtime vulnerability management) to equipping our GTM teams to win.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll lead a small team while staying close to the work: crafting messaging, building launch plans, and presenting to customers and sellers.

Product Marketing sits within Product Management at Oligo. You'll partner daily with PMs on roadmap and launches, and work closely with Sales, Marketing, and leadership on pipeline generation and enablement. You'll connect what we build with how the market understands its value.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the Function

  • Own positioning, messaging, and narrative across Oligo’s product lines, ensuring consistency as the product evolves.
  • Define the product marketing roadmap and priorities, aligned with product development and GTM goals.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a small team of product marketers.
  • Represent Product Marketing in cross-functional planning, bringing market insights and competitive intelligence into roadmap decisions.

Drive Execution

  • Product launches & campaigns: Lead end-to-end GTM for new products and features, from positioning and messaging to launch plans, sales enablement, and integrated campaigns.
  • Market & competitive intelligence: Track competitors across ADR, CNAPP, EDR, AppSec, and AI security, translating insights into positioning and product recommendations.
  • GTM enablement: Equip Sales, SEs, and partners with the training and tools they need to win, including battlecards, one-pagers, pitch decks, demo narratives, and ROI models.
  • Content & storytelling: Create product-led content across blogs, product tours, videos, launch assets, conferences, and analyst materials, ensuring consistent messaging across channels.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of Product Marketing experience in cybersecurity, including 2+ years leading or mentoring product marketers. Runtime security experience is a plus.
  • Proven track record of launching technical software products and driving adoption of new capabilities.
  • Strong technical acumen, with the ability to engage with engineers and security practitioners, understand detection architectures, and translate technical concepts into clear business value.
  • Exceptional writing, storytelling, and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex technical products compelling and relevant to buyers.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise software buyer journeys and complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Analytical mindset, with the ability to turn data and market insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Creative, energetic, and collaborative, with the ability to influence without authority and thrive in the ambiguity of a fast-growing company.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in runtime protection, application security, cloud security, or detection and response (ADR, CNAPP, EDR, WAF).
  • Experience working at a company defining or entering a new market category.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a Journeyman QA Specialist to support program quality-management and software quality-assurance activities for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Journeyman QA Specialist to support program quality-management and software quality-assurance activities for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This role supports execution of the Quality Management Plan, performs quality reviews of program deliverables and workflows, and validates Task Order Management Portal enhancements before release.

The QA Specialist will test portal forms, automations, dashboards, permissions, workflows, and data-quality controls to confirm that capabilities meet Government requirements and function as intended. The successful candidate will document and track defects, manage Corrective Action Requests and Preventive Action Requests, support root-cause analysis, and help capture lessons learned that improve program performance.

This position is remote, with preference given to candidates located in or near Chicago.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The QA Specialist will:

  • Support implementation, execution, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the program Quality Management Plan.
  • Perform quality-assurance and quality-control reviews of program deliverables, reports, workflows, forms, records, and supporting documentation.
  • Verify that deliverables are accurate, complete, consistent, traceable to requirements, and compliant with approved standards and formats.
  • Develop and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, checklists, and validation procedures for Task Order Management Portal enhancements.
  • Validate portal forms, workflows, automations, dashboards, notifications, permissions, data fields, calculations, and reports.
  • Confirm that portal enhancements satisfy documented Government requirements and acceptance criteria before release.
  • Conduct functional, regression, integration, workflow, permissions, and data-quality testing.
  • Document test results, defects, expected and actual behavior, severity, supporting evidence, and recommended corrective actions.
  • Enter, classify, prioritize, track, retest, and close defects in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Manage Corrective Action Requests and Preventive Action Requests from identification through validated closure.
  • Perform or support root-cause analyses for defects, process failures, recurring findings, and quality-performance concerns.
  • Verify that corrective and preventive actions resolve identified issues and reduce the likelihood of recurrence.
  • Track quality-review findings, responsible owners, due dates, status, remediation evidence, and closure decisions.
  • Support Monthly Status Reports, project status meetings, Program Management Reviews, and other reporting activities with quality metrics and trend information.
  • Analyze defect trends, recurring quality issues, workflow failures, data discrepancies, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Maintain quality records, test evidence, review logs, defect registers, corrective-action records, lessons learned, and audit trails.
  • Support quality reviews of transition documentation, trip reports, purchasing packages, status reports, plans, and other program artifacts.
  • Participate in release-readiness reviews and provide evidence-based recommendations regarding deployment.
  • Coordinate testing and quality reviews with the Quality Manager, developers, portal administrators, task leads, program analysts, and Government stakeholders.
  • Assist with internal assessments, Government reviews, quality-surveillance activities, and audit preparation.
  • Capture lessons learned and recommend updates to processes, controls, templates, test suites, and quality procedures.
  • Protect sensitive Government, program, personnel, test, and performance information.

Qualifications

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Quality Management, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 6 years of relevant professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in software quality assurance, software testing, program quality, quality control, business-process testing, or a related discipline.
  • Experience supporting Department of Defense, federal civilian, or other Government programs.
  • Experience implementing or supporting a formal Quality Management Plan.
  • Experience reviewing contract deliverables for accuracy, completeness, consistency, traceability, and compliance.
  • Experience developing and executing test plans, test cases, test scripts, acceptance criteria, and regression-testing procedures.
  • Experience testing forms, workflows, automations, dashboards, permissions, notifications, reports, and data-quality controls.
  • Experience validating Microsoft SharePoint, Power Platform, ServiceNow, Jira, or comparable portal and workflow capabilities.
  • Experience documenting, classifying, prioritizing, tracking, retesting, and closing software defects.
  • Experience managing Corrective Action Requests, Preventive Action Requests, or comparable remediation workflows.
  • Experience performing root-cause analysis and validating corrective and preventive actions.
  • Experience conducting functional, regression, integration, workflow, permissions, and user-acceptance testing.
  • Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, DevSecOps, ITIL, or hybrid delivery environments.
  • Knowledge of requirements traceability, release management, configuration management, and change-control practices.
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001, CMMI, Lean Six Sigma, or comparable quality frameworks.
  • Experience using Azure DevOps, Jira, ServiceNow, Power BI, SharePoint, automated testing tools, or comparable quality-management platforms.
  • ITIL Foundation, CSQA, ISTQB, ASQ, Lean Six Sigma, or a comparable quality or testing certification.
  • Strong analytical, testing, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational, documentation, and time-management skills.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to objective, evidence-based quality decisions.
  • Ability to translate Government requirements into testable acceptance criteria.
  • Ability to manage multiple reviews, test cycles, defects, corrective actions, and deadlines.

About the Client
Our client is an established, mid-sized US company that sells to business customers and runs a lean, hands-on finance function. Their accounting team works in a practical, less automated environment built on Sage 100 and Excel, where people are trusted to own their work from start to finish. They’re looking for a dependable remote professional to take charge of their entire AR desk and work closely with their sales, operations, and accounting teams.
Why does this role exist?
The company needs one experienced, detail-oriented person to take full ownership of its accounts receivable, from invoicing through collections and reconciliation. This role keeps cash flowing in, customer accounts accurate, and billing disputes resolved quickly, so leadership can trust the numbers without chasing them. You’ll also give light administrative support to company leadership.

The Impact you’ll make

Invoicing Customer Account Management
  • Prepare and send accurate invoices, statements, and supporting documentation
  • Maintain accurate customer records, including billing addresses, contacts, payment terms, tax details, and account changes
  • Review or help establish customer credit limits and payment terms
Cash Application Payment Research
  • Review bank activity, lockbox information, checks, ACH payments, wires, credit card payments, and remittance details
  • Manually post and apply customer payments in the ERP system (Sage 100)
  • Research and resolve unapplied cash, short payments, overpayments, deductions, and misapplied payments
Collections
  • Monitor aging reports and keep a consistent collection cadence for current and past-due accounts
  • Contact customers by phone and email about invoices, balances, payment commitments, disputes, and overdue accounts
  • Maintain accurate collection notes, promise-to-pay dates, and account status updates
Disputes, Credits Adjustments
  • Research invoice discrepancies and work with sales, operations, and accounting to resolve customer disputes
  • Process and apply approved credit memos, customer credits, adjustments, and write-offs
Reconciliation, Reporting Leadership Support
  • Reconcile customer accounts, the AR subledger, revenue accounts, and related general ledger activity
  • Prepare AR aging, collection, dispute, and cash receipt reports for management
  • Provide occasional administrative support to company leadership, including scheduling, document preparation, and follow-up coordination

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Required
  • Recent, long-term, hands-on full-cycle AR experience with a stable job history
  • Personally handled collections, manual cash application, credit terms, credits, disputes, and reconciliations, ideally within a one- or two-person AR team
  • Recent experience supporting a US-based company or communicating directly with US customers
  • Clear, easily understood spoken English for unscripted customer calls, plus strong written English
  • Proficiency in Excel and experience with accounting or ERP systems, with a strong grasp of debit and credit mechanics
Your superpowers are...
  • Technical
    • Full-cycle AR: invoicing, cash application, collections, aging, and reconciliation
    • Basic accounting principles and debit and credit mechanics
    • Sage 100 (or comparable ERP), Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and the Microsoft Office Suite

  • Soft skills
    • Confident, clear phone communication, even in detailed, unscripted, or tense conversations
    • Direct, professional communication, with the ability to work well with strong personalities
    • Sharp attention to detail and strong organization
    • Independence: you manage your own workload without needing to be chased
    • Collaboration with sales, operations, and accounting to get to the root of a problem
WFH Set-Up:
  • Computer with at least 8GB RAM, an Intel i5 core processor/AMD Ryzen 5 Processor and up.

  • Headset with an extended mic that has noise cancellation and a webcam
  • Back-up computer and internet connection
  • Quiet, dedicated workspace at home
You should apply if...
  • You take pride in owning a whole process and don’t need a big team or heavy automation to do it well
  • You’re comfortable picking up the phone and having firm, respectful conversations about money
  • You speak up, ask direct questions, and are at ease with colleagues who are equally direct
  • You like digging into the details until the numbers tie out
  • You’re reliable and consistent, and you’ve stayed long enough in past roles to see your work through
  • You’re happy to jump in on small admin tasks when leadership needs a hand
What to expect...

  • Must have a reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace
  • Required to provide own computer with Intel Core i5 or something similar or higher operating system

Position Summary

The Chief Risk Officer (CRO) – Retail Banking is responsible for establishing and leading the enterprise-wide risk management framework for the retail banking business. The CRO oversees credit, operational, market, liquidity, compliance, fraud, cyber, conduct, and reputational risks while ensuring alignment with the bank's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite.

The role provides independent oversight and challenge to business activities, safeguarding the institution's financial stability, customers, and reputation while enabling sustainable growth.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Risk Management

  • Develop and maintain the retail banking risk management framework.
  • Establish risk appetite statements, risk limits, and governance standards.
  • Ensure effective identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation of risks.
  • Provide independent oversight of business decisions and strategic initiatives.
  • Promote a strong risk culture throughout the organization.

Credit Risk Management

  • Oversee retail credit portfolios, including:
    • Mortgages
    • Personal Loans
    • Credit Cards
    • Auto Loans
    • Consumer Finance Products
  • Establish underwriting standards and credit policies.
  • Monitor portfolio quality, delinquency trends, and loss performance.
  • Lead stress testing and credit risk scenario analyses.
  • Recommend risk-adjusted lending strategies.

Operational Risk Management

  • Develop frameworks to identify and manage operational risks.
  • Monitor operational incidents, control failures, and emerging risks.
  • Oversee business continuity and operational resilience programs.
  • Strengthen internal controls and risk reporting mechanisms.
  • Ensure effective risk and control self-assessment processes.

Regulatory Compliance & Conduct Risk

  • Ensure compliance with banking regulations and consumer protection laws.
  • Oversee conduct risk management and fair customer treatment initiatives.
  • Maintain strong relationships with regulatory authorities.
  • Lead regulatory examinations and risk-related audits.
  • Ensure implementation of regulatory changes and risk controls.

Fraud & Financial Crime Risk

  • Oversee fraud prevention, detection, and investigation programs.
  • Strengthen anti-money laundering (AML) and counter-terrorist financing controls.
  • Monitor financial crime risks and emerging threats.
  • Ensure effective transaction monitoring and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Collaborate with law enforcement and regulatory agencies when necessary.

Market & Liquidity Risk Oversight

  • Monitor interest rate risk and liquidity risk exposures.
  • Evaluate balance sheet vulnerabilities and stress scenarios.
  • Support asset-liability management activities.
  • Ensure adherence to regulatory capital and liquidity requirements.

Cybersecurity & Technology Risk

  • Oversee technology and cyber risk governance.
  • Assess cybersecurity threats and resilience capabilities.
  • Ensure robust controls for digital banking platforms.
  • Monitor third-party and vendor risk exposures.
  • Support digital transformation initiatives through effective risk management.

Governance & Reporting

  • Present risk reports to Executive Management, Risk Committees, and the Board.
  • Develop key risk indicators (KRIs) and risk dashboards.
  • Ensure timely escalation of significant risk issues.
  • Maintain effective risk governance structures and committee frameworks.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead risk management teams across multiple disciplines.
  • Develop future risk leaders and succession plans.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, integrity, and transparency.
  • Promote collaboration across business, compliance, audit, and technology functions.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration, Risk Management, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree (MBA, Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field) preferred.

Professional Certifications

Preferred certifications include:

  • Financial Risk Manager (FRM)
  • Professional Risk Manager (PRM)
  • Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)
  • Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS)

Experience

  • 15+ years of progressive banking and risk management experience.
  • Extensive experience within retail banking risk management.
  • Proven leadership experience overseeing enterprise risk functions.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, boards, and executive committees.
  • Strong understanding of consumer lending, deposits, payments, and digital banking.
  • Experience leading large, multidisciplinary risk teams.

Technical Competencies

  • Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
  • Retail Credit Risk
  • Operational Risk
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Financial Crime Risk
  • Fraud Risk Management
  • AML/KYC Frameworks
  • Market Risk

  • Cybersecurity Risk
  • Operational Resilience
  • Stress Testing
  • Risk Analytics & Modeling
  • Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic Leadership
  • Risk-Based Decision Making
  • Executive Communication
  • Board & Regulatory Engagement
  • Crisis Management
  • Ethical Leadership
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Change Leadership
  • Problem Solving
  • Team Development

Skin + Me is a mission-driven start-up with seriously big skin goals.

We’re looking for licensed Doctors / Physicians based in Hungary who are fluent in English and German to join our incredible Medical Team at Skin + Me.

This role will be part of a team that specialises in prescribing Skincare products to patients based in Europe - initially in Germany, using our digital dermatology platform. This is a fully remote role, with the physician based in Hungary.

About the role:

Joining the Medical Team at Skin + Me is an opportunity to develop your clinical expertise in Dermatology within a unique, fast-moving and collaborative environment, working alongside some of the best minds in dermatology across Europe.

You will play a key role in delivering safe, effective, and personalised dermatology care to our patients in Germany, while helping us continuously improve how dermatology is delivered digitally.

Previous experience in dermatology is advantageous but not essential - structured onboarding, training, and clinical support are provided for the role.

Most importantly, we’re looking for someone with clinical humility, sound judgment, strong communication skills, and the confidence to work autonomously.

Who you are:

  • Registered Medical Doctor in the Operational Register of Healthcare Professionals maintained by the National Directorate General for Hospitals (Országos Kórházi Főigazgatóság, OKFŐ)

  • Hold a valid medical stamp/registration number issued via the Hungarian system (through the National Health Insurance Fund — NEAK).
  • Hold a valid EU medical licence and are authorised to treat patients in Germany (e.g. German Approbation or recognised EU qualification permitting cross-border care)
  • Based in Hungary, with the legal right to work there
  • Hold a C1 Certificate in Medical German
  • Professional fluency in English, to work with our English Medical Team.

What you’ll do:

  • Review patient consultations, assess medical histories and clinical images, and diagnose, prescribe, and manage treatment plans for patients in Germany
  • Be trained to a high level of clinical competency, enabling you to diagnose and manage common skin conditions including acne, melasma, hyperpigmentation and skin-ageing concerns
  • Once trained you will work independently within agreed clinical pathways, making your own prescribing decisions and escalating complex cases when appropriate
  • Act as a point of escalation for complex or atypical dermatology cases ensuring we provide the best care, working closely with our Customer Support Team
  • Contribute to the ongoing development of our consultation model, clinical pathways, and digital workflows within a dynamic start-up environment
  • Maintain a strong focus on clinical quality, patient safety, and prescribing governance
  • Work closely with our in-house medical leadership and wider clinical team. Continuously develop your clinical knowledge through regular CPD sessions with our dermatologists
  • Monitor and uphold prescribing safety and quality standards

Working pattern:

  • This is a full-time role, 5 days per week
  • May includes some weekend work on a rota basis (e.g. 1 weekend in every 5)
  • Fully remote, working from Hungary

Why should you choose Skin + Me?

  • A daily challenge – a fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment where no two days are the same
  • Make a difference – help improve the skin health and confidence of thousands of patients across Germany
  • Support network – work alongside experienced medical leaders, investors, and advisors who have built some of the world’s best consumer health companies

At MCI, we believe that your hard work deserves recognition and reward. Our compensation and benefits packages are designed to be competitive and to grow with you over time. Starting compensation is based on experience, and we offer a variety of benefits and incentives to support and reward our team members.

What You Can Expect from MCI:

While specific benefits and incentives may vary by geography, the core of our commitment remains the same: rewarding effort, providing growth opportunities, and creating an environment where every employee feels valued.

If you’re ready to join a company that recognizes your contributions and supports your growth, MCI is the place for you. Apply today!

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be largely sedentary and will be required to sit/stand for long periods while using a computer and telephone headset. The employee may occasionally be required to move about the office to accomplish tasks; reach in any direction; raise or lower objects, move objects from place to place, hold onto objects, and move or exert force up to forty (40) pounds.

MCI helps customers take on their CX and DX challenges differently, creating industry-leading solutions that deliver exceptional experiences and drive optimal performance. This individual will review available data or requests new reports to make recommendations on staffing to consistently meet service levels and run and requests enhancements to analytic reports on a regular and ad-hoc basis that assist in identifying areas of performance improvement, providing recommendations for efficiencies, and projecting staffing for future volume.

Is this you? Find out more below!

Responsibilities

How do I make an impact on my team?

Position Overview

The Senior Technical Support Engineer, MI – I (Tier 1) provides highly visible remote technical support across our product lines for HCUS customers. This role focuses on more complex issue and is the second level support across our Synapse products. This engineer is expected be able to resolve most of the cases that are presented to them and responsible for documenting more in-depth evaluations of issues that they are unable to resolve. This engineer must be comfortable with making decisions while working on these more complex issues. This role requires a firm grasp of time management and organizational skills.

To meet the needs of our customers, working outside normal business hours and on some weekends/holidays is required. In addition to working OT to handle workload and meet required metrics/expectations.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM Healthcare Americas Corporation, we’re on a mission to innovate for a healthier world, and we need passionate, driven people like you to help us get there. Our cutting-edge healthcare solutions span diagnostic imaging, enterprise imaging, endoscopic and surgical imaging, as well as in-vitro diagnostics.

But we don’t stop at healthcare; our Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) team harnesses advanced radiography solutions to keep transportation infrastructure, aerospace, and oil and gas assets safe and running smoothly.

Ready to innovate, collaborate, and make a difference? Join us and bring your big ideas to life while working in a dynamic, flexible environment that fuels your creativity and drive.

Our headquarters is in Lexington, Massachusetts, an inspiring healthcare research hub in a historic town.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit:

Job Description

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Supports our Synapse products by remotely troubleshooting and resolving issues, assessing and clearing monitor alarms, and providing our customers with timely responses.
  • Works on 3rd party hardware, software, and network related issues that are sold or supported by FUJIFILM.
  • Effectively and efficiently uses the FUJIFILM knowledge resources available to help in the troubleshooting process.
  • Collaborates with peers and other team members when working on more complex technical issues.
  • Effectively documents cases throughout the process of troubleshooting the issue.
  • Strictly follows the Technical Assistance Center (TAC) escalation process to move cases, in a timely manner, to the next level engineer when an issue cannot be resolved.
  • Engineers must have the ability and skillset to answer and facilitate incoming customer calls, effectively communicate with our customers, and document the interactions within a case.
  • Works cross-functionally with other Synapse teams/products as required and handles other duties as assigned.
  • Monitors TAC phone system wall boards to ensure that proper statuses are maintained.
  • Positive customer surveys, documentation accuracy and consistency, timely case and project completion, and finishing the assigned trainings are standard expectations for all FUJI engineers.
  • Maintains a high level of success with yearly goals provided by your manager and metrics defined on a team level.
  • Working outside of normal business hours, overtime, holidays, and participation in an on-call rotation are required to cover the needs of the business.
  • Some short notice overnight travel, based on the needs of the business, to work on customer systems.
  • Adheres to the Company's quality and regulatory compliance requirements, without exception, and ensures that all job duties inherent in the position description are performed in accordance with established policies and procedures.
  • Comply with all applicable U.S. Food and Drug Administration (U.S. FDA) medical device regulatory requirements, applicable ISO 13485 standard requirements and all other applicable laws, regulations, and standards.

Qualifications:

Baseline Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree, Trade School Certification (Industry related), or Industry Experience Equivalent
  • One or more industry-specific certifications in relevant technical background (Microsoft, VMware, Cisco certifications preferred).
  • Working knowledge of Windows OS (Microsoft Server 2012, 2016, 2019, 2022+), networking, SQL Server, and/or Oracle.
  • Knowledge of current network technologies.
  • Superior communication and interpersonal skills, excellent phone manner.
  • Ability to achieve results and meet goals in a fast-paced, team environment.
  • Ability to make independent decisions based on interpretation of technology data and product knowledge.
  • Excellent organizational and multi-tasking skills.
  • Knowledge of Synapse workflows and their implementations.
  • Knowledge of clinical data transfer protocols and interfaces (HL7 and DICOM)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • FUJIFILM Synapse Administration experience.
  • Working knowledge of Synapse workflows and their implementations.
  • Working knowledge of clinical data transfer protocols and interfaces (HL7 and DICOM)
  • Knowledge with Synapse application front end.
  • Knowledge of medical informatics architecture (VMware and Storage Solutions).
  • Knowledge of Linux Architecture.
  • Experience of using Postgresql
  • Industry-specific certifications in relevant technical background (Microsoft, VMware, Cisco certifications).
  • Security Certifications (Security + or higher)

Key Performance Indicators:

  • To maintain this position engineer’s must:
    • Maintain Security+ Certification (Security + or higher)
    • Maintain and expand knowledge acquired to be designated as a TAC Subject Matter Expert (SME) in two disciplines.
  • All engineers must maintain a case workload within 10% of the median of their peers at a minimum.
  • Case backlogs must stay at or below 25 cases (not including escalated cases) unless approved by management.

Physical Requirements:

The position requires the ability to perform the following physical demands and/or have the listed capabilities:

  • The ability to use your hands and fingers to feel and manipulate items, including keyboards, up to 100% of applicable work time.
  • The ability to stand, talk, and hear for 75% of applicable work time.

Travel:

Occasional (up to 10%) travel may be required based on business need.

jobs.description:
Roles & Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Define and own BukuWarung's data strategy across payments, credit, fraud, and merchant growth

  • Embed analytics into GTM planning, channel performance (OTS, Digital, Partnerships), and executive decision-making

  • Be a credible partner to the management team & business heads - translating data into capital allocation and product prioritization decisions

  • Drive BukuWarung's roadmap toward a unified data infrastructure that consolidates all distribution channels and operations into a single internal system

Credit Underwriting & BukuModal

  • Build proprietary MSME credit scoring models leveraging BukuWarung's payments transaction data, device usage patterns, merchant behavioral signals, and external alternative data sources

  • Develop thin-file and no-file underwriting approaches suited to Indonesia's informal merchant economy

  • Partner with BukuModal's lending team to define risk appetite, portfolio monitoring, and early warning systems for credit deterioration

  • Build models that improve approval rates while managing NPL - demonstrating that financial inclusion and credit discipline are not in tension

Fraud, Risk & Trust

  • Design a near-real-time fraud detection engine across BukuWarung's payments channels: covering EDC/POS, QRIS soundboxes, and digital payment flows

  • Build risk models for merchant onboarding, transaction monitoring, and dispute resolution

  • Define intervention logic: when to flag, step up, block, or escalate - tuned to the risk tolerance and unit economics of each merchant segment

  • Partner with Operations to reduce manual reconciliation and investigation overhead through automated risk signals

Payments & Hardware Analytics

  • Build analytics to track EDC and Bukupe QRIS device activation rates, transaction velocity post-activation, and device-level lifetime value

  • Identify leading indicators of merchant churn or device dormancy - enabling proactive field intervention before revenue is lost

  • Support Operations with data-driven visibility into channel performance, partner fulfillment SLAs, and logistics efficiency (Shipper and 3PL tracking, kit dispatch timelines, serial mapping accuracy)

  • Help build the business case for owning a Jakarta warehouse by modeling cost, control, and speed trade-offs vs. the current 3PL model

GTM & Growth Analysis

  • Define channel-level performance metrics across different channels enabling smarter budget allocation and incentive design

  • Build merchant cohort and LTV models that inform acquisition targeting and retention investments

  • Develop experimentation infrastructure (A/B testing, synthetic controls, holdout groups) to drive evidence-based product and GTM decisions

  • Partner with the field sales team to instrument and improve the on-spot merchant activation journey

Data Infrastructure & Governance

  • Architect modern data pipelines (streaming + batch) to support low-latency decisioning for fraud, credit, and real-time merchant insights

  • Build a data platform that makes clean, governed, accessible data a company-wide resource

  • Define data governance frameworks suited to Bank Indonesia regulations, OJK compliance requirements, and cross-border fintech data standards

  • Ensure data quality, lineage, and reliability - particularly for credit and fraud models where data errors carry direct financial consequences

Team & Organization Building

  • Scale the data team from 5 to a high-performing organization of data engineers, ML engineers, analysts, and risk scientists

  • Hire for both technical depth and business acumen - people who can move from a model to a board slide

  • Build a culture of storytelling with data: dashboards that drive action, not just reports that get read

  • Create reusable frameworks and analytical tools that empower non-data teams (Ops, Finance, GTM) to self-serve on routine questions

Requirements

Must-Have

  • 8-12 years in data leadership, with at least 4 years in fintech (payments, lending, or fraud/risk)

  • Hands-on experience building credit underwriting models for thin-file or informal economy borrowers - MSME or consumer lending in emerging markets preferred

  • Deep expertise in fraud detection systems across digital payment channels (QR, card, wallet)

  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, and ML frameworks (XGBoost, LightGBM, deep learning for behavioral data)

  • Experience with streaming data architectures (Kafka, Flink, or Spark Streaming) for real-time decisioning

  • Proven ability to build and lead data teams - hiring, mentoring, and retaining strong talent

  • Strong executive communication: able to translate model outputs into business decisions and board-level narratives

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience in Indonesia or Southeast Asia fintech, with familiarity with Bank Indonesia and OJK regulatory frameworks

  • Prior work on IoT or device telemetry analytics (relevant to EDC/POS and QRIS soundbox fleet management)

  • Exposure to agent-based or field sales distribution models and the analytics that support them

  • Experience deploying voice or alternative data signals in underwriting or fraud models

jobs.title: CRM Senior Programmer Analyst
jobs.excerpt: What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know?
jobs.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

Position Summary

The Salesforce Developer is the builder-orchestrator; the person who turns solution designs into working, production-quality software, increasingly by specifying, directing, and rigorously verifying AI-generated code, not only by hand-writing every line. You will write Apex, build Lightning Web Components, design Flows, implement integrations, and deliver the features and enhancements that power Illumina’s Commercial and Services organizations on the Salesforce platform, working fluently with AI coding assistants while remaining fully accountable for the correctness, security, and quality of everything you ship.

You are responsible for the majority of hands-on delivery on the team, increasingly by directing and verifying AI-generated code, not only writing it by hand. You will work from solution designs provided by Solution Architects, under technical direction set by the Technical Architect, and in close collaboration with Test Automation Engineers who validate your work. You will produce clean, well-tested, secure code that meets Illumina’s engineering standards and scales to support a global organization, whether you typed it or an AI agent produced it, you own it.

This role operates within an Agile Scrum delivery model. You will participate in sprint planning and grooming alongside Product Owners, Solution Architects, Technical Architects, and TAEs. You will collaborate with TAEs to define test strategy for your features; quality is a shared responsibility, built into every sprint, not a handoff at the end. As the Salesforce platform evolves with AI capabilities like Agentforce and Data Cloud (Data 360), you will build and implement these solutions alongside the rest of the engineering team. As AI takes on more first-pass implementation, your leverage shifts upstream, to clear specifications, strong tests, and disciplined review, and your judgment about what “good” looks like becomes the most valuable thing you bring.

Responsibilities

Software Development

  • Write production-quality Apex code; classes, triggers, batch processes, queueable jobs, and scheduled Apex. Follow the team’s architectural patterns (trigger handler frameworks, service/domain/selector layers) and coding standards defined by the Technical Architect.
  • Build Lightning Web Components (LWC); custom UI components using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript within the LWC framework. Implement wire services, imperative Apex calls, event handling, and Lightning Message Service. Follow SLDS design patterns and accessibility standards.
  • Design and build Flows; record-triggered, screen, scheduled, and autolaunched flows. Make appropriate decisions about when to use declarative automation vs. Apex based on the team’s established guidelines.
  • Implement integrations; REST/SOAP API callouts, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, and named credentials. Build error handling, retry logic, and logging into integration implementations. Work with middleware where required.
  • Implement Agentforce solutions; build custom Apex actions for agents, configure Prompt Builder templates, write Agent Script for deterministic control, and implement Trust Layer guardrails as directed by solution designs.
  • Implement Data Cloud (Data 360) configurations; data streams, data model objects, identity resolution, calculated insights, and activations based on solution designs and architectural direction.
  • Configure Salesforce platform features; objects, fields, validation rules, page layouts, permission sets, sharing rules, and other declarative elements as part of feature delivery.

AI-Augmented Engineering

  • Work in agentic, spec-driven workflows: write a clear specification and acceptance criteria, delegate first-pass implementation to AI coding assistants, then review, correct, test, and own the result.
  • Engineer the context AI tools need to be useful and safe: maintain rules/standards files, ground agents in the org’s metadata via the Salesforce DX MCP, and supply relevant examples and data.
  • Verify AI-generated code with the same rigor as peer code, checking intent, security (CRUD/FLS, SOQL injection), governor-limit safety, hallucinated APIs, and adherence to team patterns. Treat verification as first-class engineering.
  • Use AI coding assistants (such as Cursor and Agentforce Vibes, plus conversational tools like Claude or ChatGPT Enterprise where approved) to accelerate development, refactoring, debugging, test writing, and documentation, and share effective prompts and patterns with the team.
  • Follow Illumina’s rules for safe use of AI tools on regulated health data: respect data boundaries, never expose PHI/PII or secrets, and understand the IP and authorship implications of AI-generated code.

Code Quality & Testing

  • Write comprehensive unit tests for all Apex code; positive, negative, and bulk scenarios. Achieve meaningful test coverage beyond the 75% minimum. Use test data factories and proper mocking techniques.
  • Participate in code reviews; both as a reviewer and as a contributor receiving feedback. Provide constructive, educative feedback to peers. Address code review feedback promptly and thoughtfully.
  • Follow the team’s coding standards, security practices, and architectural patterns. Write code that is clean, maintainable, well-documented, and aligned with the Technical Architect’s direction.
  • Write secure code; enforce CRUD/FLS checks, prevent SOQL injection, protect against XSS/CSRF, and implement appropriate data access controls. Follow the team’s secure coding guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Test Automation Engineers to define test strategy for your features during sprint planning. Ensure your implementations are testable and that acceptance criteria are met before handoff.
  • Identify and reduce technical debt in the areas you work in. Refactor legacy code when opportunities arise during feature delivery. Advocate for technical improvements during sprint planning.
  • Verify AI-generated code as rigorously as hand-written code; ensure unit tests meaningfully cover AI-produced implementations, where subtle logic errors and hallucinated APIs tend to hide.

DevOps & Deployment

  • Use Git (GitHub) for version control; branching, committing, creating pull requests, and resolving merge conflicts. Follow the team’s branching strategy and PR workflows.
  • Deploy code and metadata using the team’s CI/CD pipeline (AutoRabit, DevOps Center, Salesforce CLI). Troubleshoot deployment failures and resolve metadata conflicts.
  • Manage sandbox environments for development and testing. Maintain environment hygiene and coordinate with TAEs on test data and environment needs.
  • Support release activities; pre-deployment validation, smoke testing, and post-deployment verification. Participate in release planning by identifying dependencies and risks.

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Participate actively in Agile Scrum ceremonies; sprint planning, daily standups, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate with Solution Architects to understand solution designs and ask clarifying questions before implementation begins. Raise concerns about feasibility, complexity, or alternative approaches early.
  • Work under the technical direction of the Technical Architect; following established patterns, participating in design discussions, and seeking guidance on complex implementation decisions.
  • Collaborate with Test Automation Engineers throughout the sprint; not just at handoff. Share early builds, discuss test scenarios, and work together to ensure features are delivered with quality.
  • Communicate progress, blockers, and risks proactively. Escalate technical challenges early rather than struggling in isolation.
  • Support production issues; troubleshoot, diagnose, and fix defects in production. Participate in incident response and post-incident reviews. Learn from production issues to improve future implementations.

Growth & Continuous Learning

  • Invest in continuous learning; new Salesforce platform features, Agentforce capabilities, Data Cloud, and evolving development practices. Use Trailhead, documentation, and self-directed learning to stay current.
  • Leverage AI coding assistants (such as Cursor, Agentforce Vibes, Claude, ChatGPT Enterprise, or similar) to accelerate development. Critically evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, and adherence to team standards.
  • Share knowledge with the team; through documentation, brown bags, code review discussions, and mentoring less experienced engineers.
  • Pursue relevant Salesforce certifications to deepen platform expertise and validate skills.

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience (Apex, LWC, Flows, and/or platform configuration).

  • Experience writing Apex code; classes, triggers, unit tests, and SOQL/SOSL queries. Understanding of governor limits and bulkification patterns.
  • Experience building Lightning Web Components or equivalent modern JavaScript-based UI components.
  • Experience with Salesforce declarative automation; Flows, validation rules, and platform configuration.
  • Experience with version control (Git) and CI/CD practices for Salesforce deployments.
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum delivery models.
  • Experience with Salesforce integrations (REST APIs, Platform Events) is preferred.
  • Experience with ServiceMax, Conga CPQ/CLM, Data Cloud, or Agentforce is a plus.
  • Experience with regulated environments (HIPAA, FDA, SOX) is preferred.
  • Certifications (Preferred): Foundation & Platform - Salesforce Administrator, Platform App Builder.
  • Certifications (Preferred): Development & Specialization - Platform Developer I, Platform Developer II, Agentforce Specialist, Data Cloud (Data 360) Consultant.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Technical

  • Proficiency in Apex development; object-oriented programming, trigger patterns, SOQL/SOSL queries, DML operations, governor limits, and bulkification.
  • Proficiency in Lightning Web Components; HTML, CSS, JavaScript, wire services, imperative Apex, event handling, and SLDS.
  • Understanding of Salesforce declarative automation; Flows (record-triggered, screen, autolaunched), validation rules, and the order of execution.
  • Understanding of the Salesforce data model, security model (profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, FLS), and multi-tenant architecture constraints.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce integration patterns; REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, and named credentials.
  • Familiarity with DevOps tooling; Git/GitHub, AutoRabit or Salesforce CLI for deployments, and CI/CD pipeline concepts.
  • Awareness of Agentforce and Data Cloud (Data 360) concepts; willingness to learn and implement these evolving platform capabilities.
  • Understanding of secure coding practices; CRUD/FLS checks, SOQL injection prevention, and XSS/CSRF protection.
  • Fluency with AI-augmented engineering: agentic and spec-driven workflows, context and prompt engineering (rules files, Salesforce DX MCP, grounding), and critical verification of AI-generated code, using assistants such as Cursor, Agentforce Vibes, Claude, or ChatGPT Enterprise.

Professional

  • Builder mindset; takes pride in writing clean, well-tested, maintainable code. Cares about craft, not just getting it done.
  • Collaborative; works effectively with SAs, TAs, TAEs, POs, and fellow engineers. Treats quality as a shared responsibility. Assumes positive intent.
  • Communicative; articulates progress, blockers, and technical tradeoffs clearly. Asks questions rather than making assumptions. Documents work for the team’s benefit.
  • Growth-oriented; invests in learning new platform capabilities, accepts feedback constructively, and actively seeks to improve. Uses AI tools to accelerate development while maintaining critical evaluation.
  • Accountable; delivers on commitments. Takes ownership of their work quality. Transparent about challenges and timelines.
  • Detail-oriented; thorough in implementation and testing. Considers edge cases, error handling, and downstream impacts.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or equivalent related work experience.

We are a company deeply rooted in belonging, promoting an inclusive environment where employees feel valued and empowered to contribute to our mission. Built on a strong foundation, Illumina has always prioritized openness, collaboration, and seeking alternative perspectives to propel innovation in genomics. We are proud to confirm a zero-net gap in pay, regardless of gender, ethnicity, or race. We also have several Employee Resource Groups (ERG) that deliver career development experiences, increase cultural awareness, and offer opportunities to engage in social responsibility. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status, and genetic information. Illumina conducts background checks on applicants for whom a conditional offer of employment has been made. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws. Background check results may potentially result in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment. The background check process and any decisions made as a result shall be made in accordance with all applicable local, state, and federal laws. Illumina prohibits the use of generative artificial intelligence (AI) in the application and interview process. If you require accommodation to complete the application or interview process, please contact . jobs.description:
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.

Job Overview

Data communications applications change at an exponential pace and the Data and Devices Business Unit is at the heart of a continuously expanding connected life. Accordingly, we provide responsive, iterative and fundamentally agile capabilities to support today's demands. Our customers are building the devices and the infrastructure that is redefining what information technology means. Our products push markets and meet the ever-changing need of the evolving, more connected, data-driven world. We are enhancing the way we do business, focusing on the most important things and staying agile and responsive to the needs of a faster, more connected world.

Are you a self-starter, an influencer and have a passion for evolving high-speed data communication technology? At TE Connectivity, you will find a culture that rewards such hands-on engineering spirit. We empower our engineers to work collaboratively supporting our customer’s next generation of high-speed data communication products. This is a great opportunity to join our team that is seeking a like-minded person to develop relationships with key technology individuals at customers to understand technology pain points and direction.

As a system architect in our Data & Devices Business Unit, this individual will be focused on the compute, storage, artificial intelligence, and networking industry. You will interface with customers in order to understand how their systems function and determine their evolving technology needs. The System Architect is responsible for generating the high-level system architecture requirements and ensuring the TE technology and product roadmaps are in line with customer next-generation product needs. This person is required to follow and help drive strategy both internally and externally at key industry communication standards.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Customer Engagement

  • Serve as the primary technical liaison for TE’s customers, actively engaging with hyperscalers, OEMs, and system architects to gain deep insights into next-generation compute, AI, storage, and networking challenges.
  • Proactively identify and assess technology disruptors, translating emerging trends into strategic R&D initiatives and product development roadmaps to maintain TE’s industry leadership.
  • Cultivate and strengthen customer partnerships, fostering co-development opportunities and collaborative innovation to accelerate next-gen infrastructure advancements.
  • Drive thought leadership by educating and influencing internal and external stakeholders, from executives and product teams to key decision-makers in customer organizations, on emerging industry trends, TE’s technical capabilities, and high-value engineering solutions.
  • Bridge the gap between customer needs and TE’s technology roadmap, ensuring TE delivers future-proof, scalable, and high-performance interconnect solutions tailored to the evolving data infrastructure landscape.

System-Level Architecture & Product Strategy

  • Define high-level system architecture requirements, ensuring TE’s product roadmap is aligned with next-generation compute, AI, and networking ecosystems.
  • Drive TE’s technology vision and strategy, ensuring our interconnect solutions support the evolving needs of standards like PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, InfiniBand, and the next-gen AI workloads.
  • Lead the evaluation of high-speed electrical, optical, and hybrid interconnect solutions, balancing performance, power, latency, cost, and manufacturability.
  • Collaborate with internal R&D, product development, and business units to shape product development roadmaps based on real-world customer challenges and market trends.
  • Drive technical due diligence for potential partnerships, acquisitions, and ecosystem collaborations, ensuring TE stays at the forefront of innovation.

Standards Development & Industry Influence

  • Actively participate in and influence key industry standards groups (e.g., OCP, PCI-SIG, IEEE, Ethernet Alliance, CXL Consortium), ensuring TE’s strategic alignment with the future of data communication.
  • Lead and influence discussions on emerging protocols and interface standards, ensuring TE is at the forefront of next-generation high-speed, low-latency interconnect technologies.
  • Champion TE’s technical leadership by actively contributing to the development of next-gen copper and optical interconnect standards, positioning TE as an industry innovator, ensuring our solutions stay ahead of the competition
  • Represent TE at industry forums, conferences, and standards organizations, reinforcing our role as a leader in high-speed interconnect technology and ensuring our strategic perspectives drive industry advancements.
  • Develop and present thought leadership content, including technical whitepapers, reference designs, keynote presentations, and industry presentations, to amplify TE’s influence within the standards community and the broader industry ecosystem.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution

  • Work cross-functionally with engineering, product management, sales, and marketing teams to translate technical insights into compelling product offerings.
  • Drive the execution of high-impact, innovative technical projects, ensuring seamless alignment between customer needs, business goals, and engineering capabilities.
  • Guide TE’s go-to-market strategy for new interconnect solutions, ensuring that our technical differentiation is clearly communicated and leveraged in competitive landscapes.

What your background should look like:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering. Having a dual bachelor’s degree in business or an MBA is a plus
  • Generally requires 10 years of relevant electrical engineering work experience and 5+ years of experience in the system-level design in the datacenter, compute, networking or storage industry
  • In-depth knowledge of hardware and associated signaling environments. Technical expertise in high-speed engineering and design
  • Deep knowledge of compute, networking, AI / ML, or storage architecture.
  • Expertise with industry-standard design tools (e.g., simulation, modeling, CAD, or signal integrity analysis)
  • The geographically dispersed group requires that the candidate be self-motivating with the ability to take the initiative to accomplish tasks with limited direction
  • Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to diverse audiences
  • Effectively able to build relationships with external customers and industry leaders as well as internally across all levels, disciplines, and geographies
  • Ability to spend 25%-30% of your time traveling

Competencies

Values: Integrity, Accountability, Inclusion, Innovation, Teamwork

COMPENSATION

  • Competitive base salary commensurate with experience: $154,100 – $231,100 (subject to change dependent on physical location)
  • Posted salary ranges are made in good faith. TE Connectivity reserves the right to adjust ranges depending on the experience/qualification of the selected candidate as well as internal and external equity.
  • Total Compensation = Base Salary + Incentive(s) + Benefits

jobs.description:
👥 Please note that fluency in French is required, as it is our main business language. English is considered our secondary working language.

📅 Date de démarrage

  • ASAP dans l'idéal

🏡 Type de contrat

  • CDI ou Freelance

  • Temps plein

  • Séniorité : Confirmé(e) / Senior

🌍 Localisation

  • 100% Remote (Europe) - zone CET ± 4h

  • Hybride possible pour les profils basés en Suisse

💼 Description du poste

DotWorld est un Venture Builder et SaaS Studio qui conçoit, lance et scale des produits digitaux utilisés par des millions de personnes à l'international. L'automobile fait partie de nos verticales stratégiques : nous y opérons un SaaS qui aide les particuliers à prendre de meilleures décisions autour de leur voiture grâce à la donnée.

Le produit existe depuis 3 ans et tourne déjà à pleine vitesse. L'objectif est clair : continuer d'accélérer, en Europe comme sur de nouveaux marchés internationaux encore peu servis, à commencer par les États-Unis.

Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons un(e) Product Manager Growth pour prendre les commandes de la verticale. Tu es le ou la garant(e) du produit et de sa croissance : tu exécutes vite et bien au quotidien, et tu construis avec les co-fondateurs du projet la vision et la stratégie long terme. Tu es propriétaire de bout en bout, de l'hypothèse à la mise en production, jusqu'à la décision de généraliser ou d'arrêter.

Ici, on mesure l'impact, pas l'effort. Ce qu'on attend : de la croissance et des rapports de grande qualité.

👥 Description de l'équipe

Tu pilotes une squad resserrée et autonome : un Lead Tech (Axel), deux développeurs et un Product Designer. Chez DotWorld, le/la PM a aussi la capacité d'être builder : tu peux pousser tes propres idées et avoir un impact direct sur ce qui part en production.

Tu travailles en accès direct avec les deux co-fondateurs du projet, Laurent et David, ainsi qu'avec notre CPO, Jérémy. Tu collabores étroitement avec l'équipe Growth / Acquisition de Bastien BRICOUT sur les canaux d'acquisition (y compris les plus innovants) et avec l'équipe Data, qui t'aide à faire émerger des opportunités à partir de l'usage du produit.

💻 Tes responsabilités

Stratégie & vision de la verticale

  • Construire avec les co-fondateurs la roadmap à 12-36 mois : marchés, segments, nouvelles offres, partenariats data

  • Suivre de près l'écosystème automobile (acteurs, usages, données, réglementation) et en tirer des opportunités concrètes

  • Aligner tech, design, marketing, data et partenaires externes autour d'objectifs communs

Croissance & exécution

  • Optimiser les funnels, du premier contact à la première valeur perçue, jusqu'à la conversion

  • Construire les leviers de rétention et de valeur perçue tout au long du cycle de vie de l'utilisateur(rice)

  • Piloter le backlog, arbitrer les priorités et livrer en continu avec l'équipe

Expansion internationale

  • Préparer le produit à grandir : nouveaux pays, nouvelles langues, nouveaux canaux, sans perte de qualité

  • Adapter l'expérience à chaque marché : produit, landing pages d'acquisition, moyens de paiement, conformité réglementaire

Données & partenariats

  • Identifier et intégrer de nouvelles sources de données fiables pour enrichir les rapports

  • Explorer les APIs du marché et développer les partenariats associés

Expérimentation & analyse

  • Formuler, prioriser et valider rapidement des hypothèses à partir de la donnée, des retours utilisateur(rice)s et de la recherche

  • Mener les A/B tests de bout en bout, de la conception à la lecture des résultats

  • Construire tes tableaux de bord et partager des insights actionnables avec l'équipe et les co-fondateurs

⭐ Ton profil

Expérience

  • 4 ans minimum en product management

  • Des résultats prouvés et chiffrés sur des produits à fort volume ou en forte croissance : tu sais raconter comment tu as fait passer un produit de x2 à x5 ou x10, avec du vrai revenu et de l'impact derrière

  • Une maîtrise solide des métriques SaaS / abonnement (conversion, churn, rétention, LTV, ARR…) - indispensable

  • Une expérience en environnement B2C est fortement recommandée

  • Une expérience sur le marché US est un vrai plus

  • Un intérêt pour l'univers auto, la mobilité ou les produits data-driven est apprécié

Compétences techniques

  • Analytics produit : funnels, cohortes, analyses de sessions, dashboards (PostHog ou équivalent)

  • Conception et lecture rigoureuse d'A/B tests

  • Rédaction de specs claires et actionnables

  • Prototypage autonome, y compris à l'aide d'outils d'IA

  • Usage quotidien et autonome de l'IA (prototypage, analyse, rédaction) - toujours au service de la croissance, jamais pour la vitrine

Compétences interpersonnelles

  • Profil doer : tu passes de la réflexion à l'action et produis toi-même un prototype, une analyse ou une spec

  • Vision stratégique : tu sais prendre de la hauteur et traduire une stratégie en priorités concrètes

  • Esprit entrepreneurial et grande autonomie

  • Exigence qualité et standard UX élevé

  • Capacité à fédérer des équipes transverses et des partenaires externes

Compétences linguistiques

  • Français courant - c'est notre langue de travail principale

  • Anglais niveau B2 minimum - c'est notre langue de travail secondaire, et il est évalué pendant le processus de recrutement

  • Tu es à l'aise pour échanger avec des partenaires internationaux et relire avec précision des interfaces et contenus en anglais

✨ Les avantages du poste

  • Un rôle transverse : tu pilotes la croissance, les revenus, la rétention, la satisfaction et le produit de A à Z

  • Un très gros projet déjà à grande échelle, avec un joli potentiel

  • Tout le spectre business, acquisition, rétention et produit - bien plus qu'une seule fonctionnalité dans une grosse structure

  • Un accès direct aux co-fondateurs et aux décideur(se)s, sans couches intermédiaires

  • De nouveaux marchés internationaux à ouvrir, à commencer par les États-Unis

  • Un environnement IA-first, avec la capacité d'être builder et de pousser tes propres idées en production

🔥 Les défis du poste

  • Un haut niveau d'exigence : le projet est piloté par deux co-fondateurs très impliqués, qui challengent et apportent beaucoup d'idées

  • Un spectre très large, qui demande un profil complet et une vraie capacité à prioriser

  • Faire émerger de nouveaux leviers de rétention, au-delà du parcours d'abonnement classique

  • Ouvrir un nouveau marché from scratch, en adaptant tout ce qui va avec : produit, acquisition, paiement, réglementation

📋 Notre processus de recrutement

  • Entretien de découverte avec notre Talent Acquisition Manager, Noémie - 30 min

  • Étude de cas en live avec notre CPO Jérémy, un(e) Product Manager et Laurent, co-fondateur du projet - 1h

  • Entretien culturel avec notre Head of HR & Finance Matteo et notre CEODavid - 1h

  • 1 prise de référence avec un(e) ancien(ne) Manager

ℹ️ A propos de DotWorld

Dotworld est un Venture Builder et SaaS Studio. Notre modèle est simple mais exigeant : nous concevons, lançons et scalons plusieurs produits SaaS en parallèle. Notre équipe, entièrement distribuée, évolue avec une culture forte : Test, Learn, Scale. Nous créons des outils concrets qui facilitent le quotidien de millions de personnes dans le monde entier. Aujourd'hui, notre activité est structurée autour de différents univers produits, allant d'outils RH à des solutions de gestion de contenus et de création design.

Notre approche Nous construisons des SaaS robustes, intuitifs et techniquement solides. Une fois les bases maîtrisées, nous les déployons à l'international grâce à un travail poussé de traduction et de localisation. L'accélération se fait ensuite par une stratégie d'acquisition performante, pilotée par nos expert(e)s SEO et SEA.

Ce modèle fonctionne - et il fonctionne fort

Plus de 50 millions de visiteur(se)s par an 0 levée de fonds : une croissance 100 % autofinancée Rentables dès la première année De 1 à 50+ collaborateur(rice)s en 4 ans

Une équipe autonome, engagée et exigeante Tout cela, nous le construisons en équipe. Notre force, ce sont des personnes autonomes, engagées, où chacun(e) a un vrai impact. 90 % de l'équipe travaille en remote, avec une culture fondée sur la confiance, la flexibilité et le respect des rythmes individuels. Nous cultivons un environnement bienveillant, stimulant et exigeant, où l'épanouissement individuel nourrit la réussite collective.

Une culture d'excellence Chez Dotworld, nous visons des standards élevés : qualité, rigueur et efficacité au service de l'impact. Nous sommes orienté(e)s résultats : la performance et le dépassement de soi nous animent au quotidien. L'amélioration continue, l'innovation et la créativité sont au cœur de notre culture. Chaque produit est affiné de manière itérative jusqu'à atteindre la meilleure version possible. Nous intégrons les technologies les plus récentes de façon réfléchie, pour offrir des solutions modernes, performantes et conçues pour durer.

Et la suite ? Nous recherchons des profils curieux, autonome, malins et enthousiastes - des personnes qui aiment faire, tester, construire, améliorer… tout en visant haut. 👉 Envie de nous rejoindre ? On a hâte d'échanger avec toi.

🌿 Environnement de travail

  • Des opportunités de développement professionnel : chez DotWorld, nous croyons que chaque employé(e) a le potentiel de se dépasser. Nous offrons des opportunités pour apprendre, grandir et influencer le futur de notre entreprise.

  • Une culture d'innovation : nous encourageons constamment nos équipes à penser en dehors des sentiers battus et à apporter de nouvelles idées.

  • Forte croissance de l'entreprise avec en conséquences des perspectives d'évolutions fortes dans les années à venir.

  • Tout est à créer : chaque idée, chaque initiative compte pour bâtir ensemble notre culture, nos projets et notre vision de demain.

👥 Diversité

DotWorld est une entreprise qui adhère pleinement au principe d'égalité des chances et d'accès à l'emploi pour tou(te)s. Nous croyons en un environnement de travail inclusif, où chacun(e) peut s'épanouir et contribuer à notre succès collectif, quelles que soient les identités ou origines de chacun(e).   • Conduct research across the full payments user journey, from onboarding and activation through ongoing usage, trust, and retention.
  • Be a trusted subject-matter expert for customer research, providing clear, evidence-based recommendations to inform decisions.
  • Work across departments to scope, plan, design and execute impactful research initiatives.
