  • Utilize research findings to influence payments strategy, roadmap prioritization, and growth initiatives.

  • Adept at mixed-method research, preferably stemming from a background in SaaS businesses.

jobs.description:
Location: Remote (Latam Only)
Employment Type: Full-time, contract
Reports To: Engineering and technology leadership

About the Role

We’re hiring a senior, hands-on IT Infrastructure & Network Engineer to own the corporate IT environment for a technology company building connected edge solutions. You’ll be the go-to person for Microsoft 365, identity and access, servers, networking, security, backups, and remote connectivity.

Infrastructure and systems administration is the core of this role, backed by strong network engineering skills. You’ll also partner with Software Engineering and DevOps on device connectivity, traffic analysis, and troubleshooting across edge-connected systems and lab environments.

What You’ll Do

IT Infrastructure & Microsoft 365

  • Administer Microsoft 365: users, groups, licensing, permissions, and authentication
  • Manage Microsoft Entra ID, MFA, and identity and access controls
  • Support Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive
  • Own onboarding, offboarding, provisioning, and account lifecycle
  • Maintain asset, access, and configuration documentation and coordinate with vendors

Server & Systems Administration

  • Administer and troubleshoot a mix of on-premises and hosted Windows and Linux servers
  • Handle patching, updates, storage, services, and secure remote administration
  • Monitor server health, logs, capacity, and availability
  • Maintain and test backup, restore, and recovery procedures
  • Coordinate on-site or third-party hands-on support when physical work is needed

Network Engineering

  • Configure, support, and document corporate, engineering, and edge network environments
  • Work across TCP/IP, VLANs, switching, routing, NAT, DNS, DHCP, firewalls, wireless, VPN, cellular, and fiber
  • Support segmentation, resiliency, redundancy, and failover
  • Support routers, switches, controllers, media converters, transceivers, and PoE equipment
  • Collaborate with customer IT teams, vendors, and integrators on connectivity and design

Traffic, Performance & Capacity Analysis

  • Capture and analyze traffic from applications, APIs, cameras, edge devices, and telemetry
  • Calculate bandwidth and capacity needs from device counts, event rates, and payload sizes
  • Diagnose latency, packet loss, retransmissions, and congestion
  • Estimate cellular data consumption for mobile and in-vehicle systems
  • Use Wireshark, tcpdump, iperf, or similar tools to deliver sizing and performance recommendations

Engineering & Edge Systems Support

  • Help Software Engineering isolate whether issues come from software, network, OS, hardware, or third-party systems
  • Support integration of controllers, cameras, RFID/LPR equipment, gateways, and antennas
  • Support Windows- and Linux-based edge environments, including services, interfaces, and certificates
  • Support development and validation lab environments

DevOps Collaboration

  • Partner with DevOps on DNS, routing, firewalls, TLS/certificates, and secure communications
  • Provide packet captures, logs, and diagnostics for root-cause analysis
  • Support connectivity across corporate infrastructure, edge systems, customer sites, and hosted systems

Technology Evaluation & Proofs of Concept

  • Assess networking, compatibility, and integration requirements for new technologies
  • Build and validate prototype and proof-of-concept environments
  • Document constraints, dependencies, test results, and deployment readiness

Security & Documentation

  • Apply security best practices across M365, servers, networks, and remote access
  • Maintain network diagrams, IP/VLAN records, port and firewall requirements, and configuration standards
  • Participate in incident investigation, root-cause analysis, and corrective action

What You Bring

Required

  • Strong experience across IT infrastructure, systems administration, and network engineering
  • Hands-on Microsoft 365 administration, including Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, and OneDrive
  • Strong Windows Server administration plus practical Linux experience
  • Experience managing physical, hosted, and remotely administered servers
  • Deep knowledge of TCP/IP, VLANs, switching, routing, subnetting, NAT, DNS, DHCP, firewalls, VPN, and segmentation
  • Packet capture, traffic analysis, bandwidth estimation, and capacity planning skills
  • Experience with wired, wireless, fiber, and cellular networks
  • Experience supporting connected devices such as controllers, cameras, gateways, or IoT equipment
  • Working knowledge of MFA, TLS/certificates, and infrastructure security
  • Strong documentation and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and remotely
  • Advanced English proficiency, both written and spoken

Preferred

  • Degree in IT, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or equivalent experience
  • Microsoft 365, Entra, or Windows Server certifications
  • CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent hands-on networking expertise
  • Experience in environments mixing corporate IT, on-prem servers, hosted systems, and edge infrastructure
  • Experience with monitoring, backup/recovery, and virtualization tools
  • Exposure to industrial networking, RFID/LPR, cellular routers, or edge hardware
  • Familiarity with zero-trust and secure remote-access architectures
  • Scripting in PowerShell, Bash, or Python

What We Offer:

  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge products
  • Fully remote and distributed team
  • Async-first collaboration environment

  • PTO, paid holidays, and family leave

Looking for Dermatology Specialist

With a specialization in dermatology is a medical professional who combines general medical knowledge with specialized expertise in dermatological conditions. The job description for such a role typically includes a range of responsibilities related to the diagnosis, treatment, and management of various skin disorders. Here's a general overview of the job description:

Patient Consultations:

Conducting thorough consultations with patients to understand their medical history and skin-related concerns.

Performing physical examinations focused on dermatological issues.

Ordering and interpreting relevant diagnostic tests, such as biopsies or skin cultures.

Diagnosis and Treatment:

Diagnosing various skin conditions, including but not limited to dermatitis, eczema, psoriasis, acne, skin cancer, and infectious diseases.

Developing and implementing appropriate treatment plans, which may involve medications, topical treatments, minor surgical procedures, or referrals to specialists.

Collaboration and Referrals:

Collaborating with other healthcare professionals, including specialists in internal medicine, oncology, or surgery, to ensure comprehensive care for patients with complex conditions.

Referring patients to specialized dermatologists or other healthcare providers when necessary.

Record Keeping:

Maintaining accurate and detailed medical records, including patient histories, examination findings, treatment plans, and follow-up notes.

Telemedicine:

Embracing and utilizing telemedicine platforms to provide remote consultations and follow-ups.

Qualifications:

  1. Medical Degree:
    • Completion of a Doctor of Medicine (MD) or equivalent degree from an accredited medical school or university.
  2. Residency Training in Dermatology:
    • Completion of a specialized residency training program in dermatology accredited by a recognized medical board or authority.
    • The residency program should cover a comprehensive range of dermatological conditions and procedures.
  3. Board Certification or Equivalent Qualification:
    • Board certification in dermatology from a recognized medical board, such as the American Board of Dermatology (ABD), the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada (RCPSC), or an equivalent international board.
    • Alternatively, proof of successful completion of an equivalent certification examination recognized by the Health Authority Abu Dhabi (HAAD) or Dubai Health Authority (DHA).
  4. Valid Medical License:
    • Possession of a valid and unrestricted medical license issued by the Health Authority Abu Dhabi (HAAD) or Dubai Health Authority (DHA) permitting the practice of dermatology in the United Arab Emirates (UAE).
  5. Clinical Experience:
    • Substantial clinical experience as a dermatology specialist, preferably in a hospital, clinic, or healthcare facility in Abu Dhabi or the UAE.
    • Proficiency in diagnosing and managing a wide range of dermatological conditions, including but not limited to acne, eczema, psoriasis, dermatitis, skin infections, and skin cancer.
    • Experience in performing dermatological procedures and surgeries, such as biopsies, excisions, cryotherapy, laser therapy, and cosmetic dermatology procedures.

Are you a Customer Success leader who gets energy from helping your team win? Do you enjoy coaching CSMs through tough renewals, spotting where a process is slowing the team down, and fixing it so the whole team performs better? If so, we'd love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Analista de Processos e Melhoria Contínua
jobs.excerpt: Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online.
jobs.description:
Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.

Hoje contamos com dois escritórios, no Rio de Janeiro e em São Paulo, e nosso modelo de trabalho é flexível, com maior atuação remota. Eventualmente, podem acontecer encontros presenciais pontuais, sempre de acordo com a necessidade e alinhamento com o time. Este modelo oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.

Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.

Nossa área é responsável por sustentar a qualidade, a consistência e a eficiência das operações que protegem a plataforma e a experiência de quem compra e vende. Atuamos em moderação de conteúdo, antifraude, atendimento e performance operacional, conectando dado, processo e governança para que as decisões da operação sejam rápidas, rastreáveis e confiáveis.

Estamos estruturando um time dedicado a Processos e Melhoria Contínua, com a missão de transformar a forma como a operação evolui: sair da melhoria pontual e reativa para um modelo vivo, com esteira de mudanças controlada, padrões documentados, indicadores de qualidade de processo e um ciclo permanente de identificação e captura de ganhos.

Se você gosta de entrar no processo real, entender o porquê de cada etapa, medir onde a eficiência se perde e reconstruir o fluxo com método e evidência, essa vaga é para você.


Se você quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa é a sua chance! Nessa posição de Analista de Processos e Melhoria Contínua, você irá somar ao time de Processos e Melhoria Contínua, que tem como objetivo transformar as operações em processos maduros, padronizados e eficientes, sustentados por governança e evidência de otimização operacional.

No dia a dia você vai:

  • Conduzir o diagnóstico as-is de processos operacionais ponta a ponta, por meio de entrevistas, observação da operação, análise de dados e workshops com as áreas envolvidas;
  • Mapear e documentar fluxos em BPMN, identificando gargalos, retrabalhos, handoffs desnecessários, pontos de decisão frágeis e desperdícios;
  • Desenhar e propor o cenário to-be, com ganho quantificado (produtividade, tempo de ciclo, qualidade, custo e risco) e plano de implantação viável;
  • Construir e manter os ativos de padronização do processo: POPs, fluxogramas, SIPOC, matrizes RACI, árvores de decisão e critérios de exceção;
  • Estruturar e conduzir projetos de melhoria contínua aplicando DMAIC, PDCA, Kaizen e A3, do problema definido ao ganho sustentado e comprovado;
  • Definir e acompanhar KPIs de processo (tempo de ciclo, aderência, retrabalho, qualidade, SLA e produtividade), transformando o número em recomendação de decisão;
  • Analisar causa raiz com método (Ishikawa, 5 Porquês, análise de Pareto, FMEA), evitando conclusões baseadas em percepção;
  • Identificar e priorizar oportunidades de automação (regras, integrações, RPA e uso de IA aplicada), atuando junto a Produto e Tecnologia na tradução do processo em requisito;
  • Operar a esteira de mudanças de processo: receber a demanda, avaliar impacto e risco, versionar, comunicar, treinar e verificar a adoção real na operação;
  • Conduzir a gestão da mudança junto às equipes internas e a parceiros de BPO, garantindo que o processo redesenhado seja de fato executado como desenhado;
  • Apresentar diagnósticos, hipóteses e resultados para lideranças, de forma objetiva e sustentada em dado;
  • Atuar como referência técnica de processos para as demais squads da área, disseminando método e apoiando análises de melhoria conduzidas por outras equipes.

E o que você precisa ter?

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia (de Produção, preferencialmente), Administração, Estatística, Sistemas de Informação, Gestão da Qualidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada em gestão por processos e melhoria contínua, cobrindo o ciclo completo: diagnóstico as-is, redesenho to-be, implantação e sustentação do ganho;
  • Domínio de BPMN e de ferramentas de modelagem (Bizagi, Lucidchart, Miro, Visio ou equivalentes);
  • Vivência prática com metodologias Lean e Lean Six Sigma (DMAIC, VSM, Kaizen, PDCA, A3) aplicadas a projetos com resultado mensurado;
  • Certificação Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt ou Green Belt;
  • Capacidade analítica com dados: Excel avançado e leitura autônoma de indicadores em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Looker ou similar);
  • Experiência em construção e acompanhamento de KPIs e SLAs operacionais, incluindo definição de metas e análise de desvio;
  • Habilidade comprovada de condução de entrevistas, workshops e reuniões de alinhamento com áreas de negócio;
  • Clareza de comunicação escrita e oral, com capacidade de sintetizar análise complexa em recomendação executiva;
  • Autonomia, organização e maturidade para atuar em ambiente dinâmico, com múltiplas frentes simultâneas e priorização constante.

Será um diferencial:

  • Certificação Green Belt (para o nível sênior) ou Black Belt;
  • Certificação CBPP ou formação em BPM CBOK;
  • Experiência em operações digitais: atendimento/CX, contact center, moderação de conteúdo, trust & safety, antifraude, risco ou backoffice de larga escala;
  • Vivência com gestão de parceiros de BPO e com governança de processos terceirizados;
  • Conhecimento de SQL para consulta e validação de dados;
  • Experiência com automação e IA aplicada a processos (RPA, workflows, agentes, modelos de decisão automatizada);
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis (squads, sprints, OKRs) e com ferramentas como Jira e Confluence;
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de governança e gestão de riscos (Três Linhas, COSO, COPC, ISO 9001);
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura técnica.

Informações adicionais

Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

SafeGuard Services (SGS), a subsidiary of Peraton, performs data analysis, investigation, and medical review to detect, prevent, deter, reduce, and make referrals to recover fraud, waste, and abuse.

The Fraud Investigator is expected to perform high level complex investigations of medical professional service providers and develop cases for future action, including referral to law enforcement, education, over payment recovery and other administrative actions. Will work with internal resources and external agencies to develop cases and corrective actions as well as respond to requests for data and support.

  • An investigator uses good judgment and may work independently with minimum supervision and direction.
  • The investigator also may work as part of a team as there may be times when the investigator needs to work with state and/or federal investigators and other personnel.
  • An investigator handles multiple caseload assignments concurrently; organizes and analyzes complex evidentiary patterns; interviews and obtains statements from witnesses and others.
  • Investigators may also be required to complete complex investigative reports that apply regulations or rules to the program(s) affected by the behavior being investigated. There may also be times when the investigator will need to apply federal or state laws.
  • Investigators are expected to research and understand the relevant offenses being investigated; conduct efficient and effective investigations concerning those alleged offenses and detect or verify suspected violations; obtain information and evidence by observation, record examination, and interview.
  • Investigators then analyze the results of the investigation to ascertain if the allegations have been corroborated and work with others to determine the appropriate steps that need to be taken to address the issues.
  • As part of an investigation, the investigator will need to prepare correspondence; be objective and accurate and communicate with others with tact.
  • There may be times when investigators need to react to unplanned situations, be flexible in planning their activities and adopt effective courses of action.
  • As investigators will be working with health privacy information, they also must maintain confidentiality and understand all the laws, rules and regulations concerning health privacy.
  • Telework available from Maine, New Hampshire, Vermont, New York, Rhode Island, Connecticut, Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, Delaware, District of Columbia, New Jersey, Maryland, Northern Virginia.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • 2 years with BS/BA or 6 years of experience with a HS diploma/equivalent
  • Knowledge of Medicare and/or Medicaid programs and the rules, regulations, policies and procedures
  • Knowledge and experience in the healthcare industry.
  • Strong investigative skills
  • Strong communication and organization skills
  • Strong PC knowledge and skills
  • US citizenship is required

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong background in investigations.
  • Experience in reviewing claims for technical requirements, performing medical review, and/or developing fraud cases
  • Knowledge of investigative practices regarding healthcare providers.
  • Background in evaluating, reviewing and analyzing medical claims and records
  • Ability to learn and operate a variety of data systems, equipment and tools used in investigations

Essential Functions:

  • Ability to perform research and draw conclusions
  • Ability to organize a case file, accurately and thoroughly document all steps taken
  • Ability to present issues of concern, citing regulatory violations, alleging schemes or scams to defraud the Government
  • Ability to compose correspondence, reports and referral summary letters
  • Ability to communicate effectively, internally and externally
  • Ability to interpret laws and regulations
  • Ability to handle confidential material.
  • Ability to manage and prioritize workload effectively so that customer metrics are met or exceeded.
  • Ability to educate providers, provider associations, law enforcement, other contractors and beneficiary advocacy groups on program safeguard matters
  • Ability to work independently and as a member of a team to deliver high quality work
  • Ability to attend meetings, training, and conferences, overnight travel required.
  • This position may require the incumbent to appear in court to testify about work findings.

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. jobs.excerpt: Spacelift is the infrastructure orchestration platform built for the modern software era, managing the full lifecycle for both traditional IaC and AI-accelerated infrastructure.
jobs.description:
Spacelift is the infrastructure orchestration platform built for the modern software era, managing the full lifecycle for both traditional IaC and AI-accelerated infrastructure. It integrates with Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation, Pulumi, and Ansible in a single governed workflow so you deliver secure, compliant infrastructure at scale. Developer self-service, Golden Paths with guardrails, an OPA policy engine, and drift detection accelerate developer velocity while maintaining control. Spacelift Intelligence adds AI-powered provisioning and diagnostics across traditional and AI-driven workflows.

Spacelift was founded in 2020 by long-time DevOps practitioner Marcin Wyszynski and successful entrepreneur Pawel Hytry and has raised $82.3M in funding over four rounds from top venture capital firms including Insight Partners, Blossom Capital, Hoxton Ventures, Inovo Venture partners and Five Elms Capital.

The role:

Product & Design at Spacelift is scaling its surface area: more product teams, more cross-functional partners and a way of working we are actively reshaping.

We need someone who keeps that machine running. Someone who owns the tooling, the rituals, the data, and the customer feedback loop so that PMs, designers, and Epic Owners spend their time on product decisions, not chasing reports, hunting templates, or stitching together feedback from five places.

About you:

  • You've been doing product analytics, product ops, or a hybrid PM-adjacent role and want to broaden into operations.

  • You're fluent in SQL and comfortable working with product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Metabase, Amplitude, or similar).

  • You're organised in a way that makes other people more effective. You build systems, not just lists.

  • You can hold the line on process without becoming process for its own sake. "Do not fall in love with process."

  • You're comfortable working across Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, CS, Support, and Solutions Engineering.

  • You're intellectually humble. You ask good questions, you change your mind when the data says so.

  • Fluent English

  • Located within EU

Nice to have:

  • Experience with infrastructure, DevOps, or developer-tools products.

  • Familiarity with Working Backwards / PR-FAQ as a framework.

  • Experience administering ClickUp or Notion.

  • Background working alongside design and research (Figma, discovery interviews).

What you will do:

  • Own and administer the Product & Design tool stack (Notion, Mixpanel, Metabase, Hex, Featurebase, Figma) and keep it working as a coherent system

  • Run product process rituals: weekly syncs, epic demos, kickoffs, retros, pre-mortems, and quarterly planning

  • Build and maintain KPI, adoption, and usability dashboards; write SQL and build visualizations directly; partner with PMs on discovery analytics

  • Design and operate the customer feedback pipeline — consolidating signals from six channels (Featurebase, Sales, CS, Support, CAB, discovery interviews) into a weekly digest routed to the right PM at the right time

  • Track which customer requests turned into shipped features, in-progress work, or deliberate declines, and close the loop back to Sales and CS

  • Maintain PR/FAQ and 5 Questions templates in Notion; track which initiatives have artifacts, which are missing them, and surface gaps to the SVP of Product & Design

  • Coordinate cross-functional release logistics with Marketing, Sales, CS, Support, and Solutions Engineering

  • Advocate for data hygiene: consistent event taxonomy, instrumentation standards, clean property naming

Hiring Process:

  • Intro interview with Olga Gradowska-Pernak, Technical Recruiter

  • Hiring Manager interview with Jonah Kowall, SVP of Product & Design

  • Take-home exercise

  • Home Assignment Debriefing Session with the Product Team

Why Spacelift?

  • Innovative Culture: Join a team shaping cloud infrastructure management’s future.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be a key player in driving Spacelift’s business and AWS partnership to new heights.

  • Work-Life Balance: Flexible work environment, with remote-first options and competitive compensation packages.

  • Collaborative Team: Work with passionate, talented people committed to driving success for our customers and partners.

Our values

  • We build for CUSTOMERS

  • We RESPECT each other

  • We take OWNERSHIP seriously

  • We succeed through COLLABORATION

  • We embrace SPARK & WONDER

More here:

Join Us! At Spacelift, you won’t just be working on a technical product - you’ll be part of a team shaping the future of DevOps. Apply to contribute to a platform loved by its users and take your career to the next level!

PRINCIPALES FONCTIONS ET RESPONSABILITÉS

  • Traiter les réclamations d’indemnisation des travailleurs en déterminant la recevabilité et les indemnités dues pour les réclamations d’indemnité à long terme, surveiller l’exactitude des provisions et déposer la documentation requise auprès de l’organisme provincial.

PRIMARY PURPOSE: To analyze complex or technically difficult workers' compensation claims to determine benefits due; to work with high exposure claims involving litigation and rehabilitation; to ensure ongoing adjudication of claims within service expectations, industry best practices and specific client service requirements; and to identify subrogation of claims and negotiate settlements.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS and RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Communicates claim activity and processing with the claimant and the client; maintains professional client relationships.
  • Ensures claim files are properly documented and claims coding is correct.
  • Refers cases as appropriate to supervisor and management.

ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Supports the organization's quality program(s).
  • Travels as required.

Education & Licensing

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university preferred. Professional certification as applicable to line of business preferred.

Experience

  • Five (5) years of claims management experience or equivalent combination of education and experience required.

Skills & Knowledge

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.


Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Manager, Value & Access Analytics - GTN Forensics


Live

What you will do
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. The Manager, GTN Forensics, will support the development and delivery of cross-portfolio analytics that improve visibility into Gross-to-Net (GTN) performance and help identify potential anomalies, leakage, and process-improvement opportunities. As a member of the Value & Access Insights team, this role will independently execute defined workstreams supporting GTN initiatives, from business-question framing through analysis, validation, and stakeholder communication.

Collaborating closely with US Value & Access transformation initiatives and other cross-functional partners, the Manager will support broader GTN forensics priorities and advance scalable analytics, reporting, and proof-of-concept capabilities. The role will work with Contracting & Pricing (C&P), CPE, Market Access, data product and technology teams, and other stakeholders to address payer and provider contracting, pricing, invoice, and performance questions.

This is a hands-on, collaborative role requiring strong analytical judgment, disciplined project execution, and the ability to communicate findings clearly across business, analytics, and technology audiences. The individual will coordinate inputs across teams, document methods and decisions, and help transition successful analyses into repeatable and durable capabilities.

This position reports to the Senior Manager, Value & Access Insights - Cross-Portfolio & Innovation.


Responsibilities

• Execute defined analytical workstreams supporting GTN forensics priorities, from problem framing and data assessment through analysis, validation, and delivery. Coordinate with workstream leads and partner teams to maintain timelines, resolve issues, and ensure outputs are accurate and useful.

• Support recurring and ongoing GTN related activities by identifying unusual plan-, invoice- or claims-level patterns; conducting preliminary root-cause analyses; preparing findings for review with business partners; and tracking feedback, disposition, and follow-up actions.

• Collaborate with Value & Access transformation initiatives and other Value & Access Insights leads to advance shared GTN forensics capabilities. Contribute business requirements, data definitions, user-acceptance testing, documentation, feedback, and rollout support for integrated tools, data products, and workflows.

• Develop and maintain recurring reports, dashboards, presentations, and other communication materials that summarize findings and progress. Adapt the level of detail for technical and non-technical audiences and escalate material risks or decisions in a timely manner.

• Gather stakeholder feedback, help refine analytical rules and thresholds, identify opportunities to improve repeatability and efficiency, and support training, release, and adoption activities for new or enhanced capabilities.

• Maintain clear documentation of processes, data definitions, analytical logic, assumptions, decisions, and handoffs. Follow applicable privacy, governance, compliance, and quality standards and contribute to consistent ways of working across teams.


Win

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The strategic professional we seek is a motivated individual with these qualifications.


Basic Qualifications

• Doctorate or foreign equivalent degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field; OR

• Master's or foreign equivalent degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field and 2 years of relevant experience; OR

• Bachelor's or foreign equivalent degree in Business Administration, Accounting, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field and 4 years of relevant experience


Preferred Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience in the biopharmaceutical industry, health care analytics, market access, and/or strategy consulting, with familiarity with GTN, payer or provider contracting, pricing, rebates, reimbursement, coverage, or access.

• Experience independently delivering defined analytical workstreams or supporting analytics products from requirements and data assessment through testing, reporting, and stakeholder adoption.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with complex data, identify patterns and root causes, and translate results into clear business implications.

• Working proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint and experience with one or more analytical or reporting tools such as SQL, Python, R, Tableau, Power BI, or Anaplan.

• Familiarity with invoice, rebate, claims, contract, chargeback, access, reimbursement, or other health care and market access datasets is preferred.

• Strong written and oral communication skills and the ability to explain analytical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Demonstrated collaboration, organization, and project-management skills, including the ability to manage multiple priorities, coordinate across teams, and deliver against agreed timelines.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality, documentation, compliance, and continuous improvement.

Thrive

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

Job Title: Clinical Trial Manager (Sponsor Dedicated)

Job Location: Durham, North Carolina, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Local Trial Manager (LTM)

Global Clinical Operations

Overview

The Local Trial Manager (LTM) provides local management of clinical trials within assigned countries, ensuring studies are conducted in accordance with protocol requirements, applicable regulations, ICH-GCP guidelines, and internal procedures. The LTM is responsible for overseeing operational study delivery from startup through closeout while partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure quality, timelines, and patient recruitment objectives are achieved.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead country-level execution of assigned clinical trials, ensuring milestones, quality metrics, and timelines are met.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for country-specific study operations.
  • Support site identification, feasibility assessments, site selection, and activation activities.
  • Collaborate with investigators, site staff, and cross-functional teams to drive study performance and enrollment.
  • Monitor study progress and proactively identify and mitigate operational risks.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, GCP guidelines, study protocols, and SOPs.
  • Oversee site readiness, site performance, and issue resolution throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Partner with study teams to develop and execute recruitment and retention strategies.
  • Facilitate study team meetings and communicate study updates, risks, and mitigation plans.
  • Support management of vendors, study supplies, budgets, and invoicing activities as applicable.
  • Coordinate local regulatory submissions and approvals in partnership with study startup teams.
  • Ensure timely and accurate maintenance of study documentation, CTMS, and eTMF records.
  • Support audit and inspection readiness activities and help address findings through corrective actions.
  • Ensure appropriate reporting and documentation of safety-related information and protocol deviations.
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives and best practice sharing across the organization.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Nursing, Pharmacy, or a related field preferred.
  • Clinical research experience with demonstrated experience managing clinical trial activities.
  • Strong knowledge of ICH-GCP, clinical trial regulations, and study conduct requirements.
  • Experience working with investigators, clinical sites, and cross-functional study teams.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
  • Experience with CTMS, eTMF, and other clinical trial management systems preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
  • Ability to travel as required.
Preferred Experience
  • Experience overseeing studies from startup through closeout.
  • Experience supporting global or multicountry clinical trials.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to proactively identify and address study risks.
  • Demonstrated ability to build effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff - Vice President of HIV, Hepatitis, and TB
jobs.excerpt: OverviewThe Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc.
jobs.description:
Overview

The Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc. (CHAI) is a global health organization committed to our mission of saving lives and reducing the burden of disease in low-and middle-income countries. We work at the invitation of governments to support them and the private sector to create and sustain high-quality health systems.

CHAI was founded in 2002 in response to the HIV/AIDS epidemic with the goal of dramatically reducing the price of life-saving drugs and increasing access to these medicines in the countries with the highest burden of the disease. Over the following two decades, CHAI has expanded its focus. Today, along with HIV, we work with our partners to prevent and treat infectious diseases such as COVID-19, malaria, tuberculosis, and hepatitis. Our work has also expanded into cancer, diabetes, hypertension, and other non-communicable diseases, and we work to accelerate the rollout of lifesaving vaccines, reduce maternal and child mortality, combat chronic malnutrition, and increase access to assistive technology. We are investing in horizontal approaches to strengthen health systems through programs in human resources for health, digital health, and health financing. With each new and innovative program, our strategy is grounded in maximizing sustainable impact at scale, ensuring that governments lead the solutions, that programs are designed to scale nationally, and learnings are shared globally.

At CHAI, our people are our greatest asset, and none of this work would be possible without their talent, time, dedication, and passion for our mission and values. We are a highly diverse team of enthusiastic individuals across 40 countries with a broad range of skill sets and life experiences. CHAI is deeply grounded in the countries we work in, with the majority of our staff based in program countries. Learn more about our exciting work:

CHAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and is committed to providing an environment of fairness, and mutual respect where all applicants have access to equal employment opportunities. CHAI values diversity and inclusion and recognizes that our mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people with diverse experience, backgrounds, and culture.

Position Overview

The Chief of Staff works as the right hand to the Vice President who leads CHAI's HIV, Hepatitis, and TB cluster, a growing portfolio of three disease programs working with governments, suppliers, communities, partners, and donors. You will join senior leadership on the cluster's most visible work, from donor pitches to board presentations, and see how decisions get made across a global organization. This is a rare opportunity to help shape the direction of programs that reach millions of people in low- and middle-income countries.

The role has two main parts. The first is communication and synthesis: gathering input from program teams and turning it into the decks, briefs, pre-reads, and talking points the VP uses with donors and partners. Doing this well takes an analytical mind, since you will often need to work through data or pressure-test an argument before it's ready for the VP. Presentations are a large part of this, and you will build executive-quality decks yourself. The second is leading special projects for the VP, typically cross-cutting efforts that no single program team owns. Some will be planned, such as coordinating a joint donor proposal across teams, and others will call for surge support on an urgent VP priority, such as project managing the development of an investment case. For each, you will scope the work, set the plan, bring in the right people, and see it through to a result. Across both parts of the role, you will prepare the VP for key meetings, follow up on what was agreed, and help the VP decide where to spend time by triaging incoming requests and flagging what needs a decision. You will work closely with leadership across the three programs, who keep ownership of their technical work.

The base location is flexible as long as you can consistently work East Coast hours, and some travel will be required.

Responsibilities

Communications and Synthesis

  • Work with program leadership to develop presentations, briefs, memos, pre-reads, and talking points that help senior leaders understand complex topics, make decisions, and communicate priorities.
  • Produce board-, CEO-, and donor-facing presentations that are clear, rigorous, and visually sharp, often on short timelines.
  • Translate cost-effectiveness analysis and market and epidemiological data into narratives a non-specialist can follow and act on.
  • Maintain a high standard for all materials leaving the VP's office.

Special Projects

  • Lead cross-cutting projects the VP sponsors, such as coordinating a joint donor proposal across program teams: define the problem, build the work plan, bring in the right people, and see the work through to a result.
  • Provide surge-support on urgent VP priorities, such as project managing the development of an investment case.
  • Track milestones, owners, and dependencies for these projects, and coordinate external inputs such as consultants and vendors to keep deliverables on time and to standard.
  • Identify gaps and troubleshoot challenges as they surface, taking ownership and working with cluster leadership to resolve them.

Fundraising and Resource Mobilization

  • Work with teams to develop compelling donor-facing materials, including concept notes, proposals, budget narratives, and pitch decks that make a sharp case for investment.
  • Prepare the VP for donor and partner meetings with briefings, positioning, talking points, and follow-up tracking.

Prioritization and Follow-Through

  • Act as the VP's trusted strategic partner, developing clear analyses and actionable recommendations on the cluster's highest priorities, in close partnership and with input from the relevant program leads.
  • Keep a clear view of the VP's and cluster's top objectives, and help the VP decide among competing demands and where attention is most needed.
  • Help the VP frame decisions, weigh trade-offs, and anticipate what is coming across workstreams.
  • Connect the cluster's OKR process to the VP's agenda, flagging work that is off track or requires the VP's input.
  • Triage what comes into the VP's office, synthesizing and routing what requires a decision.
  • Prepare the VP for CEO, board, senior leadership, and partner engagements.
  • Follow up on agreed actions, identify blockers, and escalate issues requiring the VP's intervention.

Cluster Alignment and Coordination

  • Build strong relationships across HIV, TB, and Hepatitis leadership and the wider organization, using them to anticipate risks and support alignment across teams.
  • Manage the cadence of cluster leadership meetings, including agendas, decisions, and follow-ups.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree and, as a guide, six or more years of professional experience in management consulting, global health, strategy, operations, or a comparable environment.
  • Exceptional at producing content, especially in PowerPoint, with a demonstrated track record of independently building executive-quality decks as well as concept notes, briefs, and talking points. Strong visual and data storytelling is essential, and candidates should be ready to share recent decks they built themselves.
  • Strong technical writing skills and ability to synthesize at an executive level.
  • Sound judgment about confidentiality; ability to manage sensitive information and communications with discretion.
  • Fluency with AI tools in everyday work, including research, synthesis, and drafting, and the judgment to check their output and recognize where they fall short.
  • Proven project management ability: building plans across a diverse set of stakeholders and driving complex projects to completion with minimal supervision.
  • Experience developing fundraising or business-development materials such as proposals, concept notes, or pitches.
  • Exceptional research, writing, and structured problem-solving skills, with the judgment to know what the VP actually needs.
  • Comfortable creating structure for new or loosely defined work, and the drive to get hands dirty across a range of tasks.
  • Confident managing up and taking initiative, with the presence to work effectively with senior leaders.
  • Candour, including willingness to disagree with the VP.
  • A deep commitment to CHAI's mission and values.

Competencies

We are seeking an exceptional and highly motivated individual with a genuine desire to maximize global health outcomes. An ideal candidate will be:

  • Insightful: draws clear conclusions from a large amount of analysis, quickly grasps new programs and their key issues, and understands how a single workstream fits into larger priorities.
  • Independent: plans an efficient approach to hard problems, proactively takes the next step, and reliably delivers.
  • Practical: exercises judgment in allocating effort to what is decision-critical, and re-prioritizes as circumstances change.
  • Analytical: comfortable with quantitative and qualitative data, and able to extract logical conclusions and recommendations from it.
  • Communicative: navigates varied and sensitive stakeholder environments, from in-country teams to senior donor executives, and is an exceptional writer of both memos and presentation materials.
  • Rigorous: holds a high bar and produces work that stands up to internal and external scrutiny.
  • Adaptable: comfortable with ambiguity and shifting scope, quick to ramp on new topics, and able to develop expertise on a steep learning curve.

There is no 'perfect' candidate for this role. We are more interested in aptitude, judgment, and excitement for the work than in a fixed set of years or experiences, and we are open to a range of seniority to find the right fit. If this role excites you, please apply.

Advantages

  • Experience in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment such as strategy consulting, investment banking, or pharma.
  • Exposure to HIV, TB, hepatitis, or infectious-disease programming, or to market shaping, procurement, or access-to-medicines work.
  • Experience developing proposals and pitches in a fundraising or development function in the social-impact space.
  • Experience working remotely with a decentralized team
  • Experience working in or supporting low- and middle-income countries.

Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong Python and embedded Linux experience to maintain and expand software running on NVIDIA Jetson devices deployed in industrial inspection systems. This role involves managing containerized applications, hardware configuration, software releases and OTA updates, integrating devices with backend systems through MQTT and Kafka, and collaborating with electrical engineers to deliver reliable, maintainable solutions in production environments.

Responsibilities

  • Maintain and expand the Python and Docker software that runs on NVIDIA Jetson devices in the client's deployed inspection towers and drive-over virtual lifts.

  • Run the full deployment lifecycle:

    • initial flashing and hardware configuration, using an existing Python tool

    • site-specific provisioning that connects the hardware back to the client's systems

    • versioned deployment of containerized applications for each site and hardware configuration

  • Manage software versions and releases across production and experimental devices and locations, including the OTA update process

  • Work with two electrical engineers who source and validate components, turning their findings into deployable, updatable software, including drivers for peripherals and imaging hardware.

  • Build and maintain messaging between devices and backend systems through MQTT and Kafka.

  • Proactively identify technical needs and help prioritize the team's work.

  • Document how the system works and support colleagues in debugging and maintaining it

Key Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with Python as the primary language, including production software running on hardware in the field.

  • Experience building and deploying software on embedded Linux computing platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson or comparable single-board computers and system-on-modules.

  • Hands-on Docker experience packaging, versioning and deploying containerized applications.

  • Strong experience of team-based version control and release management: branching strategies, resolving merge conflicts, package versioning, and supporting multiple releases across production and experimental devices at different locations.

  • Experience working with message brokers, specifically MQTT and Kafka (or similar like RabbitMQ).

  • Experience implementing or configuring Linux drivers for external peripherals and imaging hardware such as cameras.

  • Proven ability to work independently: finds work that needs doing, helps prioritize it, and delivers without depending on a predefined ticket list.

  • Clear technical documentation habits and the willingness to share knowledge, including helping peers at the same or higher level debug and maintain the system.

Role Summary

The Chief Legal Officer (CLO) is the senior legal executive responsible for overseeing the organization's legal strategy, governance, regulatory compliance, corporate affairs, and risk management. The CLO serves as a trusted advisor to the CEO, Board of Directors, and executive leadership team, ensuring the organization operates within legal and regulatory frameworks while supporting business growth and strategic initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Legal Strategy & Executive Advisory

  • Serve as the principal legal advisor to the CEO, Board, and executive leadership team.
  • Develop and execute the organization's legal strategy in alignment with business objectives.
  • Provide legal guidance on strategic initiatives, mergers and acquisitions, partnerships, and corporate restructuring.
  • Anticipate and mitigate legal risks associated with business operations and growth.

2. Corporate Governance

  • Ensure compliance with corporate governance standards and best practices.
  • Advise the Board and executive leadership on fiduciary responsibilities and governance matters.
  • Manage board resolutions, corporate records, and governance policies.
  • Support corporate secretarial functions where applicable.

3. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

  • Oversee enterprise-wide legal and regulatory compliance programs.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on the organization.
  • Develop legal risk mitigation frameworks and compliance controls.

4. Contracts & Commercial Transactions

  • Lead the negotiation, drafting, and review of significant commercial agreements.
  • Oversee contract management processes and legal documentation standards.
  • Provide legal support for strategic partnerships, vendor agreements, and customer contracts.
  • Ensure contractual arrangements adequately protect organizational interests.

5. Litigation & Dispute Resolution

  • Manage litigation strategy and external legal counsel relationships.
  • Oversee dispute resolution, arbitration, mediation, and regulatory investigations.
  • Assess litigation exposure and recommend appropriate legal actions.
  • Ensure effective management of legal claims and liabilities.

6. Mergers, Acquisitions & Corporate Transactions

  • Lead legal due diligence for mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and investments.
  • Structure transactions to minimize legal and regulatory risk.
  • Manage external advisors and legal workstreams throughout transaction lifecycles.
  • Support post-merger integration activities from a legal perspective.

7. Ethics, Compliance & Corporate Integrity

  • Promote a culture of ethics, integrity, and compliance.
  • Oversee whistleblower programs, investigations, and ethics policies.
  • Ensure adherence to anti-corruption, anti-bribery, and corporate conduct standards.
  • Lead internal investigations involving legal and compliance matters.

8. Legal Team Leadership

  • Build and lead a high-performing legal and compliance function.
  • Manage legal budgets and external counsel expenditures.
  • Develop legal talent and succession planning initiatives.
  • Establish legal operations processes and performance metrics.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Juris Doctor (JD), LLB, or equivalent law degree.
  • Licensed attorney admitted to practice in a relevant jurisdiction.
  • 15+ years of progressive legal experience.
  • Minimum 5+ years in a senior legal leadership role (General Counsel, CLO, Head of Legal, Legal Director).
  • Experience advising executive leadership and boards of directors.
  • Strong background in corporate law, governance, compliance, commercial contracts, and regulatory matters.
  • Experience managing complex legal transactions and litigation.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleWe're hiring an Ops & Marketing Project Manager to be the organization backbone of a small, fast-moving team.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We're hiring an Ops & Marketing Project Manager to be the organization backbone of a small, fast-moving team. Plans get made in Slack, work gets briefed in Notion, and the gap between those two is where things quietly die. You're the person who closes that gap.

This role sits primarily on the operations side of our home fragrance brand. You'll own wholesale operations end to end, and you'll be the one keeping product development, inventory, and production moving: chasing suppliers, holding timelines, building the project boards, and making sure nothing sits waiting on an answer nobody asked for.

You'll also own the marketing calendar and the project flow behind it. Our marketing team moves fast across website, paid, email, and creator work, and it needs someone who makes sure that once something is decided it has an owner, a date, a dependency map, and someone chasing it. You're not deciding what we launch. You're the person who knows the status of everything, without being asked.

We're an AI-forward company, and this is an AI-forward role. Claude is part of how this team works every day, not a side experiment. We expect you to build your systems, SOPs, trackers, and reporting with AI in the loop, and to keep finding the places where it takes busywork off your plate and off the plates of the people around you. You don't need a technical background. You do need real curiosity and the willingness to make it part of how you work.

What You'll Do

  • Own wholesale day to day: processing orders, charging payments, creating shipments and inbounds, and the customer service that comes with it
  • Create 3PL orders for suppliers, samples, and anything else needed
  • Write the SOPs as you go, so the function can be handed to a dedicated coordinator over time. Designing your own replacement here is part of the job, not a threat to it

Product Development, Inventory, and Production

  • Supplier follow-up, cost comparisons, timelines, and project boards across new products and packaging
  • Stay closely on top of production status and timelines, and flag slippage early enough that we can do something about it
  • Support inventory operations and learn the fundamentals of production from the team, with room to take on more here over time

The Marketing Calendar

  • Own a single calendar across brands and channels: website, paid creative, email and SMS, creator and UGC, promotions, and product launches
  • Hold the dates. Work backwards from the launch date rather than forwards from today, so creative, approvals, and builds land in the right order
  • Turn strategy into briefed work. When a plan arrives as ten line items with five names attached, you break it into owned tasks with real dates and confirm who has what
  • Catch collisions before they cost a day: duplicate briefs, two designers on the same asset, work blocked on an approval nobody requested
  • Run the weekly cadence. What shipped, what slipped and why, and what's at risk next week, published without being asked for it

Systems, Notion, and AI

  • Own Notion as the system of record for these areas: structure, templates, status hygiene, and getting people to actually use it
  • Build real systems where only informal structure exists today, then keep them alive. A board nobody updates is worse than no board
  • Use AI to build and run those systems, from drafting SOPs and briefs to pulling together reporting and tracking what's outstanding
  • Keep creator and partnership records, contracts, and payments accurate and moving, in step with finance and the partnerships team

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Exceptional organization. This is the single most important quality for this role
  • 3+ years managing multiple concurrent projects across teams
  • Operations experience in e-commerce, consumer brands, wholesale, or supply chain
  • Direct marketing experience, ideally owning or running a marketing calendar across channels
  • You already use AI seriously in your own work, and you can show us how. We care more about how you think with it than which tools you've touched
  • Hands-on Notion experience. You've built databases and views that other people relied on, not just filled in someone else's
  • Experience working inside a CRM and keeping it clean and current (Folk, HubSpot, Salesforce, Klaviyo, or similar)
  • Strong follow-through. You're persistent with suppliers, vendors, and teammates until you get an answer
  • The instinct to surface problems early, with a recommendation attached
  • Strong written communication. Most of this job happens in writing, across time zones
  • Strong English communication skills
  • Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills, and comfort across Word, PowerPoint, and Google's suite of tools

Nice to Have

  • Wholesale or B2B operations experience, including basic customer service
  • Familiarity with Shopify, Cin7, Klaviyo, or Figma
  • Experience with product development or packaging timelines

Benefits

    • 💰 Competitive salary in USD
    • 🕒 Flexible working schedule
    • 🌎 100% remote, long-term career opportunity

Es un profesional en desarrollo especializado en el diseño, desarrollo y apoyo en la liberación de arneses eléctricos (conjuntos de cables, conectores y componentes) principalmente para sistemas de bajo voltaje (LV), aunque puede tener exposición limitada a alto voltaje (HV) en entornos supervisados. ¿Cómo lo hace?

Utiliza herramientas como Siemens Capital Essentials (con supervisión) para crear dibujos de manufactura 2D, listas de cables y definiciones de conectores, basándose en datos 3D de CATIA proporcionados por equipos senior.

Colabora con proveedores y equipos internos para asegurar que los diseños cumplan con estándares como IPC/WHMA-A-620 (básico) y USCAR-21/USCAR-2 (con apoyo).

Apoya en la resolución de problemas técnicos durante la instalación y debugging de arneses, siempre con supervisión en casos complejos.

Participa en procesos de APQP y PPAP (en roles de apoyo), así como en la gestión de ECRs (Engineering Change Requests) bajo la dirección de un líder.

¿Por qué es importante?

El trabajo del IE2 en Arneses Eléctricos es clave para:

Apoyar la integración técnica entre componentes eléctricos y mecánicos en proyectos supervisados.

Contribuir a minimizar riesgos de fallos eléctricos en producción, siguiendo procesos establecidos.

Optimizar la manufacturabilidad en tareas específicas, reduciendo costos en proyectos de complejidad media.

Desarrollar habilidades para escalar a roles senior, especialmente en industrias como automotriz (LV).

Requirements

Habilidades Específicas

Experiencia:

3 a 5 años en diseño de arneses eléctricos (LV), creación de dibujos de manufactura 2D, listas de cables y librerías de componentes en Siemens Capital Essentials.

Herramientas:

Uso intermedio de CATIA V5/V6 (rutado 3D) y Siemens Capital Essentials.

Conocimientos técnicos:

Interpretación de esquemas eléctricos lógicos y físicos.

Protocolos de comunicación CAN, LIN.

Restricciones físicas básicas: protección térmica, selección de materiales.

Rutado de cables en interfaces estáticas y dinámicas.

Procesos de calidad:

APQP, PPAP (apoyo en gestión de ECRs).

Gestión: Seguimiento de BOM y colaboración con proveedores.

Critical minerals are the bottleneck in the clean energy transition, and finding them faster is as much a machine learning problem as a geophysics one. At Fleet Space, our satellite-enabled exploration technology helps generate the data and the models to find deposits faster and more efficiently.

To help continue to build and scale our products we are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to help build out our ML operations to develop, mature and deploy the models and systems behind that work. You will partner with our another Senior ML Engineer & our Data science team to take their research models from notebooks and prototypes through to production-grade products, and you will own the pipelines, GPU environments and infrastructure those systems run on.

This is a role with a focus on scaling our ML ops alongside our Senior ML Engineer. You will design leakage-safe evaluation, verify that uncertainty calibration holds as new data lands, and keep every model's lineage reproducible from config through to prediction.

You will also own our ML experiment platform: MLflow tracking and the model registry, run identity and provenance conventions, and the environments and dependencies that training jobs run in. Where the platform team has shared infrastructure modules you will reuse them, and you will contribute new patterns back.

What You’ll Do
  • Work with the data science team to transition research models into production-ready products, with code quality, scalability and best practice built in rather than retrofitted.
  • Build and maintain robust, efficient ML and data pipelines and the infrastructure behind them, including configuring GPU environments for scalable ML systems.
  • Own model quality across retrain cycles: leakage-safe evaluation, calibrated uncertainty that holds as new data lands, and reproducible lineage from config to prediction.
  • Own the ML experiment platform end to end: MLflow tracking and model registry, run identity and provenance conventions, and the environments and dependencies training jobs run in.
  • Partner with the platform team, reusing shared infrastructure modules where they exist and contributing new patterns back.
  • Write clean, testable Python (SOLID principles) backed by unit tests and automated end-to-end tests.
  • Keep pace with where ML and MLOps are heading, and bring the useful parts back into how we work.
What We Are LookingFor

  • Deep expertise in machine learning across modeling, data engineering and architecture, with proven experience as a software engineer focused on ML
  • Alignment to our stack; Python (Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch), MLflow, AWS, Databricks, Terraform, GitLab, and Zarr and Icechunk for big-array data
  • ML Engineers that enjoy and want to focus on ML ops
  • Experience with Geospatial data would be a big plus
  • Experience in startup environments, building ML products and environments from early stages
  • Experience across the full ML lifecycle, from data preprocessing and feature engineering through to training, evaluation and deployment.
  • A track record of taking research artifacts (notebooks, scratch apps, prototype models) to production-grade solutions that scale, for example models served as a service.
  • Data engineering from first principles: deterministic, idempotent pipelines, schema and contract discipline at data boundaries, and deliberate failure and retry semantics.
  • Software delivery from first principles: continuous release with automated gates, observability, and clean design in application architecture.
  • Solid grounding in MLOps: model development, deployment and data versioning, ideally in a startup or scale-up environment.
  • Strong Python, with the common data science and ML libraries, and solid software engineering fundamentals across data structures, algorithms and design patterns.
  • Hands-on AWS and Databricks experience, managing infrastructure as code with Terraform and designing to well-architected principles.
  • Experience with code and data version control such as GitLab, MLflow and Icechunk.
  • A high-ownership mindset: you balance technical debt against speed of value delivery and make that trade-off pragmatically.
  • A high-agency mindset: you are comfortable where structure does not exist yet and needs to be built, and you treat iterative delivery as a means to that end rather than a ceremony.
  • Exposure to big-array data such as remote sensing workflows, including Zarr and Icechunk, would be an advantage, as would experience with big data technologies, contributions to open-source ML projects, and comfort working with AI-assisted development workflows such as agentic coding tools and AI code review.
About Fleet Space
Fleet Space Technologies' vision from the beginning was to build technologies to help humanity explore and connect the Earth, Moon, and Mars.

This led us to develop and launch one of Australia's largest constellation of satellites, create our satellite-enabled mineral exploration technology (ExoSphere), and send Australia's first seismic technology (SPIDER) to the Moon in 2026. ExoSphere, our end-to-end mineral exploration solution powered by space and AI, aims to accelerate critical mineral discovery needed for the clean energy technologies foundational to humanity's future.

As part of Fleet's founding vision, we also apply our technology to innovative solutions for defense and space exploration, including an upcoming mission to the Moon. We are headquartered in Adelaide, South Australia, with growing teams in the USA, Canada, and beyond.


Company Culture
As a company, we are revolutionising the exploration of new worlds with advanced space technology to build a more prosperous future for humanity.

As a culture, we are ambitious, innovative, and collaborative and we put our customers first in everything that we do.

Our company values guide us to our North Star of ambitious, collaborative success: AD ASTRA (“To the Stars!”)

  • Add Value: Obsessively add value for our customers
  • Drive Excellence: Benchmark against the best
  • Agile Action: Take Action. Independent, fast, frugal action
  • Seek Truth: Be curious. Explore
  • Take Responsibility: Make decisions and own them
  • Radical Ideas: We are unique. We do things differently
  • Always Deliver: We always find a way to get it done on time
Our Benefits Include
  • We have an extremely flexible work culture, with a mix of onsite, hybrid and remote workers who take time for school runs, exercise and appointments. It's about getting the work done, not time at desk.
  • Equity (ESOP) grants.
  • 20 days of annual leave + 10 extra Wellness days per year.
  • Learning budgets.
  • Access to confidential Psychologist appointments via our Employee Assistance Program.
  • Plenty of opportunity to be part of an amazing STEM program to create the next generation of explorers.
Equal Opportunity
Fleet is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Fleet is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, colour, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

What You’ll Do:

  • Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.
  • Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.
  • Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.
  • Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.
  • Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.
  • Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.
  • Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

Compensation: The United States base salary range for this full-time position is $140,000-$200,000 + bonus + equity depending on experience

Job Description

A bit about this role:

The Pricing Actuary is a critical actuarial leader responsible for directing the strategy, modeling, and execution of our annual Medicare Advantage (MA) bidding process. This role demands deep, battle-tested expertise in Medicare Advantage bid preparation, rate cell modeling, CMS regulations, and risk adjustment mechanics.


Beyond pure technical depth, success in this role hinges on flawless operational execution: hit non-negotiable regulatory deadlines, bring process consistency to complex financial cycles, and work collaboratively across market leadership, clinical teams, finance, and executive stakeholders.

We place the highest value on proven real-world execution, technical precision, and collaborative leadership. While professional actuarial credentials are recognized, a track record of driving timely, accurate, and strategic MA bids is what truly defines success in this role.


Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:


  • Medicare Advantage Bid Strategy & Execution
    • Annual Bid Leadership: Direct and oversee the end-to-end development, modeling, and submission of annual Medicare Advantage (Part C and Part D) bids, ensuring total compliance with CMS guidelines and strict adherence to statutory deadlines.
    • Product & Benefit Pricing Strategy: Partner with product, clinical, and local market leaders to design competitive benefit packages, evaluating product trade-offs, supplemental benefits, and cost-sharing mechanics against financial and growth targets.
    • Assumption Development: Establish, defend, and document core actuarial bid assumptions, including baseline utilization, unit cost trends, risk adjustment factors, administrative expense allocations, and margin targets.

  • Modeling, Technical Rigor & Process Consistency
    • Actuarial Modeling & Automation: Build, refine, and maintain scalable bid pricing models, ensuring high standards of technical accuracy, model governance, and repeatable execution across expanding market footprints.
    • Sensitivity & Scenario Analysis: Perform complex scenario testing and sensitivity analyses to quantify the financial impacts of proposed CMS payment policy changes, risk model updates, benchmark shifts, and competitive market dynamics.
    • CMS Regulatory Translation: Interpret annual CMS Call Letters, Bid Instructions, and Rate Announcements, translating regulatory changes into actionable modeling adjustments and executive strategic guidance.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategic Alignment
    • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work seamlessly across Finance, Healthcare Economics, Clinical Operations, and Network Management to ensure bid assumptions reflect actual operational capabilities, clinical programs, and provider contracting terms.
    • Data Integration & Quality Assurance: Partner closely with data engineering and analytics teams to ensure the integrity, completeness, and accuracy of historical claims, enrollment, and risk adjustment data fed into bid models.
    • Executive & Regulatory Presentation: Prepare clear, compelling executive-level presentations summarizing bid strategy, financial returns, and risk profiles for executive leadership, board members, and regulatory reviewers.

Required skills and experience:

(Hands-on execution ability, proven track record, and collaborative performance take precedence over formal degrees or certifications).


    • Core Actuarial & MA Experience: 8+ years of progressive healthcare actuarial experience, with at least 5+ years of deep, direct focus on Medicare Advantage bid pricing, plan design, and CMS bid submission.
    • Proven Track Record of Deadline Execution: Demonstrated ability to consistently drive complex, time-sensitive projects to completion on schedule, managing high-stakes regulatory deadlines with poise and precision.
    • Technical & Modeling Expertise: Advanced proficiency in actuarial modeling, claims data extraction, and financial modeling tools (e.g., SQL, Python, R, SAS, or advanced Excel modeling).
    • Deep Regulatory Mastery: Thorough understanding of Medicare Advantage pricing mechanics, including Part D direct subsidy/benefit design, CMS risk adjustment models (CMS-HCC, RxHCC), Star Ratings financial impacts, and benchmark calculations.
    • Collaborative Leadership: Exceptional interpersonal skills with a proven track record of working constructively across cross-functional teams, translating complex actuarial concepts into clear strategic choices for non-actuarial partners.

Desired skills and experience:

  • (Actuarial designations are valued, but equivalent practical mastery and demonstrated track record are fully recognized).
    • Actuarial Credentials (Optional): Associate (ASA) or Fellow (FSA) of the Society of Actuaries, and Member of the American Academy of Actuaries (MAAA). Fully equivalent experience and bid leadership track record will be strongly considered.
    • Broad Financial & Managed Care Perspective: Experience interfacing with reserving, underwriting, risk adjustment operations, or medical economics functions.
    • Startup / High-Growth Agility: Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where processes are continuously refined and optimized.


Salary range: $175,000 - $250,000 / year

Strategic Analytics & Business Insights

Data Governance & Metric Standardization
