jobs.description:
Career-defining. Life-changing.

At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career

About This Role:

Manager, Customer Care Training & Delivery

About This Role

The Manager, Customer Care Training leads the Customer Care training function, including new hire onboarding, ongoing learning, training content, readiness support, and adoption of approved learning technologies. This role is accountable for ensuring training programs prepare employees to perform effectively in a high-volume, regulated, and digitally evolving Customer Care environment.

This role manages Training & Development Specialists and partners closely with Customer Care Operations, Quality, Workforce Management, Support Readiness, Compliance, and other business partners to plan, deliver, and continuously improve onboarding, continuing education, systems training, AI-enabled learning initiatives, and change-readiness support.

The Manager ensures training is consistent, current, measurable, and aligned to operational priorities, quality expectations, compliance requirements, and employee readiness needs. The role uses training data, learner feedback, quality trends, operational metrics, and stakeholder input to identify gaps, recommend solutions, and support responsible adoption of approved AI tools and learning technologies.

What You'll Be Doing

Training strategy, delivery and operations

  • Lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of Customer Care onboarding, role-based training, continuing education, systems training, refresher training, and change-readiness learning programs.
  • Manage training schedules, facilitator assignments, learner communications, classroom or virtual learning logistics, and team coverage to meet operational needs.
  • Ensure training programs are delivered consistently, reflect established curriculum and procedures, and remain aligned to business requirements, quality standards, compliance expectations, and approved operational changes.
  • Support updates to training materials based on changes to processes, systems, products, policies, and procedures.
  • Partner with stakeholders, subject matter experts, and business partners to obtain information needed to maintain accurate training content.
  • Review participant and stakeholder feedback to recommend improvements to training materials and delivery on a regular basis.
  • Facilitate training or provide coverage as needed.
  • Use approved AI and digital learning tools to improve content development, learner engagement, knowledge reinforcement, and scalable training delivery.
  • Support evaluation, implementation, and adoption of approved AI-enabled learning solutions in partnership with business, compliance, privacy, and technology stakeholders.

Employee readiness, performance and training effectiveness

  • Monitor learner attendance, completion, assessment results, proficiency progress, quality trends, and readiness indicators across assigned training programs.
  • Coordinate knowledge checks, assessments, practice activities, and other established methods for evaluating learner readiness.
  • Partner with Customer Care Operations, Quality, Workforce Management, and Support Readiness to identify recurring knowledge, skill, process, or adoption gaps and translate them into training reinforcement plans.
  • Provide coaching and feedback to trainers regarding facilitation and training delivery.
  • Track established training metrics, summarize trends, and provide regular updates, insights, and recommended actions to Customer Care leadership.
  • Identify trends or recurring training needs and recommend appropriate follow-up actions.
  • Support employees as they transition from training to production by coordinating reinforcement, coaching support, job aids, and readiness feedback loops with Operations and Quality.
  • Use training data, learning analytics, operational feedback, and approved AI-generated insights to identify knowledge gaps, readiness risks, and development opportunities.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of AI-enabled learning solutions and recommend improvements to support employee proficiency and performance.

Learning support for business change and transformation

  • Develop and coordinate training plans for new or updated processes, systems, products, policies, procedures, workflow changes, and technology-enabled ways of working.
  • Partner with business leaders and subject matter experts to understand upcoming changes, assess learner impact, define training needs, and align timelines for readiness support.
  • Ensure impacted training materials are updated and communicated to trainers and learners.
  • Support adoption of new tools, processes, and workflows through training, job aids, coaching resources, reinforcement activities, and stakeholder feedback loops.
  • Gather employee and trainer feedback following changes and escalate recurring issues or training needs as appropriate.
  • Support training initiatives related to automation, AI-enabled business tools, digital channels, knowledge management, and other technology changes that affect Customer Care operations.
  • Assist employees in adopting new digital and AI-enabled solutions through training, coaching, job aids, and reinforcement activities.

Compliance & Quality

  • Ensure training is delivered in accordance with established company policies, procedures, quality requirements, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain training documentation and records in accordance with established requirements.
  • Coordinate required reviews and approvals of training materials.
  • Partner with Quality, Compliance, Privacy, and other appropriate functions to address training-related requirements.
  • Reinforce expectations related to quality, documentation, privacy, customer support standards, and escalation procedures.
  • Support training-related activities associated with audits or inspections as needed.
  • Support the responsible and compliant use of approved AI tools within training programs and learning content development.

People leadership and team management

  • Manage, coach, and develop Training & Development Specialists, setting clear expectations and supporting strong performance, accountability, engagement, and continuous growth.
  • Establish team priorities, assign work, monitor progress, remove barriers, and ensure training deliverables are completed in alignment with business needs.
  • Manage training schedules and team coverage to support operational needs.
  • Provide regular feedback, coaching, and performance management for direct reports.
  • Support development of trainer capabilities in facilitation, instructional delivery, learning technology, and training content development.
  • Support the development of trainer capabilities related to AI tools, digital learning technologies, and emerging learning practices.
  • Promote teamwork, accountability, continuous improvement, and a strong customer focus.
  • Escalate resource, performance, or operational issues to management as appropriate.

About You

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in training, learning and development, customer care operations, or a related field.
  • 1+ year of experience leading, supervising, coaching, or training.
  • Experience delivering or supporting training programs in an operational environment such as Customer Care, contact centers, patient support, healthcare operations, or a similar service environment.
  • Working knowledge of adult learning principles, facilitation, coaching, and training assessment methods.
  • Experience developing or updating training materials, job aids, or other learning resources.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple training activities, schedules, and priorities.
  • Ability to use training results, employee feedback, and operational information to identify training needs and recommend improvements.
  • Experience utilizing technology-enabled learning solutions, training platforms, or digital tools to support employee development and performance improvement.
  • Ability to analyze performance and training data to identify trends and recommend learning solutions.
  • Strong communication, organization, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience using learning management systems, training technologies, or similar tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, medical device, life sciences, or another regulated industry.
  • Experience supporting training within a contact center or customer support environment.
  • Experience supporting remote or geographically distributed employees.
  • Experience with scenario-based or proficiency-based training and assessment.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, contact center technologies, knowledge management platforms, or digital learning tools.
  • Experience leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to support training delivery, content development, knowledge management, coaching, or employee enablement.
  • Experience implementing or supporting AI-enabled learning technologies, digital adoption platforms, or workforce development solutions.
  • Familiarity with Generative AI tools and their application within learning and development environments.

Operating through our family of brands—CMLS, nesto, and Nesto Cloud—our mission is to build Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future and create a true Canadian champion in lending technology and financial services. Learn more at:

At nesto, we're passionate about challenging the status quo and building a better mortgage experience and saving money on their mortgages for Canadians. We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and creativity where every team member is empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and grow. If you're looking to solve meaningful problems alongside ambitious, supportive teammates, you'll feel right at home here.

This is a remote-first role open to candidates anywhere in Canada. You'll have the flexibility to work from home or from any of our offices nationwide.

nesto's AI Stream is building Maestro, our AI underwriting and lending engine. Maestro reads documents, applies credit policies automatically, and generates clear, auditable decisions in minutes. The team is in an active build phase with significant near-term delivery commitments, and we need a senior engineer who can take ownership of major projects and help set technical direction quickly.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Lead major features and projects end-to-end, surfacing trade-offs clearly so delivery stays on track without compromising quality
  • Design and optimize agentic AI workflows that combine deterministic rules with LLM perception, embedding search, and structured output extraction
  • Build and own evaluation pipelines, including golden sets, offline and online evals, and regression tracking, to measure model quality over time
  • Shape architecture decisions for the AI agent platform, setting high technical standards through code reviews and collaborative problem-solving
  • Use AI tooling and agent harnesses to write and ship code faster, so the team can keep pace with its deadlines
  • Mentor peers and collaborate with cross-functional teammates to hit delivery timelines

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, with strong backend and API skills
  • Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with LLMs, ideally running them in production (prompting, RAG, or structured extraction)
  • A data science, data analysis, or statistics background
  • Experience with model implementation, monitoring, and evaluation across the full lifecycle
  • Solid software engineering fundamentals, including testing, design patterns, and agile practices
  • Comfort with AI-assisted development tooling and agent-based workflows
  • Experience leading projects or stepping into a technical lead role

Nice-to-Have

  • Familiarity with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), vector databases, and document intelligence pipelines
  • Experience managing AI production systems trade-offs (cost, latency, etc.)
  • Experience working in regulated domains, such as OSFI E-23 compliance

This Role Might Be for You If

  • You want to build something from the ground up and see it through, rather than move into people management
  • You've shipped LLM features to production and care about how they're evaluated
  • You're comfortable letting AI tooling accelerate how you write and review software
  • You've led projects before and are ready to take a tech lead role on product-oriented projects with real deadlines
  • You come from backend or API work and have built data skills alongside it

  • Learning & Growth — Education assistance, mentorship, training, and opportunities to build your career across Nesto Group.
  • Tools for Success — Modern technology, collaborative teams, and the resources you need to do your best work.


Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

jobs.description:
About the Role

The Product Manager, Onboarding plays a critical role in ensuring the product organization builds the right solutions in the right way by deeply understanding how the system operates today, how clients and associates use it, and what investments are needed to improve performance, stability, quality and ultimately scalability over time. This role includes writing user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria, and leading cross-functional refinement sessions.

This role sits at the intersection of client needs, business priorities, technology capabilities, and cross-team execution. As a PM, you will be making informed trade-offs on how to maximize the velocity of the team, the sequencing of the work optimally, balancing effectively, instrument outcomes, and creating the flexibility needed for rapid experimentation. By maintaining a clear view of system health, dependencies, risks, and future opportunities, the Product Manager, Systems enables stronger product decisions, faster learning, more reliable delivery, and ultimately better end-to-end experiences.

Day to day, you’ll…

  • Execute delivery of a defined roadmap for Onboarding initiatives that will enable assisted tax clients to easily provide their data and documents to H&R Block and have a successful tax engagement with their tax professional
  • Ensure the successful execution and delivery of assigned features within large-scale products, organizing necessary resources through planning ceremonies, and supporting the product backlog while managing scope, schedule, quality, costs, resources and risks
  • Write detailed user stories and requirements with acceptance criteria that can be properly translated into automated tests
  • Lead product ceremonies for cross-functional product squads using modern SDLC best practices and methodologies, ensuring high performance and collaboration. Create an environment of psychological safety for innovation and foster a strong sense of ownership within the team
  • Coordinate activities and report regularly to the product team and leadership; regularly conduct team retrospectives and drive resulting actions
  • Utilize tools such as WalkMe, LaunchDarkly or Adobe Target to conduct tests and experiments. Use data to continuously evaluate and adapt strategies based on test results, focusing on delivering measurable outcomes
  • Accountable for ensuring the quality of features delivered by the trio and achieving defined OKRs (Outcomes and Key Results)
  • Foster strong collaboration with engineering, design, and business teams to ensure alignment and integration
  • Engage in personal development to enhance product management competencies and adjacent functions such as Agile, Lean, DevOps, etc.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management Information Systems, Computer Science or related area, or the equivalent through a combination of education and work experience
  • 3 years of experience in product management or a related role
  • Familiarity with formal product management methodologies
  • Basic technical understanding to be able to engage with engineering teams and familiarity with technology delivery/software development methodologies (notably Agile, Lean, DevOps)
  • Demonstrated decision making, analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Effective in leading teams/squads in a matrix management environment with demonstrated record of establishing priorities and deadlines
  • Effective oral, written and interpersonal communication skills. Ability to communicate with all levels of internal associates, external vendors and business partners
  • Ability to work effectively as a part of a team with minimal formal supervision or guidance

Preferred Qualifications

  • Tax or financial industry background
  • Familiarity in building mobile apps
  • Formal product management certifications or training, or equivalent
  • Expertise with product planning tools (ADO, TheyDo, Atlassian)

Why work for us

At H&R Block, our purpose is simple: to provide help and inspire confidence in our clients and communities everywhere. For more than 70 years, we’ve led the tax industry and we continue to evolve through our Block Next strategy, blending human expertise with digital innovation.

That same commitment to care extends to our associates. When you join us, you become part of a High Performing, Connected Culture built on strong relationships, continuous learning, and a shared commitment to making a meaningful impact. We invest in your well-being through competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and support for life both in and outside of work.

This role has two modes. With the established team running the existing products, you lead through managers and team leads; daily production coding is not expected, but you must be able to review architecture and step in to steer major incidents. In the small, elite squad rebuilding the platform, you will be more hands-on.

You will own all technology in the business: product engineering, QA, DevOps and cloud, data, and infrastructure.

ABOUT TAG SOFTWARE GROUP:

TAG Software Group is a team of experienced investors and operators dedicated to acquiring, enhancing, and growing mission-critical software companies serving SMB, enterprise, and public sector customers.

Founded as part of a permanent home for software companies, we don’t buy to sell. Our focus is on long-term partnerships that protect your legacy, employees, and customers.

Our in-house team delivers an efficient, transparent, and seller-friendly process, ensuring speed and certainty of close. Once part of TAG, your company gains access to proven best practices, dedicated value-creation resources, and the extended ecosystem of our sister companies, including proprietary in-house technology including and — helping your business reach the next level.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Run and stabilize the current estate

  • Lead a production team of 20+ engineers, testers, product and platform staff.
  • Set priorities, delivery cadence and metrics: velocity, quality, release predictability, cost per product line.
  • Keep a mission-critical on-premises estate secure, supported and compliant.
  • Run clear programme governance: every initiative has an owner, plan, budget and honest monthly reporting to the MD.
  • Own reliability: incident response, postmortems and support escalation, building a team that handles incidents without you.

Build the next-generation platform with a lean, AI-first team

  • Build a small, senior, AI-native engineering team using AI-assisted development.
  • Rebuild the core product as a best-in-class cloud platform that aims to be number one in the UK market.
  • Work hands-on inside the new-platform squad: set the architecture, write and review code if needed, and set the engineering standard.
  • Make AI development tools part of every engineer's daily work, across both the legacy and new teams.

Lead the move from on premises to cloud

  • Own the migration strategy for a large installed customer base, including sequencing, integration and data migration.
  • Keep NHS integrations, accreditations and clinical-safety obligations intact throughout.
  • Consolidate hosting and infrastructure and reduce the hardware and network footprint our customers carry.

Technical environment

  • On-premises platform: Mainly C++ , C# and Java; .NET Framework; Microsoft SQL Server; Windows Server; installed at each customer site
  • Cloud platform: multi-tenant SaaS on Microsoft Azure; C#, ASP.NET Core, React; Kubernetes (AKS); PostgreSQL,
  • Hardware: company-supplied terminals, handheld scanners and printers; dispensing-robot integrations; NHS HSCN network connectivity; field engineering and workshop

Requirements

  • 8+ years in software engineering, including 4+ years leading teams.
  • Still hands-on enough to work inside a small, elite squad.
  • Personally, led a migration of paying customers from on premises to multi-tenant SaaS.
  • Strong Microsoft stack background: C#/.NET, SQL Server, Azure; able to assess legacy C++ and .NET Framework code.
  • Using AI development tools in your daily work is expected. You know how to get the most from them for yourself and your team, and can show the impact on delivery
  • Track record of hard calls: restructuring teams, stopping failing projects, managing R&D to a P&L.
  • Explains technical trade-offs clearly and rooted in commercial rationale.

Benefits

  • A rare chance to build a market-leading product with a loyal customer base already in place.
  • High autonomy within a decentralized operating structure.
  • Career growth within a rapidly expanding Valsoft ecosystem.
  • Permanent ownership: Valsoft holds its businesses indefinitely, so you build for the long term, not for an exit.
  • A peer network of CTOs and engineering leaders across Valsoft's 150+ software companies.
  • Remote work flexibility.

The Manager of Sustainability at Goodwill Industries International leads the execution of complex, high‑impact initiatives that advance Goodwill’s sustainability priorities across a diverse, multi‑stakeholder network. This role translates strategy into action by managing projects and programs that deliver measurable environmental and community outcomes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  1. Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple, concurrent sustainability projects and programs with varying scopes, timelines, and stakeholders
  2. Develop and manage project plans, workstreams, timelines, milestones, and deliverables to ensure initiatives remain on track and aligned with strategic objectives

  8. Help develop tools, templates, and resources that improve consistency and effectiveness across projects and programs
  9. Manage projects that may be supported by external funding, applying strong grant and compliance practices as needed
  10. Support collaboration with external partners, including nonprofits, funders, industry groups, and technical experts
  11. Serve as a connector across organizations and teams, helping align priorities, expectations, and timelines

  13. Represent Goodwill with professionalism and credibility in cross‑sector settings
  14. Support GII Sustainability Team in managing projects and day-to-day tasks
  15. Other duties as assigned

RELATIONSHIPS:

Internal: Daily contact with GII team members to coordinate projects and support activities
Local Goodwills: Frequent contact with Goodwill CEOs and senior staff
External: Frequent contact with external partners

SKILLS NEEDED:

  1. Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously
  2. Ability to design, implement, and oversee projects from inception to evaluation
  3. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex work into clear, audience‑appropriate materials
  4. Highly organized, detail‑oriented, and comfortable working in a fast‑moving environment
  5. Ability to prioritize amongst competing needs and opportunities
  6. Outstanding interpersonal skills with diverse people and cultures
  7. Flexibility, open-mindedness, and agility to pivot and think outside the box
  8. Travel as necessary (10-15%) to carry out duties and responsibilities

EDUCATION:Minimum of bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in one or more of the following fields:

  1. Sustainability, environmental science, or environmental studies
  2. Public policy, public administration, or nonprofit management
  3. Business administration, operations, or management
  4. Project management, systems thinking, or a related discipline

EXPERIENCE:

  1. Five or more years of relevant professional experience managing complex projects or programs, preferably in sustainability, social impact, philanthropy, nonprofit, or cross‑sector settings

  2. Demonstrated ability to lead multiple concurrent initiatives, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a collaborative, fast‑moving environment

  3. Strong project management experience, including planning, execution, coordination across teams, and progress tracking, with grant management experience preferred

  4. Experience working across organizations or networks with diverse stakeholders toward shared goals

  5. Proven ability to communicate clearly and effectively with senior leaders, partners, and cross‑functional team

DECISIONMAKING:

Decision and recommendation making for developing systems, appropriate responses to identified needs, and consultative guidance to improve performance.

SUPERVISION:

Moderatewithlatitudegivento the position in carrying out work assignments. Work is checked for accuracy and completeness.

PHYSICALEFFORT:

Sedentarywithlifting10poundsmaximumandoccasionallylifting and/or carrying such articles or files. Walking and standing are required occasionally; long hours sitting at a desk and using a computer.

EMOTIONALEFFORT:

Work environment usually hectic with periods of high stress. Must demonstrate a positive attitude in meeting daily challenges.

Our Values

We believe everyone deserves an opportunity to thrive. Goodwill’s mission grounds us and happens through each one of us. This aspiration applies to each GII team member as much as to the people we serve.GII’s organizational values guide all that we do; how we do our work and make decisions, and how we interact with each other, Goodwill members and all stakeholders.

Our mission happens through me (Passion)

We have a fire for our mission. We bring our energy, creativity and passion to all that we do. By contributing the best of what is within each of us, we inspire the same in our peers, and multiply Goodwill’s impact.

Drive to make a difference (Impact)

We believe that our work must lead to a measurable difference in the lives of the people Goodwill serves. We are committed to performance excellence in all that we do. Our strategy focuses our work to achieve that impact, and we say no to things that do not align.

You before me (Respect)

We treat all people with dignity, kindness, appreciation and respect. We are curious without judgment, and we actively listen to ensure mutual understanding. We give everyone a caring and safe place to share their opinions, their talents, and their questions. We build trust through direct, clear and transparent communication. We are open and humble.

Thriving begins at home (Well-being)

We respect the contributions and the needs of our individual team members equally, and we understand that each one of us needs different things at different times to thrive both in and out of the workplace. We strive to make genuine and continuous investments in one another and ourselves. As such, we adopt healthy, holistic approaches to our work. We proactively care for one another and ourselves by speaking up for what we need and supporting one another in achieving it.

Out of many, One Goodwill (Advancing our mission together)

We embrace all people and perspectives as we advance Goodwill’s mission to help people reach their full potential through the power of work. We acknowledge historical inequities still exist and are intentional in breaking barriers. We are committed to being part of the solutions, leaning into courageous conversations, and providing inclusive spaces and equal opportunities for real change in all of our endeavors. Our diversified reflection shall shine as one Goodwill.

Be bold, learn and grow (Agility)

We are open, creative, innovative, agile and willing to take risks. We operate with a sense of urgency, without rushing for the sake of speed. While we do our best to make good decisions, we embrace failure for the learning it affords and adapt quickly to move ahead. We are one unified team that succeeds and stumbles, and learns and grows together with humility and grace.

Together, we create solutions that make a lasting impact on the healthcare ecosystem, enabling more compassionate and cost-effective care for those who need it most.

The Role

Ceresti's engineering team is writing a lot of code. This role makes sure it is safe: threat modeled, risk evaluated, dependency-checked, and tested by someone who knows how an attacker would approach it.

The Security Engineer is the bridge between the CISO's office and Engineering. You will sit with developers, read their code, and write your own: security utility tools, automation, logging and parsing scripts, and the integrations that turn raw signal into smarter controls. Security has a front end, a back end, and a lot of scripts, and most of the work is integrating systems and automating the tooling developers already use.

You will also break things on purpose. We want someone who builds attack simulations (using AI and the tools we already run) and uses Dev, QA, and Test as a sandbox to prove where the real gaps are rather than arguing about them in the abstract.

Your main working partner is Engineering. You will occasionally build something IT runs in Microsoft 365 for example, and IT is often the end user of those tools.

What You Will Do

Secure the code Engineering writes

  • Build and maintain threat models for new and existing systems and features, and keep them current as architecture changes.
  • Read checked-in code and assess its security. This role reviews code; it does not only review reports about code.
  • Own Snyk and Docker Scout: thresholds, findings, and driving remediation with the owning teams.
  • Review the software bill of materials for outdated or vulnerable components and push fixes through to closure.
  • Review SAST and DAST output, prioritize what matters, and work the remediation with engineers directly.

Write security tooling and automation

  • Build security utility tools and automation that Engineering and the wider company use.
  • Write scripts for logging, data parsing, and signal enrichment that make controls smarter rather than noisier.
  • Integrate security systems with developer tooling so the safe path is the convenient one.
  • Build and tune detection logic and automation that the Security Analyst operates day to day.

Prove the gaps are real

  • Build penetration tests and attack simulations using AI and the tools we already run, and use Dev, QA, and Test as a test bed to demonstrate real exposure.
  • Feed results from Pentest-Tools and internal testing back into what you build next.
  • Scope, coordinate, and manage the independent third-party penetration test required for SOC 2 and HITRUST, and track findings to closure.

Shape the architecture

  • Contribute to security architecture and standards, as well as detection logic.
  • Represent security in engineering initiatives including the mobile app, tablet software, the data lake, and AI and machine-learning work.
  • Help secure the production cloud environment (AWS via Aptible) as part of Engineering's platform, as code wherever possible.

What Success Looks Like

In the first year, we would expect to see:

  • Threat models exist for the major systems and stay current as architecture changes.
  • Dependency and container findings from Snyk and Docker Scout are triaged accurately and driven to closure, not just reported.
  • Engineering consults you early on mobile, tablet, data lake, and AI work.
  • Security tooling you wrote is in day-to-day use, and detections reach the Security Analyst with low noise.
  • Attack simulations have surfaced at least one real gap that nobody had argued for on paper.
  • The annual third-party penetration test is scoped, scheduled, and tracked to closure.

What You Bring

Required

  • Five to seven years in software or security engineering. Not a first engineering job.
  • You write code comfortably and would be at home on a development team. Python, Go, or similar.
  • Hands-on application security: threat modeling, dependency and container scanning, and reading code for security flaws.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security in AWS, and of CI/CD pipelines and where security fits in them.
  • Offensive fundamentals: you can think like an attacker and build a test that proves a point.
  • The ability to explain a finding to an engineer in terms they will act on.

Preferred

  • Experience with Snyk, Docker Scout, or comparable SAST, SCA, and container tooling.
  • Detection engineering: writing and tuning rules that hold up in production.
  • An OSCP-type certification, or equivalent demonstrable offensive work.
  • Healthcare, or another environment handling regulated data.
  • Experience in a company where security was being built rather than inherited.

How you work

  • You like to experiment, and you want a test bed rather than permission.
  • You want help thinking through architecture, and you will ask for it. This role has room to grow into that.
  • You would rather demonstrate a gap, then document it so it gets fixed.
  • You treat engineers as colleagues to work alongside, not as an audience to review.

What We Offer

• Full-time remote work

  • Competitive base salary with final offer based on experience, skills, and location
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits
  • Equity participation in a growing healthcare technology company

• PTO and a culture that respects it

  • A collaborative, mission-driven environment where your work directly supports family caregivers and improves outcomes for people living with dementia

Job Summary

Program Analyst, Sr – QUERI

Aptive Resources is seeking a Senior Program Analyst to support the Department of Veterans Affairs Office of Research and Development (ORD) Quality Enhancement Research Initiative (QUERI), under the Field Enterprise Research Support Services contract.

The role supports QUERI's implementation science, quality improvement, and program evaluation portfolio by developing and executing processes for measuring, synthesizing, and reporting on project impacts, and by managing the administrative infrastructure — databases, information collection tools, file repositories, and standard operating procedures — that support oversight of funded projects.

This position supports QUERI's mission in furtherance of the Foundations for Evidence-based Policymaking Act of 2018 by applying implementation science and quality improvement knowledge to the measurement and synthesis of program and project impacts at an organizational level. The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to independently manage administrative processes, apply artificial intelligence tools, including Claude, to problem-solving and process improvement, and support program-level decision-making through analysis and recommendations within a complex, matrixed research organization.

This is a 100% remote position. Full-time (40 hours/week).

Primary Responsibilities

Primary Duties:

  • Develop and execute processes for measuring, synthesizing, and reporting on the impacts of implementation science, quality improvement, and program evaluation projects, in support of the Foundations for Evidence-based Policymaking Act of 2018.
  • Develop and execute administrative processes that support QUERI's oversight of funded projects, including the development and management of databases, information collection tools, and file repositories.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve standard operating procedures (SOPs) governing project and program administrative processes.
  • Apply artificial intelligence tools, including Claude, to problem-solving and process improvement, supporting internal process mapping and streamlining.

  • Prepare program-level reports, summaries, and analyses related to implementation science and quality improvement project activities.
  • Coordinate with program leadership and stakeholders across a complex, matrixed research organization to ensure timely and accurate processing of requests and deliverables.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with internal and external stakeholders to resolve issues, ensure data accuracy, and support program objectives.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, public administration, health administration, public health, research, data science, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience supporting program management or program analysis in a complex organization.
  • Working knowledge of implementation science and quality improvement theories, models, and frameworks (e.g., CFIR, RE-AIM), including metrics and measurement of impacts and outcomes at an organizational level.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience using generative AI tools, specifically Claude, in project management, portfolio analysis, or quality/process improvement work, with specific examples of outcomes or impact.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while managing assigned tasks and deadlines.
  • Must possess discretion and mature judgment, as confidential information is routinely encountered.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a public trust clearance.
  • Legal authorization to work in the U.S.

Desired Qualifications

  • Knowledge and background in healthcare and healthcare systems, research administration, and complex matrixed organizations.
  • Experience developing SOPs, job aids, or process improvement initiatives.

  • Active or reciprocity-eligible federal or VA public trust background investigation.
  • Systems thinking that recognizes how processes are integrated across multiple organizational levels.
  • Demonstrated ability to synthesize data and stakeholder input to inform program improvements or operational decisions.

League One Volleyball (LOVB) is reimagining women's sports. Launched in 2019, our company is a mission-led sports performance, training and media enterprise that will change the game of volleyball in the USA and empower new generations of female athletes.

It is a groundbreaking time for volleyball in the US with our historic triple Olympic Gold medals in Women's Indoor, Beach and Sitting Volleyball. Volleyball is already the #1 most played girls' youth sport. There are 38M current and former players today. Of major sports, it's the only one that is women-first (~90% of players are female). LOVB is capturing this opportunity by creating a strong club business, and from that built-in audience and fandom, is creating the best Pro League in the world and a digital ecosystem that will connect all aspects of LOVB. EEO/AA/Disability/Veteran

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer IV
jobs.excerpt: Overview Thank you for considering IT Concepts dba Kentro, where innovation drives opportunity and collaboration leads to success.
jobs.description:
Overview

Thank you for considering IT Concepts dba Kentro, where innovation drives opportunity and collaboration leads to success. Our dynamic community of experts is fully committed to advancing our customers' missions, fostering professional growth, and making a positive impact on our communities.

By joining our supportive community, you will find that Kentro is dedicated to your personal and professional development. Together, we can drive meaningful change, spark innovation, and achieve extraordinary milestones.

Kentro is hiring an AI/ML Engineer IV to serve as lead AI/ML engineer on the Federal Aviation Administration’s (FAA) Accelerated Transformation of Legacy Applications and Systems (ATLAS) program — one of the largest civilian IT modernization efforts in the federal government. ATLAS covers a mission-support portfolio of more than 200 applications and roughly 3,000 databases, and artificial intelligence is named directly in the modernization objectives: intelligent automation, enterprise data excellence, and AI integrated into how the portfolio is both transformed and operated.

In this role you define the AI engineering strategy and shared AI platform architecture for the program in alignment with enterprise architecture, data governance, cybersecurity, and program priorities. You bring mastery of AI/ML technologies, MLOps, and responsible AI practice, and you apply it to two distinct problems: using AI to accelerate the modernization itself — code understanding, automated transformation, test generation, documentation recovery from undocumented legacy systems — and building the AI capabilities that modernized FAA systems will run on.

You lead AI initiatives across the portfolio, establish shared AI engineering capabilities that other teams build on, drive innovation from pilot through production, and provide technical leadership for AI transformation. In a federal aviation context that means governance is not an afterthought: every model you put into production has to be explainable, monitored, documented, and defensible under federal AI policy.

Location: Remote - This position can be performed remotely within the United States and will support Eastern Time working hours.

Compensation Range: The anticipated base salary range for this position is $165,000–$185,000 annually and reflects Kentro’s good-faith expectations at the time of posting. Final compensation is determined based on the role’s requirements, relevant skills, experience, education, certifications, work location, applicable security clearance requirements, market conditions, internal equity, and contract requirements.

This Job Description reflects the primary duties of the role; however, it is not intended to be all‑inclusive. Team members may be asked to take on additional responsibilities in alignment with customer expectations, business needs, and Kentro’s culture of collaboration and adaptability.

*This position is contingent upon contract award*


Responsibilities

  • Define and lead the AI/ML engineering strategy for the portfolio in alignment with enterprise architecture, data governance, cybersecurity, and program priorities; determine where AI creates measurable value and sequence capabilities accordingly
  • Architect the shared AI engineering platform — approved model and provider access, prompt and agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation, model registry and serving, monitoring, and traditional training infrastructure where justified — as shared capability rather than per-project tooling
  • Establish end-to-end MLOps practice: automated training and evaluation pipelines, CI/CD for models, versioning of data, code and models, reproducibility, and controlled promotion to production
  • Lead AI-assisted modernization initiatives: apply LLMs and code-transformation tooling to legacy code comprehension, documentation recovery, automated refactoring, test generation, and data model inference across a large enterprise including legacy systems
  • Design and deliver production AI capabilities for modernized systems, including retrieval-augmented generation, document and text processing, classification, forecasting, and anomaly detection
  • Implement the technical controls that support the program’s responsible AI practice, in partnership with architecture, cybersecurity, data governance, and program leadership: bias and fairness evaluation, explainability, human-in-the-loop design, model cards and documentation, red-teaming, and pre-deployment risk assessment
  • Engineer AI systems to satisfy applicable federal obligations, including OMB AI policy for federal agency use (currently M-25-21), the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, FISMA and NIST SP 800-53 controls, and applicable FAA and DOT guidance
  • Define model evaluation standards and the monitoring regime for production models: drift detection, performance degradation, data quality gates, and retraining triggers
  • Define AI workload requirements for the data engineering interface — pipelines, feature stores, labeling strategy, provenance, and data quality — in partnership with the enterprise data architecture lead
  • Recommend which class of AI fits each use case — classical ML, generative AI, or agentic systems — and be responsible for assessing the implications that follow from that choice, including the security boundary and data exposure, privacy and data residency, inference and token cost at scale, evaluation difficulty, and long-term sustainment burden
  • Lead technical evaluation and recommendations for build-versus-buy and model selection decisions across commercial, open-weight, and cloud-provider models, accounting for cost, latency, data residency, and federal security constraints
  • Drive innovation: identify emerging AI capability, run structured pilots with defined success criteria, and productize what proves out into standard practice
  • Provide technical leadership, design review, and code review to AI/ML engineers and data scientists across delivery teams; mentor engineers new to production ML
  • Advise program leadership and FAA stakeholders on AI feasibility, risk, and realistic expectations

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline
  • 8–10 years of progressive software engineering and AI/ML experience, including demonstrated technical leadership on production ML systems
  • Proven record delivering machine learning systems into production and operating them over time — not research or proof-of-concept work alone
  • Expert proficiency in Python and the modern ML stack (PyTorch or TensorFlow, scikit-learn, pandas, and related tooling)
  • Deep MLOps/LLMOps experience: training and deployment pipelines, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated evaluation, and production monitoring
  • Hands-on experience with large language models in production, including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, fine-tuning or adaptation, evaluation, and cost and latency management
  • Cloud ML platform expertise (AWS SageMaker/Bedrock, Azure ML/OpenAI Service, or GCP Vertex AI), including containerized and scalable serving architectures
  • Strong data engineering foundation: pipelines, feature engineering at scale, and working with imperfect data from legacy sources
  • Demonstrated judgment in selecting among classical ML, generative AI, and agentic approaches, with the ability to justify the choice on security, privacy, cost, and sustainment grounds
  • Demonstrated application of responsible AI practice — fairness, explainability, documentation, and risk assessment — in a regulated or high-consequence setting
  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: version control, testing, code review, and CI/CD discipline applied to ML code
  • Ability to set standards other teams adopt, and to communicate AI capability and limitation credibly to non-technical executive and government audiences

 Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience supporting FAA, DOT, or comparable federal civilian programs, particularly where AI governance and ATO processes applied
  • Direct experience applying AI to legacy modernization — code comprehension, automated transformation, or documentation recovery at portfolio scale
  • Familiarity with federal AI governance in practice: OMB AI policy compliance, agency AI use case inventories, and high-impact AI determinations
  • Experience with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework applied to a real deployment rather than in the abstract
  • Background in aviation, transportation, or another safety-critical domain
  • Experience standing up an AI/ML engineering platform or AI center of excellence from scratch
  • Relevant certifications: AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Azure AI Engineer, or GCP Professional ML Engineer
  • Experience with agentic systems, tool use, and orchestration frameworks in production
  • Publications, open-source contributions, or conference presentations in applied ML

Clearance Requirement:

  • US Citizen
  • Existing FAA suitability determination or transferable federal background investigation strongly preferred

Benefits

The Company

We believe in generating success collaboratively, enabling long-term mission success, and building trust for the next challenge. With you as our partner, let’s solve challenges, think innovatively, and maximize impact. As a valued member of our team, you have the unique opportunity to work in a diverse range of technology and business career paths, all while supporting our nation and delivering innovative technology solutions. We are a close community of experts that pride ourselves on creating an environment defined by teamwork, dedication, and excellence.

We hold three ISO certifications (27001:2013, 20000-1:2011, 9001:2015), two CMMI ML 3 ratings (DEV and SVC) and CMMC Level 2 Certification.

Industry Recognition

Growth | Inc 5000’s Fastest Growing Private Companies, DC Metro List Fastest Growing; Washington Business Journal: Fastest Growing Companies, Top Performing Small Technology Companies in Greater D.C.

Culture | Northern Virginia Technology Council Tech 100 Honoree; Virginia Best Place to Work; Washington Business Journal: Best Places to Work, Corporate Diversity Index Winner – Mid-Size Companies, Companies Owned by People of Color; Department of Labor’s HireVets for our work helping veterans transition; SECAF Award of Excellence finalist; Victory Military Friendly Brand; Virginia Values Veterans (V3); Cystic Fibrosis Foundation Corporate Breath Award

Benefits

We offer competitive benefits package including paid time off, healthcare benefits, supplemental benefits, 401k including an employer match, discount perks, rewards, and more. We invest in our employees – Every employee is eligible for education reimbursement for certifications, degrees, or professional development. Reimbursement amounts may fluctuate due to IRS limitations. We want you to grow as an expert and a leader and offer flexibility for you to take a course, complete a certification, or other professional growth and networking. We are committed to supporting your curiosity and sustaining a culture that prioritizes commitment to continuous professional development.

We work hard; we play hard. Kentro is committed to incorporating fun into every day. We dedicate funds for activities – virtual and in-person – e.g., we host happy hours, holiday events, fitness & wellness events, and annual celebrations. In alignment with our commitment to our communities, we also host and attend charity galas/events. We believe in appreciating your commitment and building a positive workspace for you to be creative, innovative, and happy.

Commitment Equal Opportunity Employment & VEVRAA

Kentro is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

Kentro is strongly committed to compliance with VEVRAA and other applicable federal, state, and local laws governing equal employment opportunity. We have developed comprehensive policies and procedures to ensure our hiring practices align with these requirements.

As part of our VEVRAA compliance efforts, Kentro has established an equal opportunity plan outlining our commitment to recruiting, hiring, and advancing protected veterans. This plan is regularly reviewed and updated to ensure its effectiveness.

We encourage protected veterans to self-identify during the application process. This information is strictly confidential and will only be used for reporting and compliance purposes as required by law. Providing this information is voluntary and will not impact your employment eligibility.

Our commitment to equal employment opportunity extends beyond legal compliance. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees, including protected veterans, are treated with dignity, respect, and fairness.

To apply to Kentro Positions- Please click on the job link and then click the blue “Apply” button at the top right of Job Description. Please upload your resume and complete all the application steps. You must fully submit the application for Kentro to consider you for a position. jobs.description:
Make a meaningful impact on mental health care, from anywhere in the United States.

At Carbon Health, we are transforming healthcare by combining exceptional care, advanced technology, and a supportive culture to create the best experience for both patients and clinicians.

Our mission is to make high-quality healthcare accessible to everyone. To achieve this, we’ve built a thriving national network of healthcare services and a collaborative culture that fosters innovation, compassion, and excellence. At Carbon Health, clinicians work together to redefine healthcare standards, ensuring that patients receive the best care possible.

A key element of our innovation is CarbyOS, our proprietary electronic health record (EHR) system, built from the ground up with providers in mind. Designed to reduce administrative burden, CarbyOS empowers providers to focus on patient care while saving hours of work on documentation. AI tools like our hands-free note-writer are embedded throughout CarbyOS, making it one of the most advanced and user-friendly systems in healthcare.

At Carbon Health, we're committed to creating a workplace where clinicians feel supported, valued, and empowered to grow.

Mental Health Specialist – Collaborative Care (CoCM)

About the Role

Carbon Health is seeking a dedicated Mental Health Specialist to join our Collaborative Care Model (CoCM) team. This is a fully remote opportunity for a licensed mental health professional who is passionate about improving access to behavioral healthcare through evidence-based interventions, proactive follow-up, and close collaboration with primary care providers and psychiatric consultants.

As a core member of the Collaborative Care team, you will support patients on an assigned caseload by coordinating their mental and physical healthcare, monitoring clinical progress, and helping ensure they receive appropriate, timely, and effective treatment.

You will work closely with patients' medical providers and the Psychiatric Consultant to assess symptoms, facilitate engagement in care, deliver brief behavioral interventions, and identify patients who may need changes to their treatment plan or more specialized services. Using a patient registry and other clinical systems, you will track outcomes, support treatment adherence, and proactively follow up with patients who are not improving as expected.

This role is ideal for a licensed mental health professional with at least one year of experience in a Collaborative Care setting who enjoys working in a structured, team-based environment and using measurement-based care to improve patient outcomes.

Compensation & Schedule

  • Annual salary: $97,000.
  • Employment type: Full-time.
  • Work arrangement: 100% remote.
  • Location flexibility: Candidates may reside anywhere in the United States, provided they hold an active California license and are willing to obtain a Washington State license.
  • Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
  • Hours: 40 hours per week.

Why This Role?

Make a Meaningful Difference

Help patients access consistent, evidence-based mental health support while improving engagement, treatment adherence, and clinical outcomes.

Be Part of an Integrated Care Team

Collaborate with primary care providers, Psychiatric Consultants, and other healthcare professionals to support whole-person care.

Use Evidence-Based Approaches

Apply brief behavioral interventions and measurement-based care strategies to help patients work toward their treatment goals.

Work Remotely

Enjoy the flexibility of a fully remote position while contributing to a collaborative healthcare team serving patients through an integrated care model.

Support Better Outcomes at Scale

Use patient registries and structured follow-up processes to identify patients who need additional support and help ensure no one falls through the cracks.

What You'll Do

Patient Assessment & Care Coordination

  • Support the mental and physical healthcare needs of patients on an assigned caseload in coordination with their medical providers and, when appropriate, other mental health professionals.
  • Screen and assess patients for common mental health and substance use disorders using appropriate clinical tools and established protocols.
  • Facilitate patient engagement, treatment participation, and timely follow-up.
  • Educate patients about common mental health and substance use conditions, available treatment options, and strategies for managing their care.
  • Coordinate care across the primary care team and help patients navigate appropriate behavioral health resources.

Evidence-Based Behavioral Health Interventions

  • Provide brief, evidence-based behavioral interventions tailored to patients' needs and treatment goals.
  • Apply approaches such as behavioral activation, problem-solving treatment, motivational interviewing, and other appropriate brief interventions.
  • Support patients in developing practical strategies to manage symptoms and improve daily functioning.
  • Help patients identify barriers to treatment engagement and work collaboratively to address them.

Treatment Monitoring & Medication Support

  • Systematically track patient symptoms, treatment response, and clinical progress using validated measures and established workflows.
  • Conduct follow-up with patients by telephone or other approved remote methods to monitor symptom changes, treatment adherence, side effects, and potential complications.
  • Support psychotropic medication management by monitoring treatment effectiveness, adherence, and reported side effects, and communicating relevant findings to prescribing medical providers.
  • Identify patients who are not improving as expected and coordinate appropriate follow-up with the care team.

Psychiatric Consultation & Collaborative Treatment Planning

  • Participate in regularly scheduled caseload consultations, typically weekly, with the Psychiatric Consultant.
  • Help prepare and review cases involving patients who are new to the caseload, experiencing limited improvement, or requiring additional clinical attention.
  • Communicate consultation recommendations to the patient's medical provider and support appropriate follow-through.
  • Facilitate treatment plan adjustments in collaboration with the medical provider and Psychiatric Consultant.
  • Help identify patients who may benefit from more intensive treatment or specialized mental health services.

Registry Management & Clinical Documentation

  • Maintain accurate patient tracking and follow-up information in the designated patient registry and other required clinical systems.
  • Document patient contacts, clinical progress, treatment recommendations, and follow-up plans in the EHR and other applicable systems.
  • Use registry data to identify patients who need follow-up, re-engagement, or additional clinical support.
  • Ensure documentation and care recommendations are accessible to the medical provider, Psychiatric Consultant, and other treating professionals as appropriate.
  • Support consistent use of measurement-based care and population-based tracking workflows.

Referrals, Transitions & Relapse Prevention

  • Facilitate referrals to clinically indicated services outside the organization, including specialty mental health care, substance use treatment, social services, housing assistance, and vocational rehabilitation.
  • Coordinate with the care team when a patient's needs exceed the scope of the current treatment plan or available services.
  • Work with patients who have achieved their treatment goals to develop relapse-prevention and self-management plans before discharge from the caseload.
  • Support transitions in care to promote continuity and sustained progress.

About You

You are a compassionate, organized, and proactive mental health professional who values collaboration and evidence-based care. You are comfortable managing an assigned caseload, monitoring patient outcomes, and communicating clinical information clearly to a multidisciplinary team.

You understand the importance of consistent follow-up, measurement-based care, and early identification of patients who may need additional support.

Required Qualifications

  • Active, unrestricted California license in an applicable mental health discipline.
  • Willingness and ability to obtain and maintain the required Washington State license.
  • At least one year of experience working in a Collaborative Care Model (CoCM) setting.
  • Educational preparation and licensure in an applicable mental health profession, such as:
    • Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC) or Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC).
    • Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT).
    • Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) or another appropriately licensed social work professional, where eligible for the role.
  • Experience supporting patients with common mental health conditions.
  • Familiarity with evidence-based behavioral health interventions and clinical outcome monitoring.
  • Strong communication, organization, and care coordination skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with primary care providers, Psychiatric Consultants, and other members of an integrated care team.

We remove complexity, embrace innovation, and give our teams the freedom to focus on what truly matters — whether that’s transforming the future of finance with AI or finding balance to go home on time.

Founded in Sweden in 2001, Medius has grown from a local startup into a global leader in cloud-based spend management solutions. Today, thousands of organizations worldwide trust us to simplify accounts payable and spend management processes. Our journey has been driven by continuous innovation, a passion for technology, and above all — the people who make it happen.

We’re more than a software company. We’re a team of problem-solvers, innovators and collaborators working together to reinvent the category of accounts payable. Our solutions use Artificial Intelligence to eliminate manual work, bring clarity, confidence, and control, and empower finance teams of the future.

At Medius,our values guide how we work and grow together:

  • Connect – We believe in the power of people—individually and collectively—and our success depends on understanding and respecting each other. We appreciate that ‘empowering finance teams of the future’ is an exciting endeavor, and we share it with everyone around us.

  • Question – We enjoy the challenge of our work and the thrill of collaboration. We are not afraid to question ourselves and each other because we believe diverse perspectives can lead to better outcomes and that there is great power in resolution.

  • Own – We are thorough, thoughtful, and decisive. We anticipate what’s next, what a customer might need, and then we deliver. That’s how we get things done. And that’s how we remain a leader. Customers trust us to do our job so that they can focus on what they do best.

At Medius, you’ll join a diverse, global community where curiosity is celebrated, ideas matter, and innovation never stops. If you’re passionate about technology, eager to make an impact, and ready to grow alongside a team that lives its values, Medius is where you can do your best work — your impact is global.

Learn more at

Job overview

Medius builds AI-powered accounts payable and spend management software for finance teams. We help organizations replace manual invoice processing with automation that captures, matches, approves, and pays catching errors and fraud along the way. Our customers are finance and accounting leaders at companies between $50M and $1B in revenue, running ERPs including NetSuite, SAP, Microsoft, and Oracle.

The Business Development Representative role is for someone who has already learned the fundamentals of outbound and is ready to work in a territory with real ownership. This is a quality-first team. We care more about your conversation-to-meeting conversion and the durability of the pipeline you create than about your raw dial count. You will be measured at the meetings that get accepted and progress, not on activity for its own sake.

The role is also a genuine step on a path. BDR IIs at Medius are the pool we promote from into Senior BDR, Account Executive, and Business Development Manager roles, and we will tell you plainly what must be true for you to get there.

Responsibilities and duties

Own and develop a territory

•Own a defined book of named of mid-market or enterprise accounts within an assigned segment, industry, or region, and build a working plan for how you will penetrate it.

•Research target accounts using ZoomInfo, Cognism, 6sense, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and public sources to build a hypothesis of need before you make contact.

•Prioritize accounts by fit and intent rather than working the list top to bottom and be able to explain your prioritization.

•Maintain a live view of your territory who you have engaged, what you learned, when to go again so nothing worth pursuing goes cold by accident.

Generate qualified pipeline

•Run multi-channel outbound across phone, email, LinkedIn, and video to Controllers, AP Directors and Managers, Accounting leaders, and IT decision-makers.

•Personalize outreach around a real business reason an ERP migration, an acquisition, an open AP headcount, a stated working-capital target not around surface-level detail.

•Hold credible discovery conversations with finance leaders: understand how they buy and pay today, where the process breaks, and what it is costing them.

•Handle objections around timing, budget, incumbent tools, and recent ERP change without pitching past the prospect.

•Qualifying against our criteria and converting qualified leads into opportunities, with notes complete enough that the AE can walk into the meeting prepared.

•Respond to inbound MQLs within our service level and qualify them with the same rigour applied to outbound.

Partner with Account Executives

•Work as a genuine partner to your aligned AEs joint account planning, agreed target lists, and a shared definition of what qualified means.

•Run clean handoffs: confirmed time, confirmed attendees, agreed agenda, and context transferred before the call.

•Take feedback on meeting quality directly and act on it and give feedback back where the handoff is not working.

•Follow up on meetings that did not convert and keep those accounts in a deliberate nurture rather than dropping them.

Operate with rigor

•Keep Salesforce accurate and current accounts, contacts, activity, disposition reasons, and next steps. Pipeline decisions get made on this data.

•Build and manage sequences in Outreach and adapt them based on what your own results tell you rather than running them unchanged.

•Track your own conversion metrics through the funnel and come to your one-to-one able to say where the drop-off is and what you are testing.

•Use AI tools in your workflow with judgment as a drafting and research accelerator you edit, not as a send-button.

Qualifications

What you need

•1+ years in a sales development, business development, or comparable outbound role, with a track record of consistently meeting or exceeding a meetings-based target.

•Demonstrated experience with cold outbound you are comfortable on the phone with someone who did not ask to hear from you, and you can point to results from it.

•Strong written communication. You can write a short, specific, credible email to a senior finance leader without relying on a template.

•Working knowledge of a CRM (Salesforce preferred) and a sales engagement platform (Outreach, Salesloft, or similar).

•Genuine curiosity about how businesses operate financially. You do not need an accounting background, but you do need to want to understand what an AP team does.

•Evidence of coachability you can describe critical feedback you have received and what you changed as a result.

•Resilience with a specific recovery pattern. This role involves being told no at volume, and we want to know how you handle a week where nothing lands.

•Deliberate time management. You can protect the work that compounds when the day is trying to pull you elsewhere.

What helps

•Experience selling into finance, accounting, or procurement audiences.

•Background in fintech, ERP, procure-to-pay, source-to-pay, or adjacent B2B SaaS.

•Familiarity with ZoomInfo, Cognism, 6sense, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Vidyard, or comparable prospecting and intent tools.

•Understanding of ERP ecosystems NetSuite, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle — and what ERP migration means for a finance team.

•Experience mentoring or onboarding new team members.

jobs.description:
Who is Boulevard?

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.

You’ll be the first person at Boulevard dedicated to our owned customer community. You’ll figure out where our salon, spa, medspa, and wellness customers already gather online, make the case for where we should build a presence, and then run it day to day. You’ll also own our reputation on review sites and make sure customer feedback reaches the teams who can act on it. Additionally, you’ll identify the thought leaders, customer advocates, and creators within Boulevard’s communities and recommend which are worth formalizing as influencer partnerships.

This is a role for someone who wants to make an impact and act like an owner. You’ll have real room to shape the strategy from the ground up, and you’ll see how your work shows up for the people who run self-care businesses. This role is fully remote within the U.S.

What you’ll do here:

  • Research and map where our customers are active online.
  • Propose an owned community strategy and platform roadmap.
  • Launch and run Boulevard’s owned community platform(s), including moderation and engagement.
  • Monitor and respond to reviews on sites like G2, Capterra, and Trustpilot.
  • Partner with Support, Product, Education, and Paid so feedback gets to the right team and gets closed out.
  • Help define how Boulevard’s influencer program works (which of our influential community members we partner with) in collaboration with Content & Social teams.
  • Track and report on engagement, sentiment, and retention metrics.
  • Travel occasionally for trade shows, brand events, and video shoots as they come up.

What you’ll need to thrive:

  • 5-7 years of experience in strategy- and execution-heavy community roles.
  • Experience building a community strategy from an ambiguous starting point: figuring out where an audience lives and making the case for investing there, not just running a platform someone else already chose.
  • Experience managing a brand’s presence and reputation on review sites like G2, Capterra, and Trustpilot.
  • Experience building moderation and escalation workflows for an online community.
  • A track record of working with teams like demand generation, support, product, or customer success to turn community feedback into action.
  • Strong written communication and sound judgment handling sensitive or difficult conversations in public.
  • Deep customer empathy and a strong sense of urgency, responding quickly and connecting customers with the right people.
  • Strong relationships and credibility within the beauty, wellness, salon, or spa community, including knowing which forums and voices matter to our customers.
  • A plus: experience launching or managing a branded Reddit presence, experience in beauty, wellness, salon, or spa, or experience monitoring and managing feedback from Facebook groups.
  • A degree in marketing, journalism, communications, business, or another relevant field, or equivalent experience (5+ years)

How we'll take care of you:

At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we're happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For candidates in NYC, the SF Bay Area, and Seattle, the anticipated base salary range is $97,300 - $114,500 per year. For all other U.S. locations, the anticipated base salary range is $89,100 - $104,000 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling.

How we take care of our team

Our business is deeply immersed in an industry that’s centered around helping people feel their best, so we know that taking care of yourself isn’t selfish; it’s essential. That’s why our culture pairs high standards with genuine care. We don't glorify burnout or wear ‘always on’ as a badge of honor. Instead, we’ve created benefits designed to support you inside and outside of work, so you can bring your best self to both.

Here’s how we support you:

  • Competitive base pay and performance bonus eligibility because you deserve to be rewarded for your impact.
  • Equity participation for all full-time employees because we believe the people helping build Boulevard should share in our long-term success.
  • Comprehensive medical coverage with up to 100% employee premium coverage and 75% dependent coverage to help take care of you and your loved ones.
  • An annual $1,200 HSA employer contribution for eligible plans to help support healthcare costs and future planning.
  • 100% covered dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, ensuring you stay healthy, protected, and ready for whatever life brings.
  • 12 weeks of fully paid U.S. parental leave supporting all new parents equally as they take the time to bond, adjust, and be present when welcoming a new family member.
  • Flexible paid time off, plus 10 U.S. company holidays, where you are encouraged to rest, recharge, and take the time you need, guilt-free.
  • Fully remote with support, including a $200 home office setup allowance and a $50 monthly WFH reimbursement so your workspace is set up for success.
  • $200 quarterly Boulevard Bucks to prioritize your well-being and stay connected to the industry we serve.
  • And other perks like One Medical membership and Employee Assistant Program.

Job Description

What is the opportunity?

The Senior Manager, Forecast Delivery leads the strategic development and delivery of forecasting capabilities within Workforce Management Optimization (WMO). You will be a key collaborative partner in ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and continuous improvement of all next-generation forecasting deliverables, including Monthly Capacity Reviews (MCRs), transforming operational data into actionable insights that enable accurate capacity planning, optimal staffing decisions, and strong operational performance. You will champion the delivery of high-quality forecasting models and routines while partnering with data and workforce teams to ensure all deliverables meet business requirements and are successfully communicated to stakeholders. Your strategic leadership will drive continuous improvement in forecasting accuracy, data quality, and model performance.

What will you do?

  • Responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of Nextgen forecasting products and services within WMO, ensuring successful collaboration with data partners and workforce teams
  • Partner with data partners to ensure the successful delivery of all weekly and monthly forecasting deliverables, including MCRs, quality assurance reviews, and ad-hoc analytical requests
  • Establish and maintain rigorous standards for forecast accuracy, implementing monitoring and reporting mechanisms to track performance against key metrics and SLAs
  • Take ownership of identifying and implementing forecasting model improvements, leveraging advanced analytics techniques to enhance predictive accuracy and drive better business outcomes
  • Monitor historical and forecasting data for quality issues, working proactively with workforce and data partners to identify root causes, implement corrective actions, and prevent recurrence
  • Establish data governance frameworks that ensure accuracy, consistency, and auditability of all forecasting inputs and outputs
  • Communicate forecast insights and recommendations to leadership, demonstrating data storytelling skills to translate complex analyses into clear, actionable business narratives
  • Lead a team of direct reports, fostering a high-performing environment where team members are empowered to grow professionally
